title: A Small Model Asks Better: Fine-Tuning Query Clarification for Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Query clarification is essential for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) systems that face ambiguous user queries. We consider multi-turn grounded conversational scenarios where a user query is either ill-formed or ambiguous in the context of the prior dialog or, more interestingly, it may be well-formed but when posed against retrieved documents there are multiple relevant interpretations. The task is to recognize both such cases and then generate an appropriate clarification request to the user. We present ClariEdge, a new dataset of approximately 3,900 examples that include such ambiguous queries along with negative examples that do not require clarification. We also show that a lightweight fine-tuned LoRA achieves 96.6% classification accuracy and outperforms prompted baselines of many larger models on both classification and quality of clarification generation. Our study shows that hard negatives are an essential ingredient to separate out queries that are truly ambiguous from queries that may look ambiguous but are not (i.e., can be resolved from the context). The same LoRA achieves high performance in both pre-retrieval and post-retrieval scenarios; thus, it can be used in two places in a RAG pipeline as a check before answer generation. The ClariEdge dataset is available at https://huggingface.co/datasets/ibm-research/ClariEdge.

AI.tldr: 本文提出ClariEdge数据集（约3900例），用于RAG多轮对话中识别需要澄清的查询并生成澄清请求，轻量LoRA模型在分类和澄清生成上超越多个大模型提示基线。
AI.motivation: RAG系统中用户查询常模糊不清，或表面合理但对照检索文档存在多种解读；需识别此类查询并主动请求澄清。
AI.method: 构建包含歧义查询与无需澄清负例的数据集，采用难负例区分真正歧义与上下文可消解查询；微调LoRA分类器并生成澄清请求。
AI.result: LoRA达96.6%分类准确率，在分类与澄清生成质量上优于多个更大模型的提示基线；在检索前与检索后场景均表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 难负例是区分真正歧义的关键；该轻量模型可部署于RAG流水线两处作为生成前检查，数据集已公开。

title: Scaling in Games: Continued Pre-Training For Embodied Agents In Diverse Virtual Worlds
summary: Scaling data, diversity and model capacity has improved embodied learning in physical environments, where diverse experiences remain grounded in shared physical laws. Whether these gains extend to virtual worlds with different visual styles, dynamics, controls, and objectives remains unclear. We investigate this question through a controlled study of continued pre-training (CPT) across three axes: data volume, diversity, and model size. Our 120 training configurations span four model sizes from 0.8B to 27B, six data budgets from 50 to 1,600 hours, and five mixtures ranging from Minecraft-only data to diverse multi-world corpora. We assess performance and generalization using three-level validation losses and gameplay benchmarks from in-corpus worlds to unseen worlds. Our results show: (1) more data improves in-corpus performance, diversity improves transfer to related worlds with limited gains in distant worlds, and model size improves data efficiency but generalizes worse to distant worlds under single-world training; (2) we observe an early interface phase with broad cross-world benefits and a later world phase with gains narrowed to in-corpus and related worlds, and fit an empirical scaling law relating validation loss to data volume, diversity and model size; and (3) our models are competitive with Minecraft specialists and frontier models in 3D worlds, and perform best in real-time settings. However, the limits of imitation and persistent gaps in distant worlds suggest that building generalist embodied agents requires richer training stages beyond continued pre-training.

AI.tldr: 该论文通过120组受控实验研究持续预训练（CPT）在虚拟世界中的扩展规律，发现数据量、多样性和模型规模分别影响语料内性能、相关世界迁移与远端世界泛化，并拟合出经验缩放定律。
AI.motivation: 物理环境中数据、多样性与模型容量的扩展能提升具身学习，但这些收益能否迁移到视觉风格、动态、控制方式和目标各异的虚拟世界尚不清楚，作者希望系统探究这一问题。
AI.method: 开展跨三个维度（数据量、多样性、模型规模）的受控持续预训练研究，共120组训练配置：4种模型规模（0.8B–27B）、6种数据预算（50–1600小时）、5种数据混合（从纯Minecraft到多世界混合语料）；通过三级验证损失和从语料内世界到未见世界的游戏基准评估性能与泛化。
AI.result: (1) 更多数据提升语料内性能，多样性改善向相关世界的迁移但远端世界增益有限，模型规模提升数据效率但单世界训练下对远端世界泛化更差；(2) 存在早期"接口阶段"（跨世界收益广）与后期"世界阶段"（收益收窄至语料内及相关世界），并拟合出关联验证损失与数据量、多样性、模型规模的经验缩放定律；(3) 模型在3D世界中可与Minecraft专家模型及前沿模型竞争，实时场景表现最佳。
AI.conclusion: 模仿学习的局限性与远端世界的持续差距表明，构建通用具身智能体需要超越持续预训练的、更丰富的训练阶段。

title: SpecEvo: Speculative Evolution with Large Language Models for Cost-Efficient Scientific Discovery
summary: LLM-driven evolutionary search is a promising paradigm for scientific discovery, but existing methods remain costly and slow, often applying expensive reasoning uniformly while underusing evidence from failed, redundant, and saturated trials. We introduce Speculative Evolution (SpecEvo), a multi-LLM framework that coordinates lightweight and frontier models through continual consolidation of search evidence. Lightweight models power both parallel Speculators, which generate and refine candidate programs, and an Advisor, which distills accumulated successes, failures, and saturated directions into persistent guidance for subsequent exploration. At sparse checkpoints, a frontier-model Navigator inspects the evolving population and intervenes through synthesis, surgical refinement, or reframing according to search stagnation. This speculate-then-consolidate workflow delegates routine exploration and evidence consolidation to inexpensive models while reserving frontier reasoning for strategic interventions whose benefits extend across many subsequent low-cost evaluations. Across 176 tasks spanning four scientific and algorithmic discovery domains, SpecEvo matches or outperforms frontier-model baselines while reducing API cost by up to 80%, achieves up to 1.5x greater evaluation efficiency than cost-efficient baselines on equation discovery, and improves over the strongest CO-Bench baseline by 3.8%. These results support trajectory-conditioned model coordination as an effective approach to cost-efficient scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: SpecEvo 提出多LLM协同的"推测-整合"进化搜索框架，用轻量模型承担常规探索与证据整合，前沿模型仅在稀疏检查点做策略性干预，在176个任务上以最高节省80%成本匹配或超越前沿模型基线。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM驱动的进化式科学发现方法成本高、速度慢：它们均匀地对所有步骤施加昂贵推理，同时未充分利用失败、冗余和饱和试验中蕴含的证据。
AI.method: SpecEvo 协调轻量模型与前沿模型：轻量模型驱动并行的 Speculators（生成与精炼候选程序）以及一个 Advisor（将累积的成功、失败与饱和方向蒸馏为持久指导）；在稀疏检查点，前沿模型充当 Navigator，依据搜索停滞情况以合成、精细修补或重构三种方式介入。
AI.result: 在覆盖四个科学与算法发现领域的176个任务上，SpecEvo 匹配或超越前沿模型基线，API成本最高降低80%；在方程发现上评测效率比成本高效基线最高提升1.5倍；比最强 CO-Bench 基线提升3.8%。
AI.conclusion: 结果支持"以轨迹为条件的模型协同"（trajectory-conditioned model coordination）是代价高效科学发现的有效途径。

title: Automating ML for Science: Can Frontier Agents Climb Scientific Hills in the Wild?
summary: Frontier coding agents are increasingly framed as end-to-end automated researchers, and ML for science offers a demanding test of that promise: improving a scientific model often requires domain insight beyond routine ML engineering. We introduce Agent4Sci, a long-horizon testbed for measuring how far today's agents can improve the published best models on scientific ML benchmarks, spanning 20 benchmarks across 11 domains. Rather than ranking agents on a leaderboard, Agent4Sci asks what kinds of progress agents can make on these tasks under in-the-wild conditions, and where they fall short. Empirically, today's frontier agents advance the published best on every benchmark, with Claude Opus reaching 10.4% mean relative improvement and no run flagged for academic misconduct. These gains, however, come almost entirely from a bag of ML-engineering tricks rather than research-level insight. Trajectory analysis surfaces three recurring limitations in this setting: novelty miscalibration, resource under-utilization, and rapid collapse into local engineering sweeps. Lightweight plug-in skills for research ideation, experiment management, and scheduled checklists raise Claude Opus from 10.4% to 20.1% and Codex from 4.4% to 8.1%, while yielding more diverse, domain-relevant interventions. Agent4Sci gives the community a way to track and push frontier agents from ML engineering toward domain insight on real-world ML-for-science problems. Code and data are available on GitHub (https://github.com/maszhongming/agent4sci) and Hugging Face (https://huggingface.co/datasets/MingZhong/agent4sci).

AI.tldr: Agent4Sci是一个跨11领域20个科学ML基准的长时程测试平台，用于衡量前沿编码agent能否超越已发表最优模型。实验显示agent均能超越SOTA（Claude Opus平均相对提升10.4%），但提升主要来自ML工程技巧而非科研洞察；加入轻量插件技能后，Opus提升至20.1%，Codex从4.4%升至8.1%。
AI.motivation: 前沿编码agent被视为端到端自动科研者，而ML for science任务需要超越常规工程能力的领域洞察，因此需要一个真实条件下检验agent科研能力的测试平台。
AI.method: 构建Agent4Sci长时程测试平台，覆盖11个领域20个科学ML基准，不采用排行榜排名，而关注在真实条件下agent能取得何种进展及短板；结合轨迹分析，并设计研究构想、实验管理、定期检查清单三类轻量插件技能。
AI.result: 前沿agent在所有基准上均超越已发表最优，Claude Opus平均相对提升10.4%，且无学术不端标记；但增益几乎全部源于ML工程技巧。轨迹分析揭示三大局限：新颖性误判、资源利用不足、快速陷入局部工程搜索。插件技能使Opus达20.1%、Codex由4.4%升至8.1%，干预更具多样性且贴近领域。
AI.conclusion: Agent4Sci为社区提供追踪并推动前沿agent从ML工程走向领域洞察的真实科学ML问题平台，代码与数据已在GitHub和Hugging Face开源。

title: Who Verifies the Builder? Toward Independent Assurance for Agent-Produced Software
summary: Coding agents can now implement a specification, write and run tests, repair failures, and declare the result ready for release. When the same agentic system produces both the software and the evidence of its correctness, a passing test suite is no longer independent evidence: visible tests become an optimization target, code and tests may share one misinterpretation of the specification, and the builder's own tests may simply be incomplete. This paper argues that agent-produced software requires an assurance plane that is structurally independent of the build plane. We characterize four gaps between stakeholder intent and production (requirement, conformance, evaluation, and model gaps) and identify which of them verification can close. We propose a framework that separates building from verifying, introduces a Verification Contract stating what must be demonstrated before release, and organizes verification in a specification-first phase without access to the implementation and an implementation-aware phase based on mutation analysis, property-based testing, and fuzzing, with an assurance report that leaves the release decision to a human. We evaluate the framework in a pre-registered study on three stateful services, two of them written by third-party models, and an EvalPlus pilot. The builder's programs were correct, but its own tests missed subtle interactions: a verifier in a fresh context detected more of the 46 seeded faults than the builder's tests (Holm-corrected p = 0.006) and surfaced the ambiguities of the specification, at the price of rare false oracles. A verifier from another provider did not add detection.

AI.tldr: 论文主张当编码智能体同时产出软件与其正确性证据时，需建立与"构建平面"结构独立的"保障平面"（assurance plane）；提出将构建与验证分离、以验证契约为核心、分规格优先与实现感知两阶段的框架，并在预注册研究中验证其能比构建者自测发现更多种子缺陷。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体可自行实现规格、写测、修错并宣布可发布，导致通过测试不再是独立证据：可见测试成为优化目标、代码与测试可能共享同一规格误解、自测可能不完备。因此需要结构上独立于构建的验证机制。
AI.method: 界定需求、符合性、评估、模型四类意图—产出差距并说明验证能弥合哪些；提出分离构建与验证的框架：引入 Verification Contract 明确发布前必须证明的内容，验证分两阶段——无实现访问的规格优先阶段，以及基于变异分析、性质测试、模糊测试的实现感知阶段，最终由人类依据保障报告做发布决策。在三个有状态服务（两个由第三方模型编写）和 EvalPlus 试点上做预注册实验。
AI.result: 构建者程序本身正确，但其自测遗漏细微交互；全新上下文的验证者在 46 个种子缺陷中检出率高于构建者测试（Holm 校正 p=0.006），并揭示规格歧义，代价是偶发错误预言；来自另一提供商的验证者并未提升检出。
AI.conclusion: 智能体生成的软件需要与构建平面结构性独立的保障平面；验证者上下文独立性是提升缺陷检出的关键因素，但需容忍少量伪预言，且跨提供商并不自动带来增益，发布决策仍应保留给人类。

title: How Far Can the Gemma 4 Speech Encoder Go Without Changing Its Weights? Saudi and Gulf Arabic Speech Recognition with a Frozen and an Adapter-Augmented Encoder
comment: 24 pages, 15 tables, 5 figures. Code and public-set results: https://github.com/AmrKhalil9/frozen-embeddinggemma2-arabic-asr
summary: We study the 305M-parameter audio encoder shared by Gemma 4 and EmbeddingGemma 2 (identical except for its final projection) for Saudi and Gulf Arabic speech recognition, without changing any of its weights. A frozen system trains only a 22.6M-parameter CTC reader over a mix of encoder layers; an adapted system adds 3.1M low-rank adapter parameters, a 41.5M-parameter hybrid CTC/attention reader and joint decoding with a sub-word language model. Against Cohere Transcribe Arabic (2.07B parameters), re-run on identical audio, the frozen system trails in word error rate (WER) but is statistically indistinguishable in character error rate (CER) on five of six human-labelled conditions, while running 3.4 times faster on CPU with greedy decoding. The adapted system is statistically indistinguishable in WER on a public Saudi customer-service call (19.20% against 19.27%) and on clean Emirati speech, is significantly better on telephone-coded Emirati speech, has a significantly lower CER on all six conditions of these sets, and beats a 0.6B recogniser fine-tuned on SADA in WER on all six; it still trails Cohere in WER on long-form Saudi speech. On a blind, human-corrected public call-centre sample it ranks 4 of 15 systems, behind three commercial APIs (significantly only one) and ahead of the other self-hostable systems by point estimate. An optimised joint decoder runs it at 139 times real time on one GPU. We also show that references made by correcting machine drafts favour the drafting system. Code and public-set results are released.

AI.tldr: 研究冻结Gemma音频编码器用于沙特/海湾阿拉伯语语音识别，仅训轻量CTC读取器与LoRA适配系统，在CER/部分场景WER上与2.07B商用模型持平，且CPU速度快3.4倍、GPU达139倍实时。
AI.motivation: 现有高性能阿拉伯语ASR模型（如Cohere Transcribe Arabic，2.07B参数）体积大、推理慢。作者希望在不改动共享音频编码器权重的前提下，探索用轻量读取器/适配器实现沙特与海湾阿拉伯语的实用语音识别，并兼顾效率与精度。
AI.method: 基于Gemma 4与EmbeddingGemma 2共享的305M音频编码器（仅末投影不同），冻结全部编码器权重。冻结系统：仅训练22.6M参数CTC读取器（混合多层特征）。适配系统：加3.1M LoRA适配参数、41.5M混合CTC/注意力读取器，并结合子词语言模型联合解码。与Cohere Transcribe Arabic在同一音频上对比，另与0.6B SADA微调模型及15个系统盲测比较。
AI.result: 冻结系统WER落后，但六个条件中五个CER统计无差异，CPU贪心解码快3.4倍。适配系统在公开沙特客服通话（19.20% vs 19.27%）和干净阿联酋语音上WER无差异，电话编码阿联酋语音显著更优，六个条件CER均显著更低，并在六项WER上均胜过SADA微调0.6B模型；长时沙特语音WER仍落后。盲测人工校订客服样本中15系统排第4（仅次于三家商用API，仅一家显著）。优化联合解码达单GPU 139倍实时。并指出机器草稿修正所得参考偏向起草系统。
AI.conclusion: 冻结编码器加轻量读取/适配即可在字符级和多数场景达到商用大模型水平，且效率高、可自托管；但在长时语音和整体WER上仍有差距。同时揭示“机器草稿修正”构建参考数据会引入评估偏差。

title: Guess and Send: World-Model-Guided Semantic Packet Transmission for Robust Video Perception
summary: Reliable video perception over bandwidth-constrained wireless links requires transmitting information that the receiver cannot already recover from its evolving scene representation. This paper introduces WorldGT, a world-model-guided semantic packet transmission framework that prioritizes information according to its contribution to the receiver's perception. A shared feature-space world model predicts the receiver's scene state through affine motion compensation and learned residual displacement, while sender-side verification identifies reusable predictions. An acknowledgment-synchronized receiver twin estimates task-impact scores through two counterfactual evaluations, guiding packet selection and unequal error protection over LDPC-coded wireless channels. A compact 3-bit feature representation increases spatial coverage under stringent bandwidth constraints, while predictive fallback sustains perception during packet outages. Experiments on KITTI and VisDrone under Rayleigh fading and AWGN demonstrate substantial gains in low-SNR conditions. On KITTI at a 4.13% reference bandwidth budget, WorldGT achieves 47.5% J&F at 0 dB Rayleigh SNR, outperforming H.264 by 11.3 percentage points. Controlled ablations show that world-model prediction contributes up to 8.7 points under Rayleigh fading. Object-detection experiments further demonstrate the transferability of receiver-relative predictive transmission across visual perception tasks. These results establish world-model-guided, receiver-state-aware transmission as an effective approach to robust video perception under severe communication constraints.

AI.tldr: WorldGT：一种以世界模型为引导、面向接收端场景状态的语义包传输框架，仅在带宽受限无线链路上传输接收端无法自行恢复的信息，在低SNR下显著提升视频感知性能。
AI.motivation: 带宽受限无线链路下，可靠视频感知的关键是只传接收端无法从其演进的场景表示中恢复的信息，而传统编码（如H.264）未按接收端感知贡献来分配传输资源。
AI.method: 1) 共享特征空间世界模型，通过仿射运动补偿与学习到的残差位移预测接收端场景状态，发送端验证可复用预测；2) 与ACK同步的接收端孪生模型，通过两次反事实评估估计任务影响分数，指导包选择与LDPC编码信道上的非等差错保护；3) 3-bit紧凑特征表示提升紧张带宽下的空间覆盖，预测式回退在丢包期间维持感知。
AI.result: KITTI与VisDrone在Rayleigh衰落和AWGN下低SNR增益显著：KITTI在4.13%参考带宽预算、0 dB Rayleigh SNR下达到47.5% J&F，比H.264高11.3个百分点；消融显示世界模型预测在Rayleigh衰落下贡献达8.7点；目标检测实验验证了跨任务的迁移性。
AI.conclusion: 以世界模型引导、接收端状态感知的传输是极端通信约束下实现鲁棒视频感知的有效途径，并可推广至其他视觉感知任务。

title: Different Defects, Different Effects: A Controlled Audit of Face Recognition Training Data
summary: The development of face recognition has been strongly supported by the availability of large-scale training datasets. Among them, MS-Celeb-1M has played an important role by providing millions of facial images from nearly 100K identities. However, the size and heterogeneity of such datasets increase the likelihood of annotation errors, redundant samples, and other forms of data inconsistency. This motivated the introduction of refined versions, such as MS1MV2 and MS1MV3, aimed at improving the quality of the training data. Despite these cleaning efforts, we show that several types of training-data defects remain in MS1MV3. By proposing complementary data-auditing strategies, we identify five defect categories: exact and near-duplicate images, split identities, crop errors, multiple-face ambiguity, and invalid content. We then assess the effect of correcting these defects under a controlled face-recognition training protocol based on IResNet-50 and ArcFace. The results show that targeted interventions can preserve, and in some cases improve, recognition performance while requiring fewer optimization steps to reach the performance of the original training set. Duplicate removal provides the clearest overall benefit, while split-identity merging and invalid-content removal also improve training efficiency. Overall, the results indicate that the effect of dataset cleaning depends strongly on the type of defect being addressed and provide further evidence that training-data quality remains an important and comparatively underexplored factor in large-scale face recognition. The training manifests and code used in this work will be released upon acceptance.

AI.tldr: 论文审计MS1MV3人脸识别训练集，发现五类残留数据缺陷，并在IResNet-50+ArcFace受控协议下验证针对性清洗的效果差异。
AI.motivation: 大规模人脸识别依赖海量训练数据，但MS-Celeb-1M及精炼版MS1MV2/MS1MV3仍存在标注错误与冗余等问题，数据质量这一因素相对研究不足。
AI.method: 提出互补的数据审计策略，识别出五类缺陷：精确/近似重复图像、身份分裂、裁剪错误、多人脸歧义、无效内容；再在IResNet-50+ArcFace的受控训练协议下评估各类修正的影响。
AI.result: 针对性修正可保持甚至在部分情况下提升识别性能，同时用更少优化步数达到原训练集的效果；去重收益最明显，身份分裂合并与无效内容去除也提升训练效率。
AI.conclusion: 清洗效果高度依赖缺陷类型，训练数据质量是大规模人脸识别中重要但探索不足的因素；训练清单与代码将在录用后公开。

title: RESEARCHHUB: A Personalized Literature Discovery System for Biomedical Preprints
summary: We present ResearchHub, an interactive system for personalized literature discovery over biomedical preprints. Given a researcher profile or a free-form query, ResearchHub retrieves relevant papers from a domain-specific MedRxiv corpus and helps users move beyond near-duplicate recommendations through controllable novelty, diversity, and curriculum ordering. At the core of the system is prism, a bi-encoder retriever adapted to biomedical preprints using GPT-4o-generated natural language queries and a hybrid Multiple Negatives Ranking plus MarginMSE objective with cross-encoder soft labels. On 44,937 MedRxiv papers from 2023--2025, prism outperforms strong off-the-shelf dense retrievers, improving Recall@10 over SPECTER2-Search by 12.4 percentage points. ResearchHub further supports frontier retrieval based on a user's reading history, DPP-based diversity re-ranking, Local Intrinsic Dimensionality ordering from mainstream to specialized papers, and lightweight attribution cards for result explanation. The full pipeline runs with low latency, making the system suitable

AI.tldr: ResearchHub：面向生物医学预印本的个性化文献发现交互系统，核心为经GPT-4o合成查询与混合排序目标微调的双编码器检索器prism，在44,937篇MedRxiv论文上Recall@10较SPECTER2-Search提升12.4个百分点，并支持新颖性/多样性/课程式排序与结果归因。
AI.motivation: 现有文献推荐多停留在近似重复的结果层面，缺乏可控的新颖性、多样性与阅读难度递进，且通用稠密检索器在生物医学预印本领域区分度不足。
AI.method: 构建MedRxiv领域语料；用GPT-4o生成自然语言查询做领域适配；采用Multiple Negatives Ranking + MarginMSE混合目标，并以交叉编码器提供软标签训练双编码器prism；系统层面提供基于阅读历史的前沿检索、DPP多样性重排、基于局部内在维度的从主流到专精的排序，以及轻量归因卡片。
AI.result: 在2023–2025年44,937篇MedRxiv论文上，prism优于现成稠密检索器，Recall@10相比SPECTER2-Search提升12.4个百分点；整条流水线低延迟运行。
AI.conclusion: 领域适配的合成查询训练有效提升生物医学预印本检索，配合可控排序与可解释性设计，使系统具备实用部署价值。

title: Correlated Quantal Response Equilibrium: A New Equilibrium Notion for Human-AI Strategic Interactions
summary: The modeling of the behavior of agents in strategic environments and the prediction of the resulting outcomes has long been a challenging problem; this has been the focus of game theory. The introduction of AI agents as human-aids or as sole decision-makers expands the underlying question: Can we model behavior and predict outcomes of strategic games that involve a mix of AI agents and human players? As an initial answer, we propose Correlated Quantal Response Equilibrium (CQRE) that combines and generalizes classical solution concepts such as Quantal Response Equilibrium and Correlated Equilibrium. We answer questions of existence and propose a method for computing the CQRE that is a best fit to a given joint action distribution. We demonstrate the empirical effectiveness of CQRE predictions using a diverse collection of complex general-sum games, including high-rank and large-action two-player games, challenging multiplayer games, and a large-scale extension of the Selten--Chmura setting to AI--AI and human--AI play.

AI.tldr: 提出相关量子响应均衡(CQRE)，将QRE与相关均衡相结合并推广，用于建模和预测AI与人类混合参与的策略博弈中的行为与结果。
AI.motivation: AI代理既可作为人类助手也可独立决策，使得传统博弈论的建模与结果预测问题扩展为：能否对AI与人类混合的策略博弈进行行为建模和结果预测。经典解概念（QRE、相关均衡）难以直接应对这种混合场景。
AI.method: 提出CQRE解概念，融合并推广量子响应均衡与相关均衡；分析其存在性；并给出一种计算方法，使CQRE最拟合给定的联合动作分布。
AI.result: 在一系列复杂一般和博弈上验证了CQRE预测的经验有效性，包括高秩、大动作空间的双人博弈，具有挑战性的多人博弈，以及扩展到AI-AI与人类-AI对局的Selten–Chmura大规模设定。
AI.conclusion: CQRE为混合AI-人类策略环境提供了理论上有依据（存在性与可计算）且实验上有效的建模与预测工具，是对经典均衡概念的合理推广。

title: To Keep or Not to Keep: Learning KV Cache Retention in Disaggregated LLM Serving Systems
summary: Disaggregated \textsc{LLM} serving separates prefill and decode across node pools, placing a network fabric between \textsc{KV}-cache computation and consumption. This breaks a key assumption of classical cache policies: a miss no longer incurs only local recomputation, but also network transfer to the decode node. Likewise, admitting a block to the global cache requires an additional transfer, so poor retention decisions waste both memory and bandwidth. We present \textbf{KVLearn}, a learning-based framework for cost-aware \textsc{KV}-cache retention in disaggregated serving. KVLearn includes: (i) a lightweight Prefix Reuse Predictor (\textsc{PRP}) that estimates reuse probability from structural and temporal prefix features without modifying model weights; (ii) a Cost-Aware Retention Score (\textsc{CARS}) that converts reuse probability into keep/admit decisions using recomputation, transfer, and storage costs; and (iii) an Adaptive Threshold Controller (\textsc{ATC}) that adjusts admission thresholds online from observed hit rates and memory pressure. We integrate KVLearn into a globally disaggregated serving topology and evaluate it on text and multimodal workloads, including large image/video-derived \textsc{KV} blocks with heterogeneous reuse patterns. KVLearn reduces end-to-end time-to-first-token by up to 56% versus No-Cache, 38% versus LRU-Pool, and 33% versus Mooncake-style baselines, while cutting inter-node \textsc{KV} transfer volume by up to 53% versus LRU-Pool. On MM-Session, throughput remains within ${\sim}5%$ of oracle. Code is available at https://github.com/FastLM/KVLearn.

AI.tldr: KVLearn 是一个面向分离式 LLM 服务的学习型、代价感知 KV 缓存保留框架，通过复用预测、代价打分与自适应阈值显著降低首token时延和跨节点传输量。
AI.motivation: 分离式服务将 prefill 与 decode 分开部署，KV 计算与消费之间需跨网络传输，打破了传统缓存"未命中仅本地重算"的假设：未命中要付出重算+传输双重代价，而全局缓存准入也需额外传输，错误的保留决策会同时浪费内存与带宽。
AI.method: 提出三组件框架：(i) 轻量前缀复用预测器 PRP，利用结构与时间前缀特征估计复用概率，不改动模型权重；(ii) 代价感知保留分数 CARS，结合重算、传输、存储代价把复用概率转为保留/准入决策；(iii) 自适应阈值控制器 ATC，依据观测命中率与内存压力在线调整准入阈值。整体集成到全局分离式服务拓扑中。
AI.result: 在文本与多模态负载（含大尺寸图像/视频派生 KV 块及异构复用模式）上评估：端到端首token时延相比 No-Cache 最多降低 56%，相比 LRU-Pool 降低 38%，相比 Mooncake 类基线降低 33%；跨节点 KV 传输量相比 LRU-Pool 最多减少 53%；在 MM-Session 上吞吐与 oracle 相差约 5% 以内。
AI.conclusion: 将复用预测与网络/存储代价显式结合、并在线自适应调整准入阈值，可有效提升分离式 LLM 服务的缓存效率；代码已开源。

title: Reconstruction differences rival individual differences in the fly compass connectome and break trained circuit models
comment: 21 pages, 6 figures, supplementary material included. Preregistered: doi:10.5281/zenodo.23382486. Code and data: https://github.com/donti507/chessfly
summary: Neural network models are increasingly constructed from synapse-resolution connectomes, and the same circuit is now available in reconstructions from other animals and pipelines. We do not know whether such models are dependent on the reconstruction they are built from, and whether connectome differences are biological or measurement errors. We studied the Drosophila head-direction circuit in nine versions: four flies (male CNS, hemibrain, Fly Wire, BANC) and five variants of the same fly varying only by thresholds, proofreading or synapse detection. Using wiring-based correspondences validated by anatomical labels, we place all differences on one scale. A change of synapse detection within one fly changed the circuit more than halfway to the smallest inter-fly difference on four distances; proofreading differences were smaller but depended on the metric, and left and right halves of one fly differed no more than a random half. Networks trained on each wiring to hold a cued heading developed near-perfect ring attractors, but their error increased from below 1 degree to 10-28 degrees when all weights changed by 1%. Training on each wiring did not transfer to any other connectome, including other versions of the same fly; refitting thirty cell-type gains, we repaired filtering-level differences but remaining error depended on wiring distance. Training with noise lowered precision and enhanced transfer. Imaging data indicate compasses drift smoothly and do not break; they function despite differences comparable to those of this study.Therefore, connectome-constrained models need to reflect the reconstruction they stem from and the robustness normal circuits exhibit and models lack.

AI.tldr: 研究果蝇头朝向电路在9个连接组版本间（4只蝇、同一蝇的5种变体）的差异，用统一尺度衡量并训练环形吸引子网络，发现所有网络对自身连接组高度依赖、跨版本不能迁移，1%权重扰动即导致误差从<1°升至10-28°。
AI.motivation: 连接组约束的神经网络模型被广泛构建，但不知模型是否依赖具体重建、连接组差异是生物性还是测量误差，也缺少统一的量化尺度。
AI.method: 以果蝇头朝向电路为对象，取4个重建（雄性CNS、hemibrain、FlyWire、BANC）及同一只蝇仅改动阈值/校对/突触检测的5个变体共9个版本；用基于接线并由解剖标签验证的对应关系把所有差异放到统一尺度；在每个接线上训练保持线索朝向的环形吸引子网络，做跨连接组迁移、30个细胞类型增益重拟合、噪声训练和1%权重扰动实验，并与成像数据比较。
AI.result: 同一蝇内突触检测变化即达最小跨蝇差异的一半以上（4项距离度量）；校对差异较小且依赖度量，两侧半球差异不超过随机一半。各网络均形成近乎完美的环形吸引子，但1%权重变化使误差从<1°增至10-28°；训练结果不能迁移到任何其他连接组（包括同一蝇的变体）；重拟合增益可修复滤波层面差异，剩余误差随接线距离变化；加噪训练降低精度但提升迁移。成像显示指南针平滑漂移而不失效。
AI.conclusion: 连接组约束模型必须标明其所依据的重建，并需引入正常电路具备而现有模型缺乏的鲁棒性；单一重建不足以代表真实电路。

title: Forging More Tasks into Better Harnesses: Agentic Harness Evolution via Successive Scale Racing
summary: Agentic harness evolution optimizes an agent's instructions, tools, and control flow by using its task execution experiences as evolving evidence. While more evolution tasks should intuitively improve performance, our preliminary study reveals a paradoxical failure mode: the performance of existing methods degrades as the task pool expands. Our further analysis demonstrates that this degradation stems from suboptimal evidence selection during optimization, as different evidence combinations lead to substantially different evolution outcomes. To address this issue, we propose Successive Scale Racing (SSR), a framework that adaptively searches for optimal evidence combinations in each evolution round. SSR constructs diverse evidence combinations based on the corresponding task quality and coverage, and efficiently races the resulting candidate harnesses under a small compute budget. Empirically, across three distinct benchmarks, SSR achieves state-of-the-art results in all six configurations. Notably, as the task pool grows from 40 to 200, SSR steadily improves the pass rate from 64.3% to 68.3%, while the baselines' performances all drop. Furthermore, its racing mechanism identifies near-optimal candidates while reducing validation executions by 60%.

AI.tldr: 提出 Successive Scale Racing (SSR) 框架，在智能体"harness 演化"中自适应搜索最优证据组合，解决任务池扩大反而导致性能下降的悖论。
AI.motivation: 现有 agentic harness evolution 方法利用任务执行经验作为演化证据，直觉上任务越多越好，但实验发现任务池扩大时性能反而退化（悖论式失败模式）。分析表明根源在于优化过程中的证据选择次优：不同证据组合导致显著不同的演化结果。
AI.method: SSR 在每一轮演化中自适应搜索最优证据组合：依据任务质量与覆盖度构造多样化的证据组合，生成候选 harness，并在小计算预算下高效地对候选进行"竞速"（successive racing）筛选，提前淘汰劣质候选。
AI.result: 在三个不同基准、共六种配置上均取得 SOTA。任务池从 40 扩到 200 时，SSR 通过率由 64.3% 稳步提升至 68.3%，而所有基线均下降；竞速机制在将验证执行次数减少 60% 的同时识别出近最优候选。
AI.conclusion: 证据选择是 harness 演化的关键瓶颈，SSR 通过组合多样性构造与高效竞速实现了可扩展、低验证成本的自适应演化，任务增多时收益可持续。

title: Compilation Is Not Correctness: Scan-by-Scan Evaluation of LLM-Generated PLC Programs
summary: Programmable logic controllers (PLCs) automate industrial processes through repeated scans, each reading inputs, executing control logic, and updating outputs. Engineers write this logic in Structured Text (ST), a high-level textual language defined in IEC 61131-3. Large language models (LLMs) can now generate ST from natural-language requirements, yet compilation success and checks on selected properties or sampled scans can leave behavioral errors undetected. We introduce CycleBench, a benchmark of 301 ST tasks with behavioral requirements, public interfaces, reference programs, and executable scenarios. Its runtime executes each generated program and its reference under aligned inputs, initialization, and logical time, comparing their outputs after every scan. Across eight LLMs and baseline generation methods, execution pass rate trails compilation pass rate by 11.92 percentage points; observed failures include output-update, arithmetic, and timing errors. On fixed traces of programs directly generated by five LLMs, checking outputs only at every fifth scan misses 21.66% of the 157 failures detected by per-scan comparison; across sampling phases, the missed-failure rate ranges from 12.10% to 28.03%. These misses stem from transient output discrepancies, whose detection depends on the sampling phase. Building on this evaluation, we propose CycleGen, which generates multiple candidate ST programs, repairs their compilation errors with bounded compiler feedback, and selects one using runtime self-tests generated in a separate model context. CycleGen improves the execution pass rate over direct generation by 8.68 percentage points. Component ablations distinguish repair and self-test selection; candidate-count analysis shows diminishing returns, with no execution-pass-rate improvement beyond five candidates in our experiments despite 38.8% higher token consumption at eight.

AI.tldr: CycleBench提出以逐扫描（per-scan）运行时行为比对为核心的ST代码生成评测基准，揭示编译通过率掩盖行为错误的问题；CycleGen用多候选生成、有界编译修复与运行时自测选择提升执行通过率。
AI.motivation: LLM可依据自然语言需求生成IEC 61131-3结构化文本（ST），但编译成功、部分属性检查或抽样扫描检查都会漏掉行为错误，现有评测无法可靠衡量PLC程序在每次扫描中的实际行为正确性。
AI.method: 构建CycleBench：301个ST任务，含行为需求、公共接口、参考程序和可执行场景；运行时在输入、初始化与逻辑时间对齐条件下同时执行生成程序与参考程序，逐扫描比较输出。评测8个LLM及基线方法，并做抽样相位敏感性分析。进一步提出CycleGen：生成多候选ST程序，借助有界编译器反馈修复编译错误，并在独立模型上下文中生成运行时自测来选择候选。
AI.result: 执行通过率比编译通过率低11.92个百分点；故障类型包括输出更新、算术与时序错误。在五个LLM直接生成程序的固定轨迹上，每五次扫描才检查一次输出会漏掉逐扫描检测到的157个失败中的21.66%，不同抽样相位下漏检率12.10%–28.03%，源于瞬态输出偏差。CycleGen相较直接生成将执行通过率提升8.68个百分点；消融区分了修复与自测选择的作用；候选数超过5个后执行通过率不再提升，而8个候选时token消耗增加38.8%。
AI.conclusion: 逐扫描执行比对是评估LLM生成PLC程序必要且更严格的指标；瞬态行为错误对抽样相位高度敏感，抽样评测不可靠。CycleGen的修复+自测选择有效但候选数量收益递减，需权衡成本。

title: Translation and data ethics
comment: Joss Moorkens and Monja Jannet. Translation and data ethics. To appear in: S. Castilho, D. Kenny, J. Moorkens & M. I. Rivas Ginel (eds.). Developing AI literacy for translation Berlin: Language Science Press
summary: This chapter introduces data ethics for translation and discusses a number of ethical issues regarding data. These include issues of copyright, ownership and bias, which apply to all types of data, whereas there are further issues particular to minoritised language communities and those on either side of the digital divide, as data is implicated in power imbalances and dynamics. We close with a discussion of responsibility and regulation, and reflect on the growing attention on data ethics from translation studies researchers.

AI.tldr: 本章为翻译研究引入"数据伦理"框架，论述版权、所有权与偏见等通用伦理问题，以及少数语言社群与数字鸿沟相关的特殊问题，并讨论责任、监管和翻译学界对数据伦理日益增长的关注。
AI.motivation: 翻译研究日益依赖大规模数据（语料库、AI训练数据等），但数据使用中的版权、所有权、偏见及权力失衡等伦理问题缺乏系统梳理，尤其对少数语言社群和数字弱势群体的影响未被充分讨论。
AI.method: 本章为概念性/综述性论述，围绕翻译中的数据伦理议题展开分类讨论：通用性伦理问题（版权、所有权、偏见）、特定群体问题（少数语言社群、数字鸿沟两侧人群、数据与权力失衡），以及责任与监管层面的探讨。
AI.result: 本章提出了一套面向翻译的数据伦理问题框架，指出通用数据伦理问题与特定社群伦理问题之别，并强调数据内嵌于权力失衡之中；同时梳理了翻译研究界对数据伦理关注度上升的趋势。
AI.conclusion: 数据伦理应成为翻译研究的核心议题；需在通用伦理规范之外关注少数语言社群与数字弱势群体的特殊性，并通过责任分配与监管机制加以应对，未来研究有望持续深化。

title: Progressive Learning from Content to Relevance to Personalization for CTR Prediction
summary: Multimodal click-through rate (CTR) prediction is central to search systems, where ranking depends on item content, query relevance, and user preference. Existing approaches incorporate content through dense embeddings or coarse discrete IDs, yet effectively integrating fine-grained heterogeneous content with ID-based predictors remains challenging. We propose FineSID, a progressive learning framework that unifies content tokenization, query--item semantic pretraining, and personalized post-training via a shared fine-grained discrete representation. Each stage optimizes an explicit objective while preserving token-level access to content. First, a pretrained multi-scale visual tokenizer and text tokenizers convert heterogeneous content into fine-grained Semantic IDs (SIDs), explicitly aligning them with the ID features. Second, full-parameter semantic pretraining under query--item relevance supervision establishes a robust matching prior, jointly optimizing the interactions of multimodal SIDs and conventional fields within a shared predictor. Third, this initialized predictor is directly fine-tuned with user click supervision to capture implicit personalized preferences. Extensive offline and online evaluations demonstrate substantial gains in both standard CTR prediction and core business metrics. Furthermore, FineSID improves within-product creative discrimination, demonstrating its semantic generalization beyond conventional ID memorization.

AI.tldr: FineSID 是一个渐进式学习框架，通过共享的细粒度离散语义表示（Semantic IDs）统一内容分词、查询-物品语义预训练与个性化后训练，实现多模态细粒度内容与 ID 特征的有效融合以提升 CTR 预测。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态 CTR 方法用稠密嵌入或粗粒度离散 ID 引入内容，难以将细粒度异构内容与基于 ID 的预测器有效结合。
AI.method: 三阶段渐进框架：1）用预训练多尺度视觉分词器和文本分词器将异构内容转为细粒度 Semantic IDs，与 ID 特征显式对齐；2）在查询-物品相关性监督下进行全参数语义预训练，在共享预测器中联合优化多模态 SIDs 与常规字段交互，建立匹配先验；3）用用户点击监督对该预测器直接微调，捕捉隐式个性化偏好。每阶段均有明确优化目标并保持 token 级内容访问。
AI.result: 离线与在线实验显示，在标准 CTR 预测及核心业务指标上均有显著提升；同时增强了同一产品内创意的区分能力，体现出超越传统 ID 记忆的语义泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 以细粒度 Semantic IDs 为共享表示、分阶段渐进优化的思路，可有效统一内容语义与 ID 预测器，兼顾相关性先验与个性化偏好，并具备良好线上效果与语义泛化性。

title: Complexity-Aware Surgical Video Reasoning Segmentation with Digital Twin and Context Memory
summary: Conventional surgical segmentation relies on closed-set categories or explicit text queries, which cannot resolve implicit queries that require reasoning about workflows, instrument functions, and temporal relationships. To address these limitations, we propose SurgReasonSeg, a complexity-aware method that brings reasoning segmentation over digital twin (DT) representations to surgical video. Specifically, SurgReasonSeg constructs DT representations from surgical foundation models and trains two low-rank adapters (LoRA) of one large language model with reinforcement learning (RL), each specialized for a different query complexity. A lightweight router, also trained with RL, selects between the two adapters to balance latency against accuracy. SurgReasonSeg also sets the temporal context with an adaptive sliding window conditioned on query complexity and workflow phase, and retrieves relevant historical cases from a surgical context memory by workflow similarity and procedural relevance. We further introduce EndoVis-ReasonSeg, a surgical reasoning segmentation benchmark with 1,460 training and 961 test samples across semantic, spatial, and temporal categories. On EndoVis-ReasonSeg, SurgReasonSeg improves J&F over the strongest baseline, ReSurgSAM2, by 0.178, 0.237, and 0.297 on semantic, spatial, and temporal queries, and it also achieves the best results on the Ref-EndoVis17 and Ref-EndoVis18 referring segmentation benchmarks. A backbone-matched attribution protocol separates the contribution of the upstream segmenter from that of the reasoning modules. Our method runs at 18.8 FPS averaged over the query distribution, enabling real-time reasoning segmentation in surgical videos.

AI.tldr: 提出SurgReasonSeg，一个复杂度感知的手术视频推理分割方法，基于数字孪生表示、双LoRA+RL与轻量路由，并发布EndoVis-ReasonSeg基准。
AI.motivation: 传统手术分割依赖闭集类别或显式文本查询，无法处理需要推理流程、器械功能和时间关系的隐式查询。
AI.method: 从手术基础模型构建数字孪生（DT）表示；用强化学习训练同一大语言模型的两个低秩适配器（LoRA），分别适配不同查询复杂度；再用RL训练的轻量路由器在两者间选择，以平衡延迟与精度；采用随查询复杂度和工作流阶段自适应调整的滑动窗口设定时间上下文；并通过手术上下文记忆按工作流相似性和流程相关性检索历史案例。
AI.result: 在EndoVis-ReasonSeg（1460训练/961测试样本，含语义、空间、时间三类）上，J&F较最强基线ReSurgSAM2分别提升0.178、0.237、0.297；在Ref-EndoVis17和Ref-EndoVis18上也取得最佳结果；平均18.8 FPS。骨干匹配归因协议分离了上游分割器与推理模块的贡献。
AI.conclusion: 该复杂度感知框架实现了实时手术视频推理分割，且新基准为隐式查询分割提供了评测基础。

title: TAGR: Task-Adaptive Geo-Semantic Retrieval across Heterogeneous Urban Delivery Tasks
summary: As urban residents demand higher-quality instant delivery services, demand forecasting, estimated time of arrival prediction, and next-stop prediction have become critical tasks in urban delivery systems. However, the three tasks rely on historical evidence with substantially different structures and granularities. Meanwhile, their prediction targets differ in output form, making it difficult to integrate retrieved evidence through a single fusion mechanism without causing mismatch or negative transfer. These issues can increase prediction errors and subsequently lead to imbalanced resource allocation, where some regions experience unmet demand. In contrast, others suffer from underutilization, ultimately degrading overall efficiency and service quality. To address these challenges, we propose TAGR, a Task-Adaptive Geo-Semantic Retrieval framework across heterogeneous urban delivery tasks. TAGR constructs an LLM-based geo-semantic shared prior and task-specific retrieval banks to share regional knowledge while preserving heterogeneous task-specific evidence. The LLM-derived regional representations encode geographic context and semantic relations among regions, providing transferable knowledge for all three tasks without requiring online LLM inference. It further introduces a task-adaptive retrieval augmentation module to accommodate heterogeneous output structures, thereby mitigating information mismatch and negative transfer caused by a uniform retrieval-fusion strategy. Experiments on three city datasets demonstrate that TAGR consistently outperforms state-of-the-art baselines across multiple tasks.

AI.tldr: 提出TAGR框架，用LLM构建地理语义共享先验与任务专属检索库，并引入任务自适应检索增强模块，在异构城市配送任务（需求预测、ETA预测、下一站点预测）上实现统一建模并超越SOTA。
AI.motivation: 城市即时配送中需求预测、ETA预测、下一站点预测三类任务依赖结构、粒度差异很大的历史证据，输出形式也不同，难以用单一融合机制整合检索证据，易造成信息错配与负迁移，导致预测误差上升、资源分配失衡（部分区域需求未被满足，另一些区域资源闲置）。
AI.method: TAGR由三部分组成：(1) 基于LLM的地理语义共享先验，将区域表示编码为地理上下文与区域间语义关系的可迁移知识，供三类任务共用且无需在线LLM推理；(2) 任务专属检索库，在共享区域知识的同时保留各任务异构的证据；(3) 任务自适应检索增强模块，针对不同输出结构定制检索融合方式，缓解统一融合带来的信息错配与负迁移。
AI.result: 在三个城市数据集上的实验表明，TAGR在多个任务上一致优于当前最先进基线。
AI.conclusion: 通过"共享地理语义先验 + 任务专属检索 + 自适应融合"的解耦设计，可在异构城市配送任务间有效共享知识、避免负迁移，提升整体预测精度与服务效率。

title: Cycle structure of best-response dynamics in random bimatrix games
summary: We study the best-response dynamics in games with random payoffs. We consider two-player bimatrix games, with $n$ strategies each. We assume that payoffs come from a continuous distribution, and study the best-response dynamics of these games, after imposing some structure on their payoff matrices. In particular, we focus on symmetric games, antisymmetric games, common-interest games, zero-sum games, and games with independent payoffs. When two players take turns in playing the best response to the opponent's action, they eventually end up cycling through the same sequence of actions. The main focus of the paper is the cycle structure of large random games. In particular, we study the number of cycles, the number of cycles of a certain length, the length of the longest cycle, and related quantities. We show that the structure of the game has an important impact on the typical cycle structure. Our arguments are based on a representation of the best-response dynamics of these games as directed bipartite graphs, and on the cycle structure that arises in them.

AI.tldr: 研究随机收益双人双矩阵博弈中轮流最优反应动态的循环结构，发现博弈结构（对称、反对称、共同利益、零和、独立收益）显著影响典型循环结构。
AI.motivation: 最优反应动态在随机博弈中最终会进入循环，但不同收益结构下循环的数量、长度分布等循环结构特征尚缺乏系统刻画，作者希望揭示博弈结构对循环结构的决定性影响。
AI.method: 考虑每方n个策略的双人双矩阵博弈，收益取自连续分布，并施加特定结构（对称、反对称、共同利益、零和、独立收益）。将轮流最优反应动态表示为有向二分图，利用该图的循环结构进行组合与概率分析，研究循环数、特定长度循环数、最长循环长度等量。
AI.result: 证明博弈的结构对典型循环结构有重要影响：不同收益结构类别的循环数量、各长度循环数目及最长循环长度呈现不同的典型行为（文中给出相应刻画）。
AI.conclusion: 有向二分图表示是分析随机博弈最优反应循环结构的有力工具；收益矩阵的结构性假设（对称性、零和性、共同利益等）是决定循环结构的关键因素。

title: Interaction-Gated Time-Frequency Learning for Parameter-Efficient PPG-Based Heart Rate Estimation
summary: Photoplethysmography (PPG) enables low-cost and non-invasive heart rate (HR) monitoring but remains sensitive to waveform distortion, physiological variability, and measurement interference. Temporal waveform characteristics and frequency-domain periodicity provide complementary information for HR estimation; however, effectively exploring and integrating these representations within a compact model remains challenging. This paper proposes TF-IG, a parameter-efficient interaction-gated time-frequency learning framework for PPG-based HR estimation. TF-IG employs a dual-branch architecture in which a temporal branch captures pulse morphology via dilated depthwise-separable convolutions, while a frequency branch extracts cardiac periodicity information from bounded log-spectrogram representations. To combine the two domains, we introduce an interaction-gated fusion module that explicitly models feature agreement and discrepancy, while also learning feature-wise weights to balance temporal and spectral information. A parameter-shared regression head further maps the temporal, spectral, and fused representations into the final HR prediction space. Experiments on the benchmark BIDMC PPG and Respiration Dataset using a subject-exclusive training, validation, and test protocol show that TF-IG achieves a mean absolute error (MAE) of 1.227 BPM, a root mean square error (RMSE) of 2.060 BPM, a Pearson correlation coefficient of 0.9934, and 92.28 percent of estimates within 3 BPM, while remaining parameter-efficient with only 84.6K parameters. Ablation results further demonstrate the complementary contributions of the temporal and frequency branches, interaction-gated fusion, and shared regression head. These results indicate that explicitly modeling cross-domain interactions provides an effective accuracy-complexity trade-off for lightweight PPG-based HR estimation.

AI.tldr: 提出TF-IG，一种参数高效的双分支时频交互门控框架，用于PPG心率估计，在BIDMC数据集上MAE 1.227 BPM，仅84.6K参数。
AI.motivation: PPG心率监测低成本非侵入，但易受波形失真、生理变异和测量干扰影响；时域波形特征与频域周期性信息互补，但在紧凑模型中有效融合二者仍具挑战。
AI.method: 双分支架构：时域分支用空洞深度可分离卷积捕捉脉搏形态；频域分支从有界对数谱图表示中提取心脏周期性。引入交互门控融合模块显式建模特征一致性与差异性，并学习逐特征权重平衡时域与谱域信息；参数共享回归头将时域、谱域及融合表示映射到HR预测空间。
AI.result: 在BIDMC PPG与呼吸数据集上采用受试者互斥的训练/验证/测试协议：MAE 1.227 BPM，RMSE 2.060 BPM，Pearson相关0.9934，92.28%估计误差在3 BPM内；仅84.6K参数。消融实验验证时域分支、频域分支、交互门控融合及共享回归头的互补贡献。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模跨域交互可在轻量PPG心率估计中取得有效的精度-复杂度权衡。

title: Probing Spatial and Spectral Grounding in EEG Foundation Models
comment: This work has been submitted to the IEEE for possible publication. Copyright may be transferred without notice, after which this version may no longer be accessible
summary: EEG foundation models are advancing at an unprecedented pace, yet their evaluation is driven by downstream accuracy, which reveals little about whether their predictions rely on physiologically interpretable signal structure. We introduce a set of perturbation probes in two grounding axes: spatial grounding in channel identity and topographic locality, and spectral grounding in oscillatory content and waveform morphology. We apply these probes to five published EEG foundation models across motor-imagery and seizure recordings. Our experiments reveal differences in both representational sensitivity and downstream reliance. Electrode identity may be encoded without influencing downstream classification: permuting LaBraM's positional codes heavily displaced its embeddings yet reduced motor-imagery accuracy by only 1.2 points, while spectral details may be discriminable without producing specific responses to simulated clinical markers, as only REVE exceeded a spectral baseline on this task. These dissociations are hidden in common benchmarks, demonstrating how grounding probes can complement performance-based evaluation by revealing what EEG foundation models encode and what their predictions depend on.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一套扰动探针，从空间（电极身份、拓扑局部性）和频谱（振荡内容、波形形态）两个维度评估EEG基础模型，揭示模型"编码了什么"与"预测依赖什么"之间的分离。
AI.motivation: 现有EEG基础模型评估仅以下游准确率为驱动，无法判断预测是否依赖生理可解释的信号结构。
AI.method: 设计两类接地扰动探针：空间接地（通道身份、拓扑局部性）与频谱接地（振荡内容、波形形态），并在5个已发表EEG基础模型上应用于运动想象和癫痫发作记录。
AI.result: 模型在表征敏感性与下游依赖上存在差异：置换LaBraM位置编码使嵌入大幅偏移，但运动想象准确率仅下降1.2个点；频谱细节可被区分却不产生对模拟临床标志的特异响应，仅REVE超过频谱基线。
AI.conclusion: 这些分离现象被常规基准掩盖，接地探针可作为基于性能评估的补充，揭示EEG基础模型的编码内容与预测依赖。

title: Decision language models as affordable and rapid alternatives to LLM judges of clinical generative AI
summary: Automated judges of clinical artificial intelligence (AI) outputs are necessary, but large language model (LLM) judges are costly and slow at scale. We compared Jev, a decision language model that returns structured judgments, with frontier and open-weight LLM judges in four use cases. On 118 pediatric answers, Jev's agreement with physicians' ordinal quality ratings (Gwet's AC2 0.50; expected score 0.53) matched or exceeded that of seven of 12 LLM judges, including frontier models, Claude Opus 5.5 (0.49) and GPT-6 (0.38). On physician-graded binary HealthBench criteria, Jev matched or exceeded four of six LLM judges. On MedHELM's open-ended tasks, Jev's agreement with a three-LLM jury approached or exceeded the jurors' internal agreement. On HealthBench Professional, Jev matched the benchmark's reference judge, GPT-5.4, on 91% of criteria (other judges, 91-93%). Frontier judges cost 73-294 times more than Jev and took 7-57 times longer. Jev may enable efficient clinical AI evaluation at scale.

AI.tldr: 研究比较了决策语言模型Jev与前沿/开源LLM裁判在临床AI输出评估中的表现：Jev在多个用例上与医生评分的一致性达到或超过多数LLM裁判，而成本低73–294倍、速度快7–57倍。
AI.motivation: 临床AI输出需要自动化裁判，但大规模使用LLM裁判成本高、速度慢，亟需更高效的替代方案。
AI.method: 在四个用例中对比Jev（返回结构化判断的决策语言模型）与前沿及开源权重LLM裁判：118份儿科回答的质量序数评分（Gwet's AC2）、HealthBench医生标注的二元标准、MedHELM开放式任务（对比三LLM陪审团及其内部一致性）、HealthBench Professional（对比参考裁判GPT-5.4），并比较成本与耗时。
AI.result: 儿科评分AC2 0.50、期望分0.53，达到或超过12个LLM裁判中的7个（含Claude Opus 5.5的0.49、GPT-6的0.38）；HealthBench二元标准上达到或超过6个中的4个；MedHELM上接近或超过陪审团内部一致性；HealthBench Professional上与GPT-5.4在91%标准上一致（其他裁判91–93%）。前沿裁判成本为Jev的73–294倍，耗时7–57倍。
AI.conclusion: Jev有望以显著更低的成本与延迟支持大规模临床AI评估，是LLM裁判的可行高效替代。

title: Benchmarking the Quantum Leap: Auditing LLM Evaluation for Quantum Code Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) can generate quantum programs, but reliable evaluation remains difficult because benchmarks differ in task composition, scoring, and failure handling. We evaluate 15 hosted frontier, open-weight, quantum-specialized, and retrieval-augmented models on five quantum code-generation suites (530 tasks), plus 10 models on our new QuantumBenchEval (QBE) benchmark (96 tasks across six topics). We report bootstrap confidence intervals, multiplicity-adjusted paired comparisons, and audits of output validity and evaluator behavior. QiskitHumanEval-Standard approaches saturation (98.7% pass@1), while its Hard variant retains headroom (63.8%). None of the five top-two comparisons across primary suites remains significant after multiple-comparison correction. Evaluator design substantially changes scores: removing checks for unspecified quantities raises GPT-6 Astra's QBE pass@1 from 0% to 94.1% (T1) and from 1.2% to 92.9% (T6), without changing model outputs. We identify 17 QuanBench-117 tasks with shared failures linked to benchmark-owned imports. Controlled probes also reveal unexecuted unit tests, leakage of canonical functions into candidate execution, and reference imports that block otherwise valid candidates. These defects can produce both false failures and false passes, so historical QuanBench results require revalidation under an isolated evaluator. Overall, leaderboard scores alone do not adequately characterize progress in quantum code generation. We release our harness, per-sample results, and audit artifacts and recommend validating evaluators, isolating candidate code, and reporting uncertainty and output validity.

AI.tldr: 该研究系统评测15个（另10个用于新基准）前沿/开源/量子专用/检索增强模型在5个量子代码生成套件（530任务）与新建QBE基准（96任务）上的表现，报告置信区间与多重比较校正，并审计评测器有效性。发现评测器设计可极大改变分数（如GPT-6 Astra在QBE pass@1从0%升至94.1%），且QuanBench-117存在17个基准自带的导入缺陷、未执行单测、参考答案泄漏等问题，历史结果需在隔离评测器下重验。
AI.motivation: LLM已能生成量子程序，但现有基准在任务构成、评分方式和失败处理上差异大，导致可靠评测困难；现有排行榜分数难以真实反映量子代码生成的进展，且评测器本身可能存在缺陷（假失败与假通过）。
AI.method: 在两个层面评测：15个托管前沿、开放权重、量子专用及检索增强模型跑5个量子代码生成套件（530任务）；10个模型跑新提出的QuantumBenchEval（QBE，96任务、6主题）。采用bootstrap置信区间、多重比较校正的配对比较，并审计输出有效性与评测器行为；用受控探针检验未执行单测、标准函数泄漏、参考导入阻断等问题。
AI.result: QiskitHumanEval-Standard接近饱和（pass@1 98.7%），Hard变体仍有空间（63.8%）；五个主套件的五个top-two比较经多重比较校正后均不显著。评测器设计显著影响分数：移除对未指定量的检查后，GPT-6 Astra的QBE pass@1在T1由0%升至94.1%、T6由1.2%升至92.9%，而模型输出不变。发现QuanBench-117中17个任务存在与基准自带导入相关的共同失败。
AI.conclusion: 仅靠排行榜分数不足以刻画量子代码生成进展。建议验证评测器、隔离候选代码、报告不确定性与输出有效性，并在隔离评测器下重验历史QuanBench结果；作者已发布评测框架、逐样本结果与审计工件。

title: SkillEval: Learning Interpretable Ability Profiles of LLMs via Cognitive Diagnosis Models
summary: Current evaluation of LLMs on benchmarks typically aggregates performance over individual examples into a single scalar score. This approach is overly coarse and ignores the diverse scope of skills covered by benchmark datasets. To address this limitation and better exploit benchmark data, we propose SkillEval, a new evaluation framework that performs cross-model, skill-level analysis. The framework integrates advances from two areas: (1) it leverages the meta-cognitive capabilities of LLMs to automatically discover interpretable skills from questions, and (2) it applies cognitive diagnosis models (CDMs) from psychometrics to estimate per-skill abilities of LLMs. We conduct experiments on 3,811 LLMs evaluated on 9,523 items across five benchmarks spanning diverse domains (MATH, BBH, GPQA, MuSR, IFEval). Compared to the traditional average-based evaluation paradigm, SkillEval produces reliable, more calibrated and informative yet concise model profiles that more accurately predict model behavior on unseen items. We also demonstrate the utility of SkillEval in two downstream tasks: (1) LLM routing, which dynamically assigns each query to a capable but efficient model, reducing inference cost by over 60% while achieving improved performance, and (2) Computerized Adaptive Testing (CAT), where an unseen model can be efficiently evaluated using a trained CDM. Furthermore, we show that these skill profiles provide useful insights, for example, how benchmarks share skills and how instruction-tuned models differ from their base models.

AI.tldr: 提出SkillEval框架，利用LLM的元认知能力自动从题目中发现可解释技能，并结合心理测量学的认知诊断模型(CDM)估计LLM的逐技能能力，相比传统平均分数评估更可靠、校准更好且更具信息量。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM基准评估将各题表现聚合成单一标量分数，过于粗糙，忽略了基准数据集中技能覆盖的多样性，也无法充分利用基准数据。
AI.method: SkillEval跨模型、技能级分析框架：(1)用LLM元认知能力自动从问题中发现可解释技能；(2)应用心理测量学中的认知诊断模型(CDM)估计每个LLM的逐技能能力。实验覆盖3811个LLM、9523道题、五个基准(MATH、BBH、GPQA、MuSR、IFEval)。
AI.result: 相比平均评估范式，SkillEval生成更可靠、校准更佳、信息更丰富且简洁的模型画像，能更准确预测未见题目的模型表现。下游应用：LLM路由在提升性能同时降本60%以上；计算机自适应测试(CAT)可高效评估新模型；技能画像还揭示基准间技能共享、指令微调模型与基座模型差异等洞见。
AI.conclusion: 技能级+心理测量学建模的评估范式优于单一分数的平均评估，且在实际路由与自适应测试任务中具有显著实用价值。

title: Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention and Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion for Video Action Detection
comment: This paper has been accepted for publication in the proceedings of the 33rd International Conference on Multimedia Modeling (MMM 2027)
summary: In video action detection, modeling the temporal dependencies in continuous video streams is crucial. Previous methods based on deep neural networks can perform frame-level video recognition tasks. However, these methods struggle to model dynamic temporal patterns, facing challenges such as redundant frame information, difficulty balancing global and local features, and insufficient fusion of visual and textual features. To address these issues, we propose a video temporal attention module based on the Multi-Scale Latent Temporal Compression Attention, which aggregates continuous temporal sequences into feature representations across diverse temporal scales while efficiently reducing redundancy. We also introduce a Video-Text Cross Attention Fusion module that leverages cross-attention at both latent and standard feature levels, achieving fine-grained fusion between video and textual features to enhance semantic alignment and feature interaction. Experimental results across multiple video recognition benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed methods achieve superior performance compared to existing methods, validating the effectiveness and generalization capability.

AI.tldr: 提出多尺度潜在时间压缩注意力模块与视频-文本交叉注意力融合模块，用于视频动作检测中的时序依赖建模与跨模态对齐。
AI.motivation: 现有深度网络方法难以建模动态时序模式，存在冗余帧信息、全局与局部特征难平衡、视觉与文本特征融合不足三大问题。
AI.method: 1) 基于多尺度潜在时间压缩注意力的视频时序注意力模块，将连续时序序列聚合为多时间尺度的特征表示并降低冗余；2) 视频-文本交叉注意力融合模块，在潜在层与标准特征层双层级使用交叉注意力，实现细粒度跨模态融合。
AI.result: 在多个视频识别基准上优于现有方法，验证了方法的有效性与泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: 多尺度时序压缩与双层交叉注意力融合能有效提升视频动作检测的时序建模与语义对齐性能。

title: JUICE: Unified Multimodal Modeling in Pretrained Representation Spaces
comment: 69 pages, 31 figures, 37 tables. Project page: https://ced3-han.github.io/JUICE-Website/ Code: https://github.com/Ced3-han/JUICE-Code Weights: https://huggingface.co/collections/CedLJH/juice
summary: Most unified multimodal models treat images and text asymmetrically: a pretrained language model generates text, an attached diffusion head generates images, and outputs that contain both are produced in a fixed order, so the first output cannot adapt to the second. We ask whether both modalities can instead be generated by one process that is trained on them jointly from scratch. Pretrained encoder spaces hold both modalities in one continuous form and carry knowledge learned at scale, and recent work finds them effective as generative targets for vision and language. We therefore model the joint distribution directly in these spaces. We introduce JUICE (Joint Unified multimodal modeling In Continuous Encoder spaces), a single flow matching Transformer over frozen image and text representations, in which each modality has its own noise level. Which modalities are clean and which are generated then decides the task: image generation, captioning, visual question answering, or joint generation. Controlled pretraining runs test each design choice. At equal guidance, generating text as continuous states leaves image generation intact (48.41 GenEval, against 47.86 for a model trained only for text-to-image generation), while captions lose some exact wording. Training on joint and conditional denoising together beats either alone, and semantic encoder spaces beat VAE latents and raw pixels as targets. At 2.1B parameters, with no language model initialization and at 224x224, JUICE reaches up to 0.88 on GenEval and 73.1 on VQAv2. By sampling both modalities from the joint distribution (coupled sampling), it can also draw a route on a map while writing out the matching moves. On mazes with several valid solutions, joint success rises from 54.6% with independent sampling to 93.7%, and no modality has to go first. On visual spatial planning, JUICE solves 99.8% of maps at its training sizes.

AI.tldr: JUICE 提出在冻结的图文编码器连续空间中，用单个 flow matching Transformer 联合建模图像与文本，打破"先生成一方再生成另一方"的固定顺序，使两模态可互条件、共同生成。
AI.motivation: 现有统一多模态模型对图文处理不对称：预训练语言模型出文本 + 扩散头出图，且多模态输出按固定顺序产生，先输出的一方无法适应后一方。作者想问：能否让两种模态由同一个从零联合训练的生成过程产生。
AI.method: 在冻结的图像和文本表示（语义编码器空间）中直接建模联合分布。单一 flow matching Transformer，每个模态有独立噪声水平；通过指定哪些模态干净、哪些被生成来决定任务（图像生成、描述、VQA、联合生成）。控制实验逐项检验设计选择，并采用耦合采样从联合分布同时采两模态。
AI.result: 同等引导下，以连续状态生成文本不影响图像生成（GenEval 48.41 vs 纯文生图 47.86），但描述丢失部分精确措辞；联合+条件去噪同训优于单独训练；语义编码器空间优于 VAE 潜变量和原始像素。2.1B 参数、无语言模型初始化、224x224 下，GenEval 达 0.88、VQAv2 达 73.1；耦合采样在迷宫多解任务上联合成功率从 54.6%（独立采样）升至 93.7%，视觉空间规划在训练规模下解出 99.8%。
AI.conclusion: 图文可在同一连续编码器空间中由单一从零训练的生成过程联合建模，无需初始化语言模型、无需固定模态顺序，即可统一覆盖生成、理解与紧耦合的联合生成任务，并在需要双向一致性的任务上显著优于独立采样。

title: Can AI Chat Replace Traditional Search? Evidence from a RAG-based Live Events Experiment
summary: Conversational AI tools are being increasingly integrated into online search and browsing interfaces. To understand how such tools affect user behavior and search outcomes, we run a pre-registered, incentivized online experiment in which participants search a catalog of several thousand events scraped from a major live-events platform. We compare three interfaces: a classic, attribute-based filter interface (Filter), a GenAI chat interface (Chat), and a combined interface offering both (Hybrid). In both AI conditions, AI output is restricted via retrieval-augmented generation (RAG). Our main result is that, relative to the other two conditions, the Chat condition performs the worst. The effect is robust across AI models (gpt-4.1-mini, gpt-5.2 and gpt-5.4) and is driven mainly by users who perform open-ended exploration (as opposed to users searching for a specific artist, venue or sports team). Furthermore, there are no significant differences on any metrics between Filter and Hybrid. We also document two mechanisms. First, Chat creates an echo chamber: without a visible menu, users construct queries based on what they think is contained in the catalog. As a result, they frequently search for event types that are not available in the catalog, and they search too narrowly. Second, Chat leads to prompting fatigue: it shifts effort towards prompting, and away from inspecting and evaluating the output. As a result, users often pick one of the first displayed suggestions rather than examining the list more carefully. Taken together, our results suggest that AI is best used as a complementary tool to existing filter-based search rather than as a replacement.

AI.tldr: 一项预注册在线实验比较筛选器、GenAI聊天、混合三种搜索界面，发现纯Chat界面表现最差，源于"回音室"与"提示词疲劳"两大机制；AI应作为筛选式搜索的补充而非替代。
AI.motivation: 对话式AI正快速融入在线搜索与浏览界面，但其对用户行为和搜索结果的真实影响缺乏严格因果证据，尤其在用户探索未知商品目录的任务中。
AI.method: 预注册、有激励的在线实验：参与者在一个来自主流现场活动平台、含数千条事件的目录中搜索。对比三种界面——基于属性的经典筛选器（Filter）、GenAI聊天界面（Chat）、二者兼有的混合界面（Hybrid）。两种AI条件均通过RAG限制AI输出。并通过更换多个模型（gpt-4.1-mini、gpt-5.2、gpt-5.4）检验稳健性。
AI.result: 相对于另外两种条件，Chat表现最差，效应跨多个AI模型稳健，主要由进行开放式探索（而非搜索特定艺人/场馆/球队）的用户驱动。Filter与Hybrid在所有指标上无显著差异。机制一为"回音室"：缺少可见菜单时，用户凭对目录内容的臆测构造查询，常搜索目录中不存在的事件类型且搜索过窄；机制二为"提示词疲劳"：努力从检视与评估输出转向撰写提示，用户常直接选择首批展示的建议而不细看列表。
AI.conclusion: AI宜作为既有筛选式搜索的互补工具，而非替代品；界面设计应保留可见的目录结构以减少臆测查询并降低提示负担。

title: Pareto Inefficiency of EFX
summary:
We consider the problem of allocating indivisible goods to agents with additive valuations, under two classic notions of fairness and efficiency: envy-freeness up to any good (EFX) and Pareto optimality. While some of the earliest work on EFX showed that Pareto optimal EFX allocations may not exist if agents can have zero value for some goods, it has remained open whether the same is true when all values are positive.
  We present a simple instance in which every good has positive value to every agent, but no Pareto optimal EFX allocation exists. We then generalize to a family of instances showing that Pareto optimal $α$-EFX allocations may not exist for any $α> 2/3$.

AI.tldr: 本文构造了一个所有物品对所有代理人均有正价值的反例，证明即使在正价值情形下Pareto最优的EFX分配也可能不存在，并推广到α>2/3的情形。
AI.motivation: 早期EFX研究已证明当代理人可对某些物品赋零价值时，Pareto最优EFX分配可能不存在，但"所有价值均为正"这一情形下是否存在Pareto最优EFX分配长期未决。
AI.method: 在可加估值、不可分物品的分配模型中，构造一个所有物品对每个代理人均为正价值的简单反例，说明不存在同时满足EFX与Pareto最优的分配；进一步将该构造推广为一族实例。
AI.result: 存在所有价值为正却无Pareto最优EFX分配的实例；并证明对任意α>2/3，Pareto最优的α-EFX分配也可能不存在。
AI.conclusion: 正价值假设不足以保证Pareto最优EFX分配的存在性，且该不存在性可量化为α>2/3的近似松弛下界，回答了此前的公开问题。

title: Reinforcement learning for hardware acceleration and system-level optimization on FPGA and integrated-circuit platforms: A survey
summary: Reinforcement learning (RL) enables adaptive and autonomous decision-making in embedded, edge, and heterogeneous computing systems. Field-programmable gate arrays (FPGAs) and integrated circuits (ICs) offer low latency, energy efficiency, and architectural flexibility for RL deployment, while introducing challenges in resource constraints, implementation complexity, and hardware-algorithm co-design. This review surveys more than 100 studies on RL implementations across FPGA and IC platforms, emphasizing architectures, implementation strategies, performance evaluation, and applications. The literature is organized by RL family, including model-based Markov decision processes, classical value-based methods, deep RL, actor-critic, policy-gradient, and multi-agent approaches. We further classify studies by abstraction level, hardware realization strategy, and application domain, examining how RL algorithms map onto reconfigurable and fixed hardware. Unlike surveys restricted to particular algorithms or platforms, this work provides a unified analysis of FPGA and IC implementations, covering acceleration, reconfigurable architectures, energy-aware control, and system-level optimization. Comparative assessments consider resource utilization, latency, throughput, power consumption, and reported performance gains. Finally, we identify recurring architectural patterns, practical limitations, open challenges, and research directions for efficient RL-driven hardware systems. The survey offers a consolidated reference for researchers developing and evaluating RL solutions on specialized hardware.

AI.tldr: 本文综述了100多项在FPGA与IC平台上实现强化学习的研究，按RL算法族、抽象层次、硬件实现策略和应用领域进行分类，提供FPGA与IC实现的统一分析框架。
AI.motivation: RL在嵌入式、边缘与异构计算中具有自适应自主决策优势，FPGA和IC能提供低延迟、高能效和架构灵活性，但面临资源受限、实现复杂、软硬件协同设计等挑战；已有综述多局限于特定算法或平台，缺乏统一视角。
AI.method: 综述式研究：汇总100余篇文献，按RL家族（基于模型MDP、经典值方法、深度RL、actor-critic、策略梯度、多智能体）组织，并从抽象层次、硬件实现策略、应用领域三维分类，分析算法如何映射到可重构与固定硬件。
AI.result: 从资源利用率、延迟、吞吐、功耗及性能增益等方面进行对比评估，归纳出加速器设计、可重构架构、能耗感知控制与系统级优化方面的共性模式与差异。
AI.conclusion: 总结了反复出现的架构模式、实际局限、开放挑战与研究方向，为在专用硬件上开发和评估RL方案的研究者提供整合性参考。

title: Unit-Aware Differentially Private Quantum Machine Learning for Clinical and Wearable Health Data
summary: Clinical registries and wearable sensors support early health-risk assessment, yet models trained on these records may leak sensitive information when released. Differential privacy (DP) bounds this leakage by injecting noise whose total magnitude grows with the number of trainable parameters, a cost especially severe for small health cohorts. This motivates parameter efficient models including quantum machine learning (QML), whose variational circuits can represent complex decision boundaries with few trainable parameters. It raises a question: at matched input dimensionality and privacy budget, does a quantum model retain more utility than a classical one? We investigate this question on three clinical cohorts and one wearable cohort, treating each clinical record or participant as a privacy unit. We compare capacity-matched quantum, multilayer perceptron, and logistic regression models across five privacy budgets and five seeds. The quantum model leads on three clinical cohorts by up to 0.104 ROC AUC averaged across budgets; however, trails on the wearable cohort, where the small number of participants requires substantial noise. No difference survives Holm correction across 24 tests, so these results indicate a trend rather than a quantum advantage. An analytic gradient bound shows that lower clipping thresholds can improve utility by reducing noise despite clipping bias. Finally, an experiment on IBM quantum computer (ibm_fez, a 156-qubit superconducting processor) using eight fixed test cases yields mean absolute probability errors of 0.046 (private) and 0.063 (non-private) relative to simulation, supporting the feasibility of inference on noisy intermediate-scale quantum (NISQ) hardware. Code is publicly available at https://github.com/TITANS-Lab-Artifacts/DP-QML-Health.

AI.tldr: 论文探究在同等输入维度和隐私预算下，参数高效的量子模型是否比经典模型在差分隐私训练中保留更多效用。在三个临床队列和一个可穿戴设备队列上比较容量匹配的量子模型、MLP与逻辑回归，量子模型在临床队列上ROC AUC最高领先0.104，但可穿戴队列落后，且经Holm校正后24项检验均无显著差异，仅呈现趋势。
AI.motivation: 临床登记与可穿戴传感器可用于早期健康风险评估，但发布基于这些记录的模型会泄露敏感信息。差分隐私通过注入噪声限制泄露，然而噪声总幅度随可训练参数数量增长，在小规模健康队列中代价尤为严重。这促使采用参数高效模型（如变分量子电路），从而引出问题：在输入维度与隐私预算匹配的条件下，量子模型能否比经典模型保留更多效用。
AI.method: 以每条临床记录或每位参与者为隐私单元，在三个临床队列和一个可穿戴队列上，于5个隐私预算和5个随机种子下比较容量匹配的量子模型、多层感知机与逻辑回归；提出解析梯度界以分析裁剪阈值与噪声的影响；并在IBM 156量子比特超导处理器ibm_fez上用八个固定测试用例进行推理实验。
AI.result: 量子模型在三个临床队列上平均ROC AUC最高领先0.104，但在参与者数量少、需注入大量噪声的可穿戴队列上落后；24项检验经Holm校正后均无显著差异。解析梯度界表明较低裁剪阈值可通过减少噪声提升效用，尽管存在裁剪偏差。硬件实验相对仿真的平均绝对概率误差为0.046（隐私）与0.063（非隐私）。
AI.conclusion: 结果仅显示量子模型存在效用趋势，而非量子优势；小样本队列的隐私噪声是主要瓶颈。研究支持在NISQ硬件上进行隐私推理的可行性，并公开了代码。

title: Sketch2Sim: an end-to-end modular framework for hand-drawn circuit analysis
summary: This study proposes a sketch-to-simulation system to solve handwritten circuit diagrams. The system converts raw images into a Simulation Program with Integrated Circuit Emphasis (SPICE)-compatible netlist and automatically calculates the circuit's nodal voltages and currents. Another objective is to propose a holistic framework that benefits students and educators by enhancing the teaching and learning experience of electric circuits and expediting engineering design reviews. This article presents a multistage pipeline that converts raw photographs of handwritten electric circuits into executable SPICE-like netlists, providing a solution. A dataset of 1,000 hand-drawn Resistor-Inductor-Capacitor (RLC) circuits was curated and annotated for components, text regions, and character recognition. The proposed system decomposes a circuit diagram into three stages: (i) dual You Only Look Once (YOLO)-based detectors for components and text regions, (ii) a Convolutional Recurrent Neural Network (CRNN) with Connectionist Temporal Classification (CTC) and Optical Character Recognition (OCR)-based domain-aware symbol value extraction, and (iii) image processing with thresholding, skeletonization, and Density-Based Spatial Clustering of Applications with Noise (DBSCAN) to automatically identify nodes and map them with corresponding components. The proposed system produces the netlist and solves the circuit. The qualitative and quantitative ablation studies on modular stages, as well as end-to-end tests, demonstrate robust performance across various handwriting styles, lighting conditions, and clutter.This study serves as an interactive learning aid and practical tool for professionals, providing a comprehensive user interface (UI), enabling rapid digitization of circuit sketches for study, design, prototyping, or troubleshooting.

AI.tldr: 提出手绘电路图转SPICE网表的系统，将原始照片经组件/文字检测、符号识别、节点识别三步转化为可执行网表并求解电路。
AI.motivation: 手绘电路图难以直接仿真；希望服务学生与教师的教学体验，并加快工程设计评审流程。
AI.method: 多阶段流水线：(i) 双YOLO检测组件与文字区域；(ii) CRNN+CTC与OCR的领域感知符号取值提取；(iii) 阈值化、骨架化与DBSCAN自动识别节点并映射组件；构建1000张RLC手绘电路数据集（标注组件、文字区域、字符）。
AI.result: 生成SPICE兼容网表并计算节点电压与电流；模块级消融与端到端测试显示在不同书写风格、光照、杂乱背景下均表现稳健。
AI.conclusion: 系统可作为交互式学习辅助与实用工具，配完整UI，支持电路草图快速数字化，用于学习、设计、原型与故障排查。

title: VerifierBench: Benchmarking the Generation of Executable Verifiers for LLM Agents
summary: Agents need reliable ways to validate their outputs, both when completing tasks and when filtering synthetic training data. We study verifier generation: from the instruction and environment available for solving a task, an agent writes an executable verifier that must accept every valid solution and reject invalid ones. We introduce VerifierBench, a benchmark of 222 tasks from six agent benchmarks spanning tool-call, state-based, and code verification, with 4,993 hidden test cases that include alternative valid solutions and attacks; Verifier4Verifier (V4V), a six-check audit, screens its source verifiers and test suites. Across 19 models in a common agent harness, normalized balanced accuracy ranges from 10.6 to 62.1, with generated verifiers consistently rejecting invalid solutions more reliably than they accept valid ones. This apparent strength can mask overly restrictive verification: most false rejections in the analyzed records come from verifiers that accept no tested solution to a task. Case studies reveal unsupported assumptions about solution formats, tool use, and code changes that exclude valid solutions. These errors survive self-testing because agents test solutions that share the verifier's mistaken assumptions, or submit verifiers without confirming that any correct solution passes. These findings suggest testing both whether a verifier accepts a correct solution and whether it accepts other solutions permitted by the task. The project page and dataset are publicly available.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"验证器生成"任务与VerifierBench基准（222任务、4,993隐藏测试、含替代解与攻击），并用六项审计V4V筛选源验证器。19个模型归一化平衡准确率仅10.6–62.1，且生成的验证器更擅长拒绝错误解而非接受正确解；多数误拒源自"不接受任何解"的过度严格验证器，源于对格式、工具使用、代码改动的错误假设，且自测难以发现。建议同时测试验证器能否接受一个正确解及任务允许的其他解。
AI.motivation: 智能体在完成任务和筛选合成训练数据时都需要可靠地验证自身输出。现有验证器生成缺乏统一、严格的评测，且容易遗漏对合法替代解的接纳能力。
AI.method: 构建VerifierBench：222个任务，来自六个智能体基准，覆盖工具调用、状态型与代码验证三类，配4,993个隐藏测试用例（含替代正确解与攻击样例）。提出V4V六项审计，用于筛查源验证器及其测试套件。在统一智能体框架下评测19个模型。
AI.result: 归一化平衡准确率为10.6–62.1；验证器拒错能力强于接对能力；分析记录中多数误拒来自"对任务任何测试解都不接受"的验证器；案例显示其含关于解格式、工具使用、代码改动的无根据假设，且因自测解共享同样错误假设而未被发现。
AI.conclusion: 验证器生成仍不可靠，"拒错强"可能是过度严格的假象。评测应同时检验验证器能否接受一个正确解，以及能否接受任务允许的其他解；V4V与VerifierBench提供公开基准与数据集支持后续研究。

title: Scaling Therapy Supervision: Assessing Psychotherapy Fidelity Using Large Language Models
summary: Psychotherapy fidelity assessment measures how faithfully a therapist adheres to a treatment protocol, a critical determinant of positive patient outcomes. However, fidelity assessment is bottlenecked by manual expert review, rendering the process labor-intensive and unscalable. To scale therapy supervision and support clinician self-learning, we present an integrated application of large language models (LLMs) that automates psychotherapy fidelity workflows and generates actionable supervisory feedback from authentic, long-form clinical transcripts. We evaluate three open-weight models across multiple task decomposition configurations and reasoning strategies, demonstrating that evidence-first reasoning improves fidelity estimation. Furthermore, we establish the framework's external construct validity on an independent randomized controlled trial (RCT), where it reliably distinguishes Cognitive Behavioral Therapy (CBT) from non-CBT sessions across core therapeutic skills. Through a user study that evaluates the generated feedback, mental health experts indicate that the pipeline synthesizes actionable clinical feedback. Ultimately, our work offers a practical, scalable solution toward bridging the community mental health supervision gap.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一个基于大语言模型的集成应用，自动完成心理治疗保真度评估并生成可执行的督导反馈，经验证可区分CBT与非CBT会谈，且专家认可其反馈的临床价值。
AI.motivation: 心理治疗保真度评估对患者疗效至关重要，但目前依赖专家人工审阅，耗时且难以规模化，造成社区心理健康督导资源缺口。
AI.method: 在真实长程临床转录上，评估三个开源权重模型，尝试多种任务分解配置与推理策略（发现"证据优先"推理更优），并构建自动化保真度评估与反馈生成流水线。
AI.result: 证据优先推理提升保真度估计；在独立RCT数据上具备外部构念效度，能可靠区分CBT与非CBT会谈的核心治疗技能；用户研究中专家认为生成反馈具备可执行的临床价值。
AI.conclusion: 该工作提供了实用、可扩展的方案，有助于弥补社区心理健康督导缺口，支持督导规模化与临床医生自我学习。

title: OACap: Caption-Guided Active Observation for Detailed Video Captioning
summary: Unlike question answering, where a query specifies a perceptual target, open-ended detailed captioning must determine what evidence to acquire and how to integrate it into a coherent global description. We propose Observation-Adaptive Video Captioner (OACap), a caption-centered agent that turns unsupported or missing information into targeted observation requests, uses spatiotemporal tools to acquire evidence, and iteratively verifies and revises the caption. OACap captions consistently improve performance across general video-understanding benchmarks using a fixed text-only reader. To better diagnose the information they preserve, we introduce Factual-Semantic Captioning Bench (FSCap-Bench). Its Core-Support Factuality Score (CSFS) combines claim precision with importance-aware fact coverage and responds as expected to four controlled perturbation types on 93.0-98.3% of valid caption pairs. Its Cross-Modal Semantic Round-Trip Score (CSRS) measures semantic preservation through a video-caption-video-caption round trip by matching atomic facts from source and recovered captions. Together, they connect downstream textual-memory utility with factual and semantic preservation.

AI.tldr: 提出以字幕为中心的智能体OACap，通过主动获取时空证据迭代生成视频字幕，并构建FSCap-Bench诊断字幕的事实性与语义保真度。
AI.motivation: 开放式详细视频字幕不同于问答：没有明确的感知目标，须自行决定获取哪些证据以及如何整合为连贯的全局描述。近期工作常用字幕作为视频的压缩表示供下游文本模型使用，但其保留的信息是否充分、准确缺少诊断手段。
AI.method: OACap将字幕中缺乏支撑或缺失的信息转化为针对性观察请求，调用时空工具获取证据，并迭代验证与修订字幕；下游使用固定的纯文本阅读器。同时提出FSCap-Bench：CSFS将主张精度与重要性加权的事实覆盖率结合，CSRS通过“视频-字幕-视频-字幕”往返并用原子事实匹配衡量语义保持。
AI.result: OACap生成的字幕在通用视频理解基准上稳定提升性能（阅读器固定为纯文本模型）；CSFS在93.0%–98.3%的有效字幕对上对四类受控扰动呈现预期响应，并与下游文本记忆效用相关联。
AI.conclusion: 主动、可验证的字幕生成能有效支撑下游文本推理；FSCap-Bench把下游文本记忆的效用与事实性、语义保真度联系起来，为字幕质量提供可解释的诊断。

title: SAIL: A Learnable Generalisation of Spatial Autocorrelation over Graph-Structured Data
comment: 44 pages, 22 figures (7 in main paper, 15 in supplementary material). Main paper followed by supplementary material in a single file
summary: In vision and scientific domains involving spatial data, a key question is whether node feature values vary independently across space or form coherent spatial structures. Classical spatial autocorrelation statistics such as Moran's $I$ and Geary's $C$ quantify this phenomenon but operate on a single scalar variable with fixed neighbourhood weights, limiting their use for high-dimensional graph-like data. We introduce SAIL (Spatial Autocorrelation Index Learner), a differentiable framework that generalises spatial autocorrelation into a learnable operator by jointly learning feature projections defining candidate scalar fields and inter-node neighbourhood affinities. SAIL produces interpretable local and global spatial coherence descriptors, enabling supervised prediction and unsupervised discovery of spatial autocorrelation modes and hotspots. We show that SAIL exactly recovers classical spatial statistics under appropriate parametrisations and, for tasks driven by latent spatial autocorrelation, can approximate the Bayes-optimal predictor with an inductive bias matched to such tasks. Experiments on synthetic data and large-scale biomedical graphs demonstrate statistical correctness and discovery of spatial coherence with applications across vision, geospatial analysis, and biomedicine. The code repository is available at: https://github.com/pkeller00/SAIL.

AI.tldr: SAIL 将空间自相关推广为可学习的可微算子，联合学习特征投影与节点邻接亲和力，输出可解释的局部/全局空间一致性描述，并能精确恢复 Moran's I、Geary's C 等经典统计量。
AI.motivation: 经典空间自相关统计量（Moran's I、Geary's C）只能处理单一标量变量且邻接权重固定，难以适用于高维、图结构数据的空间结构分析。
AI.method: 提出可微框架 SAIL，联合学习定义候选标量场的特征投影与节点间邻域亲和力，从而将空间自相关泛化为可学习算子；输出局部与全局空间一致性描述子，支持监督预测与无监督发现自相关模式与热点；在适当参数化下可精确还原经典统计量，并对潜在空间自相关驱动的任务具有匹配的归纳偏置。
AI.result: 在合成数据与大规模生物医学图上验证了统计正确性，并在视觉、地理空间分析与生物医学任务中成功发现空间一致性结构。
AI.conclusion: SAIL 提供了统一、可解释且可学习的空间自相关建模方式，兼具理论一致性、Bayes 最优预测近似能力与跨领域实用性。

title: Transaction Foundation Models for Retrieval-Augmented Generation over Financial Transaction Data: A Comparative Evaluation with Text Embeddings
comment: 7 pages, 2 figures. Code available on Kaggle (see links in paper)
summary: Domain-specific tabular and transaction foundation models are increasingly proposed as drop-in representation learners for financial applications, but their value relative to off-the-shelf text embedding models for retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) over structured data remains underexamined. We construct a deterministic, template-generated question-answering benchmark of 1,026 questions with retrieval-level gold-document annotations over IBM's synthetic Anti-Money-Laundering (AML) transaction dataset, and compare NVIDIA's 29M-parameter Transaction Foundation Model (TFM) against five general-purpose and financial-domain text embedding models under a size- and data-matched retrieval setup, as well as against a hand-aggregated summary-text baseline. TFM substantially outperforms every size-matched generic embedder on both retrieval (Recall@5: 0.81 vs. 0.25-0.39) and end-to-end answer accuracy (66.7% vs. 27.5%). However, a simple pipeline that embeds a human-engineered aggregated summary with a generic sentence encoder matches or exceeds TFM overall, and dominates it on several low-cardinality entity categories (bank, currency, payment format). This suggests that the benefit of a transaction-native foundation model over generic text embeddings is category-dependent rather than uniform, and that careful feature aggregation can substitute for domain-specific pretraining in several practically relevant regimes. We release the benchmark generation and evaluation code.

AI.tldr: 论文构建基于IBM合成AML交易数据的1,026题RAG问答基准，比较29M参数交易基础模型（TFM）与通用/金融文本嵌入模型。TFM远超同规模通用嵌入器（Recall@5 0.81 vs 0.25-0.39；准确率66.7% vs 27.5%），但人工聚合摘要+通用句编码器可持平或超过TFM，表明领域预训练收益依赖类别而非普遍优势。
AI.motivation: 领域专用表格/交易基础模型被广泛作为金融应用的"即插即用"表示学习器，但其相对现成文本嵌入模型在结构化数据RAG中的价值缺乏系统检验。
AI.method: 构建确定性的模板生成QA基准（1,026题，含检索级金标文档标注），基于IBM合成反洗钱（AML）交易数据集；在规模与数据匹配的检索设置下，将NVIDIA 29M参数TFM与五个通用及金融领域文本嵌入模型对比，并加入手工聚合摘要文本基线。
AI.result: TFM在同规模通用嵌入器上大幅领先：Recall@5为0.81（对比0.25-0.39），端到端答案准确率66.7%（对比27.5%）。但用通用句编码器嵌入人工聚合摘要的简单管道整体可持平或超过TFM，并在银行、币种、支付格式等低基数实体类别上明显占优。
AI.conclusion: 交易原生基础模型相对通用文本嵌入的优势是类别依赖的而非统一的；在若干实际场景中，精心设计的特征聚合可替代领域专用预训练。作者开源了基准生成与评测代码。

title: When Are We Near Nash? Certifying Solutions in General-Sum Games
summary: Heuristic solvers for general-sum extensive-form games produce a stream of iterates, and practice reports the NashGap of the returned profile. We ask what a solver can know about its own iterates from the regret accumulators and the terminal-distribution accumulators its updates already maintain. In two-player games the NashGap of a weighted average strategy equals, at the maximizing player, the weighted external regret plus a signed value correction. Bounding the regret by the running counterfactual-regret accumulator gives an online certificate whose cost per checkpoint is linear in the number of terminal histories. The certificate stays sound under alternating updates and in games with three or more players. The mismatch between what alternation evaluates and what the averages record enters as one signed comparator term, maximized in a single backward pass per player whose comparator weight is nonzero. The bound is read off the regret state, with no best response against the average. Run a portfolio of training-free regret-matching solvers, output the iterate with the smallest certificate, and verify that iterate once. On the benchmark's biased Leduc family a pool of sixteen training-free solvers, seven original and nine recent variants, solves $89\%$ of the $64$ instances at threshold $10^{-5}$ this way, matching the trajectory-minimum union of the solvers. The same protocol solves $92\%$ of the $64$ pre-registered held-out instances and $89\%$ again on a third set of $64$ instances that no earlier stage used. The zero-best-response certificate certifies all $57$ in-sample solves and all $57$ fresh ones, and $58$ of the $59$ held-out ones. Its exact-comparator refinement certifies every solve in the three sets. The certificate states both and attributes its bound. Code is available at https://github.com/lbn187/CertNE.

AI.tldr: 提出一种无需最优反应的在线certificate，利用regret累加器直接给出NashGap上界，并用于免训练求解器组合选择最优迭代。
AI.motivation: 启发式求解器实践中报告NashGap，但NashGap通常需对平均策略计算最优反应，代价高且不透明。作者希望仅凭求解器更新中已维护的regret与终端分布累加器，让求解器"自知"其迭代的质量。
