Kacper reports how different technologies can be adopted to build a versatile authoring toolkit that underpins the interactive online edition of the book. Collating these distinct yet coherent perspectives allows us to reflect on future opportunities for interactive Prolog teaching materials arising from the continuous development of web technologies. The insights we offer should be of interest to teachers of Prolog as well as those wanting to find out about the latest educational technologies.

AI.tldr: 本文以 Prolog 教材《Simply Logical》从1994年纸质书+软盘到今日全交互式在线版的演变为线索，由三位作者分别从教学理念、Web 交互实现与创作工具链三个互补视角，探讨技术对教育材料的潜在影响。
AI.motivation: 探究技术（尤其是 Web 技术）对教育材料的潜在影响，并从作者与读者双重角度理解交互式教材的价值；同时为 Prolog 教师及关注最新教育技术的人提供经验与启示。
AI.method: 案例式、多视角反思性叙述：追踪该书从纸质+软盘（1994）、若干中间在线版本到完全交互式在线版的演化历程；Peter 阐述原书哲学与教学经验，Jan 说明当代 Web 编程如何实现书中理念的完全交互化，Kacper 介绍支撑在线版的通用创作工具包所采用的各种技术；最后汇总三种视角进行前瞻讨论。
AI.result: 形成了一部提供沉浸式学习体验的交互式在线教材，并凝练出三种虽不同但内在一致的观点；这些观点用于反思 Web 技术持续发展所带来的交互式 Prolog 教学材料的新机遇。
AI.conclusion: 技术的持续演进可显著增强教材的交互性与沉浸感，教学理念、Web 交互实现与创作工具链三者结合是构建现代交互式教材的关键；相关洞见对 Prolog 教学与教育技术实践者具有参考价值，并指出了未来发展方向。

title: VeriEvolve: Evaluator-First Evolution for Tool-Using Agents
comment: 24 pages, 3 figures. Accepted to the REALM Workshop at EMNLP 2026 (non-archival)
summary:
A central obstacle to self-improving agents is the absence of a reliable fitness signal for realistic stateful tasks. We introduce \textsc{VeriEvolve}, an evaluator-first evolution framework that constructs this missing evaluation layer before optimizing the agent. From task instruction, VeriEvolve synthesizes instruction-grounded challenge states and an executable evaluator that checks them. During each round of workflow evolution, the evaluator is frozen and serves as the fitness signal. Between rounds, VeriEvolve revises the evaluator by converting the end states of strong and weak runs into a pair of counterfactual test cases.
  Across all 30 MCPMark Filesystem tasks, VeriEvolve constructs 30 evaluators with 141 challenge states, achieving 141/141 agreement on the generated suites and 113/122 agreement on held-out states produced by executor agents. Evaluator-guided evolution increases externally verified success from 6/30 to 18/30 for GLM-5.2 and from 27/30 to 30/30 for Claude; refinement removes all three false positives that the weak executor exposes. Cross-environment studies on PostgreSQL, Playwright, Notion, and GitHub further expose complementary limits from observability, state representation, and search/execution capacity. These results show that executable evaluators can be synthesized and used to guide search when task success is observable and an external verifier is available for calibration.

AI.tldr: VeriEvolve 提出"评估器优先"的进化框架，先构建可执行评估器作为适应度信号，再据此优化智能体工作流。
AI.motivation: 面向真实有状态任务的自进化智能体缺少可靠的适应度信号，难以判断改进是否真的提升了任务成功率。
AI.method: 从任务指令合成"指令接地"的挑战状态和可执行评估器；每轮工作流进化时冻结评估器作为适应度信号，轮次之间用强/弱运行终态构造反事实测试对来修正评估器。
AI.result: 30 个 MCPMark Filesystem 任务上构建 30 个评估器、141 个挑战状态，生成集一致率 141/141，执行器代理留出状态一致率 113/122；外部验证成功率 GLM-5.2 由 6/30 升至 18/30，Claude 由 27/30 升至 30/30，修正后消除弱执行器暴露的 3 个假阳性。PostgreSQL、Playwright、Notion、GitHub 跨环境研究揭示可观测性、状态表示与搜索/执行能力的互补局限。
AI.conclusion: 当任务成功可观测且有外部验证器可校准时，可执行评估器可被合成并用于指导搜索；其有效性受可观测性与状态表示等条件制约。

title: KIRA: A Full-Stack Reading Screening System with Dual-Pathway Analysis for Children
comment: Accepted to IEEE Spoken Language Technology 2026
summary: Early-grade reading screening is critical for identifying children at risk of reading difficulty. Existing AI-based screeners are often limited in the scope of their analyses and evaluation metrics, or are proprietary systems that lack transparent model specifications and evaluation. We present KIRA, a dual-pathway screening system that pairs word-level fluency scoring with detailed phoneme-level error detection. We adapt pretrained word and phoneme recognizers to children's speech, reducing word error rate from 13.88% to 8.84% and phoneme error rate from 41.66% to 23.00%. Powered by these child-adapted models, we implement Word Reading (WRE) and Oral Reading Fluency (ORF), two foundational tasks in K-2 screening. The system integrates these recognizers with a web-based teacher-facing interface presenting fluency scores alongside phoneme feedback for potential targeted intervention. KIRA brings modern child-speech recognition into a full-stack, deployable, classroom-ready reading screener.

AI.tldr: KIRA：双通路早年级阅读筛查系统，结合词级流利度评分与音素级错误检测，并适配儿童语音识别，构建可部署的课堂筛查工具。
AI.motivation: 早期阅读筛查对识别阅读困难风险儿童至关重要，但现有AI筛查器分析范围和评测指标有限，或为专有系统，缺乏透明的模型规格与评估。
AI.method: 将预训练的词语识别器与音素识别器适配到儿童语音，并基于此实现词朗读（WRE）和口语阅读流利度（ORF）两项K-2基础任务；集成识别器与面向教师的网页界面，同时呈现流利度分数与音素反馈。
AI.conclusion: KIRA将现代儿童语音识别整合为全栈、可部署、面向课堂的阅读筛查器，为针对性干预提供支持。

title: Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation for Few-shot Image Classification
comment: This work is accepted by The IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV) 2027
summary: Few-shot image classification (FSIC) frequently suffers from visual ambiguity, where background clutter and RGB appearance similarities hinder discriminative feature matching in data-scarce settings. To mitigate this, we propose DAFIC, a geometry-guided framework that incorporates monocular depth into representation learning, episodic adaptation, and dense support-query matching. DAFIC first learns geometry-aware token representations through RGB-D self-supervised pre-training. Subsequently, the Depth-guided Geometric Adaptation (DGA) module uses depth-derived geometry to refine patch representations with geometry-enriched class context while suppressing background interference. Spatial Bidirectional Patch Matching (SBiM) then performs bidirectional dense matching on the refined features, reducing sensitivity to spurious correspondences and background clutter. Extensive experiments on four benchmarks show that DAFIC achieves strong performance against existing methods, with ablation and robustness analyses supporting the effectiveness of coupling geometry-conditioned episodic adaptation with bidirectional matching for few-shot visual recognition.

AI.tldr: DAFIC将单目深度引入小样本图像分类，在预训练、情景适应和稠密匹配三阶段利用几何信息，缓解视觉歧义，在四个基准上取得强性能。
AI.motivation: 小样本图像分类（FSIC）常受视觉歧义困扰：背景杂乱与RGB外观相似性在数据稀缺时削弱判别性特征匹配。
AI.method: 提出DAFIC几何引导框架：1）通过RGB-D自监督预训练学习几何感知的token表示；2）深度引导几何适应模块（DGA）用深度几何精化patch表示，注入几何增强的类上下文并抑制背景干扰；3）空间双向patch匹配（SBiM）在精化特征上做双向稠密匹配，降低伪对应与背景杂波的敏感性。
AI.result: 在四个基准上的大量实验表明，DAFIC相较现有方法性能强劲；消融与鲁棒性分析验证了几何条件情景适应与双向匹配结合的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 将几何条件的情景适应与双向稠密匹配相耦合，是提升小样本视觉识别中判别性与鲁棒性的有效途径。

title: Learning Marginal Viewpoint Utility for Budgeted Evidence Selection in RAG
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation over multi-viewpoint queries must preserve distinct answers and positions from the retrieved evidence while operating under a fixed context budget. We introduce LMVU, a lightweight ranker that learns to prioritize candidates by the marginal viewpoint coverage they add to the current selection. Training uses viewpoint annotations from each benchmark's development split to compare candidates within the same selection state. At inference, LMVU repeatedly scores budget-feasible candidates as the context grows, without accessing these annotations. We evaluate two forms of recovered viewpoint coverage: RVC$_1$ assigns each viewpoint full credit for at least one supporting source unit, while RVC$_2$ assigns half credit for one and full credit for two or more distinct source units. Exact oracles measure achievable coverage under the same evidence pool and budget. Across four viewpoint-annotated benchmarks at a 1,024-token budget, LMVU achieves gains of up to 0.047 and 0.052 points in RVC$_1$ and RVC$_2$, respectively, over the strongest non-oracle baseline for each benchmark and metric, and reaches the exact viewpoint-breadth ceiling on two benchmarks.

AI.tldr: 提出轻量级重排器LMVU，以"边际视角覆盖"为准则在固定上下文预算下为多视角查询选择证据，在四个基准上超过最强基线并部分达到理论上限。
AI.motivation: 多视角查询的检索增强生成需要在有限上下文预算内同时保留不同答案及其立场/位置信息，而现有方法难以在预算约束下保证视角广度。
AI.method: LMVU学习按候选对当前已选集合新增的边际视角覆盖度排序；训练时利用各基准开发集划分中的视角标注，在同一选择状态下比较候选；推理时随上下文增长反复对预算可行的候选打分，不依赖标注。评测用两种恢复视角覆盖指标：RVC1（每个视角至少一个支撑源单元即得满分）与RVC2（一个得半、两个及以上不同源单元得满分），并设精确oracle衡量同证据池同预算下的可达覆盖。
AI.result: 在1024 token预算下，四个带视角标注的基准上，LMVU相对各基准各指标最强非oracle基线在RVC1与RVC2上分别提升至多0.047与0.052分，并在两个基准上达到精确视角广度上限。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模视角边际覆盖是一种有效的预算内重排策略，轻量且无需推理期标注即可逼近理论上限。

title: Motion Equivariant Convolutional LSTM: When Motion Becomes a Gauge Symmetry
summary: Objects move, cameras pan, and weather drifts with the wind: much of what changes in sequential data is motion. Motion changes where things are, not what they are, and is therefore a symmetry of the data. Yet standard recurrent networks are not equivariant to it: their memory stays put while the input moves on. Flow equivariant recurrent networks first brought this symmetry into sequence models, for motions of constant velocity, or flows, by enumerating a bank of velocities. We extend this idea in three directions: from simple recurrent networks to convolutional LSTMs, from flows to motions whose velocity changes in time, and from enumerating velocities to estimating them. Treating a sequence as a field over time, we show that motion becomes a gauge symmetry: a global symmetry made local in time. Built on this view, our motion equivariant convolutional LSTM (MELSTM) uses its velocity model as the gauge field and is provably equivariant to every motion. Across future-frame prediction, classification of digits visible only through their motion, and action recognition under camera shake, MELSTM outperforms a convolutional LSTM and its flow equivariant counterpart with the same number of parameters: it is more accurate, generalizes to longer horizons and to unseen motions, and carries a fraction of the flow equivariant model's state.

AI.tldr: 本文提出运动等变卷积LSTM（MELSTM），将序列数据中的运动视为一种规范对称性，用一个可学习的速度模型作为规范场，从而实现对任意运动（不仅限于匀速）的等变循环网络。
AI.motivation: 序列数据中大部分变化是运动，而运动只改变物体的位置、不改变其身份，因此是数据的一种对称性。然而标准循环网络并不具备这种等变性：输入在移动，其记忆却停在原处。已有工作（flow equivariant recurrent networks）仅通过枚举一组速度来处理匀速运动，局限明显。
AI.method: MELSTM在三个方向上拓展已有思路：(1) 从简单RNN扩展到卷积LSTM；(2) 从匀速流扩展到速度随时间变化的运动；(3) 从枚举速度改为估计速度。作者将序列视为时间上的场，把运动看作一种规范对称性（在时间上被局部化的全局对称性），并用速度模型充当规范场，理论上证明模型对任意运动均等变。
AI.result: 在未来帧预测、仅通过运动可见的数字分类、以及相机抖动下的动作识别三项任务上，MELSTM均优于参数量相同的卷积LSTM及其流等变对照模型：精度更高，能泛化到更长的时间跨度与未见过的运动模式，且所需状态量仅为流等变模型的一小部分。
AI.conclusion: 将运动建模为规范对称性、用速度模型作为规范场，是构建运动等变循环网络的有效范式，在精度、泛化与状态效率上均显著优于现有方法。

title: D-Skill: Distilling Teacher Knowledge through Agent Skills
summary: Frontier language-model agents excel at complex tasks, but high inference costs make transferring their capabilities to smaller models essential. Traditional knowledge distillation achieves this through parameter updates, requiring access to the student's weights and additional training compute while encoding the transferred knowledge implicitly in the parameters. We introduce D-Skill, a framework that treats the teacher as a black box and distills its behavioral advantage into an interpretable natural-language skill by analyzing paired rollouts and identifying behavioral divergences and agreements. The resulting lessons are consolidated offline, with any compatible skill-update backend, into a skill document that is provided to the student at inference time. D-Skill constructs the skill entirely offline from fixed trajectories, without labels, further environment interaction, or weight updates after rollout collection. Across SpreadsheetBench-Verified, ALFWorld, and chess puzzles spanning multiple teacher-student pairs, D-Skill closes 75%-95% of the teacher-student gap without touching model weights. After a single offline pass over the paired traces, D-Skill outperforms one-epoch SFT baselines and remains competitive with multi-epoch SFT. Under the same model family, the resulting student also incurs 5.7x-8.3x lower inference cost per task than the teacher. Our results demonstrate that natural-language skill distillation offers a performant, interpretable, and efficient alternative to weight-based capability transfer.

AI.tldr: D-Skill提出一种"自然语言技能蒸馏"框架，将强教师模型的行为优势提取为可解释的自然语言技能文档，供学生在推理时使用，无需更新权重即可显著缩小师生差距。
AI.motivation: 前沿大模型智能体在复杂任务上表现优异但推理成本高，需要把能力迁移到小模型。传统知识蒸馏依赖参数更新，需访问学生权重、额外训练算力，且知识隐式编码在参数中，缺乏可解释性。作者希望实现黑盒教师、免权重更新、可解释的能力迁移。
AI.method: D-Skill将教师视为黑盒，通过对比配对rollout，识别行为分歧与一致之处，提炼出行为经验；这些经验在离线阶段用任意兼容的技能更新后端整合为一份技能文档，在推理时提供给学生。整个技能构建完全离线、基于固定轨迹、无需标签、无需进一步环境交互或权重更新。
AI.result: 在SpreadsheetBench-Verified、ALFWorld和棋类谜题等多个任务、多组师生配对上，D-Skill在不改动模型权重的情况下缩小了75%-95%的师生差距；单次离线配对轨迹处理后即优于一epoch SFT基线，并与多epoch SFT相当；同模型家族下学生推理成本比教师低5.7x-8.3x。
AI.conclusion: 自然语言技能蒸馏是一种高性能、可解释且高效的能力迁移方式，可替代基于权重的迁移方法。

title: Symmetry-Oriented Testing Framework for Variational Quantum Algorithms
comment: 11 pages, 8 figures, 3 tables. Accepted to the 2026 IEEE International Conference on Quantum Computing and Engineering (QCE26), Toronto, Canada, September 2026. Code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21405151
summary:
Testing quantum software is challenging because quantum states cannot be directly inspected. Variational quantum algorithms (VQAs) are a particularly important target as they are among the most promising approaches for near-term noisy quantum hardware. Many testing methods rely on classically computed results, which conflicts with the regime where quantum advantage is expected. Although prior studies mitigate this oracle problem, the core difficulty remains that existing approaches do not verify whether the execution deviates from the intended problem or whether the obtained solution is physically plausible.
  We propose a symmetry-oriented testing framework for VQAs that addresses this gap by using operators commuting with the target Hamiltonian as test specifications. The framework provides two complementary diagnostics: a commutator-based health check that monitors whether each execution step during optimization remains consistent with the symmetry of the target Hamiltonian, and a variance-based acceptance check that assesses the converged solution by examining whether the state is an eigenstate of the symmetry operators. Both diagnostics derive from the problem structure and do not require the exact solution.
  We evaluate the framework on representative user- and system-side faults, across multiple target systems, and under injected noise. Results show that the two diagnostics detect faulty behavior, provide informative signals of solution quality, and remain useful under noisy execution.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种面向变分量子算法(VQA)的对称性导向测试框架，利用与目标哈密顿量对易的算子作为测试规范，提供基于对易子的健康检查与基于方差的接受检查，无需精确解即可检测用户/系统侧故障并评估解质量。
AI.motivation: 量子态不可直接观测，VQA测试困难；现有方法依赖经典计算结果（与量子优势场景冲突），且无法验证执行是否偏离目标问题或解是否物理合理。
AI.method: 以与目标哈密顿量对易的算子作为测试规范，构建两个互补诊断：(1)对易子健康检查，监测优化过程中每步是否保持目标哈密顿量的对称性；(2)方差接受检查，通过状态是否为对称算子的本征态来评估收敛解。二者均源自问题结构，无需精确解。
AI.result: 在用户侧与系统侧故障、多个目标系统及注入噪声下评估：两种诊断能检测故障行为，提供有信息量的解质量信号，并在噪声执行下仍有效。
AI.conclusion: 对称性可作为VQA的有效测试规范，规避经典预言机问题，实现无需精确解的故障检测与解质量评估，且具备噪声鲁棒性。

title: SANE: Automated Scorer-Specific Metamorphic Testing for LLM Judges
comment: 15 pages, 9 figures. A shorter version was accepted for presentation at the non-archival NeurIPS 2026 TAE workshop
summary: LLM judges increasingly mediate benchmark evaluation, model selection, data curation, and training. Their decisions are useful only when each judge responds reliably to changes affecting its scoring criterion. Existing methods for reliability testing perturb inputs with known expected effects on judge scores. Prominent LLM-judge testing harnesses combine human-authored perturbation recipes with synthetic test generation, leaving scorer-specific recipe ideation outside the automated pipeline. This limits their use to fixed perturbations and pre-assumed scorer types. We introduce SANE, an agent-based framework that encodes behavioral requirements for stochastic evaluators as reusable agent instructions. Given a scorer specification, implementation, and representative inputs, the pipeline first identifies scorer-specific capabilities, then automatically derives perturbation recipes and expected score relations for each. SANE also defines a scorer-independent validation framework for generated judge tests. It determines whether each recipe agrees with scorer intent and whether each instantiated case realizes the recipe and supports its expected relation. Because SANE generates a recipe inventory tailored to each scorer, the number of aligned recipes grows as scorers are added. Across five domains, SANE produces 3.7 times as many validated test families as the Judge Reliability Harness (JRH) at comparable end-to-end validity and detects scorer deficiencies in every domain, including professionalism and toxicity, where JRH detects none. On faithfulness, SANE achieves strong human alignment in judge ranking: its test-suite scores rank 11 judge models consistently with human-labeled FaithBench performance (Spearman rho = 0.852), while JRH does not (rho = 0.100).

AI.tldr: SANE是一个基于智能体的框架，将随机评估器的行为要求编码为可复用的智能体指令，自动为每个评分器推导扰动配方和预期分数关系，并给出与评分器无关的测试验证框架。在五个领域上，其有效测试族数量为JRH的3.7倍且整体有效性相当，能检测各领域评分器缺陷；在faithfulness任务上对11个评判模型的排序与人工标注FaithBench一致（rho=0.852，JRH仅0.100）。
AI.motivation: LLM评判器广泛用于基准评测、模型选择、数据筛选和训练，但其决策只有在评分器对影响其评分标准的变化做出可靠响应时才有意义。现有可靠性测试方法依赖已知预期效应的扰动，主流测试工具（如JRH）把人工编写的扰动配方与合成测试生成结合，导致评分器特定的配方设计游离于自动化流程之外，只能用于固定扰动和预设评分器类型。
AI.method: SANE把随机评估器的行为要求写成可复用的智能体指令。给定评分器规范、实现和代表性输入，流水线先识别该评分器特有的能力，再自动为每项能力推导扰动配方及预期分数关系（如不变、单调），因此可为不同评分器自动生成配方清单。同时定义与评分器无关的验证框架：判断配方是否契合评分器意图，以及实例化后的测试用例是否真正实现该配方并支持其预期关系。
AI.result: 在五个领域上，SANE生成的有效验证测试族数量为JRH的3.7倍，端到端有效性相当，并在每个领域都检测到评分器缺陷，包括JRH完全没有检测到的professionalism和toxicity；在faithfulness任务中，SANE的测试套件分数对11个评判模型的排序与人工标注FaithBench高度一致（Spearman rho=0.852），而JRH不一致（rho=0.100）。
AI.conclusion: 自动化、评分器特定的扰动配方生成配合独立的测试验证，能显著扩展LLM评判器可靠性测试的覆盖面与诊断能力，并带来与人类判断更一致的模型排序，优于固定配方的现有工具。

title: DualHeads: Reward-tilted few-step diffusion made simple
summary: Distilled diffusion models generate high-quality images in a few sampling steps, but aligning them with task requirements and human preferences is difficult. Methods developed for multi-step diffusion models rely on differentiable rewards, or on score fields and stochastic trajectories that distilled generators may lack. We ask whether a few-step generator can be adapted using only external reward evaluations and reference samples, and show that two binary classifiers suffice. Our method, DualHeads, implements them as lightweight heads on a frozen diffusion backbone. The reward head learns which samples of the same prompt score higher, the reference head separates reference images from generated ones, and the generator maximizes a weighted sum of their logits. When the heads are optimal, this objective is KL-regularized maximization of the learned reward, and the ratio of head weights sets the regularization strength. Empirically, with both rule-based and model-based rewards, a few-step DualHeads generator reaches task rewards close to those of 40-step reinforcement learning methods while preserving image quality, at no extra inference cost. We hope that this simple and elegant dual-head formulation will help advance few-step reward-tilted generation.

AI.tldr: 提出DualHeads：仅用两个二分类头（奖励头+参考头）对冻结扩散骨干上的少步生成器做奖励对齐，无需可微奖励，推理零额外开销。
AI.motivation: 蒸馏后的少步扩散模型虽能高质量快速出图，但难以与任务要求和人类偏好对齐；现有对齐方法依赖可微奖励、score场或随机轨迹，而这些正是蒸馏少步生成器所缺乏的。作者要回答：能否仅用外部奖励评估和参考样本即完成少步生成器的适配。
AI.method: 在冻结的扩散骨干上附加两个轻量二分类头：奖励头学习同一提示下哪些样本得分更高；参考头区分参考图与生成图；生成器最大化二者logits的加权和。当two heads最优时，该目标等价于对所学奖励做KL正则化最大化，两头权重比即正则强度。
AI.result: 在规则型与模型型奖励下，少步DualHeads生成器的任务奖励接近40步强化学习方法，同时保持图像质量，且不增加推理成本。
AI.conclusion: DualHeads以简单优雅的双头形式实现了少步奖励倾斜生成，有望推动少步生成器的偏好对齐研究。

title: Generative Recommenders Forget the Long Tail: Restoring Memorization in Retrieval and Ranking
summary: Generative recommenders replace the retrieve-then-rank cascade with a single model: beam search over semantic item identifiers performs retrieval, and the same likelihood performs ranking. We show that this shared score makes them forget long-tail items twice. In retrieval, beam search keeps identifier prefixes by the probability mass of their subtrees, so tail items are pruned early, and a wider beam admits few more of them. In ranking, the likelihood places tail items below head items even when they are admitted, so expanding retrieval alone brings little or no gain. Both failures reflect missing item-level memorization (i.e., direct recall of which items co-occur), which collaborative filtering provides and shared-prefix generation lacks. To this end, we propose CAPE (Co-occurrence-Aware Pool Expansion), a training-free plug-in that restores memorization at both stages: (i) a memorization channel retrieves co-occurrence-supported tail items outside the beam and scores them with the frozen generator, and (ii) memorization-calibrated ranking fuses the generator likelihood with co-occurrence evidence while keeping the generator's first item. Experiments with two generative backbones on product and music domains show that CAPE significantly improves long-tail accuracy over the backbones and over re-ranking baselines that share its candidates, preserves or improves overall accuracy, and adds a small fraction of the latency.

AI.tldr: 生成式推荐中，单一共享打分导致长尾物品在检索和排序两阶段被"双重遗忘"；作者提出免训练的即插模块 CAPE，通过共现记忆通道和共现校准排序恢复物品级记忆，显著提升长尾准确率。
AI.motivation: 生成式推荐器用同一个似然分数完成beam search检索和排序，作者发现这种共享分数会让长尾物品被"遗忘两次"：检索阶段beam search按子树概率质量保留前缀，尾部物品过早被剪枝且加宽beam也帮助有限；排序阶段即便被召回，似然也把尾部排在头部之后。二者根源都是缺少物品级记忆（哪些物品共现），而协同过滤具备、共享前缀生成却缺失。
AI.method: 提出CAPE（Co-occurrence-Aware Pool Expansion），一种免训练即插即用方法，在两个阶段恢复记忆：(i) 记忆通道在beam之外检索由共现支持的尾部物品，并用冻结的生成器对其打分；(ii) 记忆校准排序将生成器似然与共现证据融合，同时保留生成器的首个物品。
AI.result: 在产品与音乐两个领域的实验中，搭配两种生成式骨干模型，CAPE相比骨干模型以及共享相同候选的重排基线显著提升长尾准确率，保持或改善整体准确率，且仅增加少量延迟。
AI.conclusion: 生成式推荐的共享打分机制造成长尾物品的双重遗忘，而通过引入协同过滤式的物品级共现记忆，可在不改训练的情况下有效缓解该问题，实现长尾与整体性能的双赢。

title: Building a Nested LADDER for LLM Unstructured Post-Training Pruning
summary: Non-uniform allocation can improve post-training pruning of large language models, yet quality can still degrade sharply at high sparsity. To control degradation as sparsity increases, we introduce LADDER (Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement), which allocates sparsity incrementally. At each step, it evaluates pruning an additional fraction of weights from each eligible layer and commits the layer update that causes the least end-to-end degradation per removed parameter. This process produces non-uniform sparsity profiles and exactly nested masks across multiple budgets. We evaluate LADDER on five OPT, Llama, and Qwen models across 10-90% sparsity, using SparseGPT as its candidate-generation backend and comparing against uniform and adaptive allocation baselines. Results reveal a clear operating-regime trade-off: LADDER is comparable or slightly weaker at benign sparsity but becomes substantially more robust from 70% onward. This high-sparsity advantage largely persists after posterior distillation across four of five models and translates into improved retention of aggregate zero-shot accuracy.

AI.tldr: LADDER 通过逐层增量分配稀疏度，用"每删除参数引起的端到端退化最小"准则生成非均匀、嵌套的剪枝配置，在高稀疏度（≥70%）下显著优于均匀与自适应基线。
AI.motivation: 非均匀分配能改善大模型训练后剪枝，但在高稀疏度下质量仍会急剧下降；需要一种机制来控制随稀疏度上升而出现的性能退化。
AI.method: LADDER（Layer-Wise Allocation via Damage-Driven Evaluation and Refinement）：逐步分配稀疏度，每一步评估每个可剪层再增剪一定比例权重所带来的影响，选择"单位参数删除导致端到端退化最小"的层进行更新；后端候选生成使用 SparseGPT，最终得到非均匀稀疏度剖面和跨多预算严格嵌套的掩码。在 5 个 OPT/Llama/Qwen 模型、10–90% 稀疏度上，与均匀分配和自适应分配基线对比。
AI.result: 呈现明显的工作区间权衡：低/中稀疏度下与基线相当或略弱，但从 70% 起明显更稳健；该高稀疏优势在后置蒸馏后于 5 个模型中的 4 个仍然保持，并转化为更好的零样本聚合准确率保留。
AI.conclusion: 以退化驱动的增量层间分配是提升高稀疏度后训练剪枝鲁棒性的有效手段，且嵌套掩码便于一次生成多预算配置；但其收益主要集中在高稀疏区间。

title: Back Up Before You Regret: Measuring Backup Awareness and Automating Backup in Coding Agents
summary: Coding agents now complete tasks autonomously, modifying real-world state such as artifacts, software environments, and configurations along the way. Yet they show limited backup awareness: recognizing that an action will modify state that may later be needed, and preserving it beforehand. To evaluate backup awareness, we introduce RegretBench, a benchmark of 205 executable tasks grounded in regret moments reported on platforms such as X.com, GitHub, and Stack Overflow, where users explicitly regretted not preserving state they later needed. Across six frontier models, agents complete 86.1% of tasks on average yet back up before these moments in only 15.2%, showing that task completion ability does not imply backup awareness. Because it is hard to predict which changes will be regretted, we propose BackUpper, a harness plug-in backup layer that checks every tool call and preserves affected state before modification. It combines rule-based strategies for common operations with a lightweight subagent for complex cases, and its rule table can expand with subagent decisions over time. On RegretBench, BackUpper covers every regret moment action and restores states with 92.2% average similarity to the original. Achieving this costs only $0.014 per task, with 7x fewer tokens than the main-agent self-backup baseline. When users have preferences on what to back up, BackUpper can also narrow its scope accordingly, matching human annotations on whether an action is worth preserving with an 84.5% F1 score. These results suggest that agents can keep actions reversible at low cost while respecting users' preferences.

AI.tldr: 提出RegretBench基准评估智能体"备份意识"，发现前沿模型任务完成率高(86.1%)但备份率极低(15.2%)；为此提出BackUpper工具层备份插件，全部覆盖后悔时刻动作，恢复相似度92.2%，成本仅$0.014/任务。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体自主执行任务时会修改真实状态，但缺乏"备份意识"——即预见某操作将改动后续可能需要保留的状态并提前保存，导致不可逆损失与用户后悔。
AI.method: 构建RegretBench（205个可执行任务，源自X.com、GitHub、Stack Overflow上用户明确后悔未保存状态的真实案例）；提出BackUpper：一个harness插件式备份层，拦截每次工具调用并在修改前保存受影响状态，结合规则策略与轻量子智能体处理复杂情况，规则表可随子智能体决策持续扩充；支持按用户偏好收窄备份范围。
AI.result: 6个前沿模型平均完成任务86.1%，但仅15.2%在关键时刻前备份；BackUpper覆盖所有后悔时刻动作，恢复相似度92.2%；每任务成本$0.014，token用量为主智能体自备份基线的1/7；符合用户备份偏好的判断F1达84.5%。
AI.conclusion: 任务完成能力不等同于备份意识；通过在工具层加入低成本、可扩展、尊重用户偏好的备份机制，可让智能体行为保持可逆，兼顾安全性与经济性。

title: VeeReview: Measuring Build-Verify Pairs in Agent-Authored Pull Requests from a V-Model Perspective
comment: 47 pages, 9 figures, 11 tables. Under review at Empirical Software Engineering. Replication package: https://zenodo.org/records/22884519
summary: Context: Reviewing a pull request requires verification evidence that addresses the proposed change. Coding agent benchmarks and studies of pull request outcomes do not directly assess this relationship. Objective: We test whether the V-Model's build and verify pairs can measure verification evidence in pull requests and support comparisons between agent-authored and human-authored changes. Method: VeeReview classifies four build and verify pairs using repository signals and a language-model judge. Three pairs use model judgements constrained by deterministic signals, and a rule over the diff and repository tree decides Module Design-Unit Test. We evaluated VeeReview against a 25-pull request reference set labelled by two raters and applied it to 1,454 matched pairs of agent and human pull requests from 741 repositories. Results: VeeReview assigned lower build-only rates to agent-authored pull requests on all four pairs, contrary to the preregistered hypothesis (mixed-effects odds ratios 0.52 to 0.86). Architecture-Integration was not significant. Standardization for linked issues, shipped tests and size reduced matched-rate differences by 34% to 60%, and the rule-decided pair's standardized interval included zero. The instrument did not meet its preregistered calibration criterion: agreement with adjudicated labels was 4% to 60% against a required 80%, and inter-rater agreement was weak (kappa = 0.154). Conclusions: The rule-decided pair shows that a process measure judged by a language model partly reflects how a pull request is presented rather than the verification work behind it. We report the cohort differences as observations made with this instrument, and we argue that such measures need a mechanically decided component and a validated human reference before they can support comparisons of verification practice.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 VeeReview，用 V-Model 的四个"构建-验证"配对来衡量 PR 中的验证证据，并比较 AI 智能体与人类提交的 PR；结果显示智能体 PR 仅构建率更低，但工具未达预注册校准标准，提示此类过程度量可能更多反映 PR 的呈现方式而非真实验证工作。
AI.motivation: 评审 PR 需要与变更相匹配的验证证据，但现有编码智能体基准和 PR 结果研究并未直接考察"变更—验证"这一对应关系；同时缺少可靠手段比较智能体与人类作者在验证实践上的差异。
AI.method: VeeReview 基于仓库信号与语言模型评判器，对 V-Model 的四个构建-验证配对进行分类：其中三对采用受确定性信号约束的模型判断，第四对（模块设计—单元测试）由基于 diff 与仓库目录树的规则判定。评估使用两位标注者标注的 25 个 PR 参考集，并应用于 741 个仓库中 1,454 对匹配的智能体/人类 PR。
AI.result: 智能体 PR 在四个配对上"仅构建"比率均更低（混合效应优势比 0.52–0.86），与预注册假设相反；架构—集成配对不显著。对关联 issue、随附测试和规模的标准化使匹配率差异缩小 34%–60%，规则判定配对的标准化区间包含零。工具未达预注册校准标准：与裁决标签一致率为 4%–60%（要求 80%），标注者间一致性弱（kappa=0.154）。
AI.conclusion: 规则判定的配对表明，由语言模型判断的过程度量部分反映 PR 的呈现方式而非其背后的验证工作。作者将队列差异作为该工具下的观察结果报告，并主张此类度量需具备机械可判定成分与经校验的人工参考，才能支撑验证实践的对比。

title: Building AI Research Teams for Autonomous Discovery of Linear Attention Architectures
summary: Autonomous agents can increasingly propose ideas, modify code, and run experiments, creating an opportunity to accelerate scientific discovery using teams of collaborative AI researchers. To escape local minima in the discovery, we propose to encourage orthogonal exploration by constructing the team using agents with varying expertise. However, realizing this design requires more than diverse backgrounds. When experiments are costly, a team can test only a limited number of ideas, thereby creating the need to balance exploration and exploitation when selecting a subset of researchers to propose and execute new experiments. Furthermore, each result should shape what the team tries next. We therefore ask how AI researchers with different scientific backgrounds can build on one another's findings and sustain progress under a limited experimental budget. To address these challenges, we build a team of persistent AI researchers, each grounded in a different discipline, who keep private research histories, share experimental evidence, and receive research opportunities through adaptive allocation. We demonstrate the effectiveness of this design by deploying the team to search for linear attention architectures, where it outperforms GDN2 at 1.3B scale on language modeling, common-sense reasoning, and synthetic and real-world retrieval tasks. In controlled comparisons, removing any single organizational component from our design yields markedly weaker discoveries: without disciplinary backgrounds, the search plateaus early; without private histories, researchers make less progress despite identical shared evidence; and uniform selection falls short of adaptive allocation within the same budget. These results suggest that sustained autonomous discovery depends not only on stronger agents, but also on who explores, what they remember, and how research effort is allocated.

AI.tldr: 该论文构建了一支由不同学科背景的持久化AI研究者组成的团队，通过私有研究历史、共享实验证据和自适应资源分配来平衡探索与利用，在有限实验预算下发现了优于GDN2的线性注意力架构。
AI.motivation: 自主AI智能体已能提出想法、修改代码并运行实验，有望加速科学发现。但为避免陷入局部最优需要正交探索（不同专长的智能体），而仅有背景多样性不足以实现这一目标：实验成本高昂时只能测试少量想法，需在挑选研究者与执行实验之间平衡探索与利用；且每个结果都应指导后续方向。
AI.method: 构建一支由不同学科背景的"持久化AI研究者"组成的团队：每位研究者拥有私有研究历史，共享实验证据，并通过自适应分配机制获得研究机会（而非均匀分配），以在有限实验预算下维持进展。
AI.result: 在线性注意力架构搜索任务中，该团队在1.3B规模的语言建模、常识推理以及合成与真实检索任务上均超越GDN2。消融实验显示：去掉学科背景，搜索过早停滞；去掉私有历史，即便共享证据相同进展也更少；均匀选择不如在同等预算下的自适应分配。
AI.conclusion: 持续的自主科学发现不仅取决于更强的智能体，还取决于"谁去探索、它们记住什么、研究投入如何分配"——即团队组织机制同样关键。

title: Policy-Mask: Budget-Aware Adaptation of Diffusion Features to Discriminative Tasks
summary: Selecting intermediate features from a frozen diffusion model for discriminative tasks is non-trivial because the useful signal is distributed across the denoising trajectory, network depth, and channels. In practice, this requires choosing a timestep, a block, and a channel subset. Existing methods either fix these choices by hand or optimize only a few extraction hyperparameters, most often the timestep, then reuse the same rule across inputs and budgets. We introduce Policy-Mask, a budget-conditioned policy trained on the downstream objective that jointly selects all three under a prescribed channel budget. Without normalization, the channel-score contribution grows with the number of selected channels and dominates the timestep and block updates. We normalize it by subset cardinality, keeping the three policy heads on comparable scales and stabilizing joint training. At matched budgets, Policy-Mask improves over fixed extraction and feature-filter baselines across segmentation, classification, and semantic correspondence, reaching 38.9 mIoU on ADE20K, 75.4% top-1 on CIFAR-100 at 128 dimensions, and 76.3 PCK@0.1 on SPair-71k. Component-wise ablations show that block selection materially affects downstream accuracy, and the highest recorded channel-budget score occurs at 256 retained channels, identifying a practical operating point for compact diffusion representations. We further adapt Policy-Mask to diffusion transformers, including PixArt-$Σ$ and SD3.5 MMDiT, by replacing U-Net channels with image-token hidden dimensions.

AI.tldr: Policy-Mask 是一个以预算为条件、在下游目标上训练的策策，在给定通道预算下联合选择时间步、网络块和通道子集，用于从冻结扩散模型中提取判别特征。
AI.motivation: 从冻结扩散模型中挑选可用于判别任务的中间特征非常困难，因为有用信号分布在去噪轨迹（时间步）、网络深度（块）和通道三个维度上。现有方法要么手工固定这些选择，要么只优化少数提取超参数（多为时间步），并在不同输入与预算间复用同一规则，缺乏对三者的联合、自适应选择。
AI.method: 提出 Policy-Mask：一个由预算条件化的策略，直接在下游任务目标上训练，在规定的通道预算下同时选择时间步、块与通道子集。针对通道得分贡献随所选通道数增长、从而压过时间步与块更新的训练不稳定问题，采用按子集基数归一化，使三个策略头处于可比尺度、稳定联合训练。并将方法扩展到扩散 Transformer（PixArt-Σ、SD3.5 MMDiT），用图像 token 隐藏维度替代 U-Net 通道。
AI.result: 在相同预算下，Policy-Mask 在分割、分类和语义对应任务上均优于固定提取与特征筛选基线：ADE20K 达到 38.9 mIoU；CIFAR-100 在 128 维下达到 75.4% top-1；SPair-71k 达到 76.3 PCK@0.1。组件消融显示块选择对下游精度有实质影响，最高通道预算得分出现在保留 256 通道处，为紧凑扩散表示提供了实用操作点。
AI.conclusion: 在预算约束下联合学习时间步、块与通道选择，比手工固定或仅调少数超参数的提取方式更有效；基数归一化是稳定联合训练的关键，块选择不可忽视，约 256 通道是一个较好的紧凑表示工作点，且该策略可迁移到 DiT 类骨干。

title: Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion for Query Reformulation in Dense Retrieval
summary: Dense retrieval has become a fundamental paradigm for modern information retrieval, supporting efficient semantic search across a wide range of applications. Its effectiveness, however, relies critically on query embeddings that adequately capture users' information needs, which can be difficult for short, ambiguous, or underspecified queries. Feedback-based query reformulation approaches like pseudo-relevance feedback (PRF) alleviate this by incorporating additional evidence from retrieved or generated content. However, existing embedding-space approaches commonly aggregate or interpolate feedback vectors, implicitly treating them as complete target representations. Such pointwise fusion can unnecessarily suppress query corrections along directions not expressed by individual feedback items, even when these directions are supported by complementary evidence. To address this limitation, we propose Directional Posterior Feedback Fusion (DIFF), a query reformulation framework that models feedback as directional evidence rather than target points. DIFF represents feedback as confidence-weighted directional evidence in the tangent space of the original query and jointly infers a controlled query update through prior-regularized posterior fusion, without retraining the underlying dense retriever. Experiments across multiple dense retrievers and different feedback sources show that DIFF achieves the best overall retrieval performance, demonstrating the effectiveness of explicitly modeling how feedback should constrain query updates.

AI.tldr: DIFF将反馈视为切空间中的方向性证据，通过先验正则化的后验融合推断受控查询更新，无需重训练稠密检索器即可提升检索性能。
AI.motivation: 稠密检索效果严重依赖查询嵌入质量，短、歧义或欠规范查询难以表达真实需求。PRF等反馈式改写可补充证据，但现有嵌入空间方法把反馈向量当作完整目标表示进行聚合或插值，点式融合会不必要地压制单个反馈项未表达、但由互补证据支持的方向上的查询修正。
AI.method: 提出方向性后验反馈融合（DIFF）框架：把反馈建模为方向性证据而非目标点，在原查询的切空间中以置信度加权方向表示，并通过先验正则化的后验融合联合推断受控的查询更新；整个过程不重新训练底层稠密检索器。
AI.result: 在多种稠密检索器和不同反馈来源上的实验表明，DIFF取得最佳总体检索性能，验证了显式建模"反馈应如何约束查询更新"的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 显式建模反馈对查询更新的方向性约束比传统点式融合更有效，为免训练、模型无关的查询改写提供了新思路。

title: Second Thoughts: Exploring and Planning through Comparative Imagination in World Models
summary: World models let agents compare imagined outcomes before acting, but an agent must still decide which alternatives to explore and when a proposed plan should replace its learned policy. We introduce SDI (Sibling Disagreement in Imagination), which connects these decisions through a shared actor-based reference. SDI compares action sequences imagined from the same model state, using repeated rollouts of the actor's own sequence to measure variation under fixed behavior. This reference scales both the spread across candidate returns, which provides an exploration signal, and a proposed plan's predicted advantage, which governs action acceptance. The agent executes a planned action when its advantage exceeds the reference variability by a fixed factor; otherwise, it follows the actor. SDI reuses the base agent's world model, actor, and critic without requiring an additional disagreement ensemble. Exploration and planning guide training data collection, while evaluation uses the learned actor alone. Across Meta-World, Adroit, and DM-Control, SDI achieves a higher observed task-average score than every compared baseline in each suite and matches or exceeds the strongest baseline's performance on 15 of 18 tasks. Component ablations and robustness analyses further examine the roles of exploration, planning exposure, and action acceptance. Paired evaluations from identical simulator states show that the gate improves both recovery from actor failures and preservation of successful behavior relative to ungated planning, while substantially reducing return degradation. Together, these results support comparing imagined alternatives against a shared actor reference as a unified approach to exploring and planning with world models.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 SDI（Sibling Disagreement in Imagination），以 actor 自身多次 rollout 的波动作为共享参照，同时驱动"探索信号"与"计划是否替换策略"的接受判断，无需额外 disagreement 集成。
AI.motivation: 世界模型虽能让智能体在行动前比较想象结果，但仍有两个未被解决的关键决策：应探索哪些备选方案，以及何时用提出的计划替换已学策略。现有方法通常把探索与规划当作两件独立的事，且依赖额外的不一致性集成（ensemble），代价高。
AI.method: SDI 在同一模型状态下想象多条动作序列，并对 actor 自身序列做重复 rollout，以固定行为下的变异作为参照。该参照同时缩放两件事：(1) 候选回报之间的离散度，作为探索信号；(2) 提出计划的预测优势，用于动作接受。只有当计划优势超过参照变异的固定倍数时执行计划，否则跟随 actor。方法复用基础智能体的世界模型、actor 与 critic，无需额外 disagreement ensemble；探索与规划用于训练数据采集，评估时仅用学到的 actor。
AI.result: 在 Meta-World、Adroit、DM-Control 上，SDI 在每个套件中的观测任务平均分均高于所有对比基线，并在 18 个任务中的 15 个达到或超过最强基线。消融与鲁棒性分析考察了探索、规划暴露与动作接受的作用。来自相同模拟器状态的配对评估显示：相比无门控规划，门控既改善了从 actor 失败中的恢复，也更好地保留成功行为，并显著降低回报退化。
AI.conclusion: 以共享的 actor 参照来比较想象备选，可作为统一处理世界模型下探索与规划的有效方案。

title: Self-Improving Agents with World Model Predictive Paths
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents are increasingly expected to interact with environments and improve their decisions during deployment. However, how anticipating future outcomes and drawing on accumulated interaction experience can jointly support decision-making remains underexplored. We propose a test-time framework, inspired by Model Predictive Path Integral (MPPI) control, that combines multi-branch predictive analysis with experience-based adaptation. At each step, the agent proposes multiple candidate actions and imagines their outcomes with a world model, so that alternatives can be compared without being executed in the environment. Since language environments provide neither explicit dynamics nor costs, the predicted outcomes are evaluated for task progress and risk, and MPPI-style weights over the resulting costs guide the final decision. A dual-branch experience memory enables self-improvement: the planner branch refines candidate generation and action selection, while the world model branch improves next-observation prediction. Experiments on ALFWorld and ScienceWorld across three backbones demonstrate the strong overall performance of our method and the effectiveness of experience-guided predictive control. Our code will be made publicly available.

AI.tldr: 提出受MPPI控制启发的测试时框架，将多分支预测分析与经验驱动适应相结合，让LLM智能体在不执行的情况下比较候选动作并借双分支经验记忆自我改进。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体需在部署中与环境交互并改进决策，但"预测未来结果"与"利用累积交互经验"如何共同支撑决策仍缺乏探索。
AI.method: 借鉴Model Predictive Path Integral控制的测试时框架：(1)每步提出多个候选动作，用世界模型"想象"其结果，从而无需真实执行即可比较备选；(2)因语言环境无显式动力学与代价函数，改由任务进展和风险评估预测结果，并以MPPI式权重对成本加权指导决策；(3)双分支经验记忆实现自改进——规划分支优化候选生成与动作选择，世界模型分支提升下一观测预测。
AI.result: 在ALFWorld与ScienceWorld上、三种骨干模型上实验，整体性能表现强劲，验证了经验引导预测控制的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 预测性分析与经验积累的联合可有效提升LLM智能体测试时决策能力，代码将公开。

title: VERDICT: Multi-Agent Parallel Modular Verification
summary:
Deductive verification scales to large software systems through modular reasoning, where formal contracts summarize the behavior of individual functions and enable their independent verification. Its central bottleneck is specification synthesis: constructing the contracts required for modular verification. Recent advances in large language models (LLMs) have enabled automated specification synthesis at unprecedented scale. However, existing approaches remain fundamentally bottom-up, requiring callees to be verified before their callers. This dependency limits parallelism and provides no principled mechanism for resolving interprocedural inconsistencies that propagate across call chains.
  We present VERDICT, a multi-agent framework for parallelizing modular deductive verification of large-scale programs. VERDICT is built on two key principles. First, assumption-based parallel specification synthesis assigns an agent to each function and allows it to proceed immediately using assumed contracts for its callees, enabling verification to proceed in parallel across the program. Second, bidirectional interprocedural conflict reconciliation resolves the inconsistencies introduced by these assumptions: when a synthesized contract contradicts an assumption, agents propagate the necessary revisions both up and down the call graph until the contracts converge. Experimental results on real-world C programs show that VERDICT synthesizes higher-quality specifications than existing approaches while substantially reducing verification time. In particular, VERDICT is the first approach that scales to the complete 20,000-line X.509 parser, ruling out nearly all the potential runtime errors within hours, whereas prior tools like PREGUSS fall far short even after days of execution.

AI.tldr: VERDICT：多智能体框架，用"假设驱动"并行规格合成与双向过程间冲突消解，实现大规模C程序的并行模块化演绎验证。
AI.motivation: 演绎验证依赖模块化推理，其核心瓶颈是规格合成。现有LLM方法本质上是自底向上的，要求被调函数先于调用者验证，这限制了并行性，也缺乏解决跨调用链传播的过程间不一致的原则性机制。
AI.method: 基于两条原则：(1) 假设式并行规格合成——为每个函数分配一个agent，允许其使用被调函数的假设契约立即推进，从而全程序并行验证；(2) 双向过程间冲突协调——当合成契约与假设矛盾时，agent沿调用图向上和向下传播必要修正，直至契约收敛。
AI.result: 在真实C程序上，VERDICT合成的规格质量优于现有方法，且显著缩短验证时间；首个扩展到完整的2万行X.509解析器，数小时内排除几乎全部潜在运行时错误，而PREGUSS等先前工具即使运行数天也远不能及。
AI.conclusion: 以假设并行化加双向冲突消解替代自底向上依赖，可有效提升模块化演绎验证的并行度与可扩展性，使大规模真实程序的自动化验证在实际时间内成为可能。

title: CSD: Common-Support Distillation for Cross-Tokenizer Knowledge Transfer
summary: Cross-tokenizer logits distillation enables knowledge transfer across model families, allowing students to learn from stronger or more specialized teachers. However, differences in vocabulary and segmentation make teacher and student next-token distributions difficult to align. Existing logits-based methods are easy to integrate into standard distillation pipelines, but often rely on restrictive heuristics or tokenizer-pair-specific choices. They may restrict supervision to shared vocabulary subsets, require manually selecting different objectives for different tokenizer pairs, or match only the observed chunk and its complement rather than individual alternative continuations. We introduce Common-Support Distillation (CSD), a unified logits-based framework that constructs a shared support between the teacher and student at each aligned input chunk and matches the induced distributions with a single objective. For one-to-one alignments, CSD uses explicit common-token pairs as the shared support. For other alignments, it constructs a virtual support whose probabilities are computed using the autoregressive chain rule. A residual event captures probability mass outside the explicit support, ensuring that both induced distributions remain normalized. Across four teacher-student settings comprising Llama-3.2-1B and Gemma3-1B-PT students with Qwen and Phi teachers, CSD consistently achieves the highest average performance among the evaluated cross-tokenizer methods, outperforming the strongest alternative by up to 1.8 points and surpassing both continued pretraining and same-tokenizer distillation. For Llama-3.1-8B, CSD improves average accuracy over the strongest evaluated baseline by up to 4.2 points for the base student and 1.6 points for the instruction-tuned student.

AI.tldr: 提出Common-Support Distillation (CSD)，一个统一的logits蒸馏框架，通过对齐输入块构造师生共享支撑集并匹配诱导分布，解决跨分词器知识蒸馏中的分布对齐难题。
AI.motivation: 跨分词器蒸馏可让弱学生向更强或更专精的教师学习，但词表与分词方式差异使师生下一词分布难以对齐。现有logits方法依赖限制性启发式或针对特定分词器配对的人工设计，如仅用共享词表子集、为不同配对手选目标、或只匹配观测到的chunk及其补集而非单个替代续写。
AI.method: CSD在每个对齐的输入块上构造师生共享支撑集，并用单一目标匹配诱导分布。一对一对齐时用显式公共token对作为共享支撑；其他对齐下用自回归链式法则构造虚拟支撑并计算其概率；引入残差事件捕获显式支撑之外的概率质量，保证两个诱导分布归一化。
AI.result: 在Llama-3.2-1B与Gemma3-1B-PT四组师生设置中，CSD平均性能最高，优于最强替代方法最多1.8分，并超过继续预训练与同分词器蒸馏。对Llama-3.1-8B，base学生平均准确率提升最多4.2分，指令微调学生提升1.6分。
AI.conclusion: CSD以统一、无需分词器配对特定设计的目标实现有效的跨分词器logits蒸馏，在多种师生规模与模型家族上稳定优于现有方法与基线。

title: Data-Driven Glyph Positioning for Handwritten Music Synthesis
comment: 10 pages, 1 biblio page, presented at The 20th International Conference on Document Analysis and Recognition
summary: Synthesised data is a common strategy to address the lack of annotated handwritten music scores in Optical Music Recognition (OMR). Smashcima is a recent synthesis framework that assembles pages of handwritten scores by sampling glyph images from MUSCIMA++ and positioning them with hard-coded rules. In this work we ask whether these rules are grounded empirically and whether a learned model for context-dependent positioning can further improve synthesis quality. We extract inter-glyph distributions from around 285 thousand annotated relationships across MUSCIMA++ and OmniOMR, finding that several key parameters deviate systematically from real handwriting. Replacing these constants with empirical means reduces positioning RMSE by up to 60%. We then train a Graph Neural Network (GNN) on the Music Notation Graph structure to predict context-dependent offsets, achieving an additional 50 to 85% RMSE reduction on stems and beams by modelling how neighbouring glyphs constrain placement. Cross-dataset analysis shows that spacing differences between the two corpora are explained by note density (3.3), not style, and that duration-proportional spacing does not hold in handwriting (R2 = 0.001). In downstream evaluation, a YOLOv8 detector pretrained on GNN-positioned synthetic data achieves +30% mAP50 over the baseline and +11% over empirical means when fine-tuned on 200 real handwritten staves, showing that positioning accuracy matters for downstream OMR.

AI.tldr: 本文检验Smashcima乐谱合成框架中硬编码定位规则的经验依据，并用实证分布与图神经网络改进符号定位，最终提升下游OMR性能。
AI.motivation: 手写乐谱光学识别（OMR）缺乏标注数据，常依赖合成数据；而Smashcima等合成框架使用硬编码规则定位符号，这些规则是否符合真实手写习惯尚不清楚。
AI.method: 从MUSCIMA++和OmniOMR约28.5万条标注关系中提取符号间分布；用经验均值替换硬编码常数；再在Music Notation Graph结构上训练GNN预测上下文相关偏移。
AI.result: 硬编码参数系统性偏离真实手写，替换后定位RMSE最多降低60%；GNN再使符干、符梁RMSE再降50–85%；跨数据集差异由音符密度（3.3）解释而非风格；时长比例间距在手写中不成立（R²=0.001）；YOLOv8在200行真实谱表微调后，较基线+30% mAP50，较经验均值+11%。
AI.conclusion: 现有合成框架的硬编码定位规则缺乏经验依据，实证分布与学习式上下文定位可显著提升合成数据质量，且定位精度对下游OMR有实际影响。

title: Beyond the Vote: When Do LLMs Add Value to Retrieval-Based Tabular Classification?
summary: Retrieval-based in-context learning (ICL) enables large language models (LLMs) to predict tabular labels from similar examples, but it remains unclear whether LLM inference improves on direct voting over those same examples. We address this question by comparing four general-purpose LLMs with distance-weighted nearest-neighbor voting (Distance-KNN) using identical retrieved neighbors across 19 tabular classification datasets. With the number of demonstrations fixed, enlarging the retrieval candidate pool improves accuracy for all predictors, yet Distance-KNN achieves the highest mean accuracy at every pool size. More detailed analyses reveal that LLM gains are concentrated where retrieved neighbors exhibit low label consensus and vary across models. These gains further depend on the average feature-space distance to the test query: under low label consensus, some LLMs outperform Distance-KNN in close and intermediate neighborhoods, but all fall behind on average in the most distant group. Complementary experiments on the number of demonstrations, prompt formulation, retrieval representation, and label-balanced demonstration selection largely preserve the overall findings. These results characterize when LLM inference adds predictive value beyond distance-weighted voting in retrieval-based tabular ICL.

AI.tldr: 在19个表格分类数据集上，用相同检索邻居比较4个通用LLM与距离加权KNN投票：KNN在各候选池规模下平均准确率最高；LLM的增益集中于邻居标签一致性低、且距离查询较近的场景。
AI.motivation: 基于检索的上下文学习（ICL）常被用于表格分类，但尚不清楚LLM推理是否真的优于对同样检索样例做直接投票，本文系统检验这一问题。
AI.method: 在19个表格分类数据集上，对4个通用LLM与Distance-KNN使用完全相同的检索邻居进行对比；固定演示数量、变化检索候选池规模；并做标签一致性、特征空间距离分析，以及演示数量、提示构建、检索表示、标签平衡选样等补充实验。
AI.result: 增大候选池可提升所有预测器准确率，但Distance-KNN在每个池规模下平均准确率最高；LLM增益集中在邻居标签一致性低的情形且因模型而异；低一致性下部分LLM在近、中距离邻域优于KNN，但在最远距离组整体落后；补充实验基本保持上述结论。
AI.conclusion: LLM推理相对距离加权投票的额外预测价值是有条件的：主要出现在邻居共识低且距离较近的样本上，而整体平均仍不及Distance-KNN，为检索式表格ICL的适用边界提供了刻画。

title: Extreme Low-State Quantized Transformer for Electricity-Load Forecasting
summary: Aggressive low-state weight quantization can substantially reduce neural-network representational flexibility, making predictive performance difficult to preserve when only a few discrete weight states are available. We investigate this regime for Transformer-based electricity-load forecasting using 3-, 5-, 7-, and 16-state weight quantization across feed-forward-only and attention-plus-feed-forward quantization. Two tasks predict either the next hour or the next 24 hours from the preceding 48 hours across two co-primary electricity-consumption datasets. Direct post-training quantization (PTQ) increased mean normalized root-mean-square error (NRMSE) relative to full precision by 6.25 and 7.04 percentage points in Datasets A and B, whereas quantization-aware fine-tuning (QAT-FT) recovered approximately 90.2% and 94.5% of these penalties. Quantization-aware training from random initialization (Scratch-QAT) also produced competitive low-state solutions, with particularly favorable behavior at three states. We further introduce accumulated-update thresholding, which accumulates optimizer-proposed weight changes before commitment. Relative to paired Scratch-QAT controls, this reduced committed shadow-weight updates by approximately 99.7% and discrete state transitions by approximately 77--80%, while mean NRMSE changed by only +0.042 and +0.197 percentage points. These results show that useful Transformer forecasting can be retained under highly discrete weight representations while strongly suppressing target-state activity, supporting a prospective route toward compact, low-activity edge forecasting using multilevel synaptic devices.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究Transformer电力负荷预测模型在极端低状态权重量化下的性能保持问题，并引入"累积更新阈值化"机制大幅抑制权重更新活动。
AI.motivation: 激进的低状态权重量化会显著削弱神经网络表征灵活性，仅有少量离散权重状态时难以保持预测性能；同时面向边缘/多值突触器件部署，需探索能否在高度离散表示下保留有用预测能力并降低目标态活动。
AI.method: 基于Transformer电力负荷预测任务，设置3、5、7、16状态权重量化，覆盖仅前馈与注意力+前馈两种量化范围；任务为用前48小时预测下一小时或未来24小时，使用两个共主电力消耗数据集；比较直接PTQ、量化感知微调(QAT-FT)、随机初始化量化感知训练(Scratch-QAT)，并提出累积更新阈值化（先累积优化器提议的权重变化再提交）。
AI.result: 直接PTQ使平均NRMSE相对全精度分别上升6.25与7.04个百分点（数据集A、B）；QAT-FT分别挽回约90.2%与94.5%的损失；Scratch-QAT也具竞争力，3状态时表现尤佳；累积更新阈值化相比配对Scratch-QAT对照，提交的影子权重更新减少约99.7%，离散状态转移减少约77–80%，而平均NRMSE仅变化+0.042与+0.197个百分点。
AI.conclusion: 高度离散权重表示下仍可保留有效的Transformer预测能力，同时可强力抑制目标态活动，为基于多值突触器件的紧凑、低活动边缘预测提供了可行路径。

title: Behavior Beyond Text: Evaluating Refusal Transfer Failure in LLM Agents
comment: Raj Saha and Ekagra Gupta contributed equally and share first authorship
summary: While large language models are increasingly deployed as tool-calling agents, their safety evaluations still focus primarily on their ability to refuse harmful requests in text. We investigate whether the refusal behavior in text transfers to tool use. We construct a benchmark of 2,304 prompts across four domains, consisting of matched triplets that present the same harmful or benign request in text-only, standard tool-enabled, and adversarially framed tool-enabled settings. We then assess tool-call safety using 20 predefined forbidden actions. Testing five models of varying sizes and families, we find that requests refused in text frequently result in unsafe tool calls. Under standard tool-enabled prompting, this divergence occurs for 10-52 percent of harmful requests refused in chat. To mechanistically investigate this gap, we identify a refusal-associated direction in the residual stream of each of the five models. We find that in tool-enabled contexts, the activations along this direction decrease in four of five models. Furthermore, lower activation predicts unsafe tool calls across all five models (AUC 0.76-0.86). However, restoring the signal to the respective text-only value through activation patching only prevents a subset of unsafe calls, primarily by suppressing tool use rather than by producing safer calls. Steering along the refusal direction nearly eliminates unsafe calls only at strengths that also suppress benign tool use or degrade the output quality. Our findings indicate that the identified refusal direction contributes to whether a model acts, but only partially explains the refusal divergence. Therefore, evaluating the safety of tool-calling agents requires directly examining their actions along with their textual responses.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究LLM在纯文本场景中的"拒绝行为"是否能迁移到工具调用场景，发现文本中被拒绝的请求在工具启用时常被执行为不安全调用，并对此进行机制分析。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多被部署为工具调用智能体，但安全评估仍主要关注文本拒绝能力，忽视了工具使用场景下的行为差异与潜在风险。
AI.method: 构建含2,304条提示的基准，覆盖四领域，由同一有害/良性请求的三种匹配三元组组成（纯文本、标准工具、对抗性框架工具），用20种预设禁止动作评估工具调用安全性；测试5个不同规模与家族的模型；在残差流中识别"拒绝相关方向"，通过激活与激活修补进行机制分析与干预实验。
AI.result: 在标准工具提示下，10–52%的已在文本中被拒绝的有害请求导致不安全工具调用；工具情境下5个模型中有4个沿拒绝方向的激活下降；激活越低越能预测不安全调用（AUC 0.76–0.86）；将信号恢复至文本值仅阻止部分不安全调用，且主要通过抑制工具使用而非生成更安全的调用；沿拒绝方向引导仅在同时抑制良性工具使用或降低输出质量的强度下才近乎消除不安全调用。
AI.conclusion: 识别出的拒绝方向部分决定模型是否行动，但只能部分解释拒绝行为的差异；评估工具调用智能体的安全性必须同时直接考察其动作与文本回应。

title: AI-Based End-to-End Automotive Design and Software Development for SDVs
summary: This paper explores the potential of Artificial Intelligence (AI) to enable end-to-end automotive design and software development for Software-Defined Vehicles (SDVs). Based on our contributions within the Central Car Server (CeCaS) and follow-up EU-funded projects, we present an AI-driven toolchain integrating Large Language Models (LLMs) with Model-Driven Engineering (MDE) to automate the transformation of natural-language requirements into system architectures, executable software, and validation artifacts. The approach emphasizes traceability, consistency, and compliance with safety-critical automotive development requirements. Validation is performed on a centralized vehicle computing platform supporting adaptive cruise control and emergency braking, tested in Hardware-in-the-Loop (HiL) and Software-in-the-Loop (SiL) environments. We discuss current capabilities, practical limitations, and future directions toward increasingly automated, reliable, and quality-assured automotive software development with minimal human intervention.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出一种AI驱动工具链，将大语言模型（LLM）与模型驱动工程（MDE）结合，实现从自然语言需求到系统架构、可执行软件及验证工件的端到端自动化汽车软件开发，并在支持ACC与紧急制动的集中式车载计算平台上通过HiL/SiL验证。
AI.motivation: 软件定义汽车（SDV）需要端到端的汽车设计与软件开发能力，而安全关键开发对可追溯性、一致性和合规性要求极高，传统人工流程难以满足；作者希望探索AI能否在最小人工干预下实现高度自动化且可靠的开发。
AI.method: 基于CeCaS中央车载服务器项目及后续欧盟项目的成果，构建AI驱动工具链：用LLM解析自然语言需求，经MDE进行模型化转换，自动生成系统架构、可执行软件与验证工件，并强调可追溯性与一致性。在集中式车载计算平台上针对自适应巡航控制与紧急制动进行HiL和SiL测试。
AI.result: 在支持ACC与紧急制动的集中式车载计算平台上完成了HiL与SiL验证，展示了工具链的当前能力；同时论文讨论了实际限制与未来方向。
AI.conclusion: LLM与MDE结合的AI工具链具备推动汽车软件端到端自动化的潜力，可朝更高度自动化、可靠且质量有保证、人工干预更少的开发模式发展，但仍需应对实际约束。

title: Is Refusal Direction Universal across Low-Resourced Languages?
summary: Refusal directions have been shown to transfer cross-lingually with near-perfect effectiveness across safety-aligned languages (Wang et al., 2025), reportedly regardless of resource level. However, the only truly low-resourced language evaluated is Yoruba, which is strongly misaligned and shows limited transfer, leaving open how refusal directions behave for other low-resourced languages. We extend PolyRefuse to three additional low-resourced languages (Belarusian, Bashkir, and Tajik) and replicate the pipeline of (Wang et al., 2025) on Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct. We find that universality is graded rather than binary: directions from safety-aligned and partially-aligned languages transfer broadly, while those from strongly misaligned languages fail to reliably modulate refusal behavior on any target tested, including other misaligned languages, once ceiling effects are accounted for. Geometric alignment and behavioral transfer are further shown to be partially dissociated. These findings complicate the universality claim and suggest that users of the least-resourced, most strongly misaligned languages may face weaker safety guarantees.

AI.tldr: 本文扩展 PolyRefuse 实验到三种低资源语言（白俄罗斯语、巴什基尔语、塔吉克语），发现拒绝方向的跨语言迁移是"分级"而非二元普适的：安全对齐与部分对齐语言的方向可广泛迁移，而强错位语言的方向即便在其它错位语言上也难以可靠调控拒绝行为，且几何对齐与行为迁移存在部分解耦。
AI.motivation: Wang 等人（2025）声称拒绝方向可在安全对齐语言间近乎完美地跨语言迁移，且与资源水平无关；但真正评估的低资源语言只有约鲁巴语，其强错位、迁移有限，因而"普适性"结论缺乏证据支撑，需要更多低资源语言来检验。
AI.method: 将 PolyRefuse 基准扩展到白俄罗斯语、巴什基尔语和塔吉克语三种低资源语言，并在 Qwen2.5-14B-Instruct 上复现 Wang 等人（2025）的完整流程，比较不同对齐程度语言所提取拒绝方向的跨语言迁移效果，并在排除天花板效应后考察几何对齐与行为迁移的关系。
AI.result: 普适性是分级的而非二元的：来自安全对齐与部分对齐语言的方向可广泛迁移；来自强错位语言的方向在控制天花板效应后，无法在任何测试目标（含其它错位语言）上可靠地调节拒绝行为；几何对齐与行为迁移之间呈现部分解耦。
AI.conclusion: 研究结果对"拒绝方向跨语言普适"的论断构成挑战，提示使用资源最少、错位最严重语言的用户可能获得更弱的安全保障。

title: MINER: Modeling Inter- and Intra-Person Variance for Reidentification
comment: Paper accepted to the WACV 2027 Algorithms track
summary: Clothes-Changing Person Re-Identification (CC-ReID) remains challenging due to drastic appearance shifts across outfits. Most prior works devise biometric signal-extraction heuristics to enhance inter-person variance, e.g., using segmentation masks, while leaving intra-person variance uncontrolled. We present MINER, a simple model-agnostic framework that suppresses garment bias by contrasting hard examples and adaptively balancing dataset-dependent intra- and inter-person variance. Extensive experiments show that MINER improves retrieval across CC-ReID benchmarks, achieving state-of-the-art performance on four datasets and ranking among the leaders in all three tracks of the open TVRID RGB-Depth ReID challenge.

AI.tldr: MINER是一个模型无关的简单框架，通过对比困难样本并自适应平衡数据集相关的类内与类间方差，来抑制服装偏差，提升换装行人重识别性能。
AI.motivation: 换装行人重识别（CC-ReID）因不同服装导致的剧烈外观变化而具有挑战性。多数已有工作设计生物特征信号提取的启发式方法（如使用分割掩码）来增强类间方差，但类内方差未受控制。
AI.method: 提出MINER框架：一个模型无关的简单方法，通过对比困难样本（contrasting hard examples）抑制服装偏差，并自适应地平衡数据集相关的类内方差与类间方差。
AI.result: 在多个CC-ReID基准上提升检索性能，在四个数据集上取得最先进性能，并在开放TVRID RGB-Depth ReID挑战赛全部三个赛道中名列前茅。
AI.conclusion: MINER以简单、模型无关的方式有效抑制服装偏差并平衡方差，显著提升换装行人重识别的泛化与检索表现。

title: X-Embedding: Two-Stage Training for Multilingual Patent Prior-Art Retrieval
summary: Multilingual patent prior-art retrieval requires identifying X-category references that are particularly relevant to the novelty or inventive step of a claimed invention, beyond topical similarity across languages and document views. We present X-Embedding, a two-stage framework that first learns patent-domain representations and then optimizes X-category retrieval relevance. The first stage aligns complementary sections within patents and corresponding sections across different-language patent-family members, learning from both patent structure and multilingual expressions. The second stage learns X-category relevance using examination-report X citations as positives and negatives drawn from retrieval candidates and A-category citations. Matryoshka representation learning (MRL) enables 64- and 1024-dimensional embeddings within one model. Evaluation on a common Chinese, English, and Japanese collection with four query views yields 89.09% overall macro Hit@100 at 64 dimensions, exceeding Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and RoBERTa by 21.25 and 3.68 percentage points, respectively. Under the same second-stage training and evaluation conditions, two-stage training outperforms direct supervised fine-tuning by 3.19 points, with gains of 5.34 and 4.72 points for English and Japanese and higher scores in nine of twelve language-view combinations. Overall macro Hit@10 and Hit@20 also improve by 3.71 and 3.79 points, respectively. These results support sequential patent-domain and task adaptation for improving aggregate X-category retrieval on this multilingual collection.

AI.tldr: 提出X-Embedding两阶段框架，先学习专利领域表示（专利内部章节对齐与跨语言同族章节对齐），再以审查报告X类引用优化X类检索相关性，采用MRL支持64/1024维嵌入。在中英日集合上64维整体macro Hit@100达89.09%，超越Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 21.25点、RoBERTa 3.68点；两阶段比直接SFT高3.19点。
AI.motivation: 多语言专利现有技术检索不仅需要跨语言、跨文档视角的主题相似，还需识别与新颖性/创造性高度相关的X类对比文件，现有通用嵌入模型难以满足这一领域与任务需求。
AI.method: 两阶段：第一阶段学习专利领域表示，对齐专利内部互补章节及不同语言专利同族的对应章节，融合专利结构与多语言表达；第二阶段以审查报告中的X类引用为正例，结合检索候选与A类引用构造负例，学习X类相关性；并用Matryoshka表示学习在单一模型中支持64维和1024维嵌入。
AI.result: 中英日集合、四种查询视角下，64维整体macro Hit@100为89.09%，分别超Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B 21.25点、RoBERTa 3.68点；相同二阶段条件下两阶段优于直接监督微调3.19点（英/日分别+5.34/+4.72），12种语言-视角组合中9项更优；macro Hit@10与Hit@20分别提升3.71和3.79点。
AI.conclusion: 顺序进行专利领域适应与任务适应可有效提升该多语言集合上的X类检索整体表现。

title: Measure First, Then Allocate: Calibrated Rollout Budgets for MCP Agents in Reinforcement Learning
summary: Training tool-using language models requires costly interaction, yet identical rewards within a rollout group provide no group-relative learning signal. We use reward disagreement to guide harness evaluation and the allocation of rollouts for policy training in Model Context Protocol (MCP) environments. We first introduce Discord, which tests harness edits using exact paired inference and decision-preserving early stopping: only disagreeing paired outcomes favor one harness over another. This insight motivates prospective allocation in BRACE (Bank-calibrated Rollout Allocation under Correlated Episodes). BRACE combines historical task evidence, uncertainty in task success rates, and a correlated reward model to forecast mixed-reward groups before allocating generation budget. Controlled harness experiments favor Discord, while live MCP experiments expose a retention-cost trade-off. At three Qwen3-VL model scales, BRACE exceeds the strongest plotted baseline peaks with fewer new training rollouts; historical-bank collection is counted separately. It also leads the compared methods on BFCL and NESTFUL without further training. Ablations probe the bank, estimator, and allocation score; prospective evaluation checks forecast calibration. These results support forecasting reward contrast before generation.

AI.tldr: 论文用"奖励分歧"来指导评测与rollout分配，提出Discord评测框架与BRACE预算分配方法，在MCP环境中以更少rollout取得更高训练效果。
AI.motivation: 训练工具使用型语言模型需要昂贵的交互成本，而同一rollout组内若奖励全部相同（同全对或全错），则组相对优势信号为零，浪费了生成预算。
AI.method: 1) Discord：用精确配对推断与决策保持的早停来评测harness改动，只有配对结果出现分歧才判定一个harness更优；2) BRACE：在生成前利用历史任务证据、任务成功率不确定性及相关奖励模型，预测哪些组会产生混合奖励（即存在分歧），从而分配rollout预算。
AI.result: 受控harness实验中Discord占优；真实MCP实验揭示保留成本的权衡。在三个Qwen3-VL规模上，BRACE以更少新rollout超过最强基线峰值（历史采集单独计）。在BFCL与NESTFUL上无需额外训练即领先对比方法；消融检验了bank、估计器与分配分数，前瞻性评估验证了预测校准。
AI.conclusion: 在生成之前预测奖励对比度是可行且有效的，可显著提升训练与评测的rollout效率。

title: PerMIT: Securing Persistent Memory for LLM Agents via Machine-Checked Integrity Theorems and Scalable Community Trust
summary: Persistent memory is a largely undefended surface for injection and poisoning, and the same risk limits memory sharing among agents. We present PerMIT, a memory architecture with provable integrity guarantees under an explicit trust assumption: only user-typed inputs and values confirmed at a gate are trusted. PerMIT mediates the release and use of untrusted environment-derived values through a finite memory interface, while preserving agent-driven multi-turn planning and tool choice. Over this finite interface, we prove two integrity theorems that are also machine-checked in Lean 4, which together ensure that environment-derived memory reaches a sensitive action only if confirmed at the gate and influences the agent's behavior only through what the gate displays. Every attack in our threat model thereby reduces to a single auditable decision, which a human, an LLM verifier, or both can make in practice. On Trojan Hippo, PerMIT records zero observed attack success with self-verification and lightweight verifiers. Because each confirmation is a logged verdict on exact content, endorsements accumulate across users, and sufficiently endorsed items become community-confirmed with no further verification required. Under explicit assumptions, we prove and corroborate in simulation a co-scaling property: as the community grows, the risks of promoting poison and of wrongly evicting benign knowledge fall, while per-user verification effort does not rise. On $τ^2$-bench, communities of up to 90 autonomous agents use PerMIT to build shared knowledge bases with no direct memory injection promoted, and the resulting knowledge significantly improves new agents on held-out tasks, suggesting a path toward agents that safely self-improve at test time.

AI.tldr: PerMIT 是一种带可证明完整性保证的智能体记忆架构，仅信任用户输入与闸门确认值，通过有限记忆接口中介环境派生值，实现防注入/投毒的可审计决策与社区共识扩展。
AI.motivation: 持久记忆是注入与投毒几乎无防护的攻击面，同一风险也限制智能体间的记忆共享。
AI.method: 提出 PerMIT：在显式信任假设下（仅信任用户键入输入与闸门确认的值），通过有限记忆接口中介不可信环境派生值的释放与使用，同时保留智能体驱动的多轮规划与工具选择；在该有限接口上证明两条完整性定理并用 Lean 4 机器验证；每次确认作为对确切内容的记录裁决，背书可跨用户累积，形成社区确认知识。
AI.result: Trojan Hippo 上自验证与轻量验证器下观测攻击成功率为零；证明并在仿真中印证协同扩展性（社区增大时投毒晋升与良性知识误驱逐风险下降，而单用户验证成本不升）；τ²-bench 上最多 90 个自主智能体的社区构建共享知识库，无直接记忆注入被晋升，且知识显著提升新智能体在留出任务上的表现。
AI.conclusion: PerMIT 将记忆攻击面收敛为单一可审计决策，为智能体安全共享记忆、在测试时安全自我改进提供了可行路径。

title: CloudIR-Bench: A Benchmark for Root Cause Analysis and Mitigation of Cloud Incidents
summary: Root cause analysis (RCA) and mitigation prediction are essential for incident management, enabling the identification of underlying causes of failures and ensuring the reliability of complex cloud-based systems. With rising incident volume and system complexity, incident reports have become a valuable resource for these tasks. Recent studies have shown promising results using Large Language Models (LLMs) to predict root causes and mitigation actions from textual descriptions in incident reports. Despite these advances, further progress is hindered by the lack of publicly available datasets; existing work relies on private data, which limits transparency, reproducibility, and generalization. To address this gap, we introduce CloudIR-Bench, the first publicly available benchmark providing a dataset and evaluation framework for incident report-based RCA and mitigation prediction. Curated from incident reports across five leading cloud-based systems, CloudIR-Bench captures a diverse range of real-world production scenarios representing authentic failures and engineers' reasoning. We also release an open-source evaluation framework that includes eight recent LLM-based approaches. Our comprehensive evaluation includes zero-shot and in-context learning experiments, along with a qualitative analysis to identify where and why LLMs fail. Benchmarking results reveal the capabilities and limitations of existing LLMs in this domain. The benchmark, including the dataset, framework and supplementary materials, is available at https://github.com/hoangtnm/CloudIR-Bench.

AI.tldr: 提出CloudIR-Bench，首个公开的基于事故报告的根因分析与缓解措施预测基准，含数据集与评测框架。
AI.motivation: 事故报告的RCA与缓解预测对云系统可靠性至关重要，但现有LLM研究依赖私有数据，缺乏透明度、可复现性与泛化性验证。
AI.method: 从五个主流云系统的事故报告中整理数据集，构建统一评测框架，集成八种近期LLM方法，并开展零样本、上下文学习实验及定性失败分析。
AI.result: 基准覆盖多样真实生产故障场景；实验揭示现有LLM在该任务上的能力与局限，并定位其失败原因。
AI.conclusion: CloudIR-Bench填补了公开数据与评测空白，数据集、框架与补充材料已开源，为后续研究提供可复现基础。

title: Guilt by Association: Semantic Leakage Drives Associative Gender Bias
summary: Semantic leakage occurs when a concept in the prompt steers model generation about an entity, even though the concept is irrelevant to it (e.g., a person who likes yellow is said to work as a school bus driver). It has mostly been studied in settings where the concept is directly attributed to the entity the model is asked about. This leaves open whether leakage is a flawed heuristic, where the model builds a profile of that entity, or a much broader associative tendency, e.g., working across seemingly unrelated entities. We argue for the latter: even after removing the attribution of the concept to the specific entity, leakage persists. Next, we extend this idea to gender bias. While work on gender bias in LMs typically looks at cases where the stereotyped concept is attributed to an entity, our findings suggest that a concept may steer outputs with its mere presence in the scene. We show this using gendered concepts under two conditions: when the subject engages with the concept, and when the concept just sits in the scene. We find that both shift model generation toward the stereotype to a similar extent. Together, our results suggest that semantic leakage drives a form of bias that is overlooked by current evaluations.

AI.tldr: 论文发现"语义泄漏"并非针对特定实体的画像式启发，而是一种更广泛的联想倾向：即使概念与被询问的实体无关，其出现本身（仅"在场"）也会以类似程度将生成推向刻板印象，这构成现有评测忽视的一种偏见。
AI.motivation: 以往语义泄漏研究局限于概念被直接归属到被询问实体的设定，因此不清楚泄漏究竟是模型为该实体构建画像的缺陷启发式，还是跨实体的更广泛联想倾向；同时性别偏见评测也只关注刻板概念被归属于实体的情况。
AI.method: 两步实验：(1) 去除概念对特定实体的归属后，检验泄漏是否仍存在；(2) 将同一思路扩展到性别偏见，在两种条件下比较——主体与概念发生交互（如参与某活动）vs. 概念仅存在于场景中（不交互），观察输出向刻板印象偏移的程度。
AI.result: 去除归属后语义泄漏依然持续，支持"广泛联想倾向"假说；在性别概念下，交互条件与仅"在场"条件都将模型生成推向刻板印象，且偏移程度相近。
AI.conclusion: 语义泄漏是一种超出实体归属的普遍联想机制，并驱动了一种当前评测所忽略的偏见形式；偏见评测需考虑概念"在场"本身的影响。

title: Pair-Free Coarse-to-Real Video Generation via Real-to-Coarse Image Supervision
summary: Coarse-to-real (C2R) video generation converts coarse animation, simulation, or game-rendered videos into photorealistic videos while preserving scene layout, camera motion, and dynamics. Training such models requires aligned (coarse, realistic) video pairs, which are expensive to create and confine prior systems to narrow synthetic domains. We exploit a simple asymmetry: paired videos are hard to obtain, but paired real-to-coarse images are easy to construct with existing editing and 3D reconstruction tools. Using these image pairs, we train the DINO-R2C model to transfer realistic images to coarse images in DINO feature space, and apply it frame-wise to ordinary real videos to synthesize pseudo-coarse videos. The C2R# model then learns to generate each real video from its pseudo-coarse counterpart, free from needing (coarse, realistic) video pairs. At inference, the DINO-R2C model is discarded and actual coarse videos drive the C2R# model directly. Thus, our pair-free training scales with any real-video corpora rather than with paired synthetic videos. We will release the model and project webpage at https://gonzalognogales.github.io/coarse2real-sharp/.

AI.tldr: 提出免配对训练的Coarse-to-real视频生成方法：利用易得的真实-粗糙图像对训练DINO-R2C在DINO特征空间做真实图→粗糙图变换，逐帧生成伪粗糙视频，再训C2R#模型从伪粗糙视频重建真实视频，推理时丢弃DINO-R2C。
AI.motivation: C2R视频生成需保持布局、相机运动与动态，但训练依赖昂贵且难以获取的对齐(粗糙,真实)视频对，导致现有系统只能局限于狭窄的合成域。
AI.method: 利用"真实→粗糙图像对易构造"的不对称性：用编辑与3D重建工具制作图像对，训练DINO-R2C在DINO特征空间进行图像风格/域转换；对其逐帧作用于普通真实视频合成伪粗糙视频；再以伪粗糙视频为条件训练C2R#重建对应真实视频。推理时仅用C2R#，由真实粗糙视频直接驱动。
AI.result: 无需任何(粗糙,真实)视频对即可训练C2R模型，训练数据可随任意真实视频语料扩展，而非受限于配对合成视频；将发布模型与项目主页。
AI.conclusion: 通过图像级配对替代视频级配对，实现可扩展的免配对C2R视频生成训练范式。

title: pplx-embed-v2-late Technical Report
summary: In this report, we introduce pplx-embed-v2-late, a pair of 0.6B and 9B multilingual and multimodal late-interaction models. Both models achieve state-of-the-art results within their respective size classes across a range of text, image, and visual document retrieval benchmarks. On visual document retrieval tasks, pplx-embed-v2-late-0.6b is competitive with models several times larger than itself. The models are trained via representation distillation from an 18B teacher. Consequently, they share an embedding space that supports asymmetric deployment: documents can be indexed with the 9B model and queried with the low-latency 0.6B model. Both models are available at https://huggingface.co/collections/perplexity-ai/pplx-embed-v2.

AI.tldr: 提出 pplx-embed-v2-late 系列（0.6B 与 9B）多语言、多模态 late-interaction 检索模型，通过 18B 教师模型表征蒸馏训练，在文本、图像、视觉文档检索的同尺寸类别中达到 SOTA，并支持 9B 建库 + 0.6B 查询的非对称部署。
AI.motivation: 现有嵌入模型难以同时兼顾多语言/多模态覆盖、检索质量与低延迟部署成本；大模型效果好但查询开销高，小模型效果不足。作者希望用一套共享嵌入空间的大小模型组合来解耦"索引成本"与"查询延迟"。
AI.method: 采用 late-interaction（多向量）架构，构造 0.6B 与 9B 一对模型；二者均从 18B 教师模型做表征蒸馏（representation distillation），从而对齐到同一嵌入空间，实现跨尺寸的兼容与可互换。
AI.result: 两模型在各自参数规模档位内于文本、图像、视觉文档检索基准上均取得 SOTA；在视觉文档检索上，0.6B 版本可媲美数倍于其规模的模型；共享嵌入空间使 9B 索引 + 0.6B 查询的非对称部署成为可能。
AI.conclusion: 通过蒸馏获得可跨尺寸共享的 late-interaction 嵌入空间，是一种兼顾检索质量、多模态能力与实际部署效率的实用方案；模型已开源发布（Hugging Face）。

title: ArcFlow: Training Flow Policies for Multiple Solver Budgets
summary: Flow-matching policies adjust inference cost through the number of solver steps, but reinforcement learning at a single fixed solver budget can hide degradation at cheaper deployment budgets and even erase useful one-step behavior present in a pretrained policy. We introduce Action-Ratio-Clip Flow (ArcFlow), a deployment-aware algorithm for training one flow policy across a specified range of solver budgets. ArcFlow combines action-aligned supervision, budget exposure, and worst-budget checkpoint selection. For reconstruction objectives, its bridge aggregates temporal probes into one surrogate ratio and one PPO-style clip per action, with a boundary residual exactly equal to deployed one-step reconstruction error. Cycling exposes the shared field to the deployment range, and selection optimizes its performance floor. For native velocity objectives, multi-budget endpoint supervision applies the same principle without replacing the native update. Both realizations preserve the architecture and deployment-time cost. Across DM Control, manipulation, and locomotion, ArcFlow attains the highest mean one-step return among five flow-policy baselines on 25 of 30 tasks under each method's reported training settings. Component studies identify complementary improvements from boundary supervision, the fixed-grid bridge, budget exposure, and deployment selection. These results establish deployment-budget-aware training as an effective route to strong low-step control with one policy serving multiple inference costs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ArcFlow，一种面向部署预算的流匹配策略训练算法，使单一策略在指定的多个求解步数预算下均表现良好，尤其擅长一步推理。
AI.motivation: 流匹配策略通过求解步数调节推理成本，但固定单一预算做强化学习会掩盖更低预算下的性能退化，甚至破坏预训练策略已有的一步行为。
AI.method: ArcFlow 结合动作对齐监督、预算暴露（循环训练覆盖部署预算范围）与最差预算检查点选择。重建目标下，其 bridge 将时间探针聚合成单一代理比率和每动作 PPO 式裁剪，边界残差恰等于部署侧一步重建误差；原生速度目标下，多预算端点监督沿用同一原则而不替换原生更新，且不改变架构与部署成本。
AI.result: 在 DM Control、操作与运动任务中，在各自报告的训练设置下，ArcFlow 在 30 个任务中的 25 个上取得五种流策略基线中最高的平均一步回报；消融显示边界监督、固定网格 bridge、预算暴露与部署选择各有互补增益。
AI.conclusion: 部署预算感知训练是获得强低步控制的有效途径，可用一个策略服务多种推理成本。

title: AgentPolicyForge: From Executable Environments to Policy Benchmarks and Adaptive Guards
summary: Customized agent deployments define policies over tools, resources, and execution conditions. Providing these policies in the task agent's prompt does not reliably prevent violations. Training a guard requires examples of tool calls that comply with or violate those policies. We introduce AgentPolicyForge, a framework that uses executable environments to construct policy benchmarks and iteratively train policy guards. With this framework, we construct PolicyGym, a dataset across ten policy families using 698 scenarios for training data generation and 254 separate held-out scenarios for human-reviewed test sets. Tool calls are executed and their outcomes recorded to help determine whether they comply with the policy. Every violating case uses a permitted tool, requiring checks of arguments, resources, and context rather than tool identity alone. The case construction process supports iterative guard training: an attacker generates requests using retrieved strategies, and the guard is fine-tuned on balanced, environment-verified examples. Training improves policy enforcement even with a fixed archive. Updating the archive further reduces in-domain attack success compared with keeping it fixed. We compare policy-aware task agent self-regulation with a trained policy guard. On PolicyGym, the final guard-based configuration achieves a 40-44% relative reduction in attack success rate and fewer benign rejections than policy prompting alone.

AI.tldr: 提出 AgentPolicyForge 框架与 PolicyGym 数据集，通过可执行环境生成策略违规样例并迭代训练策略守卫（guard），相比仅靠提示词，攻击成功率相对降低 40-44%，且误拒更少。
AI.motivation: 定制化智能体部署需对工具、资源和执行条件施加策略约束，但仅把策略写进任务智能体提示词无法可靠阻止违规；而训练守卫又缺少合规/违规工具调用样例。
AI.method: AgentPolicyForge 利用可执行环境构建策略基准并迭代训练守卫。基于此构建 PolicyGym：覆盖十类策略族，698 个场景用于训练数据生成，254 个独立留出场景构成人工审核测试集。工具调用被真实执行并记录结果以判定合规性；所有违规样例都使用被允许的工具，需检查参数、资源和上下文而非仅工具身份。构造流程支持迭代训练：攻击者用检索到的策略生成请求，守卫在平衡且经环境验证的样例上微调。
AI.result: 训练可持续提升策略执行效果，即使策略档案固定；更新档案比固定档案进一步降低域内攻击成功率。在 PolicyGym 上，最终守卫配置相较仅策略提示实现 40-44% 的攻击成功率相对下降，且良性拒绝更少。
AI.conclusion: 可执行环境驱动的样例生成与迭代训练是构建可靠策略守卫的有效途径，优于让任务智能体自我约束的策略提示方法。

title: Do Coding Agents Understand Why Systems Crash---and Why They Don't?
summary: Coding agents are increasingly capable of fixing real-world bugs, yet they still struggle with large systems codebases such as the Linux kernel. To understand why, we test how agents reason about execution in these codebases through crash reasoning: predicting from source code whether a given input crashes the system. A correct prediction alone, however, does not establish this ability, since it may come from merely spotting suspicious code. In this paper, we propose source interventions: we pair source trees that differ by a single commit, so that the same input crashes only one of them, and test whether agents predict crashes more often on the crashing tree. Experiments with four coding agents on SysRB, our dataset of 934 such pairs from Linux and OSS-Fuzz projects, yield three main findings. First, agents are biased toward predicting no crash: they rarely raise false alarms but miss many real crashes, and even the best agent misses over a quarter of them. Second, locating the code that determines the crash outcome is not enough: agents often misjudge its effect, especially when the crash occurs far from that code. Third, testing only on crashing code is misleading: agents that merely notice suspicious code predict crashes on both source trees, which would look like correct reasoning on the crashing tree alone. Together, these findings indicate that current coding agents cannot yet reliably reason about execution in complex systems codebases, and that paired evaluation is necessary to measure this ability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"源码干预"配对评测方法,构建SysRB数据集(934对仅在单个commit上不同的Linux/OSS-Fuzz源码树),测试编码代理的崩溃推理能力,发现代理强烈偏向预测"不崩溃"、能定位代码但误判其作用、且仅在崩溃代码上测试会产生误导。
AI.motivation: 编码代理虽能修复真实bug,但在Linux内核等大型系统代码库上仍表现不佳。为理解原因,作者通过"崩溃推理"(从源码预测给定输入是否使系统崩溃)来考察代理对执行过程的推理能力。但正确预测本身不足以证明该能力——代理可能只是"看出可疑代码"而蒙对,因此需要更严格的评测方式。
AI.method: 提出source interventions(源码干预):构造仅相差单个commit的源码树对,使同一输入只在其中一棵崩溃,再检验代理是否在崩溃树上更常预测崩溃。据此构建SysRB数据集,含来自Linux和OSS-Fuzz项目的934个源码对,并在四个编码代理上进行实验。
AI.result: 三点发现:(1)代理偏向预测"不崩溃",误报少但漏报多,最优代理漏掉超过四分之一的真实崩溃;(2)定位决定崩溃结果的代码并不足够,代理常误判其作用,尤其当崩溃点离该代码较远时;(3)只在崩溃代码上测试具有误导性——仅"发现可疑代码"的代理会在两棵树上都预测崩溃,单看崩溃树会误以为其推理正确。
AI.conclusion: 当前编码代理尚不能可靠地在复杂系统代码库中推理执行行为;配对的干预式评测是衡量该能力的必要手段。

title: Scan or Index? large Evidence Coverage, Answer Quality, and Cost in Long-Document RAG
summary: Scanning every passage in a long document seems thorough, but does it preserve more useful evidence or produce better answers? We compare 11 retrieval configurations spanning lexical and dense search, hybrid reranking, and full-document scanning with Jev, OpenAI Decisions, and Cloudflare Clef. Our evaluation uses 396 QASPER questions and 80 questions from eight complete textbooks, with common passages, a five-passage limit, and a fixed answer generator. On books, Hybrid + Jev achieves the highest observed evidence coverage (94.1%), compared with 88.7% for Jev full scan and 81.3\% for OpenAI dense retrieval.
