For agent builders the practical finding is that ingestion, not reasoning, is where this reliability is won or lost, and that the fix is cheap and measurable.

AI.tldr: 企业智能体的摄取层在各主流转换器中普遍丢失作者通过格式（高亮、颜色等）编码的语义，导致智能体"自信地犯错"；高亮与颜色是两个关键线索，而颜色是无人保留、无人评测却常见的线索。
AI.motivation: 智能体在文档上执行任务前需经摄取层把 Word/PDF 转为 token，而该层会静默丢失信息。作者指出被所有主流转换器丢失的那一层是"文本外观所编码的作者意图"，且这种丢失不表现为明显缺失，而是让智能体自信地给出错误答案，因此需要量化并定位这种损失。
AI.method: 基于 76 份真实政策文档构建任务：恢复作者特别标出的要求，使用文件自身 OOXML 属性作为标签、以确定性匹配器（无 LLM 评委）评分。对比格式盲摄取（docling、纯文本）与保留格式的方案，跨 6 个模型（5 个 Claude 各层级 + GPT-5.6）复现。用 span 级留一法定位失去作用的格式线索，在 PDF 上验证，并统计 6,460 份文档中颜色/高亮的使用率；再做预注册实验，检验显式"标注线索"是否优于仅保留线索；最后通过渲染页面图像（独立模态，kappa=0.72）验证标签，并给出纯文本可达上限（AUC 0.664）。
AI.result: 格式盲摄取使 micro F1 从 0.690 降至 0.150（docling）和 0.075（纯文本），该差距在 6 个模型上均可复现；docling 对未被作者标记要求的假阳性率是本文方法的 4 倍。留一法将损失定位到高亮（+0.302）与颜色（+0.262）两个线索（Holm 校正 p<1e-4），而加粗、斜体、等宽、删除线均在 ±0.003 内接近零；PDF 中呈相同不对称性。颜色是主流转换器均不保留、也无解析基准评测的线索，但很常见：32.8% 的文档带有刻意的颜色/高亮，10.3% 出现在义务条款上。预注册测试显示，为智能体显式键入线索比仅保留线索额外提升 +0.085（Holm 校正 p=0.049）。
AI.conclusion: 对智能体构建者而言，这类可靠性取决于摄取层而非推理层，且修复成本低、可度量；同时颜色是当前被转换器与评测基准共同忽视的高价值线索。

title: How Much Gradient Does Truncated Backprop Lose in Looped Transformers?
comment: 31 pages, 4 figures, 11 tables. Code, pre-registrations and results: https://github.com/Aur-Shalev-Merin/lost-gradient-looped-transformers
summary: Looped transformers reuse one block of layers many times and are often trained by backpropagating through only the last k loops. We measure how much of the weight gradient this throws away, exactly and for every k from one backward pass, on nine looped language models, and report three findings. First, on a trained model this lost gradient is set near the output: once the loop count is well above k, it barely changes with the loop count (within about 0.03 from 32 to 64 loops on the three models we tested, as a pre-registered test predicted for Parcae). Where the backward signal shrinks, $ρ^k$, with $ρ$ the signal's fitted shrink per loop, approximates it at moderate loop counts but overstates it at long ones, because the fitted $ρ$ drifts up as the fit takes in more loops. On Ouro the signal grows, and keeping two of four loops still loses 81% of the final output's gradient. Second, the lost gradient falls during fine-tuning, by 0.07-0.22 within 300 steps on three of four models, on held-out problems too. The fall is not just the read-out's share of the gradient; training only the layers outside the loop reproduced up to half of it, and it also falls under truncated training. So a trained model's value overstates what truncation removes later. Third, we could not show that it predicts the training cost of truncation better than rules that need no measurement: on two new models it tied Parcae's cost at the same k, in a test too small to separate them.

AI.tldr: 该论文测量了循环Transformer中"截断反向传播"（只回传最后k次循环）所丢弃的权重梯度比例，在九个循环语言模型上精确量化了从单次反向传播即可得到的全部k值下的损失，并给出三点发现：损失梯度主要集中在输出端且随循环数变化很小；损失梯度在微调中会下降；该指标尚不能证明优于无需测量的经验规则。
AI.motivation: 循环Transformer通过多次复用同一层块并在仅最后k次循环上反向传播来训练，这种做法会丢弃部分权重梯度，但其丢弃量的大小、随循环数的变化规律以及是否可用于预测截断训练代价，此前缺乏系统、精确的测量。
AI.method: 在九个循环语言模型上，利用一次反向传播精确计算每个k值下被截断丢弃的权重梯度，并对其进行量化分析；同时进行预注册检验（针对Parcae）、考察信号随循环数的收缩率ρ的拟合、以及在微调过程中和截断训练下的动态变化，并与不依赖测量的经验规则做对比。
AI.result: 1）损失梯度集中在输出附近，当循环数远大于k时几乎不随循环数变化（三个模型在32到64循环间差异约0.03）；ρ^k在中等循环数下能近似但长期高估，因拟合的ρ随纳入更多循环而上升；Ouro上信号增长，保留四循环中的两个仍损失最终输出梯度的81%。2）微调中损失梯度在300步内下降0.07-0.22（四个模型中三个，且在留出问题上同样成立），并非仅由读出层份额造成，仅训练循环外层的层可复现至多一半的下降，截断训练下也会下降。3）在两个新模型上与Parcae同k代价持平，测试规模不足以区分，无法证明其比无测量规则更好地预测截断训练代价。
AI.conclusion: 截断反向传播丢弃的梯度并非随循环数单调增长而是近似饱和，且会随训练/微调而减小，因此训练好的模型上的测量值会高估截断在后续训练中真正移除的梯度；同时该测量指标目前尚无法证明能优于简单的经验规则来预测截断训练的计算代价。

title: Context-Augmented, Session-Calibrated Blood Pressure Tracking from Photoplethysmography
summary: Objective.To distinguish the contributions of acquisition context and photoplethysmography (PPG) to session-calibrated blood pressure (BP) tracking.Approach. The original comparison used three repeats of five-fold participant-level cross-validation in 653 AuroraBP participants, excluding calibration-labelled prediction targets. Matched analyses separated context and PPG and removed elapsed-time terms. Later exploratory follow-ups retained PPG, accelerometer signals and three initial cuff readings. Separate studies evaluated pulse-rate fusion and an intraoperative VitalDB model. Main results.The original wearable-state model achieved participant-level mean absolute errors (MAEs) of 7.697/6.139 mmHg for systolic/diastolic BP (SBP/DBP). Added context reduced MAE by 0.436/0.126 mmHg (97.5% intervals 0.305-0.573/0.053-0.200). In the matched factorial without the external PPG prior, PPG improved on calibration, time and protocol-provided posture/activity by 0.214/0.135 mmHg; removing time left the DBP interval including zero. Standard PPG descriptors contributed, but additional nonlinear/attractor benefit was not established. In a separate follow-up series, a sensor-history ensemble achieved 7.299/5.445 mmHg versus its static-rich reference's 7.363/5.470, small gains of 0.064/0.025 mmHg. Larger DBP errors did not improve uniformly. Quality-weighted fusion reduced pulse-rate MAE from 3.985 to 3.690 beats per minute. VitalDB MAEs remained 15.375/8.833 mmHg despite small PPG gains. Significance. The contribution is a calibrated evaluation framework with explicit controls, reproducible feature-cache-to-results analyses and retained negative findings. The sensor-history gain is exploratory after repeated dataset reuse. Independently estimated wearable states, complete raw-signal reproduction of the supplied richer features, external transfer and clinical adequacy remain unestablished.

AI.tldr: 该研究通过严格对照的校准评估框架，区分采集情境（context）与PPG本身对基于校准的血压（BP）跟踪的贡献，发现两者增益均较小，并保留了多项阴性结果。
AI.motivation: 原研究中可穿戴状态模型对BP的改善可能源自采集情境（姿势、活动、时间）而非PPG信号本身，需要厘清各自贡献，并避免因数据集重复使用而产生的乐观偏差。
AI.method: 使用AuroraBP数据集653名参与者，进行3次重复的五折参与者级交叉验证，排除校准时标注的预测目标；采用匹配的析因分析分离情境与PPG并去除流逝时间项；后续探索性分析保留PPG、加速度计信号与三次初始袖带读数；另行评估脉搏率融合与术中VitalDB模型。
AI.result: 原始可穿戴状态模型SBP/DBP的MAE为7.697/6.139 mmHg；加入情境使MAE降低0.436/0.126 mmHg；无外部PPG先验的匹配析因中，PPG相对校准、时间及协议给定时段姿势/活动改善0.214/0.135 mmHg，去除时间后DBP区间包含零；传感器历史集成模型为7.299/5.445 mmHg，仅比静态丰富参考改善0.064/0.025 mmHg；质量加权融合使脉搏率MAE从3.985降至3.690 bpm；VitalDB MAE仍为15.375/8.833 mmHg。
AI.conclusion: 论文贡献在于一个带显式对照、可复现（feature-cache到结果）并保留阴性发现的校准评估框架；传感器历史增益因数据集重复使用而属探索性，独立估计的可穿戴状态、完整原始信号复现、外部迁移及临床充分性仍未确立。

title: Engineering Requirements for Generative AI Agents: The BARD Process Theory
comment: Accepted at the 49th IEEE/ACM International Conference on Software Engineering (ICSE 2027)
summary: How teams engineer requirements for systems built around Generative AI (GenAI) Agents remains empirically uncharted. Existing Requirements Engineering (RE) research mainly addresses AI and ML-based systems broadly but provides no process account for agentic systems, whose non-deterministic behavior cannot be anticipated at design time. To understand how teams actually proceed, we applied Socio-Technical Grounded Theory across 36 semi-structured interviews with practitioners, interleaving data collection and analysis so that emerging findings drove our theoretical sampling and shaped successive rounds of coding. The result is Behavioral Agent Requirement Discovery (BARD), the process theory of RE for GenAI Agents. BARD holds that requirements are not fixed up front but discovered through a recurring cycle of four activities: teams scope the need, build the agent, observe its behavior, and revise what they ask for. Through this four-phase loop, the requirement evolves from a fixed specification towards behavioral and evaluation criteria. Four tensions drive transitions between phases, and two conditions frame the loop. BARD provides researchers with a framework for iteratively refining RE workflows, while giving practitioners a structured basis to embed into their development processes.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出BARD（Behavioral Agent Requirement Discovery）过程理论，揭示GenAI Agent需求不是预先固定的，而是通过"界定需求—构建智能体—观察行为—修订需求"的四阶段循环被逐步发现。
AI.motivation: 现有RE研究主要针对广义AI/ML系统，缺少对Agentic系统的过程性解释；而Agent的非确定性行为无法在设计阶段被预先预测，团队究竟如何为GenAI Agent开展需求工程在实证上仍是空白。
AI.method: 采用社会技术扎根理论（Socio-Technical Grounded Theory），对36位从业者进行半结构化访谈，数据收集与分析交替进行，以涌现发现驱动理论抽样并开展多轮编码。
AI.result: 构建了BARD过程理论：需求通过四活动循环（scope the need、build the agent、observe its behavior、revise what they ask for）持续演化，需求形态从固定规格转向行为与评估标准；四个张力驱动阶段间转换，两个条件框定循环边界。
AI.conclusion: BARD为研究者提供迭代精化RE工作流的理论框架，为从业者提供可嵌入开发流程的结构化依据。

title: Why is AI-generated language so hard to understand?
summary: There is a widespread sense that AI-generated text has recently become harder to understand. In this study, we investigate a set of psycholinguistic features that are known to correlate with human processing difficulty (e.g., object relative clauses, long syntactic dependencies, low-frequency n-grams). Using a novel corpus of AI-generated text across diverse domains, we find that AI models use these difficult features more often than paraphrases generated by round-trip translation. Compared with human writing, all nine frontier and near-frontier models use more inanimate subjects with animate verbs and more low-frequency n-grams, and most also use longer dependencies, more stacked nouns, and more reduced object relatives in conversation; we also demonstrate substantial variation across model families. We propose and test a hypothesis as to why: while human language is optimized for successful communication, AI-generated text is increasingly optimized for other goals like math, code, and reasoning, in which there is a pressure for \textit{information density} rather than successful communication. We provide a proof-of-concept for this hypothesis by fine-tuning a language model under a length penalty, which leads to a divergence from human-like linguistic behavior. Our findings highlight the axes of misalignment between linguistic processing demands in humans and LLMs, and point toward possible remedies.

AI.tldr: AI生成文本比人类写作和回译改写包含更多增加人类阅读难度的心理语言学特征，其根源可能是模型优化目标（信息密度）而非成功交流。
AI.motivation: 普遍感觉AI生成文本越来越难以理解，但缺乏系统证据说明是哪些语言特征导致困难，以及为何会出现这种偏差。
AI.method: 构建跨领域AI生成文本新语料，提取与人类加工难度相关的心理语言学特征（宾语关系从句、长句法依存、低频n-gram等），对比AI文本、回译改写文本与人类写作，并测试九个前沿/近前沿模型及不同模型家族；另通过长度惩罚微调语言模型做概念验证。
AI.result: 九个模型均比人类使用更多无生命主语搭配有生动词和更多低频n-gram；多数模型还有更长依存、更多名词堆叠、对话中更多缩减宾语关系从句；模型家族间差异显著；长度惩罚微调使模型语言行为偏离人类。
AI.conclusion: AI文本与人类语言加工需求存在系统性错位，源于优化目标从成功交流转向信息密度（数学、代码、推理）；研究指出了可能的人机语言对齐改进方向。

title: Weakly Supervised Fish Segmentation through Point-Supervised Tracking and Motion-Informed Language
comment: Accepted to IEEE OCEANS 2026 Monterey, 7 pages
summary: Understanding the properties of fish populations is increasingly important. Analyzing fish length, width, and mass is integral to maintaining healthy stock in the aquaculture industry, while counting wild fish populations supports marine conservation and coastal reef restoration efforts. Deep learning-based segmentation models offer a promising means of obtaining such information at scale. Most of these models, however, require costly and time-consuming per-pixel segmentation labels for training, which can take up to two minutes per fish to annotate manually. To address this inefficiency, we propose a weakly supervised segmentation pipeline that requires only point-labeled data (one click per fish) to produce accurate segmentation masks. Our pipeline consists of four stages. First, a point-supervised tracker predicts point annotations for each frame. These points are then converted into motion-informed language expressions, which guide a language-conditioned segmentation model (LMPM++) to capture temporal consistency and produce candidate segmentation masks. Finally, optical flow and background subtraction are applied as post-processing filters to suppress noise from incorrect segmentations. Experiments on the DeepFish dataset show improvement in foreground mean intersection over union (mIoU) as compared to baseline models.

AI.tldr: 提出弱监督鱼类分割流程，仅需每帧一次点击的点标注即可生成准确分割掩码，在DeepFish上前景mIoU优于基线。
AI.motivation: 鱼类长度、宽度、质量分析及野外鱼群计数对水产养殖和海洋保护很重要，而深度学习分割模型通常需要昂贵的逐像素标注（每条鱼可达两分钟），因此需要降低标注成本。
AI.method: 四阶段流程：(1) 点监督跟踪器预测每帧的点标注；(2) 将点转换为运动感知的语言表达；(3) 用语言条件分割模型LMPM++结合时序一致性生成候选掩码；(4) 用光流和背景减除作为后处理过滤错误分割噪声。
AI.result: 在DeepFish数据集上，前景mIoU相比基线模型有所提升。
AI.conclusion: 点标注驱动的弱监督分割管线可在显著降低标注成本的同时取得准确分割效果，适用于大规模鱼类监测。

title: LEAN: Loss-Engineered Modulation of the Model Weight-Sensitivity Distribution for Efficient, Error-Tolerant Neural Networks
summary: The weights of a trained network do not have uniform sensitivity to model accuracy: the 1% most sensitive weights carry about a fifth of the damage a bit flip can do. This distribution decides the bit-flip tolerance of a model, the fraction of weights a code must cover and the bits each weight needs; existing schemes work with the distribution training leaves. We show that we can systematically modulate or alter the weight sensitivity distribution of a trained model, thereby shifting weights from one sensitivity bin to another. The sensitivity of a stored weight is the product of its gradient and the step a flip takes in the storage format, and LEAN adds a composite regularizer on both factors, a range term that bounds the flip step and a tail term that lowers the gradient of the most sensitive weights, with one coefficient λ setting how far the distribution moves. Ten epochs with the term, as a fine-tune or as the last epochs of training, shrink the sensitive tail 5 to 13 times on nine vision models (ResNet-18, ResNet-50, VGG-16 on CIFAR-10, CIFAR-100, ImageNet) within 0.5 points of accuracy; real flips confirm that the reshaped weights do less damage, a plain gradient-norm penalty does not reproduce the effect, and a preliminary extension to three small language models shows the same tail shaping. With a BCH code over 1% of the weights the model then survives 300 progressive bit-search flips in every training seed and 500 in two of three, where three of four published defenses with the same code fail by 300 and WCAT falls to 75% at 500. The reshaped distribution also cuts the parity for a fixed guarantee 3.7 times and makes a sensitivity-ordered 8/6/4/3-bit format affordable, which stores ImageNet ResNet-50 at a 3.29-bit weight payload, 2.4 times smaller than INT8, above the accuracy of LSQ at 3 bits.

AI.tldr: 提出LEAN方法，通过复合正则项主动重塑训练后模型的权重敏感度分布，使少量BCH码覆盖即可显著提升抗比特翻转能力并降低存储开销。
AI.motivation: 训练网络的权重对精度敏感度极不均匀（1%最敏感权重承担约1/5的比特翻转损害），该分布决定了模型的比特翻转容忍度、编码需覆盖的权重比例及每位所需比特数；现有方案只能被动接受训练留下的分布，无法主动调控。
AI.method: 利用"存储权重敏感度=梯度×该翻转在存储格式中的步长"的乘积结构，LEAN在两方面加复合正则：range项约束翻转步长，tail项压低最敏感权重的梯度，由单一系数λ控制分布迁移幅度；仅需10个epoch（作为微调或训练末段）。
AI.result: 在9个视觉模型（ResNet-18/50、VGG-16 × CIFAR-10/100/ImageNet）上敏感尾部缩小5–13倍，精度损失<0.5点；真实翻转验证重塑后权重损害更小；普通梯度范数惩罚无此效果；3个小语言模型初步显示同样尾部塑形。1%权重BCH码下，所有种子可抗300次渐进比特搜索翻转，2/3种子抗500次（4个已发表防御中3个在300次即失败，WCAT在500次降至75%）。固定保证下校验位减少3.7倍，支持8/6/4/3比特敏感度排序格式，ImageNet ResNet-50以3.29-bit载荷存储，比INT8小2.4倍且精度高于3-bit LSQ。
AI.conclusion: 权重敏感度分布可被系统性地调制，LEAN以极低精度代价换来更强的抗比特翻转鲁棒性与编码效率，为可靠存储与量化部署提供新思路，并可扩展至语言模型。

title: Same Answer, Different Reasons: Trace-Level Divergence in Multilingual Large Language Models
summary: Multilingual large language models are increasingly deployed in settings where visible reasoning traces support verification, education, and safety auditing, yet standard evaluations typically measure only final-answer agreement or holistic response similarity. As a result, they establish outcome consistency without determining whether users across languages receive comparable supporting evidence. We introduce a trace-level divergence framework that compares visible reasoning traces as structured sequences, decomposing agreement into structural similarity, order consistency, and holistic similarity, with pair-specific calibration to enable comparison across languages. Across three reasoning benchmarks, seven languages, and six frontier LLMs, the natural baseline---embedding each whole response and comparing the two by cosine---systematically overstates agreement: $52.1\%$--$67.3\%$ of examples in the top quartile of holistic similarity are not in the top quartile of structural similarity. This dissociation is stable across sentence encoders and step segmentations, and blind bilingual annotation studies in two English-anchored language pairs show that human judgments align with structural similarity rather than with the holistic baseline. A same-language control shows that the level of divergence is language-specific: two English traces for paraphrases of the same question agree more closely than an English trace and its counterparts in other languages. Our results show that answer-level and holistic evaluations can substantially overestimate the consistency of multilingual explanatory artifacts, motivating trace-level evaluation for reliable multilingual deployment.

AI.tldr: 论文指出多语言LLM评估只看最终答案或整体响应相似度会高估一致性，提出trace-level divergence框架，将可见推理链的跨语言一致性分解为结构、顺序、整体相似度，并发现整体相似度会系统性高估结构与人类判断下的跨语言一致性。
AI.motivation: 多语言大模型越来越多地以可见推理链（reasoning traces）支持验证、教育和安全审计，但标准评估只测最终答案一致或整体响应相似度，只能证明"结果一致"，无法判断不同语言用户是否获得可比的支撑证据。
AI.method: 提出trace-level divergence框架：把可见推理链视为结构化序列进行比较，将一致性分解为结构相似度、顺序一致性和整体相似度，并针对语言对做配对校准以便跨语言比较。实验覆盖3个推理基准、7种语言、6个前沿LLM；包含对句编码器与步骤切分的稳定性检验、两个以英语为锚的语料对的双语盲标注研究，以及同语言对照（英文释义对照）。
AI.result: 基线方法（对整段响应做embedding后算余弦相似度）系统性高估一致性：在整体相似度前四分位的样本中，有52.1%–67.3%并不位于结构相似度前四分位；该分离在句编码器和步骤切分变化下稳定。双语盲标注显示人类判断更贴合结构相似度而非整体基线。同语言对照表明分歧程度具有语言特异性：同一问题的两个英文推理链比英文与其他语言对应链更为接近。
AI.conclusion: 答案级与整体性评估会显著高估多语言解释性产物的跨语言一致性，因此可靠的多语言部署需要trace-level（推理链级）评估。

title: Metamodel-Guided LLM Decoding for Consistent DSL Generation
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to generate software engineering artifacts written in domain-specific languages (DSLs). Correct DSL instances usually must comply with not only the concrete syntax but also the abstract syntax defined by a metamodel augmented with semantic well-formedness constraints. Existing constrained decoding approaches typically guarantee compliance only with concrete syntax or with a limited set of semantic constraints expressed over the generated text, making metamodel-level constraint consistency difficult to enforce during generation. We present MeMoDecode: a decoding framework that enforces a DSL's concrete syntax, abstract syntax, and well-formedness constraints jointly. Specifically, whenever the LLM generates a complete metamodel concept, MeMoDecode incrementally maps the current output to a partial model and verifies whether it can still be completed into a consistent instance. We combine MeMoDecode with a simple retry mechanism that resumes decoding from the most recent completable snapshot whenever an inconsistency is detected. Under a sound backend verifier, MeMoDecode never performs worse than grammar-constrained decoding on alignment metrics satisfying natural assumptions. Across four DSLs and six open-weight LLMs ranging from 0.6B to 70B parameters, MeMoDecode achieves the highest consistency, improving consistency by 23% on average over unconstrained decoding and by 8% on average over grammar-constrained decoding. It also improves benchmark performance while incurring only modest runtime overhead. These results show that metamodel-guided decoding is an effective approach for enforcing DSL consistency during decoding across diverse DSLs and LLM scales.

AI.tldr: MeMoDecode 提出一种解码框架，在 LLM 生成 DSL 工件时联合强制具体语法、抽象语法（元模型）及良构性约束：每当生成一个完整元模型概念，就将输出增量映射为部分模型并检验其可补全性，配合重试机制从最近可补全快照恢复解码。在4个DSL、6个0.6B–70B模型上一致性最优，较无约束解码平均提升23%、较语法约束解码平均提升8%，且性能提升、开销适中。
AI.motivation: LLM 越来越多用于生成 DSL 软件工件，正确实例不仅需满足具体语法，还需满足元模型定义的抽象语法与语义良构性约束。现有约束解码通常只保证具体语法或少量基于文本表达的语义约束，难以在生成过程中保证元模型级约束一致性。
AI.method: 提出 MeMoDecode 解码框架：当 LLM 生成一个完整的元模型概念时，增量地将当前输出映射为部分模型，验证其是否仍可补全为一致实例；并结合简单重试机制，在检测到不一致时从最近的可补全快照恢复解码。理论上在可靠后端验证器下，MeMoDecode 在满足自然假设的对齐指标上不劣于语法约束解码。
AI.result: 在4种DSL、6个0.6B–70B参数的开源模型上，MeMoDecode 一致性最高：相比无约束解码平均提升23%，相比语法约束解码平均提升8%；同时提升基准测试性能，仅带来适度运行时开销。
AI.conclusion: 元模型引导解码是在解码阶段强制 DSL 一致性的有效方法，可跨多种 DSL 与不同规模 LLM 适用。

title: Carving Radiology Reports at Their Evidential Joints: Anatomical Region Sets as Generation Units
summary: Organizing radiology reports into independently generated units offers a way to generate fine-grained clinical content and bind it to visual evidence. However, existing methods typically adopt generation-unit structures not directly specified in natural reports or their annotations, introducing additional modeling compromises. We propose RadCarve, which instead defines generation units directly from the anatomical region sets in existing statement-region correspondences, unifying unit formation with visual evidence selection. RadCarve's planner uses composition-specialized query banks to jointly predict unit existence and region composition from the image, iteratively refining both with regional evidence aggregated according to current membership predictions. The generator independently produces each unit's text conditioned on the joint visual evidence of its predicted region set. Compared with strong baselines, RadCarve improves CXRFEScore by 9.4% in unit generation given region sets and achieves 2.4 times the end-to-end binding F1. It also achieves leading report-generation results on Chest ImaGenome and PadChest-GR, using fewer than one-sixth as many parameters as large-scale baselines.

AI.tldr: RadCarve 直接从已有语句-区域对应关系中的解剖区域集合定义生成单元，使单元划分与视觉证据选择统一，并以组合专用查询库预测单元存在与区域组成，实现细粒度放射报告生成与区域绑定。
AI.motivation: 现有放射报告生成方法生成的单元结构并非直接来自自然报告或其标注，导致额外建模折衷；且单元划分与视觉证据选择相互割裂。
AI.method: RadCarve 的 planner 使用组合专用查询库，从图像联合预测单元是否存在及其区域组成，并依据当前成员预测聚合区域证据进行迭代精化；generator 以预测区域集合的联合视觉证据为条件，独立生成每个单元的文本。
AI.result: 在给定区域集合的单元生成任务上，CXRFEScore 提升 9.4%；端到端绑定 F1 达到强基线的 2.4 倍；在 Chest ImaGenome 与 PadChest-GR 上取得领先的报告生成效果，参数量不足大规模基线的六分之一。
AI.conclusion: 将生成单元直接锚定于解剖区域集合可消除额外折衷，统一单元形成与视觉证据选择，从而在更少参数下实现更优的细粒度生成与绑定性能。

title: OccJEPA: Occlusion as Masking for Amodal Video Segmentation
comment: 20 pages (8-page main paper + supplementary material). Code: https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa
summary: Amodal video segmentation asks for the complete mask of an object in every frame, including the parts hidden behind other objects. The best current methods generate these masks with fine-tuned video diffusion models, which need many denoising steps and an extra depth network, and give a different answer for every sample. Self-supervised video world models of the JEPA family are trained on a closely related task: predicting the representation of masked space-time regions from the visible ones. We therefore treat occlusion as masking. The tokens that the object's visible mask does not cover are dropped, the pre-trained V-JEPA 2.1 predictor fills them in, and a light head decodes the observed and predicted features into amodal masks. The resulting model, OccJEPA (Occlusion-as-masking JEPA), is deterministic and 33.5x faster than the diffusion-based state of the art, and more accurate on SAIL-VOS, on TAO-Amodal, including a held-out test split (+4.00 AP50) and visible masks tracked by SAM2, and on Kubric. Controlled experiments trace the gain to the predictor's pre-trained weights rather than to its capacity, for world models from 87M to 1.85B parameters. Code is available at https://github.com/zgp110/occjepa.

AI.tldr: OccJEPA将遮挡视为掩码，利用V-JEPA 2.1预测器补全被遮挡token，实现确定性、33.5倍加速的非模态视频分割，精度超过扩散方法。
AI.motivation: 现有非模态分割方法依赖微调视频扩散模型，需多步去噪和额外深度网络，且每次采样结果不一致（非确定性），效率低。
AI.method: 把遮挡当作掩码：丢弃物体可见掩码未覆盖的token，用预训练V-JEPA 2.1预测器填补这些token，再用轻量头将观测与预测特征解码为非模态掩码。
AI.result: 在SAIL-VOS、TAO-Amodal（含留出测试集+4.00 AP50、SAM2跟踪可见掩码）和Kubric上更准确，且比扩散SOTA快33.5倍；控制实验表明增益来自预测器预训练权重而非容量（87M–1.85B参数）。
AI.conclusion: 自监督视频世界模型的掩码预测能力可自然迁移到非模态分割，提供高效确定性方案，关键在预训练权重。

title: Actually, All Learnable Distribution Classes Are Privately Learnable
summary: We show that every class of distributions that is learnable up to arbitrarily small target error in total variation distance with finitely many samples is also learnable under ($\varepsilon, δ$)-differential privacy up to arbitrarily small target error with finitely many samples. This proves a conjecture of Ashtiani. Previous work by Bun, Kamath, Mouzakis, and Singhal [arXiv:2402.00267] gave a weak refutation of this conjecture, showing that this implication is not true when learnability is defined with respect to a fixed target error. In contrast, we show that, under the standard definition of learnability, the conjecture is true.

AI.tldr: 证明Ashtiani猜想：在标准PAC意义下，凡能用有限样本把总变差误差学至任意小分布类，也能在(ε,δ)-差分隐私约束下用有限样本达到任意小误差。
AI.motivation: 此前Bun等(arXiv:2402.00267)在"固定目标误差"的学性定义下弱反驳了Ashtiani猜想，作者希望澄清：在标准可学性定义下猜想是否成立。
AI.method: 理论证明。区分"任意小目标误差"(标准定义)与"固定目标误差"两种可学性表述，构造性/归约式论证把非隐私学习者转化为满足(ε,δ)-差分隐私且样本有限的学习器。
AI.result: 在标准定义下证明了该蕴含关系成立，从而证实Ashtiani猜想；并指出先前反例源于学习性定义的差异(固定目标误差)，两者并不矛盾。
AI.conclusion: 隐私并不在标准PAC式可学性层面带来额外障碍，"有限样本学到任意小TV误差"即可推出隐私可学；论文厘清了与既有反驳工作的定义分歧。

title: GRAM: Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging via Subspace Alignment
summary: Merging different models into a single model is highly desirable for multi-task deployment, particularly in regulated domains like healthcare. In such settings, models are often locally fine-tuned due to strict data privacy policies, necessitating that aggregation operates exclusively on the fine-tuned weights. Existing methods apply a uniform merge across all tasks, ignoring the geometric relationships among their learned subspaces. When task updates occupy misaligned subspaces, projecting them onto a shared low-rank basis discards task-relevant directions, a failure mode named \emph{subspace interference}. Through this study, we show that the per-task projection error of a merged model is governed by the principal-angle alignment between each task and the shared subspace, so that grouping geometrically compatible tasks provably reduces this error within each group. Motivated by this observation, we propose \textbf{Group-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging (GRAM)}, which uses the principal-angle geometry of task vectors to decide which tasks should be merged together and then performs a standard SVD-based merge within each coalition; the pipeline requires only the fine-tuned weights at merge time. With only one additional model ($\nK{=}2$), GRAM significantly mitigates subspace interference and consistently outperforms prior merging methods across language understanding (GLUE with Flan-T5), 8-task CLIP vision, and medical instruction tuning (Qwen2-7B-Instruct with four English/Chinese medical LoRAs).

AI.tldr: 提出 GRAM，利用任务向量间的主角度几何关系对任务分组，再在组内做SVD合并，仅需微调权重即可缓解"子空间干扰"问题。
AI.motivation: 多任务部署中需将多个本地微调模型（受隐私限制，只能用微调后的权重）合并为单一模型。现有方法对所有任务做统一合并，忽略了各自学习子空间的几何关系；当任务更新处于不对齐子空间时，投影到共享低秩基会丢失任务相关方向，即"子空间干扰"。
AI.method: 理论上证明合并模型的逐任务投影误差由各任务与共享子空间之间的主角度对齐程度决定，因而将几何相容的任务分组可证明地降低组内误差。据此提出GROUP-wise Rank-Aware Model Merging (GRAM)：用任务向量的主角度几何关系决定哪些任务应合并到一组，然后每组内做标准SVD合并；整个流程在合并时只需微调权重。
AI.result: 在K=2（仅增加一个模型）的情况下，GRAM显著缓解子空间干扰，并在语言理解（GLUE + Flan-T5）、8任务CLIP视觉、以及医疗指令微调（Qwen2-7B-Instruct + 四个中英文医疗LoRA）上持续优于已有合并方法。
AI.conclusion: 按几何相容性分组再合并，是缓解子空间干扰的有效且轻量的策略，适用于隐私受限场景下的多任务模型合并，尤其适合医疗等合规领域。

title: VeruSteer: Learning What to Repair Next in Verus
summary: LLM-based verification systems repair Rust proofs by revising programs in response to Verus diagnostics. When several error types are reported, pipelines such as AutoVerus and VeruSAGE select the next repair target using a preset priority. Yet each repair changes the program and the errors that follow, so the same reported types can require different choices at different states. We present VeruSteer, which learns to select error types from the outcomes of alternative repair trajectories. It constructs repair trees offline and compares paths from the same initial program by verification success, repair rounds, and final verification progress. These comparisons supervise a selector that combines step-wise imitation with trajectory preference ranking. The selector uses self-attention over the program, verifier feedback, and earlier selections to rank the currently reported types. It replaces the default priority within a single repair trajectory, keeping the existing repair agents and adding no repair or verifier calls for selection. We evaluate VeruSteer by replaying its choices on stored AutoVerus and VeruSAGE test trees under four generation configurations. Across 1,270 test trees, VeruSteer increases verified outcomes from 185 to 194 (14.57\% to 15.28\%), gaining 12 successes and losing three for a net improvement of 0.71 percentage points. Among trees where the default fails but a recorded alternative verifies, VeruSteer succeeds on 3 of 4 AutoVerus trees and 9 of 11 VeruSAGE trees. Among trees with recorded alternatives where the default verifies, it retains success on 14 of 15 AutoVerus trees and 12 of 14 VeruSAGE trees. It also finds shorter successful trajectories and improves final progress on some trees where all recorded trajectories fail.

AI.tldr: VeruSteer 学习如何从多条修复轨迹的结果中选择下一条要修复的错误类型，替代 AutoVerus/VeruSAGE 中固定的优先级策略，在不增加修复或验证调用的情况下小幅提升验证成功率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于 LLM 的 Rust/Verus 证明修复系统（如 AutoVerus、VeruSAGE）在同时报告多种错误时，按预设优先级选择下一个修复目标。但每次修复都会改变程序和后续错误，相同错误类型在不同状态下可能需要不同选择，固定优先级因此次优。
AI.method: 离线构建修复树，比较同一初始程序下各修复路径的验证成功、修复轮数与最终验证进展；以此监督一个选择器，结合逐步模仿学习与轨迹偏好排序。选择器用自注意力对程序、验证器反馈和历史选择编码，对当前报告的错误类型排序。它直接嵌入单条修复轨迹，替换默认优先级，复用原有修复智能体，选择过程不额外调用修复器或验证器。
AI.result: 在四种生成配置下的 AutoVerus 与 VeruSAGE 测试树上回放选择：1,270 棵树中验证成功数从 185 增至 194（14.57%→15.28%），净增 12 成功、丢失 3 个，提升 0.71 个百分点。在默认失败但存在可验证替代方案的树中，AutoVerus 4 棵成功 3 棵，VeruSAGE 11 棵成功 9 棵；在默认成功且有替代方案的树中，AutoVerus 15 棵保持 14 棵，VeruSAGE 14 棵保持 12 棵。同时能找到更短的 successful 轨迹，并在全部记录轨迹均失败的树上改善部分树的最终进展。
AI.conclusion: 数据驱动的错误类型选择优于固定优先级，但整体收益有限（+0.71pp），且存在少量回退，说明选择器仍有改进空间。

title: TrainBridge: Agentic NPU Training Optimization Guided by GPU Compilation Evidence
summary: We study how to improve training efficiency on Ascend NPUs. In the NPU training programs we study, framework-level compilation optimizations such as operator fusion are only partially applied, leaving fragmented computation and avoidable execution overheads. Profiling-guided tuning can address these inefficiencies, but it often requires costly trial and error. To make training on NPUs more efficient, we propose TrainBridge, an agentic approach for transferring GPU optimization guidance to NPU training. TrainBridge uses the highly optimized execution produced by mature GPU compilation stacks as a task-specific reference for NPU tuning. It extracts optimization intents from the GPU training execution to guide NPU program rewrites and further refines the rewritten program through iterative profiling. Our GPU-to-NPU migration experiments show that TrainBridge achieves an average 1.7x speedup across four workloads covering LLM pretraining, image classification, and vision-language training, and an average speedup of nearly 2.0x across 27 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun records with highly optimized GPU implementations.

AI.tldr: TrainBridge：利用成熟 GPU 编译栈的优化执行作为参考，提取优化意图指导 NPU 程序重写并结合迭代 profiling 精调，从而把 GPU 优化经验迁移到 Ascend NPU 训练，平均加速 1.7x，在 27 个 Modded-NanoGPT 记录上近 2.0x。
AI.motivation: NPU 训练中框架级编译优化（如算子融合）仅部分应用，留下碎片化计算和可避免的执行开销；profiling 引导的调优虽有效但需昂贵试错。作者希望以已高度优化的 GPU 执行作为"参考答案"，低成本地把优化经验迁移到 NPU。
AI.method: 提出 agentic 的 TrainBridge 方法：以成熟 GPU 编译栈产生的优化执行作为任务特定参考，从中提取优化意图（optimization intents），据此指导 NPU 程序重写，再通过迭代 profiling 进一步精化重写后的程序。
AI.result: GPU→NPU 迁移实验中，在覆盖 LLM 预训练、图像分类、视觉-语言训练的 4 个工作负载上平均加速 1.7x；在 27 个高度优化的 Modded-NanoGPT speedrun 记录上平均加速近 2.0x。
AI.conclusion: 以 GPU 优化执行为参考、由 agent 提取意图并配合 profiling 迭代重写，是一种有效的 NPU 训练加速路径，且在高优化基线下仍能获得显著收益。

title: ReSeg: Retraining-free segmentation of abdominal organs via generalizable semantic representation learning
summary: Abdominal organ segmentation is essential in modern medical applications. While existing deep learning approaches demonstrate promising performance, their heavy reliance on large-scale image data raises concerns over generalization capability and privacy risks. This motivates the development of generalizable segmentation training paradigms based on domain-randomized image synthesis, facilitating generalization across unseen real image domains. However, existing paradigms either suffer from limited segmentation performance when applied to abdominal organs, or require dataset-specific finetuning. To address these limitations, we propose ReSeg, a novel two-stage retraining-free framework for domain-agnostic zero-shot abdominal organ segmentation. At the first stage, our organ-agnostic synthetic data-driven pretraining approach exploits semantically and visually diverse synthetic images generated by a dedicated data engine to optimize a Generalizable Semantic Representation Network (GSRNet). The network is thereby capable of learning semantic features robust against variations in anatomical structure, imaging contrast, resolution and spatial context, which provide universal representation capabilities that serve as a foundation for segmentation learning. Subsequently, in the second stage, we continue to train an Organ-specific Encoder-decoder Segmentation Network (OESNet), whose encoder is initialized with the pretrained weights. This training process is facilitated by another dedicated data engine, which generates diversified visual images while strictly retaining the inherent spatial layout of abdominal organs. Comprehensive evaluation on seven abdominal organ segmentation datasets across three different modalities including CT, MRI, and PET demonstrates that ReSeg consistently outperforms existing state-of-the-art (SOTA) methods while eliminating the need for real training images.

AI.tldr: ReSeg：一种无需微调的两阶段域随机合成数据训练框架，实现跨模态零样本腹部器官分割。
AI.motivation: 现有深度学习分割方法依赖大规模真实图像，存在泛化性差与隐私风险；现有基于域随机化合成数据的范式在腹部器官上性能有限，或需针对数据集微调。
AI.method: 两阶段免重训练框架：第一阶段用专用数据引擎生成语义与视觉多样的合成图像，预训练通用语义表征网络GSRNet；第二阶段用严格保留器官空间布局的合成数据，以GSRNet权重初始化编码器，训练器官专用编解码分割网络OESNet。
AI.result: 在CT、MRI、PET三种模态共七个腹部器官分割数据集上评估，ReSeg持续优于现有SOTA方法，且无需任何真实训练图像。
AI.conclusion: 基于域随机化合成数据的两阶段预训练可替代真实数据，实现域无关、免微调的零样本腹部器官分割。

title: RL-IF: Tracking Non-local Training Data Influence for Online Reinforcement Learning
summary: Online reinforcement learning (RL) has achieved significant success in decision-making tasks, but modern online RL remains highly sensitive to the quality of training experience. Understanding the contribution of individual training instances is therefore central to data-centric RL, with applications ranging from experience selection to policy interpretation. Existing data attribution methods for online RL primarily focus on local influence within a single training round, overlooking the non-local data influence across multiple training rounds. In this work, we formalize data attribution in online RL through a trajectory-level leave-one-out quantity, RL-LOO, which measures how one training sample influences a downstream target after subsequent online updates have taken place. We then derive RL-IF, a first-order estimator that propagates data influence through both optimization effects and policy-induced sampling effects, and provide theoretical guarantees on its approximation accuracy under smoothness assumptions. Our analysis further disentangles these two effects and shows both theoretically and empirically that the full RL-IF estimator can often be well approximated using the optimization effect alone. Building on this observation, we develop RINSE, a practical data filtering method for online RL. Experiments on standard control benchmarks and an RLHF-style toxicity-mitigation setting show that RINSE improves training efficiency and final performance over standard PPO and local attribution baselines. These results suggest that RL-IF provides a practical and principled framework for understanding and improving online RL.

AI.tldr: 本文将在线强化学习中的数据归因形式化为轨迹级留一量 RL-LOO，并推导出一阶估计量 RL-IF（同时通过优化效应和政策诱导采样效应传播影响），进而提出数据过滤方法 RINSE，提升训练效率与最终性能。
AI.motivation: 现代在线 RL 对训练经验质量高度敏感，理解单条训练样本的贡献对经验选择与策略解释至关重要。但现有在线 RL 数据归因方法多只关注单轮训练内的局部影响，忽略了跨多轮训练的"非局部"数据影响。
AI.method: 提出轨迹级留一量 RL-LOO，衡量某样本在后续在线更新发生后对下游目标的影响；推导一阶估计量 RL-IF，将影响同时经由优化效应与策略诱导的采样效应传播，并在光滑性假设下给出近似精度理论保证；进一步分离两种效应，理论上与实验上均表明仅用优化效应即可很好地近似完整 RL-IF；据此设计实用的在线 RL 数据过滤方法 RINSE。
AI.result: 在标准控制基准与 RLHF 式毒性缓解设置上，RINSE 相较标准 PPO 及局部归因基线提升了训练效率和最终性能。
AI.conclusion: RL-IF 为理解与改进在线 RL 提供了兼具实用性与原理性的框架，且优化效应通常足以近似完整归因，简化了实际应用。

title: Recursive Self-Improvement on a Budget: Scoring Code Edits Before They Run
summary: A coding agent that rewrites its own scaffold has to choose which proposed edit to expand before that edit has been evaluated, and the search then has to return one agent. Each run fits one linear readout on the parent's steering-split solve rate and eight coordinates of the proposed diff, from 96 scaffold edits labeled by four evaluations of a 16-instance fit split, and then freezes the coefficients. HumanEval+ reserves 48 instances as the steering split and Polyglot reserves 64. That split scores parents and keeps an archive of four nodes. Huxley-Gödel Machine selection draws a parent by Thompson sampling on the steering counts of nodes that have already been evaluated, and it expands the child that parent proposes. Every method then returns the earliest evaluated node whose steering-split solve count is maximal. The tables report the held-out score of that node on the other 100 HumanEval+ instances and the other 145 Polyglot instances, next to the root scaffold and the calibration edit with the highest fit-split label. Twelve runs of GPT-4o return a node at 87.0% on held-out HumanEval+, against 84.2% for the parent-rate ablation. On that split Huxley-Gödel Machine selection returns 85.1%, the root is at 81.2%, and the calibration-best edit is at 82.8%. On the same split Claude Sonnet 4.5 returns 86.6%, beside 86.5% for Huxley-Gödel Machine selection, 85.3% for the parent-rate ablation, and 85.1% for the calibration-best edit.

AI.tldr: 论文研究自改写脚手架编码智能体在"先选编辑再评估"约束下的搜索问题:提出用父节点steering-split解决率加8维diff坐标拟合线性读出器,冻结系数后指导选父与扩展,并在HumanEval+/Polyglot上取得最优held-out表现。
AI.motivation: 自改写脚手架智能体必须在编辑被评估前决定扩展哪个提议编辑,且搜索最终须返回单一智能体,因此需要一种不依赖子节点评估结果的决策信号。
AI.method: 每次运行在96条脚手架编辑(每条由16实例fit split的4次评估标注)上拟合一个线性读出器,输入为父节点的steering-split解决率与提议diff的8个坐标,系数随即冻结;HumanEval+划48实例、Polyglot划64实例作steering split,用于给父节点打分并维护4节点档案。Huxley-Gödel Machine选择用已评估节点steering计数的Thompson采样抽取父节点并扩展其提议子节点,最终返回steering-split解决数最大的最早被评估节点。对照包括根脚手架、fit-split标签最高的校准编辑及父节点解决率消融。
AI.result: GPT-4o十二次运行返回节点在held-out HumanEval+(100实例)上达87.0%,高于父节点率消融的84.2%;该split上HGM选择为85.1%,根脚手架81.2%,校准最佳编辑82.8%。Claude Sonnet 4.5为86.6%,HGM选择86.5%,父节点率消融85.3%,校准最佳编辑85.1%。Polyglot上留145实例作held-out。
AI.conclusion: 基于冻结线性读出器与steering-split选择的自改写脚手架搜索优于根脚手架、单次校准编辑与父节点率消融,在两种模型与两个基准上稳定领先。

title: AssureCode: Structured Justification for Trustworthy Agentic Coding
summary: The use of AI-based tools in software development is rapidly changing how software is produced, enabling large volumes of code to be generated with limited human implementation effort. However, this raises fundamental challenges for ensuring that generated artifacts are aligned with developer intent and have been appropriately validated. In this work, we propose the use of structured argumentation in driving AI-assisted software development. Inspired by techniques from assurance engineering for safety-critical systems, we define a language of justification rationales that explicitly relate informal natural language prompts, formal specifications, assumptions about developer intentions, and program analysis evidence in a structured and verifiable format. We then describe AssureCode, a tool-supported methodology for creating such rationales as part of agentic code generation. We provide an empirical analysis of our implementation where we investigate its capacity to contribute towards justified assurance of correctness for AI-generated code.

AI.tldr: 提出用结构化论证（justification rationales）驱动 AI 辅助软件开发，将提示词、形式化规范、意图假设与程序分析证据关联，并实现工具 AssureCode，实证评估其对 AI 生成代码可信保证的能力。
AI.motivation: AI 工具能低成本生成大量代码，但难以保证生成产物与开发者意图一致并得到恰当验证，这是 AI 辅助软件开发的核心挑战。
AI.method: 借鉴安全关键系统保证工程的技术，定义一种 justification rationale 语言，以结构化、可验证的方式显式关联自然语言提示、形式化规范、关于开发者意图的假设以及程序分析证据；并实现工具支持的 AssureCode 方法学，将此类论证作为 agentic 代码生成的一部分来构建。
AI.result: 对实现进行了实证分析，考察其能否有助于为 AI 生成代码的正确性提供有理据的保证（justified assurance of correctness）。
AI.conclusion: 结构化论证方法可为 AI 生成代码的正确性保证提供支持，为 AI 辅助软件开发中的意图对齐与验证问题提供了一条可行路径。

title: LTEM: LLM-Friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown for Table Understanding and Generation
comment: Accepted to the EMNLP 2026 Main Conference
summary: Tables in real-world documents, including scientific papers, financial reports, and statistical summaries, frequently use merged cells, multi-level headers, and sectioned layouts. Yet the lightweight formats LLMs handle best (Markdown, CSV) cannot express these structures, while expressive formats (HTML, LaTeX) impose excessive token cost and parsing complexity. To enable systematic analysis of this trade-off, we introduce a taxonomy decomposing table structure into six atomic features (F1-F6) and corresponding complexity levels (L1-L6), and construct STB (Synthetic Table Benchmark), a controlled benchmark with 1,089 tables systematically distributed across complexity levels. Using this framework, we propose LTEM (LLM-friendly Table-Enhanced Markdown), a formally specified, minimal extension of Markdown that explicitly encodes spans and hierarchical headers. Experiments across five state-of-the-art LLMs show that LTEM achieves accuracy comparable to HTML, offers a favorable accuracy-token trade-off relative to HTML and LaTeX, and produces substantially fewer invalid responses than LaTeX; for table generation, LTEM is comparable to MultiMarkdown though HTML is best. We release our taxonomy, benchmark, and format specification to support future research on LLM-table interaction.

AI.tldr: 论文提出表格结构的六特征分类体系与合成基准STB，并设计Markdown最小扩展格式LTEM，在表达力与token成本间取得较好折中。
AI.motivation: 真实文档表格常含合并单元格、多级表头、分区布局，但LLM最易处理的Markdown/CSV无法表达这些结构，而HTML/LaTeX表达力强却token开销大、解析复杂，缺乏系统分析该权衡的工具。
AI.method: 提出将表格结构分解为六个原子特征(F1-F6)及复杂度等级(L1-L6)的分类法；构建含1,089张表格、按复杂度分层分布的受控基准STB；并提出形式上规范的最小Markdown扩展LTEM，显式编码跨距与层级表头。
AI.result: 在五个SOTA LLM上，LTEM理解准确率与HTML相当，相对HTML/LaTeX有更优的准确率-token权衡，无效响应显著少于LaTeX；表格生成任务中LTEM与MultiMarkdown相当，但HTML最佳。
AI.conclusion: LTEM是兼顾表达力与成本的有效方案，论文公开分类法、基准与格式规范以支持后续LLM-表格交互研究。

title: UNIVERS: Learning UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis for generalizable one-shot landmark localization
summary: One-shot landmark localization in volume scans with varying fields of view (FOVs) is challenging. While existing self-supervised learning methods have shown promising performance, they rely on contrastive learning built upon augmented views of the same image, which inherently limits their generalization in cross-modality scenarios. This motivates research on cross-modality embedding learning using paired multi-modality images. However, existing methods suffer from not only limited training data, but also the requirement of multi-stage iterative training. To address these limitations, we propose UNIVERS, an end-to-end trainable framework that learns UNIversal Voxel-wise Embedding via Randomized Synthesis. Our framework leverages diverse pseudo-data synthesized from organ shape templates, with randomization applied to semantic layout, visual appearance, FOV, and spatial pose. Coupled with cross-domain discriminative voxel-wise contrastive learning, this domain randomization strategy forces the network to disregard domain-specific biases and learn features that are robust against variations in imaging contrast, resolution, and spatial context. Consequently, the trained model enables one-shot landmark localization in multi-modality volume scans with arbitrary FOVs. In this study, the efficacy of the proposed method is demonstrated by applying it to the task of localizing the adrenal glands, which are paired, small, and irregular endocrine organs. In particular, comprehensive experiments are conducted on three challenging adrenal gland datasets. The experimental results demonstrate that UNIVERS consistently outperforms the state-of-the-art (SOTA) one-shot landmark localization approaches, with particularly prominent advantages in cross-modality scenarios. The source code is publicly available at https://github.com/Kendra9999/UNIVERS.

AI.tldr: 提出UNIVERS框架，通过随机合成伪数据学习通用体素级嵌入，实现跨模态任意FOV单样本地标定位。
AI.motivation: 传统自监督方法依赖同图增强视图的对比学习，跨模态泛化差；现有跨模态嵌入学习受限于训练数据少且需多阶段迭代训练。
AI.method: 端到端框架，从器官形状模板合成伪数据，对语义布局、视觉外观、FOV、空间姿态随机化，并结合跨域判别式体素级对比学习。
AI.result: 在三套肾上腺数据集上优于SOTA单样本定位方法，跨模态场景优势尤为突出。
AI.conclusion: 域随机化+体素级对比学习可迫使网络忽略域偏差，学得对对比度、分辨率、空间上下文稳健的特征，实现通用单样本地标定位。

title: Combating Catastrophic Forgetting in Continual Domain Adaptation via Knowledge Recasting
summary: Adapting language models to new domains during post-training risks degrading previously acquired capabilities, a phenomenon commonly known as catastrophic forgetting. Existing mitigation methods largely treat forgetting as a consequence of excessive model drift. They therefore constrain updates by preserving old outputs, replaying old data, or regularizing changes to parameters and representations so that the updated model remains close to its previous state. We take a different view: Rather than pulling the updated model back toward its old state, we translate the new domain into the model's pre-existing knowledge space, making unfamiliar knowledge learnable through familiar procedures. Therefore, we propose Skill Schema Transport (SST), a post-training framework that transports new knowledge into the model's existing skill space. SST abstracts each example type into a skill schema, preserving its essential operations, dependencies, and verification steps while removing domain-specific surface forms. By recasting new examples as instances of reusable procedures, SST turns knowledge update from trajectory memorization into procedural reuse. In continual domain adaptation settings, SST consistently reduces forgetting while improving generalization to related tasks. Across two 3B instruction-tuned backbones, SST improves average final performance on streamed domains by 2.53 to 5.75 points over sequential post-training. It also lowers max-drop forgetting in all evaluated settings, with the largest reduction from 42.41 to 7.10 points on the Qwen-3B MATH stream, while substantially recovering the OOD degradation induced by sequential updates.

AI.tldr: 提出Skill Schema Transport (SST)框架，将新领域知识转译进模型已有的技能空间，而非把模型拉回旧状态，从而在持续域适应中显著减少灾难性遗忘并提升泛化。
AI.motivation: 后训练适配新领域易导致灾难性遗忘。现有方法把遗忘视为"模型漂移过大"，靠保留旧输出、回放旧数据或正则化参数/表示来约束更新，思路是"把新模型拉回旧状态"。
AI.method: 换视角：把新领域"翻译"进模型已有知识空间，让陌生知识通过熟悉流程学习。SST将每类样例抽象为"技能模式"(skill schema)，保留核心操作、依赖与验证步骤，去除领域特定的表层形式；把新样例重构为可复用过程的实例，使知识更新从"轨迹记忆"转为"过程复用"。
AI.result: 在两个3B指令微调骨干上，流式域平均最终性能比顺序后训练提升2.53–5.75分；所有设置下max-drop遗忘均下降，Qwen-3B MATH流最大降幅由42.41降至7.10分；并大幅缓解顺序更新带来的OOD退化。
AI.conclusion: 将遗忘治理从"抑制漂移"转向"知识转译与技能复用"是有效路径；SST在持续域适应中同时降低遗忘、提升相关任务泛化并缓解OOD退化。

title: StochIKM: Automated High-Fidelity Reconstruction of Individual Patient Data from Published Kaplan-Meier Curves
summary: Individual patient data are the gold standard for secondary analysis of time-to-event evidence, but they are rarely released, and reconstruction from a published Kaplan-Meier figure could help. Existing methods all claim high fidelity, each judged by whichever agreements it happens to achieve, and each returns a single dataset although the map from figure to data is not bijective. We define fidelity explicitly: a dataset is admissible when it reproduces the risk table exactly, follows the digitized curve to within the image resolution, and respects the printed median, interval and event count. We propose StochIKM, a stochastic algorithm that digitizes the figure with a vision-capable language model and uses the high-fidelity definition as constraints, returning an admissible set of individual patient datasets. A solution is guaranteed to exist whenever the figure has been read correctly, so a failure indicts either the published figure or its digitization. In simulation and in 79 arms from published oncology trials, StochIKM reproduces the published risk tables and medians more closely than LLM-improved IPDfromKM, a high-impact alternative.

AI.tldr: 提出 StochIKM，一种用视觉语言模型数字化 Kaplan-Meier 图并结合高保真约束的随机算法，从图中重建个体患者生存数据的可采纳数据集集合。
AI.motivation: 个体患者数据（IPD）是时依证据二次分析的黄金标准，但很少公开；从已发表 KM 图重建数据可能有帮助。已有方法各自以自己碰巧达成的指标宣称高保真，且仅返回单一数据集，而图到数据的映射并非双射。
AI.method: 显式定义高保真（admissible）：必须精确复现风险表、在图像分辨率内贴合数字化曲线、并符合印刷的中位生存、区间与事件数。StochIKM 用视觉语言模型数字化图形，将上述定义作为约束，输出一个可采纳的个体患者数据集集合；只要图读取正确，解必存在。
AI.result: 在模拟实验及 79 个已发表肿瘤试验臂中，StochIKM 复现风险表与中位生存的接近程度优于高影响力替代方法 LLM-improved IPDfromKM。
AI.conclusion: 将保真度形式化为可验证约束，可得到保证存在的、可采纳的数据集集合；失败即指向图形本身或其数字化存在问题，为 KM 图数据重建提供了更可靠的框架。

title: Controlling Variability in~Neuroimaging Analysis Pipelines with~Software Product Lines
summary: Magnetic resonance imaging (MRI) is an acquisition technique used for medical diagnosis. It is notably used for structural and functional MRI (or fMRI) image analysis. MRI data is known to be complex and noisy, so pipelines are created to extract and enhance relevant information in retrieved images. The NARPS study highlighted the significant variability that can emerge from different pipelines set up by independent teams while trying to answer the same research question about brain functioning. Having different implementations realizing the same task is a typical playground for software product lines (SPLs), which may be out of the sight of neuroimage practitioners. Thus, proposing an SPL out of these different pipelines falls back on a typical reverse-engineering problem with its usual difficulties. In this document, we advocate for the conceptual adoption of SPL principles as a promising direction to improve reproducibility and consistency in neuroimaging research.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出将软件产品线（SPL）原则引入神经影像研究，以应对不同团队实现同一分析任务时产生的流程差异性，从而改善可复现性与一致性。
AI.motivation: MRI/fMRI 数据复杂且噪声大，需构建处理流程提取信息。NARPS 研究显示不同独立团队回答同一脑功能问题时流程差异显著；而多种实现完成同一任务正是 SPL 的典型应用场景，但神经影像从业者往往未意识到这一视角。
AI.method: 概念性倡导：从现有多个处理流程中反向工程出软件产品线，指出该反向工程问题及其固有困难，并提出采用 SPL 原则的思路。
AI.result: 本文为立场性/概念性文章，未给出实证结果，主要论证 SPL 适用于神经影像流程整合的可行性。
AI.conclusion: 概念性采纳 SPL 原则是提升神经影像研究可复现性与一致性的一个有前景的方向。

title: norregel: a preregistered benchmark of dated numeric values in Norwegian law
comment: 24 pages. Preregistrations, code and results: Zenodo concept DOI 10.5281/zenodo.23422302 (versions v1 10.5281/zenodo.23422303, v1.1 10.5281/zenodo.23432124, v1.2 10.5281/zenodo.23434782, 2.0 10.5281/zenodo.23437444, 2.1 10.5281/zenodo.23502580). Items are withheld
summary: norregel asks language models for numeric values in Norwegian statutes, regulations and parliamentary decisions (NOK amounts, percentages, multiples of the National Insurance basic amount (G) and age limits), each at a stated date. The 916 items were extracted mechanically from Lovdata's open data, and each carries the dated history of its provision, so an answer can be classed as correct, outdated, wrong or uninterpretable. We report a first and a second preregistered run on the same items. In the first run (five models, listed publicly only after local analysis), H1, that outdated answers are more frequent for values that took effect after a model's cutoff, could not be tested in substance, and H2 and H3 were inconclusive; Opus 5.5 and Sonnet 4.6 answered 46.7% and 40.2% of the 880 primary items correctly. The second run was preregistered and published before any of its calls, and eight models were analysed. Its pooled primary test supported H1 under the preregistered decision rule (d = 17.8 percentage points, 95% interval [7.7, 28.9], p = 0.0001). In the preregistered sensitivity analysis S8, which counts as outdated only the most recent value that differs from the key, d was 3.9 [-3.6, 12.7] (p = 0.1754), an interval that contains 0. H1 was supported in every other preregistered sensitivity analysis, but S8 is the only one that gives both groups one target value, so we do not regard the support for H1 as robust. The share of outdated answers equal to that most recent value (H2) was 56.1% [46.6, 65.0], an interval that contains 0.5, and the pooled test of a lower share correct in Nynorsk than in Bokmål (H3) was inconclusive. Several models, among them Haiku 4.5, gave mostly uninterpretable answers. Items and keys are withheld; item IDs, per-answer classes, code and results are on Zenodo.

AI.tldr: 介绍了 NorRegEL 基准：用挪威法规中带日期历史的数值问答检验语言模型的时效性，发现"过时答案"在截止日期后生效的条款上更常见，但该结论对一种敏感性分析不稳健。
AI.motivation: 法规条目中的数值（金额、百分比、G 倍数、年龄界限）随时间变化，模型的训练截止日期可能导致其给出"过时但曾正确"的答案。作者希望用可核查的真实法规历史系统地测量这一现象，并检验三条预先注册的假设（H1 过时答案与截止日期关系、H2 过时答案是否集中于最近一次旧值、H3 不同书面挪威语变体间的正确率差异）。
AI.method: 从 Lovdata 开放数据机械抽取 916 个条目，每条附带该条款随时间变化的数值历史，答案可被分类为正确、过时、错误或不可解释。进行两次预注册实验：第一轮 5 个模型（本地分析后才公开模型名单），主分析 880 项；第二轮在调用前预注册并公开，共分析 8 个模型，并设置多个预注册敏感性分析（含 S8：仅把与当前值不同的"最近一次旧值"计为过时）。
AI.result: 第一轮：H1 无法实质检验，H2、H3 均无定论；Opus 5.5 与 Sonnet 4.6 的正确率分别为 46.7% 和 40.2%。第二轮：按预注册决策规则，合并检验支持 H1（d = 17.8 个百分点，95% 区间 [7.7, 28.9]，p = 0.0001）；但敏感性分析 S8 中 d = 3.9 [-3.6, 12.7]，p = 0.1754，区间含 0。H2 中过时答案等于最近旧值的比例为 56.1% [46.6, 65.0]；H3（Nynorsk 正确率低于 Bokmål）检验无定论。Haiku 4.5 等多个模型大多给出不可解释答案。
AI.conclusion: 模型确实存在"过时数值"的系统性倾向，且与知识截止日期有关，但这一支持并不稳健：S8 是唯一使两组共享同一目标值的敏感性分析，其结果不支持 H1。因此作者不认为 H1 得到稳健证实；H2、H3 均未获支持。条目与标准答案已封闭，仅公开条目 ID、逐条答案分类、代码与结果（Zenodo）。

title: Diffusion Posterior Sampling with Uncertain Forward Models
summary: Diffusion posterior samplers reconstruct signals by combining a pretrained diffusion prior with a measurement likelihood specified by a forward model and a noise model. Calibration and reference data can characterize uncertainty in the forward model's parameters, such as blur kernels or detector responses. Fixing these parameters at estimated values leaves their uncertainty out of the likelihood, and parameter errors are thus absorbed into the reconstruction. We introduce an uncertainty-aware likelihood (UAL), a Gaussian approximation to the marginal likelihood obtained by integrating over the uncertain parameters. For each candidate signal, UAL propagates parameter uncertainty into a structured measurement covariance, reducing the quadratic penalty along residual directions that parameter variation can explain. Existing samplers can use UAL in their data updates while retaining their pretrained diffusion priors and sampling schedules. Under a fixed Gaussian nuisance model, we bound likelihood error from linearization and average divergence between the exact marginal and UAL posteriors. We compare samplers with and without UAL across six inverse problems spanning Gaussian and motion deblurring, CT, MRI, ultrasound, and fluorescence microscopy, and find improvements in reconstruction and ensemble prediction. UAL reduces geometric mean MSE by 9% to 20% across samplers in the main Gaussian-deblurring setting and by 51% to 92% in motion deblurring when non-blind samplers use the population-mean kernel. In motion deblurring, DAPS and PnP-DM with UAL also give 6.2 to 6.4 dB higher ensemble-mean PSNR than published BlindDPS and Fast Diffusion EM. On the ablation set, UAL outperforms trace-matched isotropic inflation for PnP-DM in both deblurring tasks; in motion deblurring, it also exceeds the best-tested fixed scalar data weighting by 3.3 dB for PnP-DM and 4.2 dB for DAPS in average PSNR.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"不确定性感知似然"(UAL)，通过对不确定前向模型参数积分得到边缘似然的高斯近似，将参数不确定性传播为结构化测量协方差，可嵌入现有扩散后验采样器的数据更新步骤。理论给出线性化误差界与两类后验的平均散度界，并在六类逆问题上验证重建与集成分歧预测均有提升。
AI.motivation: 扩散后验采样器通常把反演前向模型（如模糊核、探测器响应）的参数固定为估计值，导致参数不确定性被排除在似然之外，其误差被吸收进重建结果，造成偏差与过度自信。作者希望将参数不确定性正确地纳入似然建模。
AI.method: 提出 UAL：对不确定参数做积分，得到边缘似然的 Gaussian 近似。对每个候选信号，将参数不确定性传播为结构化测量协方差，从而在参数变化可解释的残差方向上降低二次惩罚。UAL 可直接替换现有采样器（如 DAPS、PnP-DM）的数据更新项，同时保留预训练扩散先验与采样日程。理论分析方面，在固定 Gaussian 冗余参数模型下，给出线性化导致的似然误差界，以及精确边缘后验与 UAL 后验之间的平均散度界。
AI.result: 在六类逆问题（高斯去模糊、运动去模糊、CT、MRI、超声、荧光显微）上对比有无 UAL 的采样器。高斯去模糊主设定下各采样器 MSE 几何平均降低 9%–20%；非盲采样器使用总体均值核时，运动去模糊降低 51%–92%。运动去模糊中，DAPS 与 PnP-DM 配合 UAL 的集成均值 PSNR 比已发表的 BlindDPS、Fast Diffusion EM 高 6.2–6.4 dB。消融实验显示 UAL 优于迹匹配的各向同性膨胀；在运动去模糊中，平均 PSNR 比其他最佳固定标量数据加权在 PnP-DM 上高 3.3 dB、在 DAPS 上高 4.2 dB。
AI.conclusion: 将前向模型参数不确定性显式积分进似然（UAL）是一种通用、即插即用的改进，能显著提升多种扩散后验采样器在多种逆问题上的重建精度与集成预测质量，并优于各向同性膨胀和固定标量加权等简单替代方案，同时具备理论误差保证。

title: Minimax-Optimal Predictive Flow Matching under Distribution Drift
summary: Flow matching learns a generative velocity field by regression, but under distribution drift a field must be deployed before the current data arrive. We study this predictive problem for a fixed, possibly nonconvex, neural class, with dynamic regret against the best represented field of each round. We propose DyProd-FM, which refits flow matching on dyadic historical prefixes and selects among the fits with a sleeping Prod master. Without knowing any drift budget, it attains regret $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_ω+1,1+\sqrt{TΩ}\})$ in the relative velocity risk variation $Ω$ and $\widetilde{O}(\min\{N_μ+1,1+T^{1/3}V_μ^{2/3}\})$ in the target-law variation $V_μ=\sum_t W_2(μ_{t+1},μ_t)$, up to approximation and fitting costs. Matching lower bounds for fixed classes show that both rates are optimal in $T$ and in the budgets up to logarithmic factors. Prior optimal dynamic-regret guarantees rely on a convex decision set with strongly convex or exp-concave losses, whereas our class may be nonconvex and no curvature in its parameters is assumed. The target-law rate rests on a second-order link between the two variations, which the base noise of flow matching provides.

AI.tldr: 本文研究非凸神经类下流匹配的预测问题，提出DyProd-FM算法，在未知漂移预算下同时达到相对速度风险变化与目标分布变化的动态遗憾最优率。
AI.motivation: 流匹配通过回归学习生成速度场，但在分布漂移下，必须在当前数据到达前部署速度场，形成预测问题。已有最优动态遗憾保证依赖凸决策集和强凸/指数凹损失，而实际神经类可能非凸且无参数曲率假设。
AI.method: 提出DyProd-FM：在二进历史前缀上重新拟合流匹配，并用以sleeping Prod为主的专家选择（master）在各拟合间选择。算法无需知道漂移预算，并以相对速度风险变化Ω和目标律变化V_μ（Wasserstein-2累积）作为复杂度度量。
AI.result: 在不需漂移预算的情况下，相对速度风险变化Ω上的遗憾达Õ(min{N_ω+1, 1+√(TΩ)})，目标律变化V_μ上的遗憾达Õ(min{N_μ+1, 1+T^{1/3}V_μ^{2/3}})，仅差近似与拟合代价。固定类下的匹配下界表明两率在T及预算上（至对数因子）均最优。
AI.conclusion: DyProd-FM在非凸、无曲率参数假设的神经类上实现了最优动态遗憾，突破了以往对凸性和强凸/指数凹损失的依赖；目标律速率依赖流匹配基础噪声提供的两种变化间的二阶联系。

title: NormTune: Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning for Reasoning-Intensive Tasks
summary: Full fine-tuning has achieved remarkable success on reasoning-intensive tasks, but it often requires substantial GPU resource consumption. Parameter-efficient fine-tuning (PEFT) provides a promising alternative for reducing this cost, yet we observe a substantial performance gap on reasoning-intensive tasks. In this paper, we present three key observations showing that this gap is closely associated with norm-related under-adaptation, where PEFT produces markedly smaller weight-update norms than full fine-tuning. Based on these observations, we propose Norm-Guided Parameter-Efficient Fine-Tuning (NormTune), a simple yet effective strategy that adaptively strengthens insufficiently updated layers according to their weight-update norms. Extensive experiments show that NormTune consistently enhances multiple PEFT methods across challenging reasoning benchmarks. Specifically, when trained on S1K-1.1, integrating NormTune into rank-8 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA yields substantial average accuracy improvements of 24.24\%, 11.33\%, and 16.21\% , respectively, across AIME 2024, MATH 500, GPQA, and AIME 2025. Moreover, NormTune-enhanced rank-256 LoRA, Bone, and MoRA achieve performance comparable to S1 full fine-tuning, with respective average gains of 2.17\%, 0.93\%, and 3.00\% over this baseline.

AI.tldr: NormTune：针对PEFT在推理任务上"权重更新范数不足"问题，按更新范数自适应增强欠更新层，显著缩小与全量微调的差距。
AI.motivation: 全量微调在推理密集型任务上效果好但GPU开销大；PEFT虽省资源，却在推理任务上存在明显性能差距，作者希望定位并消除这一差距的成因。
AI.method: 通过三点观察发现性能差距与"范数相关的欠适配"密切相关——PEFT的权重更新范数显著小于全量微调；据此提出NormTune，依据各层权重更新范数自适应地强化更新不足的层，作为可插拔策略与多种PEFT方法结合。
AI.result: 在S1K-1.1训练下，rank-8 LoRA、Bone、MoRA结合NormTune后在AIME 2024、MATH 500、GPQA、AIME 2025上平均准确率分别提升24.24%、11.33%、16.21%；rank-256设置下三者达到接近S1全量微调的水平，平均相对提升2.17%、0.93%、3.00%。
AI.conclusion: NormTune简单有效、通用性强，能普遍提升多种PEFT方法在困难推理基准上的表现，并在较大秩下逼近全量微调，为低成本推理能力微调提供了实用方案。

title: PAUSE: Search-Free Steering of Coding Agents Before Their First Source-Code Edit
summary: Coding agents can invest substantial effort in repository exploration and testing yet still produce unsuccessful patches. Existing online steering methods review trajectories periodically or invoke an advisor when a monitor detects behavioral problems; frequent reviews are costly, and the absence of anomalous behavior does not mean that an agent is on the right track. We propose PAUSE, a framework for steering coding agents with a single planning intervention. Agents reach their first source-code edit at a median of 60% of trajectory progress, after exploration, bug reproduction, and testing. PAUSE intercepts this edit request before it executes, which requires no learned monitor, no search over checkpoints, and no extra model call (search-free). A separate Planner reads the task and the pre-edit transcript and writes one repair plan; the same agent, the Executor, resumes with this plan, keeping its context and workspace. PAUSE applies online, during a live run, and offline, from a recorded trajectory prefix. We evaluate PAUSE on SWE-bench Verified and SWE-bench Multilingual with two Executors and three agent harnesses. With Qwen3-coder as Executor and GPT-5.6 Sol as Planner, online steering improves resolution by 16.8% on Verified in OpenHands and by 14.7% on Multilingual in SWE-agent. In SWE-agent, PAUSE outperforms LivePlan, a rule-triggered advisor, by 3.2% on Verified and 3.7% on Multilingual at similar Planner cost, and is comparable to SICA's periodic overseer at about 11-15% of its Planner cost. Offline, PAUSE recovers 35.4% of eligible failed Verified tasks, and resuming from the recorded prefix uses 33-41% fewer Executor tokens than restarting.

AI.tldr: 提出PAUSE：在编码智能体首次修改源码前做一次规划干预，无需监控器或搜索，显著提升修复成功率并降低成本。
AI.motivation: 编码智能体常花大量精力探索仓库与测试，却仍产出失败的补丁；现有在线干预方法（周期性复核或规则触发的顾问）成本高，且"无异常行为"并不代表方向正确，缺乏对方向的把握。
AI.method: 观察到智能体首次源码编辑发生在轨迹约60%进度处；PAUSE在此编辑请求执行前拦截，由独立Planner读取任务与编辑前轨迹，写出一份修复计划，再由同一智能体（Executor）带着原上下文与工作区继续。支持在线（实时运行）与离线（基于记录轨迹前缀）两种模式，无需学习型监控器、检查点搜索或额外模型调用。
AI.result: 在SWE-bench Verified与Multilingual上，用两个Executor、三个agent框架评测：Qwen3-coder为Executor、GPT-5.6 Sol为Planner时，在线干预在OpenHands上Verified提升16.8%，在SWE-agent上Multilingual提升14.7%；SWE-agent中相比规则触发顾问LivePlan在相近成本下分别高3.2%/3.7%，与SICA周期监督者效果相当但Planner成本仅约11-15%。离线可恢复35.4%的合格失败任务，从记录前缀恢复比重新开始节省33-41%的Executor token。
AI.conclusion: 单次规划干预即可高效纠偏编码智能体，兼顾效果与成本，并支持在线与离线复用。

title: Understanding Target Probability Reuse in Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding uses a target model to verify a tree of draft tokens in parallel. We study whether the resulting next-token distributions can help select the next tree. For unrestricted target models, we show that guaranteed exact reuse requires a distribution computed at the next round's complete context. We characterize when retaining this distribution requires sacrificing accepted tokens and establish conditions under which this loss persists across decoding rounds. Across six targets, we find that reranking first-token branches with a separately computed distribution at the current context improves expected acceptance over draft ranking, especially with small tree budgets. Drawing the first token from this distribution before allocating the tree further improves expected acceptance over pruning a preselected tree, even at equal mean tree size. In our experiments, both selection rules also decode faster than draft ranking when the separate target pass overlaps standalone drafting. Our findings show that making target probabilities available before tree allocation can improve the efficiency of speculative decoding. Our code is available at https://github.com/js-lee-AI/TargetRows.

AI.tldr: 研究投机解码中目标模型的下一个词元分布能否用于选择下一轮的草稿树。理论上，精确复用需要下一轮完整上下文处的分布；实验表明，用当前上下文单独计算的目标分布重排首词元分支、并先采样首词元再分配树，可提升期望接受率与解码速度。
AI.motivation: 投机解码利用目标模型并行验证草稿树，但草稿树的选择（分支与预算分配）通常依据草稿模型。作者希望弄清目标模型验证产生的下一词元分布能否指导下一轮树的构造，以及复用该分布是否存在理论障碍。
AI.method: 理论分析：对无约束目标模型刻画保证精确复用所需的分布条件，即须在下一轮完整上下文处计算；分析保留该分布需牺牲已接受词元的时机及损失跨轮持续的条件。实证：在六个目标模型上比较三种策略——草稿排序、用当前上下文单独计算的目标分布重排首词元分支、先从该分布采样首词元再分配树；并在单独计算的目标前向与独立草稿过程重叠时测速。
AI.result: 重排首词元分支优于草稿排序，尤其在小树预算下；先采样首词元再分配树，在相同平均树规模下优于对预选树剪枝；两种选择规则在目标前向与草稿重叠时解码均快于草稿排序。
AI.conclusion: 在树分配前就让目标概率可用，能提升投机解码效率。精确复用目标分布存在理论限制，但单独计算当前上下文分布并用于首词元选择与分支重排是有效且实用的做法。

title: From Canon to Nikon: Camera Domain Shift and Potential Equity Implications in Retinal AI
summary: Diabetic retinopathy is a leading cause of preventable blindness, yet access to regular screening remains limited worldwide. AI offers a scalable approach, but its performance can be sensitive to image quality and acquisition conditions. In a Brazilian cohort of 8,524 patients, retinal images acquired with the Nikon NF5050 were more than twice as likely to have inadequate image quality compared with those acquired with the Canon CR-2, despite refurbished Canon systems costing more than twice as much as Nikon systems. This potential cost-quality trade-off highlights an important consideration for the reliability of AI systems deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. Using a frozen pretrained retinal foundation model, we systematically evaluate whether camera-associated performance differences persist across 12 retinal disease classification tasks, four input resolutions, and five downstream classifiers. We find that camera-associated performance differences vary substantially across tasks, and that neither higher input resolution nor classifier choice consistently mitigates cross-camera variation. These findings identify camera platform as a potentially overlooked source of performance variability, with implications for the safety and reliability of retinal AI when deployed across heterogeneous imaging systems. We release all source code, evaluation scripts, and per-task results on GitHub to support reproducible benchmarking.

AI.tldr: 在巴西8524例糖尿病视网膜病变筛查队列中，Nikon NF5050相机图像质量不合格率是Canon CR-2的两倍以上，却更便宜。作者用冻结的视网膜基础模型系统评估12个疾病分类任务、4种输入分辨率与5种下游分类器，发现相机相关性能差异依任务而变，提升分辨率或更换分类器都不能稳定消除跨相机差异。
AI.motivation: 视网膜AI筛查可扩展，但性能受图像质量与采集条件影响。不同眼底相机存在"成本—质量"权衡：廉价Nikon系统图像质量更差（不合格率翻倍以上），而翻新Canon系统价格高一倍多。相机平台是否为AI性能变异中被忽视的来源，缺乏系统评估。
AI.method: 基于巴西8524名患者的队列数据；先比较Nikon NF5050与Canon CR-2的图像质量与成本。随后使用冻结的预训练视网膜基础模型，在12个视网膜疾病分类任务、4种输入分辨率、5种下游分类器的组合下，系统评估跨相机的性能差异是否能被缓解。
AI.result: Nikon图像质量不合格的可能性是Canon的两倍以上，而翻新Canon系统价格超过Nikon的两倍。相机相关性能差异在不同任务间差别显著；无论是提高输入分辨率，还是更换下游分类器，都不能一致地减小跨相机性能变异。
AI.conclusion: 相机平台是视网膜AI性能变异的一个潜在被忽视来源，对在异构成像系统上部署时的安全性与可靠性有直接含义。代码、评测脚本与逐任务结果已开源以支持可复现基准测试。

title: A Model-Free Continuous-Time RL Algorithm from Discrete-Time Off-Policy Data with End-to-End Guarantees
summary: In this paper, we study continuous-time reinforcement learning, where the state follows an unknown stochastic differential equation but only a fixed off-policy batch of discrete-time transitions is available. Standard discrete-time Q-learning becomes problematic as the sampling interval shrinks, because differences between action values vanish. Continuous-time alternatives, such as Deep Advantage Updating and martingale q-learning, preserve the action signal but jointly learn a value function and an action-dependent critic. Building on the PhiBE-Q formulation (arXiv:2606.21925), we develop a model-free PhiBE policy iteration (PhiBE-PI) framework that uses a single state-action critic while preserving the continuous-time action-ranking scale. At each iteration, the framework learns the critic directly from sampled increments and uses it to improve the policy. The same batch is reused throughout, without explicitly estimating the drift or diffusion. We further develop an implementation under linear function approximation and establish a local end-to-end suboptimality guarantee for the learned policy. Our analysis quantifies how errors from time discretization, function approximation, and finite-sample policy evaluation propagate through policy iteration. It accounts for the dependence of successive policies on the reused data, so the guarantee does not require a fresh batch at each iteration. Moreover, we identify a bias-variance trade-off: smaller sampling intervals improve the approximation to the continuous-time problem but can increase statistical error at a fixed sample size. Thus, finer time discretization does not necessarily lead to better policy performance.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出无模型的 PhiBE 策略迭代（PhiBE-PI）框架，用于仅依赖固定离策略离散转移批次的连续时间强化学习，并用单一状态-动作评论家保持动作排序尺度。
AI.motivation: 采样间隔缩小时，离散时间 Q-learning 的动作值差异消失，导致无法区分动作；已有连续时间方法（Deep Advantage Updating、martingale q-learning）需联合学习价值函数与动作相关评论家，较为复杂。
AI.method: 基于 PhiBE-Q 公式构建 PhiBE-PI：每次迭代直接从采样增量学习单一状态-动作评论家并改进策略，复用同一批次数据，不显式估计漂移或扩散；在线性函数近似下给出实现。
AI.result: 建立学习策略的局部端到端次优性保证，量化时间离散化、函数近似与有限样本策略评估误差在策略迭代中的传播，并允许策略依赖复用数据；识别出偏差-方差权衡：更细采样间隔改善连续时间近似，但在固定样本量下可能增大统计误差。
AI.conclusion: 更细的时间离散化不必然带来更优的策略性能。

title: LaVGuard: Selective Decoding for Contextual Value Drift
summary: A content-safe response can still promote priorities that conflict with its task: an assistant may demand compliance when asked to preserve autonomy. We study contextual value drift as a task-relative decoding problem with an explicit allowance for change. LaVGuard separates an authorized ten-dimensional profile from a frozen estimate of the values expressed in the visible prefix. A profile-relative density gate selects when to evaluate candidate continuations; their signed progress determines a logit tilt constrained by both changed-position and cumulative-KL budgets. We establish local surrogate improvement, pathwise budget feasibility, and a bound on response-distribution change. Profile conditioning raises boundary TPR at 5% FPR from .58 to .72. At the same .12 mean intervention ratio, the selection study reports risk-safety scores of .88 for LaVGuard and .72 for position-matched edits. The resulting interface makes task priorities actionable while keeping the extent of intervention explicit and bounded.

AI.tldr: 论文提出LaVGuard，将"上下文价值漂移"建模为带显式变化允许量的任务相关解码问题，通过授权价值画像与可见前缀价值估计的对比来有界地调控生成，在低干预率下提升边界检测与风险-安全表现。
AI.motivation: 内容安全的回复仍可能暗中推广与任务相冲突的价值优先级（例如被要求尊重自主性时反而要求服从）。现有安全方法不区分"任务相关的价值漂移"，也缺乏对干预幅度显式、可控的刻画，因此需要一种任务相对且变化量有界的解码机制。
AI.method: 将授权值画像（10维）与可见前缀中表达价值的冻结估计分离；用画像相对密度门控决定何时评估候选续写；以候选的带符号进展计算logit偏置，并由"改变位置预算"和"累积KL预算"双重约束；理论上给出局部代理改进、逐路径预算可行性与响应分布变化上界。
AI.result: 画像条件化将5% FPR下的边界TPR从0.58提升至0.72；在相同0.12平均干预率下，LaVGuard风险-安全得分为0.88，位置匹配编辑为0.72。
AI.conclusion: LaVGuard把任务优先级变成可操作的解码信号，同时使干预范围显式且有界，为任务相对的价值观对齐提供了可控接口。

title: DynaCI: Generating GitHub Actions Workflows via Dynamic Analysis
summary: Continuous Integration (CI) is an essential practice that automatically validates code changes through builds and tests. However, configuring CI workflows remains challenging, as modern software often features complex architectures, numerous dependencies, and support for diverse execution environments. Most CI platforms also require workflows to be written in their particular domain-specific languages. As a result, CI workflows are often error-prone and hard to maintain, especially for those unfamiliar with CI semantics. Prior work on automated CI workflow generation require developers to create specifications that describe their intended workflows using natural language, partial workflows, etc. However, in practice, developers may struggle to articulate requirements and may be unaware of available CI features. To address these limitations, we propose DynaCI, a novel approach that uses runtime information from developers' local environments to generate CI workflows. DynaCI (i) traces the developers' local environment to collect runtime information, (ii) constructs an initial workflow by applying runtime-informed heuristics, and (iii) iteratively refines the workflow via LLM-based Retrieval Augmented Generation (RAG). We evaluate DynaCI on 50 popular Python projects that use GitHub Actions, a popular CI platform, and compare it against the state-of-the-art CI workflow generation approaches: GH-WCOM and LLM4GW. DynaCI outperforms these existing approaches by more than 21.13% in BLEU score and 20.96% in F1 score on average. It also generates workflows without missing functionality in 56% of cases, while requiring fewer manual modifications to repair such exceptions. These results demonstrate that leveraging runtime information substantially improves LLM-based CI workflow generation, and offer a promising direction for broader DevOps configuration automation.

AI.tldr: DynaCI利用开发者本地环境的运行时信息来生成CI工作流：(i)追踪本地环境收集运行时信息，(ii)通过运行时启发式构建初始工作流，(iii)用基于LLM的RAG迭代精炼，在50个Python项目上显著优于GH-WCOM和LLM4GW。
AI.motivation: 配置CI工作流仍然困难：现代软件架构复杂、依赖众多、执行环境多样，且CI平台要求使用各自的领域特定语言，导致工作流易出错且难维护。已有自动化生成方法要求开发者用自然语言或部分工作流来写规格说明，但实践中开发者难以表达需求，也可能不了解可用的CI特性。
AI.method: DynaCI包含三步：1）追踪开发者本地环境，收集运行时信息；2）基于运行时信息的启发式规则构建初始工作流；3）通过基于LLM的检索增强生成（RAG）迭代精炼工作流。
AI.result: 在50个使用GitHub Actions的流行Python项目上评估，相比最先进的GH-WCOM和LLM4GW，BLEU分数平均提升超过21.13%，F1分数提升20.96%；56%的情况下生成的工作流无缺失功能，且修复异常所需的人工修改更少。
AI.conclusion: 利用运行时信息能显著提升基于LLM的CI工作流生成效果，为更广泛的DevOps配置自动化提供了有前景的方向。

title: C$^2$U in RAG: Compositional Concept Unlearning in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation can expose unwanted concepts through retrieved evidence even when the generator is moderated. We study query-side concept suppression with a fixed encoder and document index. Compositional Concept Unlearning (C$^2$U) routes a profile-derived direction through an augmented atom bank, adding only a bounded edited-minus-original delta to the raw query. Across five datasets, four encoders, and three seeds, the validation-selected configuration reduces pooled binary target Hit@5 by 4.25 percentage points with non-positive control degradation and target-exposure changes. Under the evaluated query transforms, it suppresses target density without increasing budgeted control-query exposure. Separately, ArXiv four-concept composition improves over an averaged-direction comparator after independent validation gates and first-use test evaluation.

AI.tldr: 提出查询侧概念抑制方法C²U：在固定编码器与文档索引下，通过增强原子银行将用户画像方向路由为有界编辑差分向量注入原始查询，实现检索增强生成中的概念遗忘。
AI.motivation: 检索增强生成即便生成器已受管控，仍可能通过检索到的证据暴露不当概念；而现有概念遗忘多针对模型参数，难以在固定编码器/索引条件下于查询侧实现抑制。
AI.method: Compositional Concept Unlearning（C²U）：由用户画像导出方向，经增强原子银行（augmented atom bank）组合路由，仅向原始查询加入有界的“编辑-原始”差分向量；验证集选择配置。
AI.result: 在五个数据集、四种编码器、三个随机种子下，二元目标Hit@5合并降低4.25个百分点，对照退化与目标暴露变化均为非正；在评测的查询变换下抑制目标密度且不增加预算内对照查询暴露；ArXiv四概念组合在独立验证门控与首次使用测试评估后优于平均方向基线。
AI.conclusion: 查询侧组合式概念遗忘可在不修改编码器和索引的前提下有效抑制检索中的概念暴露，具有可验证的抑制效果与有限的对照代价。

title: DriftNeRF: Cross-Ray Density Drifting for Sparse-View Neural Radiance Fields
summary: Neural Radiance Fields (NeRF) synthesize photorealistic novel views from dense image collections, but degrade sharply when few views are available. We attribute a specific, measurable defect to the objective itself: the rendering loss is a sum over independent rays and contains no term comparing densities that different rays assign to the same region of space, so nearby 3D points can settle on contradictory densities while every training pixel is reproduced correctly. We make this quantity explicit by measuring cross-ray density disagreement directly during training, and show that it stays high in vanilla NeRF, falls only incidentally under frequency-based regularization, and moves together with held-out quality in the sparse regime. We then close the gap with DriftNeRF, a drop-in regularizer that instantiates the drifting-field template on density samples: a masked exponential kernel aggregates densities from nearby points on other rays into a stop-gradient consensus target, and the resulting drifting field penalizes unsupported disagreement while leaving agreed-upon boundaries intact. The regularizer reads only sampled positions, ray identifiers, and predicted densities, so it requires no pretrained model, external geometry, or additional images, and transfers across field parameterizations. On NeRF-Synthetic it reduces residual disagreement by an order of magnitude, and across NeRF-Synthetic, DTU, and LLFF it improves 3-view PSNR over the strongest MLP-NeRF baseline by 0.42-0.65 dB and remains competitive with sparse-view Gaussian pipelines under a matched protocol without their depth, flow, or covisibility preprocessing.

AI.tldr: NeRF在稀疏视角下性能急剧下降，作者将这一缺陷归因于渲染损失缺少跨射线密度一致性约束，并提出DriftNeRF正则项直接惩罚邻近射线的密度分歧，在稀疏视角设定下显著提升重建质量。
AI.motivation: NeRF依赖密集图像才能合成高质量新视角，稀疏视角下明显退化。作者指出渲染损失是对独立射线的求和，不含比较不同射线对同一空间区域密度分配的项，因此邻近3D点可能收敛到互相矛盾的密度，即使每个训练像素都被正确重现——这是可测量的目标函数缺陷。
AI.method: 先显式测量训练中的跨射线密度分歧（cross-ray density disagreement），验证其在原始NeRF中持续偏高、在频率类正则下只是偶然下降、并与稀疏设定下的留出质量同向变化。随后提出DriftNeRF：一个即插即用正则项，在密度采样上实例化drifting-field模板，用掩码指数核聚合其他射线上邻近点的密度，构成带stop-gradient的共识目标，惩罚无支撑的分歧同时保留一致边界。仅需采样位置、射线ID和预测密度，无需预训练模型、外部几何或额外图像。
AI.result: 在NeRF-Synthetic上残余分歧降低一个数量级；在NeRF-Synthetic、DTU、LLFF上，3视角PSNR比最强MLP-NeRF基线提升0.42–0.65 dB；在匹配协议下与稀疏视角高斯类流水线相当，且不需要其深度、光流或共视预处理。
AI.conclusion: 稀疏视角NeRF的退化可归因于目标函数缺乏跨射线密度一致性项；DriftNeRF以极低依赖的即插即用正则有效降低密度分歧并提升稀疏视角质量，且可跨场参数化迁移。

title: Query Feedback and Teaching for Stable and Certifiable Language Generation
summary: Language generation in the limit studies whether a learner observing an enumeration of an unknown target language can eventually generate only valid, previously unseen elements. We study stability, introduced by Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Velegkas (2025), which requires the generator's infinite output set to eventually remain unchanged, and introduce the stronger notion of certifiability, which requires the generator to determine from its observations that its current output is valid. Drawing on teaching sets in learning theory, we introduce a hierarchy of teaching dimensions for generation under three increasingly strict success criteria: correctness, stability, and certifiability. These dimensions measure the minimum number of selected examples whose appearance guarantees the corresponding success condition. We also study stability and certifiability in the membership-query model of Charikar and Pabbaraju (2025). We characterize stable and certifiable generation, both with and without query feedback, and establish their relationships with uniform generation and identification in the limit. In particular, we give a finite-witness characterization of stable generation, analogous to Angluin's tell-tale characterization of identification, resolving a gap left open by Kalavasis, Mehrotra, and Velegkas (2025). We further compare these generation notions with identification in the limit and contrast their teaching requirements on well-studied language families, including regular and erasing pattern languages.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究"极限生成"中的稳定性与可证明性，引入教学维度层级刻画正确性、稳定性与可证明性三种成功准则，并在成员查询模型中给出稳定生成的有限见证刻画。
AI.motivation: 极限生成中已有"稳定性"概念，但缺乏对生成器何时能确知其输出有效的刻画，也缺少量化教学代价的工具。作者希望弥补Kalavasis等人(2025)遗留的稳定生成特征化空白，并系统比较不同生成准则与极限辨识的关系。
AI.method: 借鉴学习理论中的教学集，定义三种递增严格成功准则（正确性、稳定性、可证明性）下的教学维度层级，度量保证成功所需的最少精选样例数；同时在成员查询模型中分析稳定性与可证明性，区分有无查询反馈，并与一致生成、极限辨识进行比较。
AI.result: 在成员查询模型中刻画了有/无查询反馈下的稳定与可证明生成，建立其与一致生成及极限辨识的关系；给出稳定生成的有限见证刻画，类比Angluin的tell-tale刻画；在正则语言、erasing模式语言等语言族上对比各生成概念与极限辨识的教学需求。
AI.conclusion: 论文通过教学维度层级和有限见证刻画，统一了正确性、稳定性、可证明性三类生成准则，填补了稳定生成特征化的空白，并揭示生成与辨识在教学要求上的差异。

title: Steering Black-Box Large Language Model Agents with Pitfall Anticipation World Model
summary: Frontier black-box Large Language Model (LLM) agents are proficient at long-horizon reasoning and precise action generation. However, when it comes to a specific agentic task, they have no internalized knowledge of how that particular environment unfolds. A world model offers a natural remedy, providing the agent with environment specific knowledge by foreseeing how the environment will respond to the action it is about to take. Prior world models for LLM agents mainly predict next observations at each step, which is costly and often uninformative because individual observations provide limited task-relevant guidance and not every step requires call for foresight. This raises a key question: what a world model should predict and when should it be invoked for agentic tasks? Our pilot study suggests that world model guidance is most useful when it anticipates pitfalls within a bounded multi-step future.
