Motivated by this, we introduce Pitfall Anticipation World Model (PAWM), which selectively intervenes when a potential pitfall arises and predicts the impending failure to steer the agent away from it. PAWM is trained in two stages: Supervised Fine-Tuning (SFT) on synthetic data labeled with agent pitfalls, followed by GRPO co-training with a black-box LLM to further optimize it in the target environment. PAWM improves Claude Sonnet 4.5 performance by 24.3% on ScienceWorld and 7.7% on WebArena-Lite, outperforming a range of baselines. These results demonstrate that PAWM provides an effective form of world model guidance for black-box LLM agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 PAWM（Pitfall Anticipation World Model），一种只在潜在陷阱出现时选择性介入、预测即将发生的失败并引导智能体避开的世界模型，SFT+GRPO 两阶段训练，在 ScienceWorld 和 WebArena-Lite 上显著提升黑盒 LLM 智能体表现。
AI.motivation: 前沿黑盒 LLM 智能体擅长长程推理与精确动作生成，但缺乏对特定任务环境演化方式的内部知识。已有世界模型多逐步预测下一个观测，代价高且信息量有限，因为单步观测对任务指导有限，也并非每一步都需要前瞻。因此核心问题是：面向智能体任务，世界模型应当预测什么、何时调用。
AI.method: 先导研究发现，在有限多步未来内预判陷阱时世界模型最有价值。据此提出 PAWM：在潜在陷阱出现时选择性介入，预测即将发生的失败以引导智能体规避。训练分两阶段——先用带智能体陷阱标注的合成数据进行监督微调（SFT），再与黑盒 LLM 通过 GRPO 在目标环境中协同训练优化。
AI.result: 在 ScienceWorld 上使 Claude Sonnet 4.5 性能提升 24.3%，在 WebArena-Lite 上提升 7.7%，优于多种基线方法。
AI.conclusion: PAWM 为黑盒 LLM 智能体提供了一种有效的世界模型引导形式，说明"选择性、以陷阱为中心的预见"比逐步观测预测更高效实用。

title: FaultGene: LLM-Assisted Fault-Augmented Test Generation for Hardware-in-the-Loop Validation of Autonomous Driving Systems
summary:
Reliable validation of autonomous driving cyber-physical systems requires testing not only nominal driving behavior but also failures arising from faults in sensing and embedded computation. Physical road testing provides realistic system behavior but is costly and difficult to reproduce, while simulation enables scalable evaluation but cannot fully capture hardware-dependent behavior and fault propagation. Hardware-in-the-loop (HIL) validation bridges this gap by executing the driving stack on real embedded hardware within a simulated environment. However, preparing fault-augmented scenarios for HIL testing remains largely a manual process, limiting test coverage, scalability, and efficiency.
  We present FaultGene, an LLM-assisted framework for automated generation of executable fault-augmented tests for HIL fault-resilience validation. Given a baseline Scenic/CARLA scenario and a structured fault specification, FaultGene generates a fault-augmented test case that captures the effects of HIL-level fault injection. During offline refinement, semantic-consistency checks and execution-level feedback are used to correct candidates that fail to preserve the intended scenario context or produce the desired fault-induced degradation, and to construct high-quality supervision for fine-tuning. The resulting generator then produces fault-augmented tests directly at deployment time without requiring manually engineered reference executions or repeated refinement loops.

AI.tldr: FaultGene：用LLM自动将由Scenic/CARLA基线和结构化故障规范构成的场景转换为可执行的故障增强HIL测试用例，并通过离线语义一致性检查与执行反馈精炼、微调生成器，实现部署时直接生成。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶CPS需在真实嵌入式硬件上验证传感与计算故障下的失效行为；实车昂贵难复现、纯仿真无法反映硬件相关行为，HIL是折中方案，但为HIL准备故障增强场景高度依赖人工，限制覆盖度、可扩展性与效率。
AI.method: 给定基线Scenic/CARLA场景与结构化故障规范，生成能体现HIL级故障注入效果的故障增强测试用例；离线阶段进行语义一致性检查并用执行级反馈修正无法保持场景意图或未产生预期故障退化的候选，同时构造高质量监督数据用于微调；微调后的生成器在部署时可直接生成，无需人工参考执行或反复精炼。
AI.result: 摘要未给出定量结果；定性上，微调后的生成器可在部署阶段直接产出故障增强测试，免去手工构造参考执行与反复精炼循环。
AI.conclusion: LLM辅助+执行反馈微调的流水线可自动化HIL故障韧性测试场景构造，提升测试覆盖与可扩展性，减少人工负担。

title: Beyond Binary Labels: Diagnostic Evaluation of LLM Safety with Prompt-Level Rubrics
comment: 42 pages, 9 figures, 24 tables. Dataset will be publicly released at https://github.com/Tencent-Hunyuan/DiagSafe
summary: Current LLM safety benchmarks predominantly rely on binary safe or unsafe labels, lacking explanatory depth and suffering from low consistency across automated judges. To address this, we introduce DiagSafe, a diagnostic evaluation framework that moves beyond binary classification by employing prompt-level rubrics. Grounded in globally applicable AI safety policies, each rubric provides explicit criteria along two dimensions: safety, which targets concrete harms with specific exemptions to suppress false positives, and usefulness, which independently evaluates instruction fulfillment. To ensure a robust and realistic evaluation, we construct a bilingual (English-Chinese) benchmark grounded in a comprehensive 84-label safety taxonomy, consisting of two subsets: DiagBase, which covers single- and multi-turn prompts with direct harmful queries and template-based jailbreaks, and DiagAttack, which embeds harmful intents into complex instruction-following tasks to form challenging instruction attacks. Extensive experiments demonstrate that DiagSafe significantly enhances the reliability of LLM-as-a-judge evaluation, achieving 95.34% agreement with human annotations -- substantially higher than the 69%-87% achieved by the baselines -- and high inter-judge consistency (Cohen's $κ$ = 0.864). Furthermore, applying our framework reveals that leading LLMs differ markedly in their unsafe rates, and each model also exhibits unique vulnerabilities along different dimensions. In addition, we observe that models are particularly susceptible in Chinese and multi-turn contexts. Ultimately, DiagSafe provides a reliable and explainable tool for auditing and optimizing LLM alignment.

AI.tldr: DiagSafe：一个基于提示级评分标准（rubric）的诊断式LLM安全评测框架，从二分类升级为可解释的安全+有用性双维度评估，并配套中英双语基准（DiagBase与DiagAttack）。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM安全基准多依赖安全/不安全的二分类标签，缺乏解释深度，且不同自动评判者之间一致性低，难以可靠审计模型对齐。
AI.method: 提出提示级rubric评估：依据全球通用AI安全政策，从安全（针对具体危害并设豁免条款以抑制误报）与有用性（独立评估指令完成度）两个维度给出明确标准；构建基于84类安全分类体系的中英双语基准，含DiagBase（单/多轮直接有害查询与模板越狱）和DiagAttack（将有害意图嵌入复杂指令跟随任务形成指令攻击）。
AI.result: LLM-as-a-judge可靠性显著提升：与人工标注一致率达95.34%（基线69%–87%），评判者间一致性高（Cohen's κ=0.864）；揭示领先LLM不安全率差异明显、各有独特薄弱维度，且模型在中文与多轮场景更易失守。
AI.conclusion: DiagSafe为LLM对齐的审计与优化提供了可靠且可解释的工具。

title: PhyMo: Learning Physical Dynamics with Accurate and Continuous Motion from Multi-View Videos
summary: Recovering dynamic 3D scene geometry, appearance, and the physical motion states that govern scene evolution from multi-view videos is important yet challenging. A key difficulty is that appearance can be deceptive. Under rendering supervision alone, a model may fit the observed images by changing color or opacity to compensate for inaccurate deformation, rather than recovering the true evolving geometry and motion. This issue is especially severe in scenes with fast or locally complex motion, where inaccurate trajectories can still produce plausible images over the observed frames, but lead to unreliable reconstruction and discontinuous future prediction. In this paper, we propose PhyMo, a framework for learning evolving dynamics from multi-view videos. We introduce a Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation that drives the model to recover accurate motion from deformation, rather than relying on appearance shortcuts to explain observed motion. On top of this, we propose a Continuous Motion Evolution module with bidirectional kinematic continuity constraint to promote temporally consistent evolution of displacement, velocity, and acceleration. Together, these designs yield geometrically faithful interpolation and continuous motion extrapolation. Experiments on four dynamic scene benchmarks demonstrate state-of-the-art performance.

AI.tldr: PhyMo通过运动感知轨迹表示和带双向运动学连续性约束的连续运动演化模块，从多视角视频中恢复真实几何与运动，抑制外观捷径，实现几何忠实的插值与连续外推。
AI.motivation: 从多视角视频恢复动态3D场景的几何、外观及物理运动状态很困难，核心难点是外观具有欺骗性：仅靠渲染监督时，模型可能通过改变颜色或透明度来补偿不准确的形变，从而拟合观测图像，而非恢复真实的几何与运动。该问题在快速或局部复杂运动场景中尤为严重，错误轨迹在观测帧上仍能渲染出合理图像，但导致重建不可靠、未来预测不连续。
AI.method: 提出PhyMo框架。1）引入运动感知轨迹表示（Motion-Aware Trajectory Representation），驱动模型从形变中恢复准确运动，而非依赖外观捷径解释观测运动；2）在基础上提出连续运动演化模块（Continuous Motion Evolution），配合双向运动学连续性约束，促进位移、速度、加速度在时间上一致演化。
AI.result: 在四个动态场景基准上实验，取得最先进性能，实现几何忠实的插值与连续的运动外推。
AI.conclusion: 通过将运动与外观解耦并施加运动学连续性约束，PhyMo有效缓解外观捷径问题，提升动态场景重建的几何准确性与时间连续性。

title: The Data Differentiator Framework (DDF): Quantifying Marginal Data Value with Information-Theoretic and Game-Theoretic Measures in an Agentic Evaluation Pipeline (SDSAE)
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Primary cs.AI; cross-listed cs.LG and stat.ML
summary: In data-rich enterprises the hard question is not whether a candidate dataset is good in isolation, but whether it adds information beyond what the organization already holds, and whether that increment is worth its price. We present the Data Differentiator Framework (DDF), a composite scoring method for candidate data assets that combines (i) a mutual-information-based redundancy penalty against the existing portfolio, (ii) a cost-normalized, significance-gated marginal utility score derived from an ablation study, and (iii) explicit governance inputs (trust, identity resolution quality, strategic weights) set by the business. The framework is executed by a staged pipeline, the Strategic Data Sourcing Agent Ecosystem (SDSAE), that short-circuits expensive model-retraining steps for assets failing governance or redundancy gates. Conceptually, the DDF extends the relevance-minus-redundancy principle of mRMR feature selection from the feature level to the asset level, and adds cost normalization, a statistical significance gate, and governance terms that per-sample valuation methods such as Data Shapley do not model. We validate the framework on the public credit-card fraud benchmark (284,807 transactions) with five constructed candidate assets spanning the redundancy spectrum. Only the genuinely differentiated asset passes the significance gate ($Δ$AUC = +0.0029, DeLong $p = 1.4\times 10^{-9}$, Holm-corrected $p = 7.2\times 10^{-9}$) and receives an acquire recommendation (DDS = +0.663); the fully redundant asset scores lowest (DDS = -0.135). The recommendation is stable across 19 of 22 admissible strategic-weight configurations and across all decision thresholds in [0.15, 0.66]. We state clearly which quantities in the case study are computed from data and which are simulated governance inputs, and we discuss the design limits of a single-dataset evaluation.

AI.tldr: 论文提出数据差异化框架DDF及其执行流水线SDSAE，用于评估候选数据资产相对已有数据组合的增量信息与性价比：结合互信息冗余惩罚、成本归一化且带显著性检验的边际效用分数、以及治理输入，并在信用卡欺诈基准上验证。
AI.motivation: 企业真正的难题不是候选数据集单独是否好，而是它能否带来超出组织已有数据的增量信息，且该增量是否值得其成本。现有方法（如Data Shapley）按样本估值，未建模成本归一化、统计显著性门槛和治理因素。
AI.method: DDF为复合评分：(i) 基于互信息相对现有数据组合的冗余惩罚；(ii) 由消融实验得出的、成本归一化且经显著性门控的边际效用分数；(iii) 由业务设定的显式治理输入（信任度、身份解析质量、战略权重）。由分阶段流水线SDSAE执行，对未通过治理或冗余门的资产短路昂贵的模型重训练。理论上把mRMR的"相关性减冗余"原则从特征级扩展到资产级。
AI.result: 在公开信用卡欺诈基准（284,807笔交易）上，构造5个分布于冗余谱系的候选资产。仅真正差异化的资产通过显著性门（ΔAUC=+0.0029，DeLong p=1.4e-9，Holm校正p=7.2e-9）并获采购建议（DDS=+0.663）；完全冗余资产得分最低（DDS=-0.135）。建议在22种可行战略权重配置中的19种、以及[0.15,0.66]内所有决策阈值下保持稳定。
AI.conclusion: 框架能有效区分差异化与冗余资产并给出可解释的采购建议，且对权重与阈值较稳健；论文明确区分了实测量与模拟的治理输入，并讨论了单数据集评估的设计局限。

title: TeachBack: Learning to Teach via Bidirectional Preference Optimization for On-Policy Self-Distillation
summary: On-policy self-distillation (OPSD) enables a language model to learn from a Teacher instantiated from the same model but given access to privileged information, such as a reference solution. We find that access to sufficient privileged information allows the Teacher to generate highly accurate trajectories; however, accuracy alone does not guarantee that these trajectories are suitable for Student learning. Direct access to a complete solution may encourage shortened, reference-conditioned derivations that omit the exploration, verification, and self-correction required to solve problems without privileged information. We introduce TeachBack, a bidirectional preference-learning framework for on-policy self-distillation that learns not only from the Teacher but also how the Teacher should teach. TeachBack shapes the Teacher's generation behavior by controlling the length of the reference-reasoning suffix injected into the prompt and by varying the prompt style. While maintaining comparable Teacher accuracy, it encourages the Teacher to explore and re-solve problems, thereby reducing its reliance on the reference solution. At each rollout refresh, the shared policy generates both a privileged Teacher trajectory and a problem-only Student trajectory. A pairwise preference objective uses privileged Teacher trajectories to improve Student learning, while the reversed preference uses the Student's behavior to shape future Teacher supervision under the privileged condition. Experiments on mathematical and logical reasoning tasks show that TeachBack consistently improves Student performance over existing OPSD methods and related baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出 TeachBack 双向偏好学习框架，改进 on-policy self-distillation 中教师轨迹的"可教性"，让教师既提供准确解也教会学生如何探索与自我纠正。
AI.motivation: OPSD 中教师借助特权信息（如参考答案）可生成高准确率轨迹，但准确不等于适合学生学习：直接给出完整解答会诱导学生生成缩短的、依赖参考条件的推导，缺失无特权信息时所需的探索、验证与自我纠正能力。
AI.method: 通过控制注入提示的参考推理解后缀长度与提示风格来塑造教师的生成行为，在保持教师准确率的前提下减少其对参考解的依赖；每次 rollout 刷新时共享策略同时生成特权教师轨迹与仅问题学生轨迹，构建成对偏好目标：正向偏好用教师轨迹提升学生，反向偏好用学生行为反过来塑造未来教师监督。
AI.result: 在数学与逻辑推理任务上，TeachBack 相比现有 OPSD 方法及相关基线持续提升学生性能。
AI.conclusion: 自蒸馏不仅应学习"学什么"，还应学习"教师如何教"；通过双向偏好学习调节教师行为可更有效传递可迁移的推理能力。

title: HiddenLens: A Multi-Layer LLM Framework for Detecting and Resolving Hidden Assumptions in Software Requirements
summary: Natural-language software requirements often omit assumptions about performance, operating conditions, user behaviour, and domain constraints, affecting architecture, testing, and deployment. If undiscovered until implementation, resolving them is far more costly than addressing them early. Although ambiguity and vagueness are widely studied, less attention has been given to assumptions embedded in requirements that appear clear and reasonable. We propose HiddenLens, a novel six-layer BERT-LLM pipeline and, to our knowledge, the first framework engineered to detect, classify, question, and resolve hidden assumptions rather than merely flag ambiguity. Layer 1 uses BERT attention entropy to localise unresolved spans; Layer 2 uses CoT-prompted LLM reasoning to articulate each assumption and its failure risk; Layer 3 uses fine-tuned BERT to classify assumptions into six non-functional requirement categories: performance, security, scalability, usability, reliability, and domain; Layer 4 generates ranked clarification options using FS LLM prompting; Layer 5 enables human validation through confirmation, editing, or rephrasing; and Layer 6 rewrites the requirement using the confirmed resolution, producing an explicit, testable, and traceable requirement. We also introduce the HiddenLens Corpus (HLC), comprising 312 requirements annotated with 847 hidden assumptions across six NFR categories. Inspired by PROMISE and PURE, HLC addresses the lack of annotated data for this task and is, to our knowledge, the first dataset developed specifically for it. HiddenLens outperforms keyword-based and QuARS-Adapted baselines by 71% and 61%, respectively, achieving an end-to-end F1-score of 0.79; its BERT-based NFR classifier achieves an F1-score of 0.847. These results indicate that HiddenLens can help analysts resolve hidden assumptions before they propagate through software development.

AI.tldr: 提出 HiddenLens，一个六层 BERT-LLM 流水线，用于检测、分类、质疑并解决自然语言需求中"隐含假设"，并发布首个专门数据集 HLC。
AI.motivation: 自然语言需求常省略关于性能、运行环境、用户行为和领域约束的假设，若直到实现阶段才发现代价高昂。现有研究多关注歧义与模糊性，对"看似清晰合理"的隐含假设关注不足。
AI.method: 六层流水线：(1) BERT 注意力熵定位未解决片段；(2) CoT 提示 LLM 阐述假设及失效风险；(3) 微调 BERT 将假设分为性能、安全、可扩展性、可用性、可靠性、领域六类 NFR；(4) FS 提示生成排序后的澄清选项；(5) 人工验证（确认/编辑/改写）；(6) 按确认结果重写需求。另构建 HLC 语料库（312 条需求、847 个隐含假设）。
AI.result: 端到端 F1 为 0.79，较关键词基线和 QuARS-Adapted 分别提升 71% 和 61%；BERT NFR 分类器 F1 达 0.847。
AI.conclusion: HiddenLens 能帮助分析师在隐含假设传播到软件开发各环节之前予以解决，并填补了该任务的标注数据空白。

title: MOSAIC: An Omni-Modal Benchmark for Long-Term Memory and Cross-Modal Reasoning in Conversational Agents
summary: Omni-modal assistants must remember not only what users say, but also what they show and convey. Existing long-term memory benchmarks are mostly text-and-image or report a single end-to-end score, so they cannot locate whether evidence is lost when it is represented, retrieved, delivered, or read. We introduce MOSAIC, a benchmark of 923 questions over persona-grounded histories of 11-24 sessions spanning text, image, video, and audio. MOSAIC constructs targeted spatial, temporal, and prosodic signals rather than decorative media, with the strongest causal validation for spatial information and selector-level validation for annotated prosody, and pairs them with a matched diagnostic protocol that freezes the question, reader, prompt, and budget while intervening on representation, retrieval, and delivery. Matched decomposition shows that representation loss is modality-dependent, residual reading dominates even under gold evidence, and abstention remains weak on these controls: strong answerable scores coexist with failures to refuse. MOSAIC thus turns omni-modal memory evaluation from a leaderboard into a diagnosis of write, retrieve, deliver, and read failures.

AI.tldr: 提出MOSAIC基准，用923道题覆盖文本/图像/视频/音频的人设化长程历史，通过冻结问题-阅读器-提示-预算、仅干预表征/检索/投递的匹配诊断协议，将全模态记忆评估从单一排行榜变为可定位“写、取、投、读”失效环节的诊断。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态助手需记住用户所说的、展示的和传达的内容，但现有长期记忆基准多为文本+图像，或只给单一端到端分数，无法定位证据是在表征、检索、投递还是读取环节丢失。
AI.method: 构建MOSAIC：923题、11-24会话的人设化历史，涵盖文本、图像、视频、音频；刻意构造空间、时间、韵律信号而非装饰性媒体（空间信息有最强因果验证，标注韵律有选择器级验证）；配套匹配诊断协议，固定问题、阅读器、提示与预算，仅对表征、检索、投递做干预。
AI.result: 匹配分解显示：表征损失依模态而异；即便给定金标证据，残余的读取损失仍占主导；弃答能力偏弱——强可答分数与拒绝失败并存。
AI.conclusion: MOSAIC使全模态记忆评估成为对写入、检索、投递与读取失败的分环节诊断，而非单一排行榜排名。

title: WaFIR: Wavelet-Fourier Mixture-of-Experts with Subband-Adaptive Routing for Blind All-in-One Image Restoration
comment: 24 pages, 15 figures, 13 tables, including supplementary material
summary: Blind all-in-one image restoration must adapt a shared model to heterogeneous and sometimes mixed degradations without a task label at test time. We introduce WaFIR, a decoder module that decomposes features into Haar subbands, summarizes each subband with a compact Fourier descriptor, and routes it to prompt-conditioned spectral modulation experts. Unlike image-level frequency conditioning, WaFIR makes routing decisions at the subband level, enabling frequency-specific processing while retaining the task context learned by the backbone. Under a unified training and evaluation protocol for denoising, deraining, and dehazing, WaFIR improves average PSNR over the three tasks by 0.48 dB over the PromptIR baseline and by 0.38 dB over the recent Up-Restorer. Matched-capacity and routing controls show that the gain is not explained by additional parameters alone. On unseen noise intensities, descriptor-based routing is more robust than a discrete label-conditioned alternative and remains on par under compound degradations, while routing analyses show stable subband-dependent expert use across degradation types. These results support subband frequency structure as an interpretable complement to prompt-based conditioning for blind image restoration. Code is available at https://anonymous.4open.science/r/WaFIR/README.md

AI.tldr: WaFIR 是一个用于盲全功能图像复原的解码器模块，将特征分解为 Haar 子带，用紧凑傅里叶描述子表示每个子带，并将其路由到由提示条件化的频谱调制专家，从而在测试时无需任务标签即可处理异构与混合退化。
AI.motivation: 盲全功能图像复原需要共享模型在测试时无任务标签情况下适应异构甚至混合的退化。现有图像级频率条件化难以进行频率特异性处理，且离散标签条件化在未见噪声强度下鲁棒性不足。
AI.method: 提出 WaFIR 解码器模块：(1) 将特征分解为 Haar 子带；(2) 用紧凑傅里叶描述子概括每个子带；(3) 在子带级别进行路由决策，将子带路由到提示条件化的频谱调制专家。子带级路由实现频率特异处理，同时保留骨干网络学习到的任务上下文。
AI.result: 在去噪、去雨、去雾三任务的统一训练与评估协议下，平均 PSNR 较 PromptIR 基线提升 0.48 dB，较近期 Up-Restorer 提升 0.38 dB。等容量与路由控制实验表明增益并非仅来自额外参数。在未见噪声强度下，基于描述子的路由比离散标签条件化方案更鲁棒；在复合退化下性能相当。路由分析显示不同退化类型下子带相关专家使用稳定。
AI.conclusion: 子带频率结构可作为基于提示条件化的可解释补充，用于盲图像复原。

title: Auditing Conformal Prediction for Language Models Under Inference-Time Model Shift
comment: Accepted at the 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026). Track on Evaluations and Datasets
summary: Conformal prediction (CP) for language models is typically evaluated under a matched protocol, in which calibration and deployment use the same post-training inference configuration, such as quantization mode and inference temperature. In deployment, these choices often differ from those used at calibration to meet memory or throughput constraints or serving policies. We argue that this exposes a limitation in current CP evaluation protocols for language models. We formalize the underlying phenomenon as inference-time model shift: a change in the conformal score distribution induced by inference configuration rather than by the input--label distribution, and theoretically characterize how it breaks split-conformal exchangeability even when the task distribution and trained model are unchanged. We then evaluate its consequences across 8 language models, 4 finite-label benchmarks, and 12 inference configurations. We find that matched evaluation can substantially overstate deployment-time coverage, and that the effect is heterogeneous across models and datasets. We argue that inference configuration should be reported as a first-class experimental axis in CP evaluations for language-model systems.

AI.tldr: 该文指出语言模型共形预测(CP)通常在校准与部署同配置下评估，但在实际部署中推理配置（量化、温度等）常与校准不同，导致"推理时模型漂移"，破坏split-conformal可交换性，使覆盖率被高估。
AI.motivation: 现有CP评估采用匹配协议（校准与部署用相同推理配置），而部署时因内存、吞吐或服务策略限制，量化和推理温度等配置往往与校准不同。这一差异未被现有评估协议覆盖，可能掩盖部署期覆盖率失效的问题。
AI.method: 形式化定义"推理时模型漂移"——由推理配置（而非输入-标签分布）引起的共形分数分布变化；理论上刻画其如何破坏split-conformal的可交换性（即使任务分布与训练模型不变）；并在8个语言模型、4个有限标签基准、12种推理配置上进行实证评估。
AI.result: 匹配评估会显著高估部署时的覆盖率，且该效应在不同模型与数据集间呈异质性。
AI.conclusion: 主张将推理配置作为CP评估中的一等实验轴（first-class experimental axis）予以报告。

title: When Multiple Choices Are Correct: Asymmetric Probability Allocation in Jev and Other Decision Models
summary: Decision models return normalized probability distributions over candidate choices, which downstream applications can use to select among choices. Although their providers emphasize the reliability of these probabilities, calibration on tasks with a single correct choice does not establish their reliability when multiple choices are correct. We evaluate three decision models (Jev, Liquid d1, and GPT-6 Luna Decisions) on three diverse datasets (MetaTool, HotpotQA, and ECtHR) to study probability allocation and thresholding. Even when models rank every correct choice above every distractor, in 28% to 50% of those lists, at least one correct choice receives a probability below the uniform probability of 1/n, where n is the number of choices. We also present each model with five identical copies of a correct choice and observe probability disparities, with mean gaps ranging from 17 to 79 percentage points. We further show how these allocation disparities affect the recovery of multiple correct choices under probability thresholding. Decision-model probabilities can rank correct choices, but a probability threshold does not identify the set of correct choices.

AI.tldr: 本文评估三个决策模型（Jev、Liquid d1、GPT-6 Luna Decisions）在三个数据集上对多正确答案的概率分配与阈值筛选行为，发现概率可排序但阈值无法识别正确答案集合。
AI.motivation: 提供方强调决策模型输出概率的可靠性，但现有校准研究多基于"单一正确答案"任务，无法说明模型在有多个正确答案时概率是否可靠。
AI.method: 在 MetaTool、HotpotQA、ECtHR 三个数据集上评估三个决策模型，分析概率分配与阈值化效果；并给模型提供同一正确选项的五份完全相同的副本，测量其概率差异。
AI.result: 即便模型把所有正确选项都排在所有干扰项之上，仍有 28%–50% 的列表中存在至少一个正确选项的概率低于均匀概率 1/n；同一正确选项五份副本间的概率差平均达 17 至 79 个百分点；这些分配差异进一步影响阈值化对多个正确答案的恢复效果。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型的概率可用于正确选项的排序，但概率阈值并不能识别正确答案集合。

title: Code Comprehensor: Hierarchical Documentation and Cross-Modal Retrieval for Large Repositories
comment: Accepted at 42nd International Conference on Software Maintenance and Evolution
summary: Understanding large, complex, and rapidly evolving code bases remains a core challenge for software engineering at scale, hindering onboarding, maintenance, refactoring, and impact analysis. Providing this information to a Large-Language Model (LLM) is another hurdle, as the LLM must understand not only the required code method but also its associated methods in the grand scheme of the repository. We propose Code Comprehensor, a hybrid retrieval-reasoning framework combining (i) a code dependency callgraph, (ii) CodeScribe, which uses code-aware LLMs to generate hierarchical documentation across repository call graphs, and (iii) CodeContrast, a CLIP-style dual-encoder model trained on CodeScribe output to learn aligned text-code embeddings. CodeContrast enables fast, semantically precise retrieval of relevant code-context neighborhoods, which serve as grounded evidence for an MCP-based LLM orchestrator answering domain-specific queries. Evaluation on OpenCV and a proprietary 5M-LOC repository shows that CodeScribe-derived supervision significantly improves cross-modal retrieval in text-to-code accuracy over baseline approaches. Richer textual supervision (hierarchical documentation, parent/sibling context, and LLM-generated synthetic questions) consistently enhances performance across both repositories. LLM-as-a-judge evaluation using the popular RAGAS of the Code Comprehensor output yields above 90% faithfulness scores.

AI.tldr: 提出 Code Comprehensor 混合检索-推理框架，结合调用图、LLM 生成层次化文档（CodeScribe）与 CLIP 式双编码器（CodeContrast），实现代码上下文的语义检索与问答。
AI.motivation: 大型、复杂、快速演化的代码库难以理解，阻碍上手、维护、重构和影响分析；直接把代码喂给 LLM 又难以让其理解方法在仓库整体中的关联。
AI.method: 三层组件：(i) 基于代码依赖的调用图；(ii) CodeScribe 用代码感知 LLM 沿调用图生成层次化文档；(iii) CodeContrast 为 CLIP 风格双编码器，用 CodeScribe 输出训练对齐文本-代码嵌入，实现快速语义检索；检索到的代码邻域作为证据，交由基于 MCP 的 LLM 编排器回答特定领域查询。
AI.result: 在 OpenCV 与一个专有 500 万行代码库上评估：CodeScribe 监督显著提升文本到代码检索准确率；更丰富的文本监督（层次化文档、父/兄弟上下文、LLM 合成问题）在两仓库均稳定提升性能；RAGAS 评估的忠实度超过 90%。
AI.conclusion: 将调用图结构、LLM 生成的层次化文档监督与对比学习检索相结合，可为大规模代码理解提供高效、可落地且有据可依的问答方案。

title: Let Agents Design How They Search: Automatic Interface Optimization for Agentic Search
summary: Agentic search depends on the interface through which a language-model agent accesses and explores a corpus. Existing interface designs are fixed by hand and applied unchanged to every corpus, although effective designs may depend on the corpus. We introduce SearchWeaver, a framework for automatic search interface optimization guided by downstream search performance. A proposer uses execution trajectories and task rewards to jointly revise corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions. This pro cess optimizes what information is prepared in advance, which operations tools perform, and which decisions remain with the search agent. With GPT-5.4-nano, the optimized interfaces improve answer accuracy from 71.6% to 78.4% on BrowseComp-Plus and average nDCG@10 from 45.7 to 55.0 across four BRIGHT subsets over Direct Corpus Interaction. These findings highlight the value of jointly optimizing corpus artifacts, executable tools, and usage instructions to develop effective search interfaces.

AI.tldr: 提出SearchWeaver框架，以搜索任务表现为目标自动优化agentic search的搜索接口，联合改进语料工件、可执行工具与使用说明；在BrowseComp-Plus与BRIGHT上显著优于Direct Corpus Interaction。
AI.motivation: 现有搜索接口由人工固定设计，并对所有语料统一套用；但有效接口可能依赖于具体语料，因此需要按语料和下游搜索表现自动优化接口。
AI.method: SearchWeaver用一个proposer，基于执行轨迹与任务奖励，联合修改三类接口要素：语料工件（预先准备哪些信息）、可执行工具（工具执行哪些操作）、使用说明（哪些决策留给搜索agent），从而优化信息预处理、操作封装与agent决策的分工。
AI.result: 在GPT-5.4-nano下，相较Direct Corpus Interaction，答案准确率在BrowseComp-Plus上由71.6%提升至78.4%；在四个BRIGHT子集上平均nDCG@10由45.7提升至55.0。
AI.conclusion: 联合优化语料工件、可执行工具与使用说明能构建更有效的搜索接口；按语料特性自动优化接口具有实际价值。

title: Two for One: Privileged Learning for Resource-Constrained Screening
summary: Machine learning systems are often developed under data-rich conditions but deployed when only incomplete information is available. A natural example arises in colour fundus photography (CFP), where both eyes are commonly imaged because they can provide complementary information for ocular disease assessment. Prior approaches that exploit bilateral information either fuse both eyes in a single model or use knowledge distillation to compress a dual-eye teacher into a lightweight student that still requires both images at test time. However, bilateral acquisition may not always be feasible. We thus propose a privileged learning framework in which a teacher model has access to bilateral CFP images during training and learns representations informed by information from both eyes, while the student is trained to transfer this knowledge from the bilateral teacher using only a single-eye image as input. At inference, the student operates exclusively on this single-eye input and does not require the contralateral image. Experimental results show consistent improvements in area under the receiver operating characteristic curve over conventional monocular training, with the largest gains observed for left-eye images for the detection of age-related macular degeneration (0.931 vs. 0.966) and diabetic retinopathy (0.789 vs. 0.836).%, while requiring only a single-eye image at inference. By enabling models to benefit from bilateral information during training while requiring only a single-eye image at inference, our approach may support more reliable deployment in resource-constrained clinical and screening environments.

AI.tldr: 提出特权学习框架，训练时教师模型用双眼CFP图像，学生模型仅用单眼输入迁移知识，推理时只需单眼图像，在AMD和DR检测上AUC明显提升。
AI.motivation: 既往利用双眼互补信息的方法要么把双眼融合进单一模型，要么用知识蒸馏压缩双教师模型，但测试时仍需双眼图像；而实际采集双侧图像并不总是可行，需在推理时只用单眼却仍享受双眼信息带来的益处。
AI.method: 特权学习（privileged learning）框架：教师模型在训练阶段可访问双侧CFP图像，学习融合双眼信息的表征；学生模型仅以单眼图像为输入，通过从双侧教师处迁移知识进行训练。推理阶段学生只处理单眼输入，不需要对侧图像。
AI.result: 相比传统单眼训练，AUC一致性提升；左眼图像增益最大，AMD检测AUC由0.931提升至0.966，DR检测由0.789提升至0.836，且推理仅需单眼图像。
AI.conclusion: 该方法使模型在训练时受益于双侧信息、推理时仅需单眼图像，有助于在资源受限的临床与筛查环境中实现更可靠的部署。

title: Multi-Objective Protein Optimization via Modular Diffusion Steering
summary: Protein engineering often requires improving several properties simultaneously, motivating the search for high-performing sequences that represent useful fitness tradeoffs. Discovering these sequences is challenging because the design space is combinatorially large and experimental campaigns often permit only a few rounds of batched measurements. We introduce \textit{MODS}, a modular framework for multi-objective protein optimization via inference-time diffusion steering. For each proposal, MODS samples augmented Chebyshev scalarization weights and a fitness-surrogate ensemble member to define a scalar steering reward. Varying the weights directs generation toward different objective tradeoffs, while varying ensemble members diversifies the predictions used for guidance. Because MODS expresses multi-objective acquisition through scalar rewards, it can be paired with different diffusion models and compatible steering procedures. After each evaluation batch, MODS updates the surrogates without retraining the generative model. We evaluate MODS on six protein optimization tasks using predictive oracles trained on experimental assay data, with two diffusion models and two steering procedures. MODS achieves competitive final hypervolume across all six tasks with both diffusion models, and substantially outperforms the best evaluated baseline on several tasks. Our results demonstrate a flexible and effective approach to multi-objective protein optimization with limited feedback.

AI.tldr: MODS 是一个模块化的多目标蛋白质优化框架，通过在推理阶段对扩散模型进行"引导（steering）"来实现多目标权衡序列的生成。
AI.motivation: 蛋白质工程常需同时提升多个属性，期望找到代表有效适应度权衡的高性能序列；但设计空间组合爆炸，且实验通常只允许少量批次测量，导致多目标优化的探索十分困难。
AI.method: MODS 不做生成模型重训，而是在推理时构造标量引导奖励：每次候选采样时随机抽取增强型 Chebyshev 标量化权重和一个适应度代理模型（ensemble 成员）组成奖励，权重变化引导不同目标权衡，集成成员变化增加引导多样性。每轮评估后仅更新代理模型，可与不同扩散模型和兼容的引导流程组合。
AI.result: 在六个基于实验测定数据训练的预测 oracle 的蛋白质优化任务上，结合两种扩散模型和两种引导流程，MODS 均取得有竞争力的最终超体积，并在若干任务上显著优于最佳对比基线。
AI.conclusion: MODS 为反馈有限条件下的多目标蛋白质优化提供了一种灵活且有效的方法。

title: From Scores to Safe Sets: Exact Safety--Constrained Decoding for Medication Recommendation
summary: Recent generative medication recommendation systems ultimately produce sets of drugs, but drug--drug interaction (DDI) constraints depend on the set as a whole. A natural post-hoc approach is to first predict medications and then locally repair interacting pairs by removing one drug at a time. We ask whether this local repair step itself introduces avoidable error. Using fixed medication scores from FLAME's frozen classifier on MIMIC-III, we compare increasingly strong local repair strategies with an exact global decoder while holding the scores, output size, and DDI constraint fixed. The global decoder jointly selects the highest-scoring feasible medication set using mixed-integer linear programming. Across validation and test splits, global decoding consistently achieves higher Jaccard similarity than greedy repair, degree-aware repair, and degree-aware repair strengthened with exhaustive 1-swap local search. Its advantage is small under loose DDI constraints and becomes larger as the constraint tightens; on the test split it reaches +0.0064 Jaccard over the strongest local baseline at the strict DDI operating point. The finding also holds across a fine accuracy--DDI sweep at matched realized DDI exposure and under three score representations. At the strict setting, global decoding retains more true-positive medications while removing more false positives. These results show that medication recommendation is not only a representation-learning problem: even with a frozen clinical model, how its scores are converted into a constrained medication set can materially affect the final prediction.

AI.tldr: 在固定药物打分的条件下，用精确全局解码（MILP）替代贪心式局部修复，可在DDI约束下获得一致更优的药物集合预测。
AI.motivation: 现有生成式用药推荐最终输出药物集合，而DDI约束依赖集合整体；常见的后处理做法是先预测再逐对删除药物做局部修复，作者质疑这种局部修复本身是否引入了可避免的误差。
AI.method: 固定FLAME冻结分类器在MIMIC-III上给出的药物分数、输出规模与DDI约束，比较多种局部修复策略（贪心修复、度数感知修复、度数感知+穷举1-swap局部搜索）与基于混合整数线性规划的精确全局解码器。
AI.result: 在验证集与测试集上全局解码的Jaccard均更高；约束越严格优势越大，测试集严格DDI设定下比最强局部基线高+0.0064 Jaccard；在与实际DDI暴露对齐的精度-DDI扫描及三种分数表示下结论稳定；严格设定下全局解码保留更多真阳性并去除更多假阳性。
AI.conclusion: 用药推荐不只是表征学习问题：即使临床模型冻结，分数如何被转换为受约束的药物集合也会显著影响最终预测。

title: SWE-DIVE: Multi-Turn Coding Agent Evaluation with Dynamic User Simulation
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 workshop "Grounded User Simulation for Model Evaluation and Training: Diversity, Fidelity, and Validity'' (non-archival)
summary:
Coding agents are typically evaluated using one-shot, well-formulated prompts. Benchmarks such as SWE-bench use existing GitHub issues as input for a coding agent and evaluate whether the agent successfully solves the task. However, in real-world use cases, prompts are often not as well-formulated or structured as existing GitHub issues. Additionally, a coding agent session is not limited to a single prompt; it typically involves a multi-turn interaction in which the user iteratively adds new tasks and requirements that the agent must fulfill.
  To benchmark these abilities, we developed SWE-DIVE, a dynamic, interactive validation and evaluation framework for benchmarking coding agents in a multi-turn environment. To achieve this, we introduce a user simulator that can simulate different behavioral patterns and communicate with the coding agent. We also introduce a conversation validator that evaluates the user simulator's outputs to determine whether they fulfill the initial requirements and guide the agent toward successfully solving the task. The entire framework is embedded in a Harbor environment, which orchestrates the coding agent, user simulator, and conversation validator, and executes the test environment to determine whether the agent successfully solves the task. Our results and source code are available in our GitHub repository (https://github.com/lorenzbrehme/swe-dive_usersim).

AI.tldr: 提出 SWE-DIVE，一个多轮交互式的代码智能体评测框架，通过用户模拟器和对话验证器在 Harbor 环境中模拟真实的不规范、多轮需求场景，以弥补现有单轮基准（如 SWE-bench）的不足。
AI.motivation: 现有代码智能体评测（如 SWE-bench）依赖一次性、结构良好的 GitHub issue 提示，与真实使用场景不符：真实提示往往不规范，且交互是多轮迭代的，用户会不断追加新任务与需求，这些能力目前缺乏基准衡量。
AI.method: 构建 SWE-DIVE 动态交互式评测框架，包含三部分：1）用户模拟器，可模拟不同行为模式的用户并与智能体对话；2）对话验证器，评估用户模拟器输出是否满足初始要求并引导智能体完成任务；3）Harbor 环境，负责编排智能体、用户模拟器与验证器，并执行测试环境判定任务是否成功。
AI.result: 框架可对代码智能体在多轮、非规范提示场景下的表现进行评测并给出是否成功解题的判定；结果与源码已开源于 GitHub（lorenzbrehme/swe-dive_usersim）。
AI.conclusion: SWE-DIVE 提供了更贴近真实场景的多轮交互式代码智能体评测基准，将用户模拟与对话验证结合到端到端测试环境中，为评估智能体在迭代需求下的能力提供了新方法。

title: Intergroup Bias Predicts Expressions of Social Judgment and Empathy in the r/AmITheAsshole Reddit Community
summary: People share and understand others' experiences differently based on their social identities; often, people empathize more when the other person belongs to their ingroup compared to an outgroup. While this intergroup empathy gap is well-studied in social psychology, it remains unclear how it manifests in naturally occurring online social interactions. To this end, we measure how commenters express social judgments, as an indirect outcome of their understanding towards the posters, and empathy in text, based on whether commenters share the poster's gender or are of similar ages. We focus on posts where the poster self-reports these demographics, and analyze 126,716 comments associated with 36,163 posts from 18,111 commenters in r/AmItheAsshole, while controlling for commenter and poster group identities, post features (topic, length, and score), and both commenter- and post-level variance. Our results show that when commenters and posters are ingroup, in either gender or age, commenters are more likely to provide a Not the Asshole verdict and show greater text-based understanding as measured by LLMs. We also observe that older commenters behave differently from younger ones. Furthermore, in a subset of posts where the gender and age of the other party in the conflict are explicitly mentioned, we find that commenter-poster ingroup effects are moderated by the group relationships between the poster and the other party when commenters make social judgments. Our work highlights the importance of intergroup context and social group nuances in understanding online discourse.

AI.tldr: 本文分析r/AmItheAsshole中12.6万条评论，发现评论者与发帖者性别或年龄相同时更倾向给"NTA"判定并表现出更高的文本理解/共情，且该内群体效应受发帖者与冲突另一方群体关系调节。
AI.motivation: 社会心理学已充分研究内群体/外群体共情差距，但其在自然发生的在线社交互动中如何体现仍不清楚，本文希望填补这一空白。
AI.method: 从r/AmItheAsshole收集36,163篇帖子、18,111名评论者的126,716条评论；以评论者与发帖者在性别或年龄上的群体一致性为自变量，用社会判定（NTA/YTA）和LLM测量的文本共情为因变量；控制双方群体身份、帖子特征及评论者与帖子层面方差；并在明确提及冲突另一方性别/年龄的子集中检验调节效应。
AI.result: 当评论者与发帖者在性别或年龄上属同一内群体时，更可能给出Not the Asshole判定，且LLM测得的文本理解程度更高；年长评论者行为与年轻评论者不同；评论者—发帖者内群体效应会被发帖者与冲突另一方的群体关系所调节。
AI.conclusion: 内群体共情差距在真实在线讨论中确实存在，且深受群体语境与社会群体细微差异影响，说明理解在线话语需重视群际情境。

title: DGCM-SSFA: Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulation and Sparse Strip Frequency Attention for Efficient 3T-to-7T MRI Synthesis
summary: Synthesizing high-fidelity 7T MRI from routinely acquired 3T scans offers a practical pathway to enhanced neuroimaging without the prohibitive cost of ultra-high-field scanners. While existing deep learning approaches have achieved promising results, state-of-the-art methods typically rely on either large-scale architectures exceeding 45 million parameters or computationally intensive ensemble strategies, limiting their practicality in resource-constrained clinical environments. In this work, we propose a compact multi-domain attention framework, termed DGCM-SSFA, that achieves competitive synthesis quality with only 11M parameters. The proposed architecture integrates two complementary modules into a U-Net Transformer backbone. First, a Dual-Granularity Cross-Modulated Feature Modulator (DGCM) is embedded at multiple hierarchical levels to enhance local edge and texture details through Sobel-guided spatial attention and depthwise frequency-aware channel attention with cross-branch gating. Second, a Sparse Strip Frequency Attention (SSFA) module at the bottleneck captures global spatial context via strip-pooled attention with near-linear complexity, while simultaneously performing FFT-based spectral modulation in the frequency domain. These two modules operate synergistically with the backbone's native channel attention, forming a triple-granularity feature refinement pipeline. Extensive experiments on the UNC and BNU 3T-to-7T MRI datasets across T1w and T2w modalities demonstrate that DGCM-SSFA achieves strong structural fidelity, attaining an SSIM of 0.8431 on BNU T2w---approaching the best benchmark value of 0.8624---and 0.8100 on BNU T1w, while using substantially fewer parameters than Transformer-based alternatives such as ResViT (123.4M) and FS-RWKV (45.4M).

AI.tldr: 提出紧凑多域注意力框架DGCM-SSFA（仅11M参数），在3T-to-7T MRI合成中达到接近SOTA的结构保真度。
AI.motivation: 用常规3T扫描合成高保真7T MRI可规避超高场扫描仪高昂成本，但现有深度学习方法依赖超45M参数的大模型或高计算量集成策略，难以在资源受限的临床环境落地。
AI.method: 在U-Net Transformer骨干上集成两个互补模块：多层级嵌入双粒度交叉调制特征调制器（DGCM），通过Sobel引导的空间注意力与深度可分离的频率感知通道注意力及跨分支门控增强局部边缘纹理；瓶颈处引入稀疏条带频率注意力（SSFA），以条带池化注意力实现近线性复杂度的全局上下文建模，并在频域做FFT谱调制；与骨干原生通道注意力协同形成三级粒度特征细化流程。
AI.result: 在UNC与BNU的3T-to-7T数据集、T1w/T2w模态上验证：BNU T2w SSIM 0.8431（最佳基准0.8624），BNU T1w SSIM 0.8100，参数量显著少于ResViT（123.4M）与FS-RWKV（45.4M）等Transformer方案。
AI.conclusion: 多域（空间-频率-通道）注意力与三级粒度细化可在极小参数量下实现接近SOTA的7T合成质量，为资源受限临床场景提供实用方案。

title: Is 2:4 Sparsity Still Worth It? Semi-Structured Sparsity versus Quantization in LLM Inference
summary: NVIDIA tensor cores have supported 2:4 semi-structured sparsity since Ampere, and the pattern composes with quantization. When the two are combined, the practical question is which step to take next: from a given precision, add 2:4 sparsity or drop to the next lower precision? We compare the two at equal bits, with sparsity metadata counted, and at equal nominal tensor-core tiers, over all six GEMM operands of a transformer layer, with kernels measured on three GPU generations and online pruning and quantization included. Our results show that as long as a lower precision is available, adding 2:4 is the worse step, both less accurate and slower, because the energy that 2:4 discards from each group of four along the hardware-forced axis does not shrink with bits, while quantization error does. Once quantization reaches the lowest precision the hardware supports, 2:4 still speeds up linear layers by 1.3--1.7\x{}, and on an H100 a retrained 2:4 model served in FP8 by vLLM reaches 27\% higher prefill throughput than the dense FP8 model, with GSM8K accuracy on par. Its quality has to be won back by retraining, however, which restores perplexity long before reasoning; on Blackwell, whose sparse FP4 uses a pairwise 4:8 pattern, the loss is larger and our retraining budget did not recover it.

AI.tldr: 在等比特与等张量核档位条件下，比较"加2:4稀疏"与"降一档精度"，结论是只要有更低精度可用，加2:4是更差的一步（更不准确且更慢）；仅当量化到底层最低精度时2:4才带来1.3–1.7×加速。
AI.motivation: NVIDIA张量核自Ampere起支持2:4半结构化稀疏，且该模式可与量化叠加。实际部署中面临决策问题：给定当前精度，下一步该加2:4稀疏，还是降到下一档更低精度？现有工作缺乏在比特数可比、硬件档位可比条件下的系统对比。
AI.method: 在比特数相等（计入稀疏元数据开销）和名义张量核档位相等两种口径下对比两种方案；覆盖Transformer层全部六个GEMM操作数；在三代GPU上实测kernel，并纳入在线剪枝与量化开销。
AI.result: 只要有更低精度可选，加2:4都更差：精度更低且更慢。原因在于2:4沿硬件强制轴每4个元素中丢弃的能量不随比特下降而缩小，而量化误差随比特下降。当量化已到底层最低精度时，2:4仍可让线性层加速1.3–1.7×；H100上经重训的2:4模型以FP8经vLLM部署，prefill吞吐比稠密FP8模型高27%，GSM8K精度持平。但质量需靠重训找回，且重训先恢复困惑度、远晚于推理能力恢复；Blackwell的稀疏FP4采用4:8成对模式，损失更大，给定重训预算未能恢复。
AI.conclusion: 精度优先于稀疏：应先把量化降到硬件支持的最低精度，再考虑2:4（或Blackwell的4:8）稀疏；稀疏带来的加速需以重训成本换取，且收益在低精度新硬件上更不确定。

title: CrashGym: Measuring the Decision Value of Experimentation for LLM Agents in Counterfactual Market Crashes
summary: Language-model agents are increasingly asked to run experiments, yet benchmarks rarely measure whether those experiments improve the decisions they are meant to inform. We introduce CrashGym, a deterministic, replayable limit-order-book simulator in which an agent must choose between a deleveraging intervention and a liquidity backstop for a market about to suffer a shock-triggered crash. Before committing, the agent may query intervention experiments in a laboratory realization of the market. Its choice is then scored on an independently seeded target realization in which the simulator executes every feasible intervention, so regret relative to the best intervention is computed by directly simulating every alternative on the same target repeats, with no human or model-based judging. The simulator implements each amplification channel---persistent price impact, liquidity withdrawal, margin-driven liquidation, and an evolving strategy mix---as an explicit mechanism that can be switched on in stages. In a prospectively specified study on 24 newly sampled worlds, laboratory access reduces the mean regret of the one deployment with a complete record (Luna) from 8.878 to 3.785, a paired reduction of 5.092 utility units (nominal 95% world-bootstrap interval: 1.028--9.507), or 57.4% of the OBSERVE-ONLY mean. Prospective comparisons for two further deployments are incomplete; in a separate exploratory study, mean regret is lower with laboratory access for all four deployments evaluated. A laboratory whose strategy mix evolves endogenously yields no established advantage over one with a fixed mix. CrashGym thus measures the value of experimentation as avoided decision loss and lets simulator detail be judged by the decisions it supports.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 CrashGym——一个确定性、可回放的限价订单簿模拟器，用于衡量语言模型智能体"做实验"本身的价值：智能体可在实验室市场副本中试跑干预方案，再在独立种子的目标市场中部署，以相对最优干预的后悔值（regret）作为评分，无需人工或模型评判。
AI.motivation: 现有基准很少衡量智能体所做实验是否真的改善了其决策质量；缺少一个能把"实验的价值"直接量化为决策损失的工具和市场崩盘决策场景。
AI.method: 构建 CrashGym：确定性可回放的限价订单簿模拟器，模拟冲击触发的崩盘，智能体须在"去杠杆干预"与"流动性支持"间选择；可先在实验室实现中查询干预实验再决定。模拟器显式实现四类放大机制（持续价格冲击、流动性撤出、保证金驱动清算、演化策略组合），可分阶段开关。目标实现中穷举所有可行干预并直接模拟，据此计算真实 regret；采用世界自助法区间评估。
AI.result: 在24个新采样世界的预先设定研究中，实验室访问使记录完整的部署 Luna 的平均 regret 由 8.878 降至 3.785（配对降低 5.092，95% 区间 1.028–9.507），即 OBSERVE-ONLY 均值的 57.4%；另两个部署的前瞻对比不完整；探索性研究中四个部署的 regret 均因实验室访问而降低。策略组合内生演化的实验室相对固定组合无确立优势。
AI.conclusion: CrashGym 将实验价值量化为避免的决策损失，并使模拟器细节可按其支撑的决策质量来评判。

title: Validating Autoformalized Specifications via Contrapuntal Languages
summary: Formal specifications can make AI-generated code mechanically checkable. Because user intent is typically expressed in natural language rather than formal logic, specifications must first be derived from it, e.g., via LLM-based autoformalization. Yet autoformalized specifications are themselves untrusted, so a key challenge is validating whether they capture user intent without relying on a costly oracle such as human review. In this oracle-free setting, a natural strategy is to vote among model outputs, but because model errors are often correlated, agreement among outputs may reflect shared mistakes rather than correctness. Our key insight is that these errors can be decorrelated through representational diversity. We achieve this diversity with contrapuntal languages: pairs of task-specific formal languages, each designed to express the intended specification, yet admitting no structure-preserving translation between them. An LLM formalizes the intent independently in each language, and we accept a specification only if a solver proves the two formalizations equivalent. To construct such languages, we present a synthesis algorithm that reuses fragments of sampled seed specifications as syntactic sugar over a base specification language. We implement the approach for first-order logic specifications and evaluate it on HumanEval+ and LiveCodeBench using GPT-5.4 mini and Qwen3.6-Flash with and without thinking. Over the strongest baseline, our method increases the proportion of accepted specifications that are correct, i.e., complete and sound, by 12.0% on HumanEval+ and 42.9% on LiveCodeBench. The accepted specifications judged complete reject 98.6% of buggy program variants on HumanEval+ and 96.2% on LiveCodeBench, compared with 92.8% and 78.3% for the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出"对位语言"(contrapuntal languages)：两个无法互相结构保持翻译的任务专用形式语言，让LLM独立地在两种语言中形式化用户意图，仅当求解器证明两者等价时才接受该规格，从而实现无oracle的规格验证。
AI.motivation: AI生成代码需要形式规格才能被机械检验，但用户意图通常是自然语言，需靠LLM自动形式化；然而自动形式化的规格本身不可信。要验证其是否忠实反映意图，通常需人类审查等昂贵oracle。在无oracle设定下，对模型输出投票是常见策略，但模型错误往往高度相关，一致可能只是共同犯错。
AI.method: 核心洞见：通过表示多样性使错误去相关。构造"对位语言"——成对的任务专用形式语言，均能表达目标规格，但彼此间不存在结构保持的翻译。LLM分别在两种语言中独立形式化意图，仅当求解器证明两个形式化结果等价时接受规格。此外给出语言合成算法：采样种子规语片段，将其作为基础规格语言上的语法糖复用以构造对位语言。在一阶逻辑规格上实现，并用GPT-5.4 mini与Qwen3.6-Flash（含/不含思考）在HumanEval+和LiveCodeBench上评估。
AI.result: 相对最强基线，被接受规格中正确（既完备又sound）的比例提升12.0%(HumanEval+)与42.9%(LiveCodeBench)。被接受且判为完备的规格分别拒绝98.6%和96.2%的含bug程序变体，而最强基线仅为92.8%和78.3%。
AI.conclusion: 跨表示语言的一致性可作为正确性的可靠代理，从而在无人类oracle的情况下验证自动形式化规格，显著提升接受规格的正确率与缺陷检出能力。

title: Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Models
summary: Masked diffusion language models have emerged as an alternative to autoregressive models, enabling parallel token generation. However, standard masked diffusion language models use a shared noise schedule across positions without explicitly encoding which positions should be resolved first. Many tasks exhibit a natural priority among positions: document titles and section headings can guide the generation of body text, while Sudoku cells determined directly from the initial clues can help resolve more difficult cells. To incorporate this notion of priority (or hierarchy) among token positions, we introduce the Hierarchical Masked Diffusion Language Model (HMDLM), which augments each token position with a hierarchy level available as part of the training data, and requires zero or minimal additional annotations. It factors generation into two passes: the first predicts a hierarchy distribution over masked positions, the second predicts token distributions conditioned on it. Giving each hierarchy level its own noise schedule induces a soft, controllable preference for revealing higher-priority positions earlier while keeping decoding fully parallel. Our formulation is mathematically grounded, and we re-derive the forward and reverse processes and the NELBO for this factorization. Our evaluation shows that for the task of language generation on LM1B, HMDLM reduces perplexity by more than 1.5 points over Anchored Diffusion Language Model (ADLM), a recently proposed strong diffusion baseline; on WikiHow, we see a drop in perplexity of up to 4.4 pts on ADLM and up to 7 pts against MDLM. An LLM judge on WikiHow prefers HMDLM generations (the two variants combined) more than $2\times$ as often as the baseline. On the task of solving Sudoku puzzles requiring multi-step reasoning, it improves solution accuracy by up to $8.6\%$ absolute points over existing diffusion baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出层次化掩码扩散语言模型 HMDLM，通过在训练数据中为每个 token 位置引入层级信息并按层级设置噪声调度，实现"优先生成高优先级位置"的可控并行解码，在语言生成与数独推理任务上均优于 ADLM、MDLM 等基线。
AI.motivation: 标准掩码扩散语言模型对所有位置使用统一的噪声调度，未显式编码"哪些位置应先被确定"。但很多任务本身存在自然的优先级/层次结构：文档标题、章节标题可指引正文生成，数独中由初始线索可直接确定的格子有助于解决更难的格子。作者希望把这种位置间的层次先验纳入扩散建模。
AI.method: HMDLM 为每个 token 位置附加一个层级标签（来自训练数据，几乎无需额外标注）。生成分两遍：第一遍在掩码位置预测层级分布，第二遍在该层级条件下预测 token 分布。每个层级拥有独立的噪声调度，从而以"软"且可控的方式偏好先揭示高优先级位置，同时保持完全并行解码。作者重新推导了该因子分解下的前向过程、反向过程及 NELBO，并给出了数学上的依据。
AI.result: 在 LM1B 语言生成上，困惑度比 ADLM 降低 1.5 点以上；在 WikiHow 上，相比 ADLM 降低最多 4.4 点、相比 MDLM 降低最多 7 点困惑度；LLM 评审在 WikiHow 上偏好 HMDLM 生成结果（两个变体合计）的频率是基线的 2 倍以上。在需要多步推理的数独任务上，求解准确率比现有扩散基线最高提升 8.6 个绝对百分点。
AI.conclusion: 引入层级先验的位置级噪声调度是一种有效且代价低廉的改进，既保持了扩散语言模型的并行生成优势，又在纯语言建模和结构化推理任务上带来一致的性能提升，说明"先生成什么"的顺序信息值得被显式建模。

title: From Augmentation to Synthetic Evidence: Evaluating Generated Chest Radiographs at Dataset Intake
summary: A generated chest radiograph can be useful as declared augmentation, but the same image becomes unsupported evidence when submitted as the record of a real examination. We study this problem by separating three questions: whether an image passes an automated quality check, whether an origin classifier flags it as generated, and whether a trusted record supports the claimed acquisition. In our experiments, Qwen selects up to 20 images from pools of 1,000 existing Cheff-identified or SynthCheX candidates. A receiver evaluates quality with MedGemma and predicted origin with a classifier on frozen DINOv3 features. Quality-based selection raises quality passes from 12 to 19 of 20 for Cheff-identified images and from 8 to 17 for SynthCheX. We find no evidence that selection improves passage through both checks: no selected Cheff-identified image passes both, while uniform, quality, and quality-constrained surrogate selection produce 2, 1, and 2 SynthCheX passes. On unprocessed test images, the origin classifier flags 4,677 of 5,000 SynthCheX images, but it also misclassify 110 of 2,297 NIH (real) images and 568 of 957 genuine images from another collection as fake. Our results further show that JPEG compression reduces SynthCheX-versus-NIH AUROC from 0.987 to 0.841. Even without processing, 152 SynthCheX images pass both pixel checks. These checks can filter submissions, but they cannot verify an acquisition claim. We strongly advocate that source and intended use must be recorded and checked separately for admission of chest radiographs in medical datasets.

AI.tldr: 该研究区分"通过质量检查""被来源分类器判为生成""有可信记录支持采集声明"三个问题，实验表明像素层面的检查可以过滤提交，但无法验证采集声明的真实性，呼吁对胸部X光片的来源与用途分别记录与核查。
AI.motivation: 生成式胸部X光片作为数据增强有用，但若被当作真实检查记录提交则成为无支撑证据。现有自动质量检查与生成图像检测常被混同于"真实性验证"，需要厘清这些检查的边界。
AI.method: 由Qwen从1000张Cheff识别或SynthCheX候选池中挑选至多20张图像；接收方用MedGemma评估质量、用基于冻结DINOv3特征的分类器预测来源；并考察JPEG压缩对检测的影响，对比均匀、质量、质量约束代理三种选择策略。
AI.result: 质量选择将Cheff识别图像的质量通过数从12/20提升到19/20，SynthCheX从8提升到17；但无证据表明选择能同时通过两项检查（选中的Cheff图像无一通过，合成图像通过数为2/1/2）。未处理原图上，分类器在5000张SynthCheX中标记4677张，却将2297张NIH真实图像误判110张、957张另一真实数据集中误判568张；JPEG压缩使SynthCheX-vs-NIH的AUROC从0.987降至0.841，即便未处理仍有152张合成图同时通过两项像素检查。
AI.conclusion: 像素级检查可用于筛选提交，但不能验证采集声明。主张在医学数据集中，来源与预期用途必须被单独记录和核查，以决定胸部X光片的准入。

title: Online Open-World Wafer Defect Discovery using Hyperdimensional Computing
summary: Conventional wafer defect analysis relies on offline, closed-world classifiers that fail to detect novel, unseen defect signatures emerging during continuous semiconductor manufacturing. To address this, we propose WaferHDC, an online open-world wafer defect discovery framework based on hyperdimensional computing (HDC). The memory-centric architecture of WaferHDC enables rapid anomaly detection and grouping of recurring failures into compact hypervector representations. This allows the memory space to dynamically scale with new defect modes without retraining a static classifier or archiving entire raw wafer history. WaferHDC first models normal spatial distributions, then dynamically groups recurring failures into persistent defect memory without labels or predefined class counts. It outperforms the strongest online baseline by 13.3 p.p. in adjusted Rand index and 10.5 p.p. in normalized mutual information on the industry-standard WM-811K dataset. These results demonstrate the effectiveness of WaferHDC for continuous and open-world wafer defect analysis.

AI.tldr: 提出WaferHDC，基于超维计算(HDC)的在线开放世界晶圆缺陷发现框架，能无标签、无预定义类别数地动态发现并分组新缺陷模式。
AI.motivation: 传统晶圆缺陷分析依赖离线、封闭世界的分类器，无法检测持续制造过程中出现的新颖、未见过的缺陷特征。
AI.method: 采用以内存为中心的HDC架构：先建模正常空间分布做异常检测，再将反复出现的故障动态分组为紧凑超向量并存入持久缺陷内存，无需重训静态分类器或存档全部原始晶圆历史。
AI.result: 在业界标准WM-811K数据集上，调整兰德指数比最强在线基线高13.3个百分点，归一化互信息高10.5个百分点。
AI.conclusion: WaferHDC有效支持持续性与开放世界的晶圆缺陷分析。

title: ARCANA: A Benchmark for Abstraction and Analogical Reasoning
summary: Analogical reasoning is widely considered a fundamental component of human intelligence. Few benchmarks are designed to explicitly test far analogical reasoning - reasoning between domains that are superficially dissimilar yet share deep relational or structural similarities. In this work, we introduce an analogical reasoning benchmark called Abstraction and Reasoning Corpus of ANAlogy (ARCANA). The tasks of ARCANA require performing far analogical mappings from real-world objects or physical phenomena to abstract grid-based transformations, different from the well-known ARC-AGI benchmark which primarily emphasized innate human priors. We validate ARCANA through a human study, demonstrating that humans solve these tasks reliably. In contrast, evaluations across a range of large language models show a distinct performance gap compared to humans, revealing systematic failure modes that remain challenging for current models. To address this gap, we propose ConceptSIR, a reasoning framework based on concept slippage, introspection, and reflection. Experiments demonstrate that ConceptSIR enables standard LLMs to solve several challenging ARCANA tasks that were unsolved by direct prompting in our evaluation. Overall, our results suggest that far analogical reasoning remains an open problem for contemporary LLMs. All the materials are available at sites.google.com/view/arcanacogtest. The complete codebase, including benchmark, and ConceptSIR, is publicly available at https://github.com/density-11/arcana-test. All ARCANA data and task instances can be accessed and explored at https://arcanacogtest.org/.

AI.tldr: 论文提出远类比推理基准ARCANA（将现实物体/物理现象映射为抽象网格变换），发现LLM与人类存在显著差距，并提出ConceptSIR框架（概念滑动、内省、反思）以提升LLM表现。
AI.motivation: 远类比推理（表层不同但深层关系/结构相似领域间的推理）是人类智能核心，但少有基准显式测试它；现有ARC-AGI主要强调先天人类先验，缺乏对远类比映射的系统评估。
AI.method: 构建ARCANA基准：任务要求将真实世界物体或物理现象进行远类比映射到抽象网格变换；通过人类研究验证任务可靠性；评测多种LLM；并提出ConceptSIR推理框架，基于概念滑动（concept slippage）、内省与反思来增强标准LLM求解能力。
AI.result: 人类能可靠解题，而多种LLM表现明显落后，暴露系统性的失败模式；ConceptSIR使标准LLM成功解决若干直接提示无法解决的挑战性ARCANA任务。
AI.conclusion: 远类比推理对当代LLM仍是开放问题；ARCANA基准与ConceptSIR框架已公开。

title: Credit Where Credit Is Due: Contrastive Attribution Topology Search for Multi-Agent Systems
summary: An LLM multi-agent system (MAS) is only as good as the agents it chooses to trust: its accuracy and cost hinge on its topology, meaning which agents are included and how they communicate. A single task score, however, does not reveal which agents help or hinder performance. We propose Contrastive Attribution Topology Search (CATS), which searches for compact teams within a fixed supergraph of specialized agents. An LLM attributer compares execution traces across candidate topologies and assigns credit to individual agents. CATS uses these credits to update supergraph edges while progressively pruning weak edges and agents, yielding a small team for deployment. With small open-weight models and matched candidate evaluations, CATS improves mean accuracy on BigCodeBench by 5.3 percentage points over score-only heuristic search while using 54\% fewer deployment tokens. On MBPP, CATS matches the strongest baselines with fewer tokens than the other searches. In a HotpotQA prompt-poisoning stress test, CATS excludes all adversarially prompted agents in all three runs, whereas random search retains some at comparable accuracy. Per-agent credit thus supports both team optimization and the pruning of potentially harmful agents.

AI.tldr: 提出对比归因拓扑搜索(CATS)，用LLM归因器为各agent分配信用并据此剪枝，得到小而高效的MAS团队。
AI.motivation: 多智能体系统的准确率与成本依赖其拓扑，但单一任务总分无法揭示各agent是帮助还是损害性能。
AI.method: 在固定专家agent超图上搜索紧凑团队；LLM归因器比较候选拓扑的执行轨迹并为单个agent分配信用，用信用更新超图边，逐步剪除弱边与弱agent。
AI.result: 小开源模型下，BigCodeBench平均准确率比仅用分数的启发式搜索高5.3个百分点且部署token少54%；MBPP上以更少token达到最强基线；HotpotQA提示注入压力测试中三次运行均排除全部对抗agent。
AI.conclusion: 逐agent信用既支持团队优化，也能剪除潜在有害agent。

title: SICAF: Time-Varying Focus Bottleneck for Self-Supervised Event-Based Optical Flow with Spiking Neural Network
summary: Event-based optical flow estimation achieves high temporal resolution and dynamic range by exploiting asynchronous events, while self-supervised learning provides an effective solution to the absence of ground-truth labels. Spiking neural networks (SNNs), as brain-inspired models, process information through asynchronous spikes, naturally aligning with optical flow events. However, the temporal irregularity across event streams hinders the compact extraction of spatiotemporal features, while the absence of explicit labels leads to spurious correlations, thereby increasing redundancy within latent representations. In this paper, we propose a novel 'Compactly Compress, Time-varying Focus' training strategy. We present SICAF (Spikes Information Compression And Focus) framework that formulates the learning process as a constrained optimization with temporal modulation. It encourages self-supervised SNNs to extract compact latent representations while preventing over-compression that would discard temporal saliency. To better enable feature selectivity across time steps, we design an estimator with learnable temporal attention, achieving context awareness with cross-time dependencies. Experimental results on several datasets demonstrate that SICAF achieves state-of-the-art performance in self-supervised SNNs, with a 8.14% improvement in AEE on the MVSEC dataset and a 13.49% increase in robustness under white-box adversarial attacks.

AI.tldr: SICAF：面向自监督脉冲神经网络光流估计的"紧凑压缩、时变聚焦"训练策略，用信息压缩与时序调制提升精度与鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 事件光流需自监督以避免真值缺失，SNN与事件天然对齐；但事件流时序不规则、缺乏显式标签导致伪相关与潜在表示冗余。
AI.method: 提出SICAF框架，将学习建模为带时序调制的约束优化，鼓励紧凑潜表示并防止过度压缩丢失时序显著性；设计带可学习时序注意力的估计器以建模跨时间依赖。
AI.result: 在多个数据集上达到自监督SNN的SOTA，MVSEC上AEE提升8.14%，白盒对抗攻击下鲁棒性提升13.49%。
AI.conclusion: 信息压缩与时序聚焦的结合能有效提升自监督脉冲光流的表示质量、精度与鲁棒性。

title: Transformers as Generic Deep Neural Networks: Exact Compilation, the Cost of Removing Activation-Activation Products, and Multi-Agent Attention Clustering
comment: 36 pages, 6 tables and 2 figures in the main text, 8 supplementary tables. Code: https://github.com/iceslice0/transformer-to-dnn
summary: Transformers are deployed as a special model class. Neural processing units (NPU) add dedicated operators for attention and normalization, and quantization relies on Transformer-specific algorithms. We show the computation does not force this. Every Transformer block, with attention, LayerNorm and a GELU MLP, compiles exactly into a generic deep neural network built from fixed affine maps, routing and the square, sigmoid and inverse square root, plus GELU or its sigmoid approximation. Without activation-activation products, every transform-wise compilation adds at least $N^2$ scalar nonlinear evaluations per head for dense scores. Keeping that one operation type removes this cost; its elementwise form, present on every surveyed NPU, suffices with the sigmoid and inverse square root. For top-$k$ attention with exchangeable tail scores, we prove that exact or conditional-mean tail mass gives an unbiased, minimum-mean-square-error estimate of the attention distribution, while tail drop is conditionally biased. When queries or agents cluster, centroids choose the keys first, reducing the number of computed scores from $N^2$ to $Nk$ per head. On DeiT-Tiny, MambaIRv2-Light and Pythia-70M the compiled models match their references with all keys, standard post-training quantization applies, and the exact tail-mass estimate beats tail dropping with half as many keys on DeiT-Tiny and, for $k\le8$, on Pythia-70M.

title: Same Probabilities, Different Advice: Gain-Loss Framing Effects in High-Stakes LLM Decision Support
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly used to support consequential decisions, yet their reliability under equivalent representations of uncertainty remains unclear. Existing work has documented prompt sensitivity, cognitive biases, and confidence miscalibration, but it is still unknown whether high-stakes advice changes when the same probability is expressed through complementary gain and loss frames. We introduce FrameBench-HPS, a controlled benchmark of 2,880 prompts derived from 240 high-stakes scenarios across healthcare, finance, education/career, and legal/consumer-rights domains. Across seven LLMs, gain-loss framing changes the recommendation category in 32.4% of complete groups, with most changes involving uncertainty rather than direct reversals. Human evaluation confirms corresponding shifts in perceived risk and directiveness. Robustness experiments show that framing effects persist under conversational paraphrases and exceed ordinary repeated-generation variability. Probability canonicalization substantially reduces framing sensitivity, identifying probability representation as a practical target for improving consistency in high-stakes LLM decision support.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 FrameBench-HPS 基准（2880 条提示，源自 240 个医疗、金融、教育/职业、法律/消费者权益领域高风险场景），考察 7 个 LLM 在增益/损失框架下对同一概率的推荐是否变化；结果显示 32.4% 的完整组发生推荐类别改变，且概率规范化可显著降低框架敏感性。
AI.motivation: LLM 日益用于支持高风险决策，但其在等价不确定性表达下是否可靠尚不清楚。已有研究记录了提示敏感性、认知偏差和置信度校准问题，但"同一概率经增益与损失互补框架表达时，高风险建议是否改变"仍未知。
AI.method: 构建 FrameBench-HPS 受控基准：基于 240 个高风险场景生成 2880 条提示，覆盖医疗、金融、教育/职业、法律/消费者权益四大领域；在 7 个 LLM 上测试增益-损失框架对推荐的影响，并辅以人工评估（感知风险与指令性），再做对话式改写鲁棒性实验和概率规范化实验。
AI.result: 增益-损失框架使 32.4% 的完整组推荐类别发生变化，多数变化涉及不确定性而非直接反转；人工评估确认感知风险与指令性存在相应偏移；框架效应在对话式改写下持续存在，且超过普通重复生成的波动；概率规范化大幅降低框架敏感性。
AI.conclusion: LLM 的高风险建议对概率的增益/损失表述敏感，这是超出一般随机波动的系统性效应；概率表示是可操作的改进目标，概率规范化有助于提升高风险 LLM 决策支持的一致性。

title: Asking What a Director Sees Can Change What Vision-Language Models Choose
summary: Vision-language models are now routinely tested on theory of mind: whether they can work out what another person sees, knows, and means. A common design asks the model to report that perspective and then to act for the person, and reads a correct report beside a wrong action as a failure to use the perspective. That reading rests on a quiet assumption: that asking for the report leaves the action unchanged. We show that it does not. In a rendered Director Task, a partition hides the largest block from a director who asks for "the largest block". Asking first which blocks the director can see raises the share of replies that choose this hidden block by 12 to 88 percentage points on six GPT models and by 17 on Qwen3.8-27B, even though the models mostly report correctly which blocks the director sees. Reasoning traces and prompt rewordings suggest why: the question shifts how the request is read, from the director's view toward the model's own. When the prompt states what the director knows and refers to, fewer than 1% of replies pair a correct report with a hidden-block choice. Any evaluation that elicits a perspective report before the action it scores needs a baseline without the question, and we deliver one: paired prompts that differ only in that question, a design any perspective-taking benchmark can adopt.

AI.tldr: 在渲染版Director Task中，先问"导演能看到哪些积木"会显著提高模型选择隐藏积木（错误动作）的比例（六个GPT模型+12~88个百分点，Qwen3.8-27B+17），尽管模型对视角的报告多是正确的。这说明"报告视角"本身改变了动作，基于"报告正确+动作错误=不会用视角"的评测假设不成立。
AI.motivation: 现有视语言模型心智理论评测常让模型先报告他人视角、再为他人行动，并将"报告正确但动作错误"判定为未能利用视角。这依赖一个未被验证的隐含假设：索取视角报告不会改变后续动作。
AI.method: 构造渲染版Director Task：隔板遮挡最大积木，导演请求"最大的积木"。设计仅在"是否先询问导演可见积木"上不同的配对提示，比较动作选择；并分析推理轨迹与提示改写，考察机制。
AI.result: 先询问视角使选择隐藏积木的比例在六个GPT模型上提高12~88个百分点，Qwen3.8-27B提高17个百分点，而模型对可见积木的报告大多正确。推理轨迹与改写提示表明，提问把对请求的解读从导演视角拉向模型自身视角。当提示直接陈述导演所知与所指时，正确报告+隐藏积木选择的组合低于1%。
AI.conclusion: 在评分动作前先索取视角报告的任何评测都需设置无该问题的基线；作者提供仅在提问上不同的配对提示方案，可供任何视角采择基准采用。

title: RiO-DETRv2: Geometry-Aware Uncertainty Modeling Meets Real-Time Oriented Object Detection Transformer
summary: RiO-DETR is the first real-time end-to-end transformer for oriented object detection, yet further localization gains require a more expressive box representation. Although distributional regression has succeeded in horizontal DETRs, extending it to oriented detection introduces geometry-misaligned boundary modeling and topology-inconsistent orientation refinement. We present RiO-DETRv2, a geometry-aware uncertainty modeling framework for real-time oriented object detection. To resolve the geometry mismatch, Object-Aligned Boundary Distribution Refinement represents box boundaries as probability distributions in an object-aligned coordinate system and progressively refines them across decoder layers. For better orientation topology consistency, we introduce Circular-to-Local Angular Residual Refinement that transitions from global periodic search to local fine-grained estimation. Unified OBB Quality-Aligned Learning further aligns classification, boundary and angular refinement with complete-OBB localization quality. Together, these designs improve localization without compromising efficiency, achieving a better balance between speed and accuracy. Specifically, RiO-DETRv2-l/x achieves 53.7/54.1 mAP50-95 on DOTA, outperforming RiO-DETR-l/x by 1.2/1.5 points with nearly unchanged computational cost. Code is available at https://github.com/RicePasteM/RiO-DETRv2.

AI.tldr: 本文提出RiO-DETRv2，一个面向实时旋转目标检测的几何感知不确定性建模框架，在边界表示与角度 refine 两个层面改进RiO-DETR。
AI.motivation: RiO-DETR是首个实时端到端旋转目标检测transformer，但要进一步提升定位精度需要更强的框表示。将分布回归从水平检测迁移到旋转检测时，会出现几何不对齐的边界建模与拓扑不一致的角度 refine 两个问题。
AI.method: 三项设计：(1) Object-Aligned Boundary Distribution Refinement，在物体对齐坐标系中将边界表示为概率分布并跨解码层逐步细化；(2) Circular-to-Local Angular Residual Refinement，从全局周期搜索过渡到局部细粒度估计以保持角度拓扑一致性；(3) Unified OBB Quality-Aligned Learning，将分类、边界和角度 refine 与完整OBB定位质量统一对齐。
AI.result: 在DOTA上，RiO-DETRv2-l/x达到53.7/54.1 mAP50-95，比RiO-DETR-l/x分别提升1.2/1.5个点，计算成本几乎不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过几何感知的分布回归与角度 refine，在不牺牲效率的前提下提升旋转检测定位精度，实现速度与精度更好的平衡。

title: LLM-Based Exogenous World Modeling for Dynamic Scheduling
summary: Dynamic scheduling requires dispatching online arrivals while anticipating future jobs, as poor decisions can compound downstream costs under nonlinear tardiness objectives. We show that a pretrained large language model (LLM) can serve as the exogenous component of a structured world model, forecasting uncertain future job arrivals. Specifically, we exploit an afterstate decomposition, which separates known deterministic shop transitions from uncertain exogenous job arrivals, enabling the LLM to forecast only the latter through a compact belief representation. Building on this, we develop Afterstate World-Model Planning (AWMP), which combines an evolved, belief-conditioned dispatching strategy with short scenario-based rollouts. A surprise-triggered refresh mechanism queries the LLM only when newly observed arrivals deviate sufficiently from previous forecast, and online residual self-calibration further conditions the LLM on its recent forecast errors to handle nonstationary arrivals. Across diverse arrival distributions, AWMP reduces weighted tardiness by 6-21% on dynamic job-shop and 22-46% on flexible job-shop benchmarks, relative to the best of eight classical priority-dispatching rules.

AI.tldr: 将预训练大语言模型（LLM）用作结构化世界模型的外生分量，预测不确定的未来工件到达，并结合后状态分解与情景推演做动态调度规划（AWMP），显著降低加权拖期。
AI.motivation: 动态调度需要在线派工的同时预判未来工件到达，而非线性拖期目标下，差的决定会沿下游累积成本，因此需要对不确定到达进行前瞻性预测。
AI.method: 提出后状态分解，将已知确定性车间转移与不确定外生到达分离，使 LLM 仅通过紧凑信念表示预测到达；据此构建 AWMP，融合进化式信念条件派工策略与短情景 rollout；采用"惊讶触发刷新"机制仅在观测到达显著偏离预测时调用 LLM，并用在线残差自校准以历史预测误差为条件应对非平稳到达。
AI.result: 在多种到达分布下，相比八种经典优先派工规则中的最优者，AWMP 在动态 job-shop 上降低加权拖期 6–21%，在柔性 job-shop 上降低 22–46%。
AI.conclusion: LLM 可作为世界模型的外生不确定性预测组件，与后状态分解和轻量规划结合，在动态调度中取得稳定且显著的性能提升。

title: OSynth: A Longitudinal, Context-Sensitive Evaluation of Meeting Understanding
summary: Meeting notetakers are increasingly deployed in settings where longitudinal context is available including calendar metadata, prior meetings, emails, slides, and speaker enrollments; however, meeting corpora remain limited in terms of size, domain coverage, and available context. We present OSynth, a large-scale synthetic dataset of simulated organizations comprising 570 hours of meeting audio together with associated artifacts and a latent ground-truth state. In a pairwise comparison, human raters distinguish OSynth meetings from real meeting transcripts with only 56% accuracy based on excerpts of 150-300 words. Across state-of-the-art LLMs, additional context yields significant gains on several entity-sensitive dimensions, demonstrating limitations of contemporary approaches and the potential usefulness of OSynth in developing better-contextualized meeting-understanding systems.

AI.tldr: 本文提出OSynth——一个大规模合成会议数据集，包含570小时模拟组织会议音频及配套上下文工件与潜在真值状态，用以支撑长程上下文会议理解研究。
AI.motivation: 会议记录助手已部署在可获取日历、历史会议、邮件、幻灯片、说话人注册等长程上下文的场景中，但现有会议语料规模小、领域覆盖窄、缺乏上下文标注，难以系统研究上下文对会议理解的作用。
AI.method: 构建OSynth合成数据集：模拟组织生成570小时会议音频，配套相关工件（日历、邮件、幻灯片等）与潜在真值状态；开展人类成对辨别实验（150–300词片段）评估真实性；并对多个SOTA大模型在不同上下文条件下的实体敏感维度进行评测。
AI.result: 人类区分OSynth会议与真实会议转录的准确率仅56%，接近随机；向多个SOTA LLM提供额外上下文后，在若干实体敏感维度上取得显著提升。
AI.conclusion: OSynth具备较高真实性，可揭示当代模型在上下文利用上的局限，为开发更好上下文化的会议理解系统提供有效资源。

title: LocalAgent: Collaborative Agentic Verification for Fine-Grained Instance-Level Consistency
summary: Multimodal large language models (MLLMs) have made rapid progress in general visual understanding, yet they still struggle with fine-grained instance-level consistency verification, where the goal is to determine whether two images depict the exact same physical object under varying viewpoints, illumination, and backgrounds. This task requires both global semantic perception and precise examination of subtle local evidence, since semantically similar objects may differ only in small suspicious regions. To address this challenge, we propose LocalAgent, a collaborative agentic framework that integrates the complementary strengths of a generalist MLLM and lightweight specialist verifiers. The MLLM first reasons globally to identify suspicious local regions, which are then delegated to a Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) toolkit for fine-grained appearance and geometric matching. LEV comprises Local Appearance Consistency (LAC), which estimates appearance similarity under illumination and color changes, and Local Geometric Correspondence (LGC), which estimates spatial correspondence under viewpoint changes. LEV returns structured scalar evidence that the MLLM integrates for the final decision. We further introduce an auxiliary-capped reinforcement fine-tuning (RFT) strategy, in which answer correctness dominates auxiliary tool-use and format signals, enabling the policy to learn when verification is necessary. Experiments show that LocalAgent improves mean accuracy by 4.9% over the strongest CoT-RFT baseline while invoking a verifier on only 12.13% of samples and preserving the general multimodal capabilities of the underlying MLLM. The open-source repository is available at https://github.com/Firefly-zoo/LocalAgent-main.

AI.tldr: 提出 LocalAgent 协作式智能体框架，结合通用 MLLM 全局推理与轻量专家校验器完成细粒度实例级一致性验证。
AI.motivation: 现有多模态大模型在通用视觉理解上进展迅速，但在"两张图是否为同一物理对象"的细粒度实例级一致性验证上表现不足；该任务既需全局语义感知，又需对细微局部可疑区域精确比对，语义相似对象可能仅在小的可疑区域不同。
AI.method: MLLM 先全局推理定位可疑局部区域，再交由 Local Evidence Verifier (LEV) 工具集做细粒度外观与几何匹配。LEV 含两部分：局部外观一致性 LAC（估计光照与颜色变化下的外观相似度）与局部几何对应 LGC（估计视角变化下的空间对应）。LEV 返回结构化标量证据，由 MLLM 整合做最终决策。此外提出辅助封顶强化微调（auxiliary-capped RFT）：答案正确性主导辅助工具使用与格式信号，使策略学会何时需要验证。
AI.result: 相比最强 CoT-RFT 基线平均准确率提升 4.9%，且仅在 12.13% 样本上调用校验器，同时保持底层 MLLM 的通用多模态能力。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 将通用 MLLM 的全局推理与专用局部证据校验器结合，并配合答案优先的强化微调，可有效提升实例级一致性验证性能且成本可控，不损害通用能力。

title: From Weather to Enhanced Weathering: Weather Foundation Models for Carbon Dioxide Removal at Operational Scale
comment: Accepted at 40th Conference on Neural Information Processing Systems (NeurIPS 2026), Sydney, Australia. Workshop: Tackling Climate Change with Machine Learning
summary: Enhanced Rock Weathering (ERW) is a carbon removal solution with the potential to remove gigatons of CO$_2$ per year, but quantifying that removal today requires dense soil sampling and laboratory analysis. We evaluate five weather Foundation Models (FMs) as frozen encoders feeding lightweight decoders, under a leave-one-field-out protocol on 5,192 chronosequences from 264 fields across Brazil and the US. To our knowledge, this is the first holistic evaluation of weather FMs for ERW and the largest evaluation on operational ERW data. We find that across weather FMs, representations transfer to ERW: our best model, TerraNova-ERW, built on Aurora 1.5, positively orders measurements within fields it has never seen. Zero-shot prediction of a new field's mean removal is not yet feasible, and we attribute this to data scale: the same architecture excels on $\sim$$10^5$ natural-weathering sequences, anchoring the scale we expect ERW data must reach. Few-shot prediction, blending the model with a few samples per field, is supported today: TerraNova-ERW recovers over 60% of the highest-removal fields with two samples per field, roughly halves the samples needed to estimate a field's mean removal, and can cut sampling on our densest fields by 28-98%.

AI.tldr: 该文首次系统评估天气基础模型在增强岩石风化（ERW）碳去除量化中的迁移能力：以Aurora 1.5为骨干的TerraNova-ERW可在未见过田块内正确排序测量值，零样本预测尚不可行，但少样本混合策略已可显著降低土壤采样需求。
AI.motivation: ERW有望每年去除数十亿吨CO2，但当前量化去除量依赖密集土壤采样与实验室分析，成本高、可扩展性差；作者希望检验天气基础模型的表征能否迁移到ERW任务，从而减少采样负担。
AI.method: 将五种天气基础模型作为冻结编码器，接轻量解码器；在巴西与美国264块田、5,192条年代序列上采用留一田块（leave-one-field-out）协议评估；并提出基于Aurora 1.5的TerraNova-ERW，同时考察零样本与少样本（每田少量样本混合）设定。
AI.result: 天气基础模型表征确实可迁移到ERW：TerraNova-ERW能在未见田块内正确排序测量值；零样本预测新田块平均去除量仍不可行，作者归因于数据规模（同类架构在约10^5条自然风化序列上表现优异）；少样本下每田仅2个样本即可召回60%以上最高去除田块，将估计田块平均去除量所需样本约减半，在最密集田块可减少28–98%采样。
AI.conclusion: 这是ERW天气基础模型的首个整体评估，也是迄今最大规模的运营级ERW数据评估；少样本ERW量化当下可行且能大幅降低采样成本，而零样本能力有待数据规模提升至约10^5量级。

title: SpatialBrain: Spatial Intelligence Growing from Experience
summary: Spatial reasoning requires more than access to geometric tools: a reasoner must decide when direct observation is sufficient and when to reconstruct, measure, or change reference frames. We present SpatialBrain, a framework that retains experience about these decisions while keeping its vision-language backbone fixed. The key distinction is between evidence about a scene and experience about how to reason with that evidence. 3DFusionMemory fuses current-scene observations into queryable spatial relations. A Spatial Skill Library provides reusable tool procedures, and Spatial Cognition associates task conditions with experience about when and how to use memory and skills. Completed trajectories are abstracted into process records and consolidated between task blocks, allowing later decisions to draw on earlier execution without transferring scene coordinates or reference answers. Across five spatial-reasoning benchmarks, SpatialBrain improves on direct answers from the same backbone on four and ties on the fifth. Component comparisons, experience-coverage curves, and traced resource decisions characterize how the framework accumulates and uses these resources.

AI.tldr: SpatialBrain：固定视觉语言骨干，通过记忆、技能库和认知经验让推理者学会"何时/如何"使用工具，在五个空间推理基准中四个超越直接回答、一个持平。
AI.motivation: 空间推理不只依赖几何工具本身，更关键的是判断何时可直接观察、何时需重建、测量或切换参考系；现有方法缺乏对这种决策经验的可积累与复用。
AI.method: 保留"场景证据"与"推理经验"的区分：3DFusionMemory将当前观测融合为可查询的空间关系；Spatial Skill Library提供可复用工具流程；Spatial Cognition将任务条件与"何时/如何"使用记忆和技能的经验关联；完成的轨迹抽象为过程记录并在任务块间整合（不迁移场景坐标或参考答案）。
AI.result: 五个空间推理基准中，四个优于同骨干的直接回答，第五个持平；组件对比、经验覆盖曲线与资源决策追踪刻画了资源积累与使用方式。
AI.conclusion: 将经验与证据分离、在固定骨干上积累可复用的推理过程经验，是提升空间推理的有效途径，且无需迁移场景坐标或参考答案。

title: Signals and Queries: Token-Efficient Agentic Context Discovery
summary: User-facing LLM agents must identify which behavioral policies apply at each turn, but evaluating every policy with an LLM is costly. We introduce Signals and Queries (S&Q), a lightweight first-stage relevance filter developed for Parlant 4.0 that removes at least 30% of candidate policies before downstream evaluation while preserving high recall. For each policy, an LLM generates activating examples and hard negatives offline. An independent logistic classifier trained on their embeddings then predicts relevance using embeddings and vector dot products, with no per-turn LLM calls. This shifts expensive relevance evaluation to a smaller candidate set, while allowing each policy's classifier to be updated independently. Evaluated against 9,144 LLM-judge relevance labels covering 254 $τ^2$-bench conversation prefixes and 36 airline policies, S&Q achieves higher precision than top-K and cosine-threshold retrieval at every evaluated recall level, with consistent results across two embedding providers. These findings support inexpensive, per-policy classification as a practical first stage for reducing downstream evaluation workload in customer-facing agents.

AI.tldr: 提出 Signals and Queries (S&Q)，一种面向 Parlant 4.0 的轻量级一阶段相关性过滤器，用离线生成的策略示例训练独立逻辑回归分类器，单轮无需调用 LLM 即可筛除至少 30% 候选策略并保持高召回。
AI.motivation: 用户侧 LLM 智能体每轮都需判断哪些行为策略适用，但用 LLM 逐一评估每条策略成本过高，因此需要先做低成本的相关性过滤。
AI.method: 对每条策略由 LLM 离线生成激活示例与难负例；用独立逻辑回归分类器在其嵌入上训练，推理时以句子嵌入与向量点积预测相关性，无逐轮 LLM 调用；各策略分类器可独立更新。
AI.result: 在覆盖 254 个 τ²-bench 对话前缀与 36 条航空政策的 9,144 个 LLM 评判相关性标签上，S&Q 在所有评估召回水平上的精度均高于 top-K 与余弦阈值检索，并在两家嵌入提供商上结果一致。
AI.conclusion: 支持将低成本、按策略独立的分类作为实用的第一阶段筛选，以减少面向客户智能体的下游评估负担。

title: How Does Orthogonalization Adapt to the Neural Network Hessian Structure? A Gradient Self Outer-Product Analysis at Initialization
summary: Muon orthogonalizes a weight matrix's momentum before each step, and on neural networks this simple preconditioner beats AdamW in a wide range of tasks. Existing analyses explain Muon within general optimization frameworks or on a few specific models, and many of them view orthogonalization as a preconditioner.
