Since the Hessian is the optimal preconditioner under a quadratic approximation of the loss, these works leave a basic question open: what makes orthogonalization suited to the Hessian of a neural network? Prior work shows that the layer-wise Hessian of a neural network is row-block diagonally dominant, and Muon's implicit preconditioner, the Kronecker product $(\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top)^{1/2}\otimes\mathbf{I}$ with $\mathbf{V}$ the momentum, has the same row-block structure exactly when $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ is diagonally dominant. Diagonal dominance of $\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top$ has been observed in language models, but why a neural network produces it has not been explained. This work provides a quantitative asymptotic theory for neural networks at initialization, and points out the intuition that the overparameterization of the weight matrices drives the diagonal dominance. We analyze $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{G}\mathbf{G}^\top]$, which equals $\mathbb{E}[\mathbf{V}\mathbf{V}^\top]$ at initialization, in four canonical models: symmetric matrix factorization, deep linear networks, two-layer ReLU networks, and single-layer linear attention. In each case the diagonal entries outgrow the off-diagonal ones at explicit rates as the hidden dimensions grow; for the query, key and value weights of attention the off-diagonal vanishes altogether. Simulations of the four models and experiments on language models at initialization confirm the predicted scaling.

AI.tldr: 本文提出神经网络初始化下的定量渐近理论，解释Muon的正交化预条件子为何与神经网络Hessian结构匹配：过度参数化使动量矩阵的Gram矩阵对角占优，从而与行块对角占优的逐层Hessian一致。
AI.motivation: 现有工作多在一般优化框架或特定模型下解释Muon，且多把正交化视为预条件子。但Hessian是二次近似下的最优预条件子，因此关键问题是：为什么正交化适合神经网络Hessian？已知逐层Hessian行块对角占优，而Muon的隐式预条件子(VVᵀ)^{1/2}⊗I 恰在该Gram矩阵对角占优时具有相同的行块结构；语言模型中已观察到VVᵀ对角占优，但其成因尚未被解释。
AI.method: 在初始化时分析 E[GGᵀ]（等于初始化时的 E[VVᵀ]），覆盖四个典型模型：对称矩阵分解、深层线性网络、两层ReLU网络、单层线性注意力。推导各模型中对角元相对非对角元的显式增长速率（随隐藏维度增大）。
AI.result: 在四个模型中，对角元均以显式速率超越非对角元；对注意力的query、key、value权重，非对角元直接消失。四个模型的仿真与语言模型初始化的实验均验证了预测的缩放规律。
AI.conclusion: 权重矩阵的过度参数化驱动了Gram矩阵的对角占优，从Hessian结构角度定量解释了Muon正交化预条件子的有效性。

title: AgentMonopoly: Behavioral Patterns and Persona Control in LLM Agents
summary: How do LLM agents' strategies differ, and how much can instructions to adopt a persona change their behavior over a game? We study these questions with AgentMonopoly, an environment where agents communicate, buy and trade properties, and make decisions that affect later turns. We compare models from four families, each at two sizes, in games with identical models, different sizes of the same family, or different families. We also assign one agent a persona, a description of how it should behave, intended to change a tendency observed in games without that persona. The tested models differ in how often they trade, waive rent, and manage cash and properties. Larger models do not consistently win more games. Persona instructions change the words agents use and some of their actions, but the changes do not always match the role across all decisions. These results show why persona following should be assessed through actions and outcomes as well as language. As our findings are conditional on the tested checkpoints, prompts, and five seeds per configuration, the open-source nature of AgentMonopoly provides the experimental infrastructure for further extending these comparisons. Our code is available at https://github.com/SuELS-Group/Agent_Monopoly.

AI.tldr: 论文提出AgentMonopoly环境，考察不同LLM代理在长期互动游戏中的策略差异，以及persona指令对行为的影响。
AI.motivation: 理解LLM代理的策略差异，以及指令让其扮演特定persona能在多大程度上改变其在博弈中的行为，是代理行为评估的关键问题。
AI.method: 构建AgentMonopoly环境：代理需沟通、买卖房产并做影响后续回合的决策。比较四个模型家族、每个两档规模，在相同模型、同家族不同规模、跨家族对局中表现；并为代理分配persona以改变既定倾向。
AI.result: 模型在交易频率、免租、现金与房产管理上存在差异；更大的模型并不总是赢更多；persona指令能改变用词和部分行为，但变化并非在所有决策上都符合角色设定。
AI.conclusion: persona遵循应同时通过行为、结果和语言来评估；结论受限于所测checkpoint、prompt与每配置五个种子，AgentMonopoly开源可支持进一步比较研究。

title: Bridging Foundational and Agentic Capabilities of LLMs
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly deployed as agents, yet it remains unclear how their foundational capabilities translate into agentic capabilities. End-to-end scores leave unresolved whether low benchmark capability or weak deployment drives a failure, limiting actionable diagnosis. We bridge foundational and agentic capabilities through an operation-level measurement framework. We represent each model with a foundational profile derived from capability benchmarks and an operation profile derived from interaction trajectories, and define capability realization gaps as deviations of observed operation performance from predictions based on foundational capabilities. Experiments on fifteen model services in $τ^2$-Bench show that foundational profiles only partially predict agentic operations. Models with comparable profiles can differ substantially in execution, and these gaps remain consistent across task subsets. Operation profiles add information and substantially improve task-score prediction. The framework locates execution departures at the operation level to inform model development and agent evaluation. We will release our code and analysis artifacts.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"操作级"测量框架，将LLM的基础能力画像（来自能力基准）与操作画像（来自交互轨迹）联系起来，定义"能力实现差距"（在agent任务中观察到的操作表现偏离了基础能力所预测的水平），用τ²-Bench上15个模型服务验证这一框架。
AI.motivation: LLM越来越多作为agent部署，但基础能力如何转化为agentic能力并不清楚；端到端分数无法区分失败是源于"基准能力低"还是"部署/执行弱"，难以给出可操作的诊断。
AI.method: 构建操作级测量框架：为每个模型分别建立基础能力画像（能力基准）和操作画像（交互轨迹）；用基础能力预测操作表现，并把观察到的操作表现与此预测之间的偏差定义为"能力实现差距"；在τ²-Bench的15个模型服务上做实验，并分析操作画像对任务分数的预测增益。
AI.result: 基础能力画像只能部分预测agent操作；画像相近的模型在执行上可能差异很大，且这些差距在不同任务子集上保持一致；加入操作画像能带来额外信息并显著提升任务分数预测。
AI.conclusion: 该框架能够在操作层面定位执行偏差，为模型开发和agent评估提供可操作的诊断依据；作者将开源代码与分析产物。

title: Seeing the Forest for the Trees: Emergent Agreement from Individual Conversations
summary: As LLM agents interact in the wild and shape each other's decisions, understanding how they converge toward agreement becomes important. We study this in multi-turn conversations where two LLMs discuss subjective matters, can agree or disagree, and may change their stances. Using a linear classifier on individual conversation activations, we identify an internal representation of agreement. We find that it varies substantially across turns and conversations and does not reliably track external agreement at the individual conversation level. We therefore move beyond the representation of agreement in individual conversations, by aggregating the agreement representation across conversations. Externally, this aggregate view reveals a simple structure: when pooled across conversations, agreement can be predicted well with a Markov process, with agreement at each turn being a direct function of agreement at the previous turn. Similarly, when internal agreement is aggregated, it couples with the external Markov agreement through a power-law mapping, exposing Markovian dynamics in internal representations. Additionally, we find that after a change of stance, models express agreement externally before their internal representations reflect the same shift. These results reveal a joint structure between internal and external agreement that emerges only when internal features are aggregated across conversations. Code available at https://github.com/technion-cs-nlp/SeeingTheForestForTheTrees.

AI.tldr: 论文通过线性分类器在多轮对话激活中识别"同意"的内部表示，并发现聚合跨对话的表示后才能揭示与外部的马尔可夫结构与幂律映射耦合。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在真实环境中相互影响并塑造彼此决策，理解它们如何趋向共识变得重要，尤其是在两模型讨论主观话题时可同意/分歧并改变立场的多轮对话场景。
AI.method: 对个体对话激活训练线性分类器以识别"同意"的内部表示；分析其跨轮次与跨对话的变化；随后将同意表示跨对话聚合，与外部同意进行对比，检验马尔可夫预测及幂律映射关系。
AI.result: 内部同意表示在各轮次与各对话间差异显著，且在单对话层面不能可靠对应外部同意；聚合后外部同意可由马尔可夫过程很好预测（当前轮同意为上一轮的直接函数）；内部聚合同意与外部马尔可夫同意通过幂律映射耦合；立场改变后，模型先在外表达同意，内部表示随后才反映该转变。
AI.conclusion: 内部与外部同意之间存在联合结构，但只有在跨对话聚合内部特征时才显现；这揭示了内部表示中的马尔可夫动态及内外不同步现象。

title: ROCOCO: Robust Outline Completion of Occluded Curvilinear Objects
summary: We propose a learning-based generative model for completing curvilinear features under occlusion by environmental obstacles. To this end, we adopt a flow matching-based approach that supports the inpainting of occluded regions with the appropriate curvilinear features. To eliminate the reliance on privileged information about the occlusion a priori, we also train a UNet-based mask prediction model, which can identify regions for inpainting given only the occluded observation. The components of our approach are validated via experiments using procedurally-generated test cases, and the complete pipeline is validated using large public datasets for curvilinear objects. Against off-the-shelf inpainting baselines, ROCOCO is the strongest method by a wide margin when no occlusion mask is given, and is competitive with mask-supervised inpainting when one is, achieving best on full-image error and second only to LaMa on the occluded region, while using a completer of $7.7$M parameters against LaMa's $51$M and Stable Diffusion's $860$M.

AI.tldr: 提出ROCOCO，基于flow matching的生成模型，用于在环境障碍物遮挡下补全曲线特征；配合UNet掩码预测模型，无需先验遮挡信息。
AI.motivation: 遮挡下的曲线特征补全通常依赖先验的遮挡掩码（privileged information），现实中难以获得，需在仅有遮挡观测的条件下完成inpainting。
AI.method: 采用flow matching框架实现遮挡区域的曲线特征inpainting；额外训练UNet掩码预测模型，仅凭被遮挡观测识别需修复区域，避免对先验遮挡信息的依赖。
AI.result: 在程序化生成测试用例上验证各组件，并在大型公开曲线物体数据集上验证完整流程；无掩码时ROCOCO大幅领先现成inpainting基线，有掩码时与掩码监督方法相当——全图误差最优，遮挡区域仅次于LaMa；参数量仅7.7M（LaMa 51M、Stable Diffusion 860M）。
AI.conclusion: ROCOCO以极小参数量在无掩码条件下显著优于基线，在有掩码时具竞争力，证明掩码预测+flow matching组合可有效去除对先验遮挡信息的依赖。

title: SSMCGM-Stream: A Streaming State-Space Model for Personalized Diabetes Management
comment: Accepted to AI4Science and GenAI4Health NeurIPS 2026 workshops
summary: Continuous glucose monitoring supports diabetes management but requires forecasting models that are accurate, interpretable, and efficient enough for real-time deployment. We present SSMCGM-Stream, a streaming state-space model that maintains a personalized hidden state updated with each incoming glucose reading to provide constant-time forecasting, physiologically structured counterfactual reasoning, and interpretable forecasts through hidden-state attribution. Built on this foundation, SSMCGM-Agent delivers risk-aware, natural-language decision support by translating forecasts, explanations, and counterfactuals into grounded recommendations through a guarded language-model interface. Evaluated on the T1DEXI cohort, SSMCGM-Stream achieves forecasting performance comparable to strong neural baselines while substantially reducing computational cost, enabling continuous on-device diabetes decision support.

AI.tldr: 提出 SSMCGM-Stream，一种流式状态空间血糖预测模型，并基于其构建 SSMCGM-Agent，为糖尿病患者提供实时、可解释、风险感知的自然语言决策支持。
AI.motivation: 连续血糖监测需要预测模型兼具准确性、可解释性，并且足够高效以支持实时部署，但现有模型难以同时满足这些要求。
AI.method: SSMCGM-Stream 用流式状态空间模型为每位用户维护个性化隐状态，每收到一条血糖读数即更新，实现常数时间预测、生理结构化的反事实推理与基于隐状态归因的可解释性；SSMCGM-Agent 在此基础上通过受约束的语言模型接口，将预测、解释与反事实转化为有据可依的风险感知自然语言建议。
AI.result: 在 T1DEXI 队列上，预测性能与强神经基线相当，同时显著降低计算成本，支持设备端持续决策支持。
AI.conclusion: 该工作展示了高效流式模型与大模型代理结合的可行路径，可在隐私敏感、资源受限的设备端实现可解释的糖尿病管理支持。

title: From Prompts to Posteriors: Can LLM Agents Perform Bayesian Inference in Context?
summary: Large language models (LLMs) are increasingly applied across the scientific discovery pipeline, from synthesizing literature to generating hypotheses to informing experimental design. A unifying principle behind these tasks is the need to continuously update beliefs as evidence accumulates, for which Bayesian inference provides a natural framework. However, existing work assumes that LLMs cannot carry out principled Bayesian belief updating in context, instead relying on simplifications and heuristics. To challenge this assumption, we present a principled evaluation of Bayesian reasoning capabilities in LLMs, analyzing both the model's internal consistency as well as its ability to recover an externally determined posterior. Specifically, we build an evaluation framework spanning qualitative epistemological examples to probe probabilistic coherence, quantitative benchmarks of Bayesian inference capabilities, and analyses of the impact of non-Bayesian updates on downstream task performance. Across different scenarios, we find that LLMs generally violate Bayes' rule when updating their beliefs in context. However, when equipped with modern reasoning abilities and code execution capabilities, their performance drastically improves, enabling even the close approximation of analytically intractable posteriors. Our evaluation shows that current LLMs with access to appropriate tools could already be used to make complex belief updates in scientific discovery, enabling rapid acceleration of the efficiency and scale of AI-powered scientific discovery.

AI.tldr: 论文系统评估LLM的贝叶斯信念更新能力，发现纯上下文推理普遍违背贝叶斯法则，但结合现代推理能力与代码执行后性能大幅提升，甚至可近似解析不可解的後验。
AI.motivation: LLM已被广泛用于科学发现流程（文献综述、假设生成、实验设计），这些任务共同需要随证据累积持续更新信念，而贝叶斯推断是天然框架。但既有工作默认LLM无法在上下文中进行有原则的贝叶斯更新，转而依赖简化与启发式，本文要挑战这一假设。
AI.method: 构建分层评估框架：从定性认识论案例考察概率一致性，到贝叶斯推断的定量基准，再分析非贝叶斯更新对下游任务性能的影响；同时考察模型内部一致性与对外部给定后验的恢复能力，并对比加入推理与代码执行工具后的表现。
AI.result: 在多种场景下LLM在上下文中更新信念时普遍违反贝叶斯法则；但配备现代推理能力与代码执行能力后性能显著改善，能紧密近似甚至逼近解析上不可解的后验分布。
AI.conclusion: 当前LLM在获得合适工具后已可用于科学发现中的复杂信念更新，有望加快AI驱动科学发现的效率与规模。

title: ALIAS: Evaluating Performance and Memorization in LLM-Written TLA+ Specifications
comment: 19 pages (8 main + appendix), 6 figures, 9 tables. Code and data: https://github.com/LUC-AI4FM/ALIAS
summary: Memorization inflates the benchmark scores of large language models (LLMs), since a model can reproduce answers it saw in training. Researchers test for it with consistent identifier renaming (CIR), which gives every identifier in a task a new name, and treat a lower score on the renamed task as evidence of recall. We test this method on the Temporal Logic of Actions Plus (TLA+) language, whose model checker acts as an oracle by confirming whether a renamed task preserves the exact behaviors of the original. Across 111 TLA+-Bench tasks, renaming lowers the correctness of Claude Opus 4.8 from 28% to 18% and of GPT-5 from 9% to 7%. Most of this decrease comes from how the test grades, which requires exact names that most descriptions never state. Grading by behavior shrinks the decrease to about 3 percentage points for Opus 4.8 and to 0 for GPT-5. In two model families fine-tuned on disjoint halves of the tasks, renaming removes about half of the training gain in likelihood and costs 4.9 percentage points (Qwen) and 1.3 percentage points (Gemma) on unseen tasks. A lower score after renaming therefore mixes memorization, name-based grading, and the cost of new names.

AI.tldr: 该论文检验CIR（一致标识符重命名）作为检测LLM记忆化方法的有效性，在TLA+语言上用模型检查器作为oracle，发现重命名导致的分数下降大部分源于评分方式而非记忆化。
AI.motivation: 记忆化会虚高LLM基准分数，研究者常用CIR（给任务中所有标识符重命名，以分数下降作为记忆证据）来检测，但这一方法的有效性本身缺乏严格检验，且难以区分记忆化与重命名带来的其他影响。
AI.method: 在TLA+语言上测试CIR：利用TLA+模型检查器作为oracle，验证重命名任务是否保留原任务的行为。覆盖111个TLA+-Bench任务，评测Claude Opus 4.8与GPT-5；比较精确名称评分与行为等价评分；并在两个模型家族上分别用不相交的半数据集微调，观察重命名对训练增益与泛化表现的影响。
AI.result: 重命名使Opus 4.8正确率从28%降至18%，GPT-5从9%降至7%；但改按行为评分后，降幅分别缩小至约3个百分点和0。微调实验中，重命名消除约一半训练增益（似然），并在未见任务上造成4.9（Qwen）与1.3（Gemma）个百分点的损失。
AI.conclusion: 重命名后的分数下降混合了三种因素：真实记忆化、基于名称的评分偏差、以及适应新名称的代价。因此CIR分数下降不能直接作为记忆化的证据，需采用行为等价评分来分离效应。

title: Policy Central: Detecting Conflicts, Redundancy, and Similarity in Deployed Police Policy
summary: Policy Central is a deployed system that helps police departments find relationships between sections of their written policy: whether two sections conflict, are redundant, are merely similar, or are different. We describe the system and compare two architectures. Retrieve-Judge, a retrieve-then-classify pipeline, runs as a cheap library-wide health signal; Screen-Confirm, a screen-then-confirm cascade, is a selective audit of the documents a reviewer chooses, checking them exhaustively against one another. On a 302-pair benchmark drawn from one department's ~84 real policy documents, given each pair Screen-Confirm reaches 0.795 aggregate recall and 0.885 on Conflict, so current models judge well. Finding the pair is the hard part: Retrieve-Judge's composed recall falls to 0.457, and Screen-Confirm recovers 0.472 (0.615 on Conflict). Today these pairs are found by reading the whole library, nearly 20,000 sections, checked against one another and re-checked after every revision. A scan that returns half of them in minutes, at low cost, and can be re-run on demand changes the economics of policy review even before recall improves.

AI.tldr: Policy Central 是已部署的警务政策审查系统，用两种架构（Retrieve-Judge 与 Screen-Confirm）自动发现政策条款间的冲突、冗余、相似或无关关系，并评估其在不同环节上的召回率表现。
AI.motivation: 警务部门需在约 20,000 条政策条款中人工逐条比对，且每次修订后都要重查，成本极高；因此亟需一种能低成本、可随时重跑、快速定位政策条款关系的自动化工具。
AI.method: 构建 302 对来自某部门约 84 份真实政策文档的基准，比较两种架构：Retrieve-Judge 是"检索-判定"流水线，作为全库健康信号的低成本方案；Screen-Confirm 是"筛选-确认"级联，针对审查者指定的文档做穷尽式交叉核对。
AI.result: 给定配对时，Screen-Confirm 达到 0.795 总体召回，Conflict 类达 0.885，说明当前模型判定能力较强；难点在"找到配对"：Retrieve-Judge 的组合召回仅 0.457，Screen-Confirm 为 0.472（Conflict 0.615）。
AI.conclusion: 判定环节已较可靠，瓶颈在于配对检索；即便召回有限，数分钟内低成本返回约一半配对、且可按需重跑，已能显著改变政策审查的经济性，为后续提升召回奠定实用基础。

title: A Unified Evaluation Framework of Physical Adversarial Robustness in the Edge VLM Era
comment: Accepted at the NeurIPS 2026 Workshop on Grounded and Faithful Vision-Language Models for Real-World Deployment (VLM4RWD). 16 pages, 6 figures, 5 tables. Code: https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness
summary: Recent advancements in Vision-Language Models (VLMs) enable end-to-end visual grounding via language prompts and generative decoding, demonstrating largely improved zero-shot and open-vocabulary detection capabilities. As a result, VLMs are rapidly being deployed at the edge in safety-critical real-world systems. However, the physical adversarial robustness of edge VLMs has not been systematically studied, and the fundamental differences in output with modern object detectors create methodological challenges for fair evaluation. To compare the two families directly, we evaluate every selected representative model on one outcome: whether an adversarial patch worn on a person evades detection of the model. We report this by introducing a unified metric, conditional attack success rate (cASR), counted only on images the model still localizes under a matched gray occluder, and partition every failure into omission (no box), substitution (a box on the patch), and displacement (a box on neither). We benchmark the physical adversarial vulnerability of compact grounding VLMs against a range of object detectors, and find that the VLMs can be as vulnerable as the detectors. We disclose that failure mode is largely associated with the output format of a model rather than its architecture family. Of the three, only omission is visible to a downstream system; displacement and substitution return confident, well-formed boxes, making them potentially more dangerous failures. Further, we find that, under distribution shift, VLMs that primarily failed by omission instead shift to failing more by displacement/substitution. Thus, a grounding VLM can inherit the detector's vulnerability while showing the possibility to adopt more dangerous failure modes. Our code and data are available at https://github.com/ericliang1/physical-adversarial-robustness.

AI.tldr: 本文系统评估了边缘部署的接地型视觉语言模型(VLM)对人体佩戴物理对抗贴片的鲁棒性，与目标检测器对比，提出统一指标cASR并将失败分为漏检(omission)、替换(substitution)与位移(displacement)三类，发现VLM可与检测器同样脆弱，且失败模式主要由输出格式而非架构家族决定，位移与替换对下游更危险。
AI.motivation: VLM正快速部署于边缘安全关键系统，其零样本/开放词表检测能力显著提升，但物理对抗鲁棒性尚未被系统研究；同时VLM与目标检测器输出形式差异大，缺乏公平评估方法，现有评估难以直接比较两类模型。
AI.method: 在统一任务上比较：以人体佩戴对抗贴片是否被模型检测为唯一判据，提出条件攻击成功率cASR（仅在匹配灰色遮挡物下模型仍能定位的图像上统计），并将失败划分为omission（无框）、substitution（框落在贴片上）、displacement（框落在两者之外）三类；对紧凑接地VLM与多种目标检测器进行物理对抗基准测试。
AI.result: 紧凑接地VLM的物理对抗脆弱性可与检测器相当；失败模式与模型输出格式强相关，而非架构家族；三类失败中仅omission对下游系统可见，displacement与substitution返回高置信、规整的框，潜在更危险；在分布偏移下，原本以omission为主的VLM会转向更多displacement/substitution失败。
AI.conclusion: 接地VLM可继承检测器的脆弱性，并有可能表现出更危险的失败模式，因此边缘部署需关注输出格式层面的鲁棒性与失败监控，而非仅比较架构家族。

title: Attention-based Classification for Indirect Prompt Injection
summary: Indirect prompt injection (IPI) attacks, in which adversarial instructions are embedded in external data processed by a language model, pose a significant threat to the integrity of deployed LLM agents. Attention Tracker (Hung et al., 2025) is a recently proposed white-box detection method that identifies prompt injection attacks by monitoring how a model's attention is distributed between user task tokens and data tokens, claiming dataset-agnostic detection via a scalar focus score threshold. In this paper, we provide the first evaluation of Attention Tracker in a realistic agentic IPI setting using the AgentDojo benchmark, finding that the dataset agnosticism claim does not hold. We find that in agentic environments, long structured tool outputs subvert the fundamental assumptions Attention Tracker makes about attention that the method depends on and produces near-chance detection on AgentDojo across most model families. We propose AttnDA, an extension replacing the scalar threshold with a Fisher Linear Discriminant Analysis classifier over the per-head focus score vector, and evaluate both methods in a cross-dataset setting spanning four benchmarks. AttnDA improves detection performance across agentic and tool-integrated benchmarks, though transfer to AgentDojo remains challenging regardless of classifier choice. A covariance ablation further shows that removing inter-head correlation structure substantially contributes to performance, with complex covariance assumptions causing significant degradation on cross-domain data. These results indicate that the attentional distraction signal underlying focus-score-based detection does not transfer reliably to agentic environments, and that learned linear classifiers over head-level attention features offer improved detection performance, provided training data from the target deployment domain is available.

AI.tldr: 本文首次在真实agentic IPI场景（AgentDojo）下评估Attention Tracker，发现其"数据集无关"宣称不成立，并提出AttnDA（逐头focus分数的LDA分类器）进行改进。
AI.motivation: Attention Tracker声称可通过标量focus分数阈值实现数据集无关的间接提示注入检测，但该假设在长结构化工具输出的agentic环境中是否成立尚未被验证。
AI.method: 使用AgentDojo基准复现并评估Attention Tracker；分析长结构化工具输出如何破坏其注意力分散假设；提出AttnDA，将标量阈值替换为对逐头focus分数向量的Fisher LDA分类器，并在四个基准上做跨数据集评估与协方差消融。
AI.result: Attention Tracker在AgentDojo多数模型族上仅为接近随机的检测性能；AttnDA在agentic与工具集成基准上有提升，但迁移到AgentDojo依旧困难；消融表明去除头间协方差结构反而显著有益，复杂协方差假设导致跨域性能下降。
AI.conclusion: focus分数背后的注意力分散信号无法可靠迁移到agentic环境；基于头级注意力特征的线性分类器在有目标域训练数据时能带来更好的检测效果。

title: Solving Go under Positional Superko: Sound Proof Transfer and New Board Values
summary: Positional superko (PSK) forbids recreating any earlier whole-board position. It is part of the Chinese rules as written and of the rules used in computer Go. Yet almost all solved Go boards were computed under a simpler basic-ko rule set. PSK makes solving hard: legality depends on the whole game history, and this breaks the three tools that make solving tractable, namely transposition tables (the graph-history interaction problem), static life-and-death recognition, and safe move pruning. We present Sanko, a parallel depth-first proof-number solver that restores all three soundly. Its core is a cheap proof-transfer theorem: a stored proof stays valid on a new path unless a board that the proof's winner must create has already occurred. Sanko proves 5x5 Go in 16 minutes with six threads, where the previous state of the art needed 5.25 hours with six processes, and in about a minute and a half on one 192-thread machine. It also establishes the first PSK values of twenty-three further boards, eleven of which were unsolved under any rules. Superko changes game-theoretic values: 4x7, a full-board win under basic ko, is worth only 12 points under PSK, and we pinpoint the move at which the previously published optimal line fails. Unlike earlier solutions of empty Go boards, we release the solver source together with the command line and outcome of every run behind our values and measurements, so that all reported values can be reproduced.

AI.tldr: Sanko：首个在位置超级劫(PSK)规则下可证明正确的并行PN求解器，16分钟解出5x5围棋（前人5.25小时）。
AI.motivation: PSK禁止重现任何历史整盘局面，是书面中国规则和电脑围棋规则的一部分，但几乎所有已解围棋盘面都是用更简单的基本劫规则计算的。PSK下合法性依赖完整对局历史，破坏了解题所需的三大工具：置换表（图-历史交互问题）、静态死活识别和安全着法剪枝。
AI.method: 提出Sanko——并行深度优先 proof-number 求解器，以可靠方式恢复上述三项工具。核心是一个开销很小的"证明迁移定理"：已存储的证明在新路径上仍然有效，除非证明胜方必须创造的局面此前已出现过。
AI.result: 六线程16分钟解出5x5围棋（SOTA需6进程5.25小时），单台192线程机器约1.5分钟。另确立23个盘面的首个PSK值，其中11个在任何规则下均未解。超级劫改变博弈论值：4x7在基本劫下为全盘胜，PSK下仅值12点，并定位了已发表最优线路失败的具体着手。
AI.conclusion: PSK求解是可行且高效的；规则差异会显著改变围棋的博弈论值，此前基于基本劫的解与最优线路需重新审视。作者公开求解器源码及每次运行的命令行与结果，使所有数值可复现。

title: ChronoSynth: Constraint-Aware Question Synthesis over Temporal Knowledge Graphs
summary: Knowledge graph question generation (KGQG) generates natural-language questions from structured graph evidence and a target answer. When the input graph is temporal, a valid question must also preserve the answer field, time condition, reference event, and temporal order that determine the answer set. Existing KGQG methods and prompting baselines can produce fluent questions that alter these conditions, causing temporal semantic drift. This paper studies temporal KGQG as a constraint-preserving graph-to-question problem and proposes ChronoSynth, a memory-augmented and constraint-aware generation framework. ChronoSynth first constructs a Temporal Intent State to make the intended question semantics explicit. It then retrieves compatible typed question patterns from an indexed pattern memory, adapts them to the input graph, and validates the generated question. Validation feedback guides revisions when a supported inconsistency is detected. Experiments on CRONQUESTIONS and MultiTQ demonstrate state-of-the-art generation performance, with ablations supporting the contributions of its components.

AI.tldr: 提出ChronoSynth框架，把时序知识图谱问句生成建模为"约束保持"的图到文本生成问题，通过时序意图状态、模式记忆检索与验证反馈修订，显著减少时序语义漂移并在CRONQUESTIONS与MultiTQ上取得SOTA。
AI.motivation: 时序图谱输入的KGQG须同时保持答案域、时间条件、参照事件与时序顺序，否则问题答案集发生变化（时序语义漂移）。现有方法与提示基线虽生成流畅，却常改动这些约束，缺少显式约束建模与校验机制。
AI.method: 将时序KGQG形式化为约束保持的图到问题生成；提出ChronoSynth：(1)构建Temporal Intent State显式化预期问题语义；(2)从索引化模式记忆中检索兼容的类型化问句模式并适配输入图；(3)对生成问句进行验证，检测到有支撑的不一致时以验证反馈引导修订。
AI.result: 在CRONQUESTIONS与MultiTQ上达到SOTA生成性能；消融实验支持各组件（意图状态、模式记忆、验证修订）的有效性。
AI.conclusion: 约束保持视角+记忆增强与验证闭环能有效抑制时序语义漂移，为时序KGQG提供可行范式；未来可扩展至更复杂时序推理与多跳约束场景。

title: NeuralSRender: G-Buffer Guided Video Diffusion for Sim-to-Real Rendering
summary: The scarcity of high-quality annotated visual data remains a critical bottleneck for autonomous-driving perception. Simulators provide training data at scale, but the limited realism of synthetic videos compromises perception performance in real-world applications. To address this limitation, we propose NeuralSRender, a sim-to-real video translation framework that enhances the photorealism of synthetic videos while maintaining geometric consistency with the source scenes. Built on a pretrained video diffusion transformer (DiT), NeuralSRender uses a lightweight projector to inject geometric and material priors from G-buffers, and LoRA enables parameter-efficient adaptation. The model is trained in two stages: it first learns G-buffer conditioning from synthetic videos with accurate G-buffers, then adapts to real-world appearance using real videos with estimated G-buffers. During the second stage, an additional LoRA module is trained while the projector and first-stage LoRA remain frozen to reduce interference from estimation noise. NeuralSRender introduces only 1.45\% parameter overhead and can be trained on consumer-grade GPUs with 24 GB of memory. To support training and evaluation, we introduce GenReal, a large-scale driving video dataset comprising synthetic and real-world videos with corresponding G-buffers. Experiments demonstrate improved photorealism with competitive geometric consistency. Training perception models on our translated videos instead of raw simulator renders improves detection $\mathrm{AP}_{50}$ on nuImages from 35.1 to 40.6 and segmentation mIoU on Cityscapes from 32.4 to 40.8. Our code, data, and model weights are available at: https://github.com/WHU-USI3DV/NeuralSRender.

AI.tldr: 提出 NeuralSRender，一个基于预训练视频 DiT 的 sim-to-real 视频翻译框架，通过 G-buffer 几何/材质先验注入提升合成视频照片真实感并保持几何一致，仅增加 1.45% 参数。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶感知缺乏高质量标注数据；模拟器可大规模生成数据，但合成视频真实感不足，导致真实场景感知性能下降。
AI.method: 基于预训练视频扩散 Transformer（DiT），用轻量 projector 注入 G-buffer 几何与材质先验，LoRA 实现高效适配。两阶段训练：先用带准确 G-buffer 的合成视频学 G-buffer 条件，再用真实视频及其估计 G-buffer 适配真实外观；第二阶段冻结 projector 与第一阶段 LoRA，仅训练额外 LoRA 模块以抑制估计噪声干扰。另构建 GenReal 驾驶视频数据集（含合成与真实视频及对应 G-buffer）。
AI.result: 照片真实感提升且几何一致性具竞争力。用翻译视频替代原始渲染训练感知模型，nuImages 检测 AP50 从 35.1 升至 40.6，Cityscapes 分割 mIoU 从 32.4 升至 40.8；仅 1.45% 参数开销，24GB 消费级 GPU 可训练。
AI.conclusion: NeuralSRender 在低参数开销下有效缩小 sim-to-real 差距，显著提升下游感知性能，并开源代码、数据与权重。

title: Doob-Based Generative Policy Optimization
summary: Diffusion and flow models provide expressive policy classes for robotic and sequential decision-making systems. However, their action likelihoods are generally intractable, limiting the direct use of widely adopted policy optimization methods such as PPO and GRPO. We propose Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO), a framework that leverages Doob's $h$-transform for likelihood-free reinforcement learning fine-tuning of generative policies. DoobPO separates policy improvement from generative policy learning. It first learns a lightweight ratio model that represents the desired policy update, and then distills the resulting ratio-tilted target policy into the generative policy via conditional drift matching. This formulation applies uniformly to both diffusion and flow policies and supports a broad family of policy improvement rules, including PPO and GRPO. We prove that the practical conditional drift matching objective is gradient-equivalent to the ideal Doob drift matching objective. We further show that the induced diffusion process solves an endpoint-constrained stochastic optimal control problem. This establishes that it achieves the minimum-energy modification required to realize the desired policy tilt. Across MuJoCo continuous-control benchmarks, DoobPO achieves strong performance against competitive diffusion- and flow-policy baselines, showing a principled and practical route to RL fine-tuning for generative policies.

AI.tldr: 提出 Doob Policy Optimization (DoobPO)，基于 Doob's h-transform 实现生成式策略（扩散/流模型）的无似然强化学习微调，统一支持 PPO、GRPO 等策略改进规则。
AI.motivation: 扩散与流模型作为策略表达能力强，但其动作似然不可计算，导致 PPO、GRPO 等常用策略优化方法无法直接使用。
AI.method: 将策略改进与生成式策略学习解耦：先学习轻量级 ratio 模型表示期望的策略更新，再通过条件漂移匹配（conditional drift matching）将比值倾斜后的目标策略蒸馏回生成式策略；证明实际目标与理想 Doob 漂移匹配目标梯度等价。
AI.result: 理论上证明该诱导扩散过程求解端点约束的随机最优控制问题，实现最小能量修正；在 MuJoCo 连续控制基准上相较扩散/流策略基线表现强劲。
AI.conclusion: DoobPO 为生成式策略的 RL 微调提供了有原则且实用的路径，统一适用于扩散和流策略及多种策略改进规则。

title: MERP: A Latent-Bottleneck Framework for Robust Multi-Modal Multi-Label Emotion Recognition
summary: Multimodal multi-label emotion recognition is important for affect-aware systems, but models trained with complete text, visual, and acoustic streams often degrade sharply when some streams are unavailable at deployment. We address this train-test gap by learning a compact representation that preserves emotion-specific evidence from any available subset of modalities. We propose the Multi-modal Emotion Recognition Perceiver (MERP), which maps the joint sequence into a fixed-size latent bank, thereby keeping repeated reasoning independent of raw input length; it extracts label-specific evidence before and after latent reasoning and aligns the two levels through reconstruction. MERP further uses positive and negative class prototypes, a noise-gated feature enhancer with frequency-shaped perturbations during training, and confidence-aware class-wise fusion to strengthen separability, reduce sensitivity to missing inputs, and combine complementary predictors. Under 20 percent test-time random modality drop, MERP achieves micro-F1 scores of 0.563 on CMU-MOSEI and 0.780 on M3ED, exceeding the strongest evaluated baselines by 0.004 and 0.005, respectively; in the severe CMU-MOSEI audio-only setting, it retains 0.473 micro-F1 versus 0.022 for LDDU. These results show that fixed latent reasoning provides a practical, testable route to robust multimodal emotion recognition without requiring missing-modality examples during training. Code is available at https://github.com/Creative-zcx/MERP.

AI.tldr: 提出MERP（多模态情感识别Perceiver），用固定大小潜在表示实现对任意可用模态子集的鲁棒情感识别，在缺失模态场景下优于基线。
AI.motivation: 多模态多标签情感识别中，模型在训练时使用完整文本/视觉/声学流，但部署时模态常缺失，性能急剧下降，存在训练-测试差异（train-test gap）。目标是在无需缺失模态训练样本的情况下保持鲁棒性。
AI.method: MERP将联合序列映射到固定大小的latent bank，使重复推理与原始输入长度解耦；在潜在推理前后分别提取标签特定证据，并通过重建对齐两个层级；引入正/负类原型、训练时带频率塑形扰动的噪声门控特征增强器，以及置信度感知的类级融合。
AI.result: 20%测试时随机模态丢弃下，CMU-MOSEI micro-F1为0.563、M3ED为0.780，分别比最强基线高0.004和0.005；CMU-MOSEI仅音频严重缺失场景保持0.473 micro-F1，而LDDU仅0.022。
AI.conclusion: 固定潜在推理为鲁棒多模态情感识别提供了实用且可验证的路径，无需训练时缺失模态样本。代码已开源。

title: B-CARE: Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking
summary: Stance classifiers make errors that can be costly to identify under limited human-review budgets. Prioritizing potentially incorrect predictions remains challenging, particularly across heterogeneous base models. We introduce B-CARE (Blind Classwise Assessment of Relative Evidence for Stance Error Ranking), a prediction-blind framework for identifying high-risk stance predictions. Given only a target and text, a fixed LLM verifier assigns ordinal evidence scores to all candidate stance labels without observing the base model's prediction or confidence. B-CARE constructs a comparative risk score by contrasting the strongest alternative-class evidence with the evidence supporting the predicted class. The resulting classwise evidence profile can be reused across multiple base models without training a separate error detector or calibrating risk scores. We evaluate B-CARE on four stance benchmarks and three heterogeneous base LLMs, covering 12 dataset-model settings and 5,206 unique test instances. Evaluation includes error-ranking discrimination (AUROC and AUPRC), selective prediction (E-AURC), and review effectiveness (ErrorCapture at fixed review budgets). B-CARE achieves a mean AUROC of 0.735 and a mean AUPRC of 0.524, capturing 41.06% of errors within the highest-risk 20% of predictions. Although B-CARE does not uniformly outperform strong confidence-based baselines, it provides a reusable, complementary evidence signal for prioritizing potentially incorrect stance predictions across heterogeneous models.

AI.tldr: 提出B-CARE：一个"预测无关"的立场错误排序框架，用固定LLM验证器对所有候选标签给序数证据分，通过对比最强替代类证据与预测类证据构造风险分数，并可跨多个基模型复用。
AI.motivation: 立场分类器的错误在有限人工审核预算下代价高昂，而跨异构基模型优先识别潜在错误预测仍很困难。
AI.method: B-CARE仅接收目标与文本，固定LLM验证器在不看基模型预测和置信度的情况下为所有候选立场标签打序数证据分；以"最强替代类证据 vs 预测类证据"的对比构造相对风险分数，形成可跨模型复用的类级证据画像，无需训练单独错误检测器或校准风险分数。
AI.result: 在4个立场基准、3个异构基LLM、12种数据集-模型设置、5206个测试样本上评测：平均AUROC 0.735、平均AUPRC 0.524，在最高风险20%预测中捕获41.06%的错误；但并未全面优于强置信度基线。
AI.conclusion: B-CARE提供一个可复用、与置信度互补的证据信号，用于跨异构模型优先排查可能的立场错误；其优势在于复用性而非普遍超越置信度方法。

title: DetM-Tracker: Deterministic and Memory-Efficient VIS for Autonomous Industrial Inspection
summary: Autonomous industrial inspection requires strictly deterministic real-time inference under tight memory and computational constraints. However, existing Video Instance Segmentation (VIS) models suffer from prohibitive scaling: dense temporal memory grows with spatial resolution and sequence length, while fixed-capacity decoders fail to exploit the inherent sparsity of industrial scenes, creating a practical memory wall on resource-constrained edge platforms. We present DetM-Tracker, a streamlined VIS framework for autonomous industrial inspection, where target objects often exhibit highly similar appearance under constrained "micro" fields of view. DetM-Tracker eliminates architectural redundancy through three synergistic components: (1) Compact Scalar Memory, which condenses high-dimensional instance features into four-scalar descriptors, reducing temporal memory complexity from $O(T \cdot N \cdot R)$ to $O(T \cdot \hat{N})$. This mechanism effectively compresses frame-level representations into a bank of active instances, where $R$ denotes resolution, $N$ and $\hat{N}$ represent global and window-specific instance counts, respectively and $T$ the temporal window size; and (2) Dynamic Instance Channels, which adaptively allocate query capacity according to the actual number of visible objects; and (3) Entropy-Gated Skip Connection, which concentrates computational budget on high-uncertainty spatial regions to refine object boundaries in a single forward pass without auxiliary refinement heads. Our approach effectively bridges the gap between modern VIS models and the practical demands of industrial edge deployment, reducing inference latency by approximately 20$\times$ and VRAM consumption by 6$\times$ compared to state-of-the-art dense-feature baselines.

AI.tldr: 提出DetM-Tracker轻量视频实例分割框架，通过紧凑标量记忆、动态实例通道和熵门控跳跃连接三大组件，在工业边缘设备上实现确定性实时推理，延迟降低约20倍、显存降低6倍。
AI.motivation: 自主工业巡检需要在严苛内存与算力约束下进行确定性实时推理。现有VIS模型存在严重扩展性问题：稠密时序记忆随空间分辨率和序列长度增长，固定容量解码器无法利用工业场景的固有稀疏性，在资源受限边缘平台上形成"内存墙"。
AI.method: 三大协同组件：(1) 紧凑标量记忆，将高维实例特征压缩为四标量描述符，把时序记忆复杂度从O(T·N·R)降至O(T·N̂)，把帧级表示压缩为活跃实例库；(2) 动态实例通道，依据实际可见目标数量自适应分配查询容量；(3) 熵门控跳跃连接，把计算预算集中于高不确定性空间区域，单次前向即可精修目标边界，无需辅助精修头。
AI.result: 相比最先进的稠密特征基线，推理延迟降低约20倍，显存占用降低6倍，同时保持适用于工业巡检的性能。
AI.conclusion: DetM-Tracker弥合了现代VIS模型与工业边缘部署实际需求之间的差距，为资源受限平台上的实时视频实例分割提供了可行方案。

title: Rethinking Time Series Tokenization from a Frequency Perspective
summary: Tokenization that partitions time series into subsequences has become a foundational paradigm in modern time series modeling. However, we find that current tokenization strategies inherently introduce spectral distortions, forcing the learned representations to diverge from the true underlying patterns such as trend, periodicity, and seasonality, thereby impairing model performance. Through theoretical analysis from a frequency perspective, we derive the boundary conditions under which such distortions occur. To overcome this distortion, we propose TimeFT, a nearly distortion-free frequency-based tokenizer for time series data. TimeFT obtains tokens through frequency-domain partitioning, frequency shifting, and Nyquist sampling. The method is parameter-free, incurs negligible computational complexity, and can serve as a drop-in replacement for existing tokenizers. Our extensive experiments on diverse tasks such as forecasting, classification, and anomaly detection demonstrate that TimeFT consistently and significantly improves performance.

AI.tldr: 论文指出时间序列分词（tokenization）本质会引入频谱畸变，从频域理论推导畸变发生的边界条件，并提出无参数、低复杂度的频域分词器 TimeFT，可即插即用地替换现有分词器，在预测、分类、异常检测任务上稳定提升性能。
AI.motivation: 分词已成为现代时间序列建模的基础范式，但现有分词策略会引入频谱畸变，使学习到的表示偏离趋势、周期性、季节性等真实内在模式，从而损害模型性能。
AI.method: 从频率视角进行理论分析，推导出这类频谱畸变发生的边界条件；据此提出 TimeFT：通过频域划分、频率搬移与 Nyquist 采样获得 token。该方法无参数、计算复杂度可忽略，且可直接替换现有分词器。
AI.result: 在预测、分类、异常检测等多类任务的广泛实验中，TimeFT 均取得稳定且显著的性能提升。
AI.conclusion: 频域视角能揭示现有分词的固有缺陷，TimeFT 以极低代价实现近无畸变的分词，是一种通用、易集成的改进方案。

title: Events, Not Pixels: Where World Models Get the Return Wrong
summary: World models are increasingly used for planning, where a planner ranks candidate actions by returns imagined by the model. However, these models are judged mainly by how well they render frames, even though a visually faithful rollout can still assign the wrong return. To identify where this mismatch arises, we introduce a transition-level diagnostic that replaces imagined transitions with real ones and measures the reduction in return error against a budget-matched random control. Our analysis yields two findings. (1) Event transitions, the few steps where a reward is earned or an episode ends, are rendered as well as other steps (median pixel-error ratio 0.85), yet restoring them removes a median of 70% of the return error. In contrast, restoring transitions with the largest MSE, SSIM or LPIPS error removes less than a random choice. Across the 44 Atari-100k model--collection pairs that pass our reliability checks, including three released families, event patches outperform random patches in 39 (sign test p=1.4 x 10^{-7}), with a median gain of +44 percentage points. (2) The remaining error is structured: a complementary patch separates errors at true events from those elsewhere, while an eight-step timing tolerance recovers few events missed by our deterministic models. This structure also guides repair: a rule recorded before four repair outcomes were known predicts when a diffusion model repairs these failures. Event patches improve plan ranking, and the same concentration appears on control tasks with rare reward events.

AI.tldr: 该文提出"转场级"诊断方法，发现世界模型的回报误差主要由"事件转场"（获得奖励或回合结束的少数步骤）贡献，而非渲染质量差的步骤，并据此指导修复。
AI.motivation: 世界模型被用于规划时，主要按渲染帧的保真度来评价，但视觉上逼真的推演仍可能给出错误的回报。作者希望定位渲染质量与回报准确性之间不匹配的来源。
AI.method: 引入转场级诊断：把想象转场替换为真实转场，并与预算匹配的随机对照比较，测量回报误差的下降。分析覆盖44个通过可靠性检查的Atari-100k模型—数据集合对（含三个已发布家族），用事件补丁与随机补丁、最大MSE/SSIM/LPIPS误差补丁对比；并用互补补丁区分真实事件处与其他处的错误，施加八步时间容差；再用一条在四种修复结果未知前记录的规则预测扩散模型何时修复这些失败。
AI.result: 事件转场渲染质量与其他步骤相当（像素误差比中位数0.85），但恢复它们可消除中位70%的回报误差；恢复最大MSE/SSIM/LPIPS误差的转场反而不如随机选择。事件补丁在39/44对中优于随机补丁（符号检验p=1.4×10⁻⁷），中位增益+44个百分点。剩余误差呈结构性：互补补丁能区分真实事件与其他位置的误差，八步时间容差只能找回少量遗漏事件；预先记录的规则可预测扩散模型能否修复，事件补丁还能改善规划排序，且该集中现象在奖励事件稀少的控制任务上同样出现。
AI.conclusion: 世界模型的回报误差高度集中在少数事件转场上，与像素级渲染误差不成比例；这一结构性发现可用于诊断和修复模型，并提升基于世界模型的规划排序效果。

title: Don't Stop Long-Context Continual Pre-Training Too Early: An Empirical Scaling Law
summary: Long-context continual pre-training (LCCP) is widely used to improve long-context capability, but how its benefits scale with the number of tokens used for LCCP remains unclear. We investigate this question through modeling, monitoring, and validating the benefits of scaling LCCP. First, we establish an empirical additive power law relating long-context performance to model size and the respective token budgets of short-context pre-training and LCCP. Experiments across five model scales and more than one hundred short- and long-context budget configurations show that the fitted law reproduces the observed trends and extrapolates well to held-out model scales. Second, we introduce \textsc{Constant-Last4}, a training and observation protocol that averages the four most recent consecutive checkpoints from a constant-learning-rate run to enable stable monitoring along a single extensible training trajectory. Under this protocol, the same scaling-law form fits well and accurately predicts the LCCP performance trajectory of a 1.22B-parameter model trained on approximately 100B LCCP tokens. Finally, downstream evaluations along this trajectory show continued improvements in long-context performance, with no clear sign of saturation within the evaluated range. These gains persist after both 128K context extension and supervised fine-tuning, with benefits extending to long-context understanding and agentic tasks. Together, these results argue for continuing to scale LCCP rather than stopping early: its gains are stably observable along an extensible trajectory, quantitatively predictable, and transferable to downstream tasks.

AI.tldr: 本文系统研究了长上下文持续预训练（LCCP）的收益如何随token规模扩展，提出了将长上下文性能与模型规模、短上下文预训练与LCCP token预算联系起来的加性幂律，并提出Constant-Last4协议实现稳定监控，验证了LCCP收益可预测、可持续且可迁移。
AI.motivation: LCCP被广泛用于提升长上下文能力，但其收益随LCCP token数量如何扩展尚不清楚，缺少对"是否应继续扩大LCCP规模"的定量依据。
AI.method: 1）通过五个模型规模、上百种短/长上下文预算配置的实验，建立经验加性幂律，刻画长上下文性能与模型规模及两类token预算的关系；2）提出Constant-Last4训练与观测协议，在恒定学习率下平均最近四个连续checkpoint，实现单条可扩展轨迹上的稳定监控。
AI.result: 拟合的幂律能再现观测趋势并良好外推到未见模型规模；同一幂律形式可准确预测1.22B参数模型在约100B LCCP token上的性能轨迹；下游评测显示长上下文性能持续提升，在评估范围内无明显饱和迹象。
AI.conclusion: 收益经128K上下文扩展和有监督微调后依然保持，并可迁移到长上下文理解与智能体任务，因此应继续扩展LCCP而非过早停止。

title: Cache Locally, Recompute Selectively for Streaming Video Understanding
summary: Streaming video understanding (SVU) requires video-LLMs to process incoming video continuously while answering user queries with low latency. Recent methods reduce query-time cost by prefilling frames into KV caches during idle time and reusing the cached KVs at query time. To bound per-frame computation over unbounded video streams, these methods restrict the context available during prefill. This creates a fundamental context mismatch: the restricted context may omit information needed to properly contextualize video tokens, yet, still contain information irrelevant to the eventual query, which is unknown during prefill. We propose FrameBlend, a simple yet effective plug-and-play method to address this mismatch through selective KV recomputation, without requiring any additional training. At query time, FrameBlend re-prefills selected video tokens using query-relevant context and replaces their cached KVs with recomputed ones. Crucially, this recomputation enables shorter attention windows during idle-time prefill, substantially reducing prefill cost while improving accuracy. Experiments across three SVU frameworks and five streaming and offline benchmarks demonstrate accuracy gains of up to 3.9 pp. On RVS-Ego, FrameBlend reduces per-frame prefill FLOPs by over 20% and total processing time by 14-59% for retrieval-based frameworks, including the cost of query-time recomputation. These results demonstrate that a simple change in how contextualization is distributed between idle time and query time can improve the accuracy-efficiency trade-off for SVU.

AI.tldr: FrameBlend 提出一种无需训练的即插即用方法，通过查询时的选择性 KV 重算，解决流式视频理解中预填充阶段上下文受限导致的上下文不匹配问题，在提升精度的同时降低预填充成本。
AI.motivation: 流式视频理解需低延迟连续处理视频。现有方法在空闲时预填充帧的 KV 缓存以降低查询时开销，但为限制无界视频流的逐帧计算而限制了预填充上下文。这造成根本性的上下文不匹配：受限上下文可能缺少正确语境化视频 token 所需的信息，同时却包含与最终查询无关的信息（查询在预填充时未知）。
AI.method: FrameBlend 通过选择性 KV 重算解决该不匹配，无需额外训练。查询时，用与查询相关的上下文重新预填充选定的视频 token，并用重算的 KV 替换其缓存 KV。这一重算使空闲时预填充可采用更短的注意力窗口，从而大幅降低预填充成本。
AI.result: 在三个 SVU 框架和五个流式及离线基准上，精度最高提升 3.9 个百分点。在 RVS-Ego 上，对基于检索的框架，每帧预填充 FLOPs 降低 20% 以上，总处理时间降低 14–59%（已计入查询时重算成本）。
AI.conclusion: 结果表明确保上下文构建在空闲时与查询时之间的简单重新分配，即可改善流式视频理解的精度–效率权衡。

title: FlashNext-RL: A System Optimization Study for Long-Horizon Agentic RL of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next
summary: Long-horizon agentic reinforcement learning (RL) requires both efficient rollout generation and training on long sequences. However, the memory requirements and model-specific operators of Qwen3.8-Flash-Next make this difficult with existing open-source implementations. To resolve these limitations, we introduce FlashNext-RL, a model-specific RL training optimization framework based on prime-rl, with vLLM for software engineering (SWE) rollout generation. Our main focus is BF16 training of the full 48-layer model on a single 8xB200 node, with the first two layers, the n-gram table, the sparse-attention indexer and the multi-token prediction head frozen. We optimize host offload, gradient accumulation and the kernels for mixture-of-experts, sparse attention and the gated residual stream. In the full-model development study, non-padding training throughput increases from approximately 395 tokens/s/GPU in the initial 32K-token configuration to 4,438 tokens/s/GPU in the optimized 131K-token configuration, with hardware matmul throughput (aka without considering the cost of attention components) increasing from approximately 20 to 213 TFLOPs/GPU. A controlled cumulative study on an 8-layer model further quantifies the contributions of individual optimizations. Together with three inference nodes, the system supports a live SWE RL run with a target batch of 1,024 trainable rollouts and a 131,072-token context limit. Over steps 5-15, an iteration takes 22.4 minutes on average, with bounded entropy and trainer-sampler mismatch KL. These results highlight the importance of tailoring RL training to the model's architecture, memory layout and kernel requirements, rather than relying only on general-purpose RL infrastructure.

AI.tldr: 提出面向 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的专用 RL 训练优化框架 FlashNext-RL，基于 prime-rl 与 vLLM，实现单 8xB200 节点上 48 层全模型 BF16 训练，并支撑长上下文 SWE RL 实跑。
AI.motivation: 长程 agentic RL 需要高效 rollout 生成与长序列训练，但 Qwen3.8-Flash-Next 的显存需求与模型专用算子使现有开源实现难以胜任，尤其是单节点训练全模型与 131K 长上下文场景。
AI.method: 基于 prime-rl、用 vLLM 做 SWE rollout；冻结前两层、n-gram 表、稀疏注意力 indexer 与多 token 预测头；优化 host offload、梯度累积，以及 MoE、稀疏注意力、门控残差流的 kernel。
AI.result: 非 padding 吞吐从 32K 配置约 395 tokens/s/GPU 提升至 131K 配置 4,438 tokens/s/GPU；matmul 吞吐约 20→213 TFLOPs/GPU；8 层模型的受控累积实验量化了各优化贡献；配合 3 个推理节点支持 1,024 条可训练 rollout、131,072 上下文，步 5–15 平均迭代 22.4 分钟，熵与 trainer-sampler 失配 KL 有界。
AI.conclusion: RL 训练基础设施应按模型架构、显存布局与 kernel 需求定制，而非仅依赖通用 RL 框架；专用优化可显著提升长上下文 agentic RL 的可行性与效率。

title: PreCoMem: Predictive Cognitive Memory for Self-Evolving Long-Term Dialogue Agents
summary: Long-horizon dialogue agents need to keep user memories stable enough for personalization while adapting when the user genuinely changes. Existing memory systems often append every observation or overwrite old entries by heuristic rules, which makes transient noise hard to distinguish from real belief drift. We introduce PreCoMem, a memory consolidation framework inspired by predictive coding that represents memory as confidence-weighted beliefs about the user's state. Its core signal, Effective Surprisal, combines semantic deviation and contradiction evidence, then downweights this signal when retrieval is diffuse and unreliable. According to effective surprisal, a two-threshold gate maps each turn to one of three deterministic updates: MAINTAIN reinforces supported beliefs, PROFILE stores ambiguous cues as low-confidence hypotheses, and CORRECT softly decays reliably contradicted facts. The PROFILE stage acts as an explicit waiting room, preventing premature commitment to noisy evidence. Experiments on LoCoMo, LongMemEval-S, and PersonaMem-v2 show consistent state-of-the-art accuracy; our new DiMoBench confirms that PreCoMem adapts to non-stationary belief drift without over-reacting to noise. The code is available at https://github.com/ZhongWishing/PreCoMem.

AI.tldr: PreCoMem 提出一种受预测编码启发的记忆巩固框架，将用户记忆表示为置信度加权的信念，用有效惊奇信号加两阈值门控实现维持/假设存档/修正三类更新，在多个长程对话记忆基准上取得 SOTA。
AI.motivation: 长程对话智能体需要记忆既稳定又能适应用户真实变化；现有系统要么全量追加观测、要么按启发式规则覆盖旧条目，难区分瞬时噪声与真实的信念漂移。
AI.method: 受预测编码启发，将记忆建模为关于用户状态的置信度加权信念。核心信号 Effective Surprisal 融合语义偏离与矛盾证据，并在检索弥散、不可靠时对其降权；据此用双阈值门控将每轮对话确定性映射为三种更新：MAINTAIN（强化被支持信念）、PROFILE（把模糊线索存为低置信假设，作为显式等待区）、CORRECT（对可靠被矛盾的事实软衰减）。
AI.result: 在 LoCoMo、LongMemEval-S、PersonaMem-v2 上取得一致的 SOTA 准确率；新构建的 DiMoBench 上验证了其能适应非平稳信念漂移而不过度反应噪声。代码已开源。
AI.conclusion: 以置信度信念+有效惊奇门控替代追加/启发式覆盖，可在稳定与自适应之间取得更好平衡，PROFILE 等待区机制有效抑制过早承诺噪声证据。

title: Memory-Centric Continual Learning for AI Agents
summary: Autonomous agents powered by foundation models can reason, plan, and use tools, but their fixed weights and context limits hinder sustained learning from experience over long-term deployment. While external memory systems attempt to bridge this gap, they mostly act as passive retrieval caches, evaluated primarily by whether they can recall stored facts or past interactions. Whether memory can drive genuine continual learning remains an open question. In this paper, we introduce Memory-Centric Continual Learning (MCCL), arguing that memory should be judged by whether it improves future actions, not merely what it retrieves. MCCL has three main parts. First, a three-axis taxonomy organizes memory by where state is stored (substrates), what form it takes (assets), and how it is managed (policies). This defines a two-loop lifecycle that updates memory state in an inner loop while refining management policies in an outer loop based on task feedback. Second, an evaluation protocol measures retention under interference, adaptation to change, and task transfer to isolate genuine behavioral gains from simple context expansion. Third, a memory scaling framework models how agent performance scales with experience, storage capacity, and compute budgets across non-parametric and parametric memory. Together, these components reframe agent memory from passive lookup to continuous learning, offering a principled route toward self-improving autonomous agents.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"以记忆为中心的持续学习"(MCCL)新范式，主张记忆应以"是否改善未来行为"而非"能否检索"来评价，并给出三维分类法、双环生命周期、评估协议与记忆扩展框架。
AI.motivation: 基于基础模型的自主智能体虽能推理、规划和用工具，但权重固定、上下文有限，难以在长期部署中积累经验；现有外部记忆系统多为被动检索缓存，仅以能否召回事实或历史交互为标准，记忆能否驱动真正的持续学习仍悬而未决。
AI.method: MCCL包含三部分：(1) 三维分类法——按状态存储位置(基底)、记忆形态(资产)、管理方式(策略)组织记忆，并定义双环生命周期：内环更新记忆状态，外环依据任务反馈优化管理策略；(2) 评估协议——衡量干扰下的保持、对变化的适应、任务迁移，以区分真实行为提升与单纯上下文扩展；(3) 记忆扩展框架——建模智能体性能随经验、存储容量与计算预算在非参数与参数化记忆下的扩展规律。
AI.result: 论文属立场/框架性工作，未报告具体实验数值；其"结果"在于提出上述分类法、双环生命周期、评估协议与扩展框架，为判断记忆是否带来行为增益提供了可操作标准与建模工具。
AI.conclusion: 该工作将智能体记忆从被动查找重新定位为持续学习，为构建可自我改进的自主智能体提供了有原则的路径。

title: DisasterRoute: Evidence-Guided Dual-System Routing for Visual Disaster Question Answering
summary: Visual question answering from low-altitude UAV imagery must deliver timely and accurate judgments to support disaster response under limited edge computing resources. Routine questions may be answered through direct decisions, whereas more challenging questions may benefit from step-by-step reasoning. However, existing research primarily focuses on improving models' visual understanding and generative reasoning capabilities, with limited exploration of efficient direct decision-making and its adaptive coordination with generative reasoning. We develop Disaster-S1 based on a vision-language model adapted to the disaster domain. Trained for option discrimination, it outputs a probability distribution over answer options in a single multimodal forward pass for fast decision-making. We further propose DisasterRoute, a dual-system routing framework that combines prediction confidence with disaster evidence to decide whether to accept the initial answer or invoke the disaster reasoning model DisasterVL for review. By allocating inference computation on demand, the framework retains the efficiency of direct decision-making and improves overall question-answering accuracy through selective review. Experiments on DisasterBench show that Disaster-S1 achieves superior accuracy with low latency, while DisasterRoute further improves accuracy through selective review at substantially lower latency than full reasoning.

AI.tldr: 提出Disaster-S1（单次前向选项判别快速决策）与DisasterRoute（双系统路由）框架，按需分配推理算力，在低时延下提升灾害无人机视觉问答准确率。
AI.motivation: 低空无人机影像的灾害视觉问答需在受限边缘算力下及时准确作答。简单问题可直接决策，难题才需逐步推理；但现有研究多关注视觉理解与生成推理能力，对高效直接决策及其与生成推理的自适应协同探索不足。
AI.method: 基于适配灾害领域的视觉语言模型构建Disaster-S1，以选项判别方式训练，在单次多模态前向中输出答案选项概率分布实现快速决策；并提出DisasterRoute双系统路由框架，结合预测置信度与灾害证据，决定接受初始答案还是调用灾害推理模型DisasterVL复核。
AI.result: 在DisasterBench上，Disaster-S1以低时延取得更高准确率；DisasterRoute通过选择性复核进一步提升准确率，且时延显著低于全量推理。
AI.conclusion: 直接决策与生成推理的自适应路由可在边缘资源约束下兼顾效率与准确性，按需分配推理算力是灾害无人机视觉问答的有效方案。

title: Local and Sparse Kernel Operator Learning for Incompressible Flows: An Operator Lagrange Formulation
summary: We present a local and sparse kernel method for learning the solution operators of incompressible flows. It builds on our earlier property-preserving kernel method, whose global output reconstruction and dense operator regression scale poorly. Our method replaces the global output reconstruction by local divergence-free interpolants with divergence-free polynomials of any degree, solved in parallel on the GPU. These interpolants are divergence free, periodic on periodic domains, and, with a multiscale kernel, approach Kolmogorov statistics under refinement. A compactly supported kernel, positive semidefinite in any input dimension, makes the operator regression sparse. Its support radius, and hence the sparsity, is fitted to data, and optional affine polynomials in the input capture global trends. Operator Lagrange weights join the two. They cost one sparse solve per new input and act on the training fields before the output reconstruction, so their local coefficients are never formed. We show that, unlike direct evaluation, Lagrange evaluation does not amplify solve errors by the cancellation among spatial coefficients. On ten fluid benchmarks, validation selects sparse matrices nearly everywhere, with densities that mostly decrease as the training set grows, and affine augmentation lowers the error by more than an order of magnitude for forced isotropic turbulence. These sparse models are at least as accurate as our earlier dense method and more accurate than neural operators. Lagrange evaluation is as accurate as direct evaluation with local output reconstructions, and up to nearly three orders of magnitude more accurate with global ones. We also present GPU timings and storage.

AI.tldr: 提出局部稀疏核方法学习不可压流解算子：用局部无散插值替代全局重构，配合紧支撑核实现稀疏回归，精度优于神经算子且更高效。
AI.motivation: 先前保持性质的核方法因全局输出重构与稠密算子回归而扩展性差，需要降低计算与存储成本。
AI.method: 用任意次数的无散多项式做局部无散插值（GPU并行求解），替代全局重构；周期域上保持周期性，多尺度核下趋于Kolmogorov统计。采用任意维半正定紧支撑核使回归稀疏，支撑半径由数据拟合，可选仿射多项式捕捉全局趋势，用算子Lagrange权重连接两部分（每个新输入一次稀疏求解，且不显式形成局部系数）。
AI.result: 十个流体基准上，验证集多数选择近全稀疏矩阵，密度随训练集增大而下降；仿射增强使强迫各向同性湍流误差降低一个数量级以上。稀疏模型精度不逊于原稠密方法且优于神经算子；Lagrange评估在局部重构下与直接评估相当，在全局重构下最高近三个数量级更准，且不放大求解误差。
AI.conclusion: 局部稀疏核方法在保持无散、周期性与统计性质的同时，实现更优的精度、可扩展性与存储效率，并给出GPU耗时与存储数据。

title: RubricOpt: Self-Revision of Semantic Rubrics for Preference Optimization
summary: A model's failures can reveal gaps in the behavioral criteria guiding its training. We introduce RubricOpt, a framework that lets a policy revise these criteria within preference optimization. The policy diagnoses its own rubric-free outputs, retains requirements already covered by the rubric, and edits clauses that leave recurring failures unaddressed. A shared semantic representation connects task demands, preference-data contrasts, and rubric clauses, while a deterministic gate checks evidence references and fixed semantic anchors. The rubric then guides Direct Preference Optimization (DPO) during training, with preference pairs, labels, and the objective held fixed, and is removed at evaluation. Our analysis relates the local effect on rubric-free success to semantic alignment and a residual beyond the measured factors. Experiments on capability and open-ended generation benchmarks show that rubric conditioning can improve outcomes over ordinary DPO, with gains and regressions varying across models and datasets. A matched continuation isolates the contribution of revision from additional training and finds mixed incremental effects for the tested edit, whose feedback overlaps the evaluation set. RubricOpt thus brings the behavioral specification itself into the policy's feedback loop.

AI.tldr: RubricOpt让策略在偏好优化中自我修订行为准则（rubric）：诊断无rubric的输出、保留已覆盖条款、编辑未解决反复失败的部分，用共享语义表示对齐任务需求/偏好对比/rubric，再以rubric引导DPO训练，评估时移除rubric。
AI.motivation: 模型失败往往暴露出训练所依据的行为准则存在缺口，但传统偏好优化中准则固定不变，策略无法参与自身行为规范的修订。
AI.method: 策略自我诊断无rubric输出；保留已有条款、编辑未解决反复失败的条款；共享语义表示连接任务需求、偏好数据对比与rubric条款；确定性门控校验证据引用与固定语义锚点；rubric引导DPO（偏好对、标签、目标保持不变），评估时去除。
AI.result: 能力与开放式生成基准上，rubric条件化相比普通DPO可提升结果，但增益与退化因模型和数据集而异；匹配续训实验分离出修订本身的贡献，发现该编辑（其反馈与评估集重叠）的增量效果好坏参半。
AI.conclusion: RubricOpt将行为规范本身引入策略的反馈回路，理论上把无rubric成功率的局部效应与语义对齐及超出已测因素的残差相联系。

title: Right On Q: Recovering Reasoning under Quantization via Self-Generated Trajectories
summary: Quantization-aware training (QAT) aims to recover reasoning capabilities in low-bit large language models (LLMs). Existing recipes typically supervise the quantized student with the original full-precision model on fixed response sequences. However, the resulting low-bit quantized models still struggle on long-horizon reasoning tasks and often fail to terminate within a token budget that suffices for the full-precision model. We identify two challenges in closing this gap. First, fixed-response supervision leaves a mismatch between training prefixes and those encountered during student generation, and this trajectory divergence grows as responses lengthen. Second, on its own prefixes, the student underpredicts some next-token candidates and overpredicts others, and this distributional misalignment becomes more frequent at high-entropy prefixes. We present OnQ, a low-bit recovery pipeline that combines on-policy distillation and candidate-wise Dynamic KL. Starting from block-wise calibration, the quantized student generates responses and receives full-precision teacher supervision on its own prefixes. Dynamic KL weights forward and reverse KL by each candidate's teacher-student probability ratio to balance correction of under- and overprediction. Across Qwen3-1.7B, 4B, and 8B at 2- and 3-bit precision, OnQ achieves the highest nine-benchmark average, with the largest gains on long-horizon reasoning benchmarks. At 2 bits, it outperforms every baseline on every benchmark at every model size, improving the Qwen3-8B average by 10.26 points over the strongest baseline. It also produces shorter responses with fewer truncations and repetitive errors.

AI.tldr: 提出 OnQ，一种低比特 LLM 恢复流程，结合 on-policy 蒸馏与候选级 Dynamic KL，显著提升长程推理能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 QAT 用全精度教师监督固定响应序列上的量化学生，导致低比特模型在长程推理任务上表现差、难以在足够 token 预算内终止。存在两个挑战：(1) 训练前缀与学生生成时遇到的前缀不匹配，且随响应变长轨迹偏移加剧；(2) 学生在自己前缀上对部分候选下一 token 低估、部分高估，这种分布错配在高熵前缀处更频繁。
AI.method: OnQ 流程：从分块校准（block-wise calibration）出发，量化学生自行生成响应，并在其自身前缀上接受全精度教师的监督（on-policy 蒸馏）；并采用候选级 Dynamic KL，根据每个候选的教师-学生概率比加权前向与反向 KL，以平衡对低估和高估的纠正。
AI.result: 在 Qwen3-1.7B/4B/8B 的 2-bit 与 3-bit 精度上，OnQ 取得九项基准最高平均分，长程推理基准提升最大。2-bit 下在每个模型尺寸的每项基准上均优于所有基线，Qwen3-8B 平均分较最强基线提升 10.26 分；同时响应更短、截断与重复错误更少。
AI.conclusion: OnQ 通过 on-policy 蒸馏与 Dynamic KL 有效弥合低比特 LLM 在长程推理上的差距，兼具更强性能与更高生成效率。

title: Think-Capture: Active 3D Geometry Acquisition for Spatial Reasoning in Vision-Language Models
summary: Vision-Language Models (VLMs) excel at 2D recognition but often fail to maintain consistent 3D relations across sparse viewpoints, leading to spatial hallucinations under occlusion and perspective changes. Existing methods commonly fuse all frames with dense geometry, incurring substantial computation and context overhead while encouraging blind reliance on imperfect estimators. We present Think-Capture, a query-conditioned framework that first identifies task-critical objects and then acquires their geometry on demand. A 3D toolkit lifts zero-shot masks into a common coordinate frame, and a Symbolic 3D State Abstraction compresses object and camera states into structured text. Hierarchical Group Relative Policy Optimization (GRPO) trains the VLM on cases in which geometry either helps or misleads, teaching it when to use tool evidence and when to fall back on visual cues. Think-Capture-4B reaches 54.4% on MindCube-Tiny (+21.5 points over its backbone), 39.1% on the MMSI-Bench positional subset (+7.9), and 42.8% on ViewSpatial (+5.2). It also remains robust under coordinate and mask perturbations. The full stack fits one 24 GB GPU and serves as an asynchronous high-level reasoner on an Agibot G1. Our code is available at https://github.com/819346675/Think-Capture.

AI.tldr: Think-Capture：查询条件化的 VLM 框架，先定位任务关键物体再按需获取几何，配合符号化 3D 状态抽象与分层 GRPO 训练，实现稳健的 3D 空间推理。
AI.motivation: 现有 VLM 在多视角、遮挡和视角变化下难以保持 3D 关系一致，产生空间幻觉；而现有方法密集融合所有帧的几何信息，计算与上下文开销大，且让模型盲目依赖不完美的几何估计器。
AI.method: 1) 查询条件化流程：先识别任务关键物体，再按需获取其几何；2) 3D 工具包将零样本掩码提升到统一坐标系；3) 符号化 3D 状态抽象（Symbolic 3D State Abstraction）把物体与相机状态压缩为结构化文本；4) 分层 GRPO 在"几何有益/几何误导"两类样本上训练 VLM，学习何时使用工具证据、何时回退到视觉线索。
AI.result: Think-Capture-4B 在 MindCube-Tiny 达 54.4%（较骨干 +21.5），MMSI-Bench 位置子集 39.1%（+7.9），ViewSpatial 42.8%（+5.2）；在坐标与掩码扰动下保持稳健；完整系统可装入单张 24GB GPU，并作为异步高层推理器部署于智元 Agibot G1。
AI.conclusion: 按需获取几何 + 符号化状态表示 + 策略学习式工具使用，可在低成本下显著提升 VLM 的 3D 空间推理一致性与鲁棒性，并具备真实机器人部署可行性。

title: Dissimilarity-Based Markov Decision Processes for Stabilizing State Distributions
comment: 44 pages, 12 figures, 13 tables. Xun Shen, Yuepeng Wang, and Daniyal Sajedi-Hosseini contributed equally. Under review at TMLR
summary: Reinforcement learning for stochastic systems typically optimizes expected cumulative rewards, while reliable and repeatable behavior also depends on how the state distribution evolves over time. Optimizing expected return alone does not guarantee that this distribution converges to a desired target or remains stable. This paper develops a theoretical framework for learning policies that stabilize state distributions. We formulate the problem as a Dissimilarity-based Markov Decision Process (DMDP), in which the policy acts on the current state distribution and the objective measures its dissimilarity to a target distribution. We establish sufficient conditions under which the optimal policy makes the target distribution asymptotically stable. To support policy learning, we introduce a finite-dimensional representation of distributions and show how stability guarantees for its parameter dynamics extend to the underlying state distributions. We further develop certificates for the learned policies, including their deployment using estimated distribution parameters. These results quantify how learning and estimation errors affect the guarantees and identify conditions under which learned policies retain asymptotic stability. For practical implementation, we combine distribution estimates and target-dependent rewards with PPO and SAC. A computable example on a linear system illustrates the proposed theoretical certificates. Furthermore, experiments on a HalfCheetah task demonstrate the benefits of distribution feedback and explicit target matching for regulating the velocity distribution.

AI.tldr: 本文提出基于相异度的马尔可夫决策过程（DMDP）理论框架，将策略作用于当前状态分布并以分布与目标的相异度为目标，研究使状态分布收敛到目标且渐近稳定的策略学习，并给出有限维表示、稳定性证书及PPO/SAC实现。
AI.motivation: 传统强化学习只优化期望累积回报，无法保证状态分布在时间上的演化收敛到期望目标或保持稳定；而可靠、可重复的行为需要状态分布层面的稳定性。因此需要一个针对状态分布稳定性的理论与算法框架。
AI.method: 将问题建模为DMDP：策略作用于当前状态分布，目标是度量其与目标分布的相异度；建立最优策略使目标分布渐近稳定的充分条件；引入分布的有限维表示，把参数动力学的稳定性保证推广到真实状态分布；构建学习策略的证书（含基于估计分布参数部署的情形），量化学习与估计误差影响；实践中结合分布估计与目标相关奖励，用PPO和SAC实现。
AI.result: 给出使目标分布渐近稳定的充分条件；证明有限维参数动力学的稳定性可扩展到原状态分布；提供考虑学习/估计误差的策略证书并识别保持渐近稳定性的条件；线性系统算例验证理论证书；HalfCheetah实验显示分布反馈与显式目标匹配有利于调节速度分布。
AI.conclusion: 仅优化期望回报不足以保证状态分布的收敛与稳定，DMDP框架为分布稳定的策略学习提供了理论保证与可部署证书，并能与PPO/SAC等实用算法结合，在连续控制任务中体现分布反馈与目标匹配的收益。

title: An Exact 93-Move Solution to a Nonlocal Crystal-Exchange Puzzle
summary: We determine the minimum number of directional commands needed to solve alevel of Order of the Sinking Star, modeled as a crystal-exchangepuzzle on an 11*11 board. A command swapsthe player with the nearest crystal in the selected row or column, regardlessof distance; only an empty ray permits an ordinary unit walk. Two gates admitthe player to the exit exactly while all sixteen crystals occupy their targetcells. We give an explicit 93-command solution and exclude every shortersolution by an exact, cost-bounded breadth-first search. The search representsa position by its seventeen occupied cells and one active cell. Its admissibleheuristic partitions command costs between a compressed core abstraction andresidual motion, strengthened by a necessary activation detour and a cornervisit condition. The completed computation retained 605,349,215 occupied setsand 1,863,925,136 states. We prove the reductions and pruning conditions,describe the exact storage scheme, and provide source code, execution logs,and a reproduction driver. The result is a computer-assisted proof for thespecified instance, with an explicit implementation trust boundary.

AI.tldr: 本文确定了《Order of the Sinking Star》某一关卡的最小方向指令数，将谜题建模为11×11棋盘上的水晶交换问题，并给出93步显式解，同时通过精确代价有界广度优先搜索排除了所有更短解。
AI.motivation: 针对《Order of the Sinking Star》特定关卡，需确定解决该谜题所需的最少方向指令数。由于“指令”会与同行/同列最近水晶交换（无视距离），且只有空射线上才可做普通单步移动，搜索空间极大，需要严格的最优性证明而不只是给出一个解。
AI.method: 将谜题建模为11×11棋盘上的水晶交换问题；出口门仅当16颗水晶全在目标格时开放。给出一个93指令的显式解，并用精确的代价有界广度优先搜索排除所有更短解。搜索将局面表示为17个占据格加1个活跃格；采用可采纳启发式，将指令代价在“压缩核心抽象”与“残余移动”间分配，并用必要的激活绕行条件和角落访问条件加强剪枝。作者证明了各项约简与剪枝条件的正确性，描述了精确存储方案，并公开源码、执行日志与复现驱动。
AI.result: 得到93指令的显式解；完整计算保留605,349,215个占据集合和1,863,925,136个状态，证明不存在更短解。结果为该指定实例的计算机辅助证明，并明确了实现信任边界。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以可复现的计算机辅助证明方式，严格确立了此关卡的最少指令数为93，并提供了显式解、可采纳启发式与剪枝证明、存储方案及复现材料，同时界定了证明所依赖的实现信任边界。

title: ECHO: Emergent Common-Mode Hidden Offsets Drive Vocabulary Collapse in Preference Optimization
summary: Preference optimization can improve every ranking metric while building a hidden, shared representation shift that the relative loss barely sees, one that can eventually destroy generation. We trace this failure to the common-mode offset, a shared directional shift in the model's hidden states that appears across token positions, prompts, and both chosen and rejected responses. Because it moves chosen and rejected representations together, the relative ranking loss barely reacts to its accumulation. As this offset grows, it projects onto the output layer to form a vocabulary well, elevating a single token's probability until it dominates decoding and causes generation collapse. The isolated offset alone reconstructs the vocabulary well, injecting the learned offset into an untreated base model recreates the collapse where norm-matched random directions do not, and masking this common component from the loss prevents the well in our flagship setting. Under the per-token ranking loss we study, the same collapse appears in 14 of 17 base-model lineages and under full-parameter fine-tuning. Moreover, the offset is not merely an artifact of collapse, since it is already present in textbook DPO and SimPO runs that form no well. Textbook DPO keeps it weakly aligned with any single vocabulary direction even with three times our base budget. Trained from base models for that budget, however, full-parameter SimPO drives it into collapse on both Llama-2 and Llama-3.1, and the same kind of offset grows, without a well, from a public SFT checkpoint under the official SimPO recipe. Across 17 UltraFeedback runs, the better a run ranks held-out responses, the less often two public reward models prefer its samples to the base model's. These findings expose a blind spot in standard ranking metrics and introduce a representation-level signal that can warn of generation collapse before it occurs.

AI.tldr: 偏好优化虽能提升各项排序指标，却会累积一个相对损失几乎察觉不到的隐层表示"共模偏移"。该偏移随训练增长，投影到输出层形成"词汇井"，抬高单一token概率直至解码崩溃；而排序指标对此毫无反应。
AI.motivation: 现有偏好优化方法主要关注相对排序损失（chosen vs rejected），并以此作为训练和评估的核心信号。作者质疑：为什么这些方法在排序指标持续变好的同时，生成质量却可能崩溃？核心动机是揭示标准排名指标的系统性盲区，并寻找能在崩溃发生前预警的表示层信号。
AI.method: 作者定义并追踪"共模偏移"（common-mode offset）：跨token位置、prompt以及chosen/rejected响应的隐状态共享方向性偏移。由于chosen和rejected同步移动，相对排序损失对其不敏感。方法包括：将偏移单独投影到输出层以检验"词汇井"的形成；向未训练基座模型注入学到的偏移以复现崩溃（并与范数匹配的随机方向对照）；从损失中屏蔽该共模分量以验证其因果作用；在17个基座模型谱系、全参数微调、DPO/SimPO、Llama-2/Llama-3.1、公开SFT检查点及17个UltraFeedback运行上进行大规模实证。
AI.result: 1) 偏移单独即可重建词汇井；2) 注入偏移可复现崩溃，范数匹配的随机方向则不能；3) 屏蔽共模分量可防止词汇井形成；4) 该崩溃在17个基座谱系中的14个出现，全参数微调下亦然；5) 偏移并非崩溃的副产物—教科书式DPO和SimPO（即使不形成词汇井）已存在该偏移，DPO即使预算增至3倍仍仅与任一词汇方向弱对齐；6) SimPO全参数训练在Llama-2和Llama-3.1上均导致崩溃；7) 在17个UltraFeedback运行中，held-out排序越好的运行，两个公开奖励模型越不常偏好其样本。
AI.conclusion: 标准排序指标存在根本盲区：它们无法察觉共模偏移的累积，进而无法预警生成崩溃。作者提出一种表示层信号（共模偏移），可作为生成崩溃的早期预警。研究同时揭示排序指标变好可能与生成质量及奖励模型偏好脱钩，对偏好优化的评估与训练设计有重要启示。

title: Encoded but Unused: Bounding the Sources of VLM Errors
summary: In this paper, we investigate why vision-language models (VLMs) produce errors by decomposing them into two sources: visual-representation failures, in which the visual evidence required for the correct answer is not encoded, and visual-utilization failures, in which this evidence is encoded but not successfully used. We propose to estimate the visual-utilization failure rate using lightweight probes and derive theoretical bounds on the true rate that account for probe imperfections. We introduce VELens (Visual Evidence Lens), a rank-based probe that traces visual evidence for both a target object and its ground-truth attribute, such as color, material, or shape, across VLM layers. We evaluate VELens on over 6,000 images using LLaVA-1.6-7B and Qwen2.5-VL-7B. Our method achieves ROC-AUC scores of 0.95 and 0.91, respectively, and outperforms alternative probes in both low-resource and unseen-attribute settings. Using it to diagnose errors, we estimate that visual-utilization failures account for 84.4% of LLaVA errors and 70.0% of Qwen errors, with conservative lower bounds of 77.5% and 61.0%, respectively. Overall, our study identifies visual utilization as the dominant bottleneck in VLMs and suggests that a central opportunity for improvement lies in developing better mechanisms to locate, route, and use the visual information they already encode.

AI.tldr: 本文将VLM错误分解为视觉表征失败与视觉利用失败，提出轻量探针VELens估计利用失败率并给出理论界限，发现视觉利用是VLM的主要瓶颈（LLaVA错误中约84%源于此）。
AI.motivation: 现有研究多关注VLM出错，但未区分错误源于视觉信息未被编码，还是已编码却未被利用；厘清二者对定位瓶颈和改进模型至关重要。
AI.method: 将错误分为视觉表征失败与视觉利用失败；用轻量探针估计利用失败率，并对探针不完美给出真值的理论界限；提出VELens——基于秩的探针，跨层追踪目标对象及其真实属性（颜色、材质、形状）的视觉证据；在6000+图像、LLaVA-1.6-7B与Qwen2.5-VL-7B上评测，并与替代探针在低资源及未见属性设定下比较。
AI.result: VELens取得ROC-AUC 0.95（LLaVA）与0.91（Qwen），优于替代探针；估计LLaVA错误中84.4%（保守下界77.5%）、Qwen错误中70.0%（下界61.0%）来自视觉利用失败。
AI.conclusion: 视觉利用是VLM的主导瓶颈；改进机会在于开发更好的机制来定位、路由并使用模型已编码的视觉信息。

title: Better Policies, Worse Verifier Audits
summary: Verifier stacks increasingly sit inside post-training and test-time compute loops. We study a specific control loop: a component verifier is evaluated on fresh policy outputs against the full success label and refreshed when that aggregate score falls. For a conjunctive target $y = F \wedge M$, its on-policy AUC is $(1-q)A_{\mathrm{own}} + qA_{\mathrm{cross}}$, where $q = \Pr[F=1 \mid y=0]$. As the policy masters $F$, $q$ can rise toward one, removing weight from $F$-failures and rewarding information about $M$. We call this on-policy audit collapse. We derive a sharp identified set, a complete-erasure threshold, and the exact point at which the audit can prefer a worse component verifier; its population optimum is the full-outcome predictor, not the component oracle. An exact oracle exhibits the collapse, a natural multi-label text control shows inversion can select a head with lower canonical $F$-AUC at the observed failure mixture, and a prediction-registered ECG study shows that acting on the audit can reduce off-policy $F$-AUC, transfer the damage to an unseen generator, and increase downstream constraint violations. Preserving own-failure support prevents the damage. Matching label-complexity bounds and a controlled-mixture audit give the corresponding repair: audit the component on its own failures, and keep those failures in the refresh distribution.

AI.tldr: 论文研究验证器在训练/测试循环中被"聚合分数下降即刷新"的审计回路，揭示对合取目标 y=F∧M 的 on-policy AUC 会随策略掌握 F 而"审计崩塌"，导致审计偏好更差的组件验证器；给出修复方案：在自身失败上审计组件并保留该失败分布。
AI.motivation: 验证器越来越多地被嵌入后训练与测试时计算回路，但对"以新鲜策略输出上的聚合分数刷新验证器"这一控制回路的可靠性缺乏分析。作者想弄清楚：当目标是合取型（F 且 M）时，这种审计是否会误导组件验证器的选择。
AI.method: 将 on-policy AUC 分解为 (1-q)A_own + qA_cross，其中 q=Pr[F=1|y=0]；推导出尖锐的可识别集（sharp identified set）、完全擦除阈值，以及审计会偏好更差组件验证器的精确临界点；在精确 oracle、自然多标签文本控制和预测注册的心电（ECG）研究三类设置上做验证。
AI.result: oracle 实验展示崩塌现象；多标签文本控制显示反演会在观测失败混合下选出规范 F-AUC 更低的头；ECG 研究显示依据该审计行动会降低 off-policy F-AUC、把损害迁移到未见生成器，并增加下游约束违反。保留自身失败支撑可防止损害。
AI.conclusion: 聚合审计的总体最优是"全结果预测器"而非组件 oracle；修复方案是：在组件自身的失败上做审计，并在刷新分布中保留这些失败（匹配标签复杂度下界、受控混合审计验证有效）。

title: Parallel Thinking for Large Language Model with Path Diversity
summary: Parallel thinking has emerged as a promising paradigm for enhancing the reasoning capabilities of Large Language Models (LLMs) by exploring multiple reasoning paths simultaneously. However, we identify that parallel thinking via Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically suffers from the mode collapse of reasoning paths, where parallel thinking trajectories degenerate into similar ones. This homogeneity undermines the fundamental motivation of parallel thinking, that is, maintaining multiple hypotheses concurrently to prevent premature loss into a suboptimal solution. In this paper, we propose Diverse Parallel Thinking (DPT), a simple yet effective RL approach for parallel thinking designed to encourage path diversity. DPT rewards the model to develop distinct reasoning strategies by penalizing the prefix similarity of parallel thinking paths, thereby enhancing a more comprehensive exploration of the reasoning space. We conduct various experiments and analyses across multiple reasoning benchmarks to demonstrate the effectiveness of DPT. Results show that DPT successfully outperforms previous parallel thinking methods, achieving state-of-the-art performance over baselines. We validate path diversity as a key element to improve parallel thinking. Our code is available at https://github.com/JiaruQian/DPT.

AI.tldr: 论文指出并行思考在强化学习中易出现"推理路径模式崩溃"，提出DPT方法，通过惩罚并行推理路径间的前缀相似度来奖励模型发展不同的推理策略，在多个基准上取得SOTA性能。
AI.motivation: 并行思考旨在同时探索多条推理路径以提升LLM推理能力，但基于RL的并行思考常出现模式崩溃：多条并行轨迹趋于相似，丧失了"同时保有多个假设以防过早陷入次优解"的核心价值。
AI.method: 提出Diverse Parallel Thinking（DPT），一种简单有效的RL方法：对并行思考路径之间的前缀相似度施加惩罚，从而激励模型形成彼此不同的推理策略，增强对推理空间的全面探索。
AI.result: 在多个推理基准上的实验与分析表明，DPT优于先前的并行思考方法，在基线上达到SOTA，并验证了路径多样性是提升并行思考的关键因素。
AI.conclusion: 路径多样性对并行思考至关重要；通过奖励差异化推理策略、惩罚前缀相似度，DPT有效缓解模式崩溃并提升推理性能，代码已开源。

title: Beyond Small Talk: Modeling Disclosure Trajectories in Human-AI Conversation
summary: Recently, we see a rise in conversational agents as a form of social and emotional support, where disclosure will unfold over time. Yet, current evaluations of these agents typically examine isolated conversational states. In analyses of naturally occurring conversations, disclosure history and current disclosure are confounded which tends to make their effects difficult to isolate. We thus introduce Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation (TraDE), an evaluation framework grounded in Social Penetration Theory that utilizes predefined disclosure trajectories and evaluates how preceding disclosure history shapes model behavior under matched current disclosure. Through the use of TraDE, we demonstrate across multiple models and relational behavior benchmarks that responses to disclosures matched on depth can differ depending on the preceding trajectory, particularly in whether models accept or challenge the user's framing. We also observed that these differences track accumulated exposure to deeper disclosure rather than any single moment of vulnerability or the order of disclosures. It also tends to persists for several turns after disclosure returns to shallow levels. For several behaviors, we also demonstrate that models diverge most consistently from human supporters in the Emotional Support Conversation corpus (ESConv) not when users open up but rather when they step back in their disclosure. TraDE thus provides a systematic way to expose history-dependent relational behavior that evaluations of isolated conversational states would otherwise miss.

AI.tldr: 提出TraDE评估框架，用预设自我披露轨迹考察对话历史如何影响模型的关系行为。
AI.motivation: 现有对话智能体的评估只考察孤立的单轮对话状态；而在自然对话中，披露历史与当前披露相互混淆，难以分离两者的作用。
AI.method: 基于社会渗透理论（Social Penetration Theory）设计Trajectory-based Disclosure Evaluation（TraDE）：预设披露轨迹，在匹配当前披露深度的条件下评估先前披露历史对模型行为的影响；在多个模型和关系行为基准上进行测试，并与ESConv中人类支持者对比。
AI.result: 相同深度的披露，因先前轨迹不同会引发不同回应，尤其在模型是否接受或质疑用户的框架上；差异跟随累计的深度披露暴露量而非某一刻的脆弱性或披露顺序；披露回到浅层后效应仍持续数轮；模型与人类支持者差异最一致地出现在用户“收回”披露时，而非敞开时。
AI.conclusion: TraDE能系统揭示依赖历史的关系行为，这是孤立状态评估所无法发现的。

title: Failure Modes of Vision-Language Models for Human Activity Understanding in Thermal HRI
summary: Thermal cameras enable robots to perceive human activities in darkness while revealing less personally identifiable appearance information and fewer details of the surrounding environment than RGB cameras. As vision-language models (VLMs), originally developed for RGB imagery, are increasingly integrated into embodied systems for scene understanding and high-level planning, thermal sensing offers a promising way to extend activity perception to low-light and privacy-sensitive settings. However, the failure modes of VLMs in thermal human activity understanding for human-robot interaction (HRI) remain underexplored. We fill this gap by evaluating seven locally deployable VLMs, including models developed for physical AI and robotics, on two person-centric thermal datasets. Our diagnostic tasks examine fine-grained action recognition, activity timeline reconstruction, and the ability to withhold unsupported answers. Paired RGB recordings serve as a performance reference, while controlled variations in frame sampling, thermal input presentation, and reasoning are used to assess whether the observed errors can be mitigated. Our results show that models can recognize broad activity categories but struggle with fine-grained actions such as coughing, sneezing, and yawning.
