They also produce inaccurate event timelines and hallucinate actions involving objects. Simple thermal input preprocessing and additional reasoning offer only limited, model-dependent gains. Abstention behavior also varies across models even under explicit instructions, limiting their reliability for practical robotic use.

AI.tldr: 该论文系统评估了7个可在本地部署的视觉语言模型（含面向具身智能/机器人开发的模型）在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上的表现，涵盖细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建和"拒答/不臆测"能力，并用配对的RGB数据作为性能参照、通过控制帧采样/热输入呈现/推理等变量考察错误缓解空间。结果发现模型能识别粗粒度活动类别，但在咳嗽、打喷嚏、打哈欠等细粒度动作上表现不佳，时间线重建不准确且会幻觉出涉及物体的动作；简单的热图预处理与额外推理仅带来有限的、依赖模型的增益，拒答行为在明确指令下仍不稳定。
AI.motivation: 热成像相机能让机器人在黑暗中感知人类活动，同时相比RGB相机泄露更少的个人身份外观信息和环境细节，适合低光与隐私敏感场景。随着为RGB图像开发的视觉语言模型（VLM）日益被集成到具身系统中用于场景理解与高层规划，将热感知扩展到活动理解具有吸引力。然而，VLM在面向人机交互（HRI）的热成像人类活动理解中的失效模式仍研究不足，本文旨在填补这一空白。
AI.method: 对7个可本地部署的VLM（包括面向物理AI与机器人开发的模型）在两个以人为中心的热成像数据集上进行诊断性评测。任务包括：细粒度动作识别、活动时间线重建、以及对无依据答案的拒答（abstention）能力。配对RGB录像作为性能参照；并控制变化帧采样方式、热成像输入呈现方式与推理（reasoning）设置，以考察观察到的错误是否可被缓解。
AI.result: 模型能够识别粗粒度活动类别，但在咳嗽、打喷嚏、打哈欠等细粒度动作上表现吃力；生成的事件时间线不准确，并会幻觉出涉及物体的动作。简单的热成像输入预处理和额外的推理仅带来有限的、依赖具体模型的增益。即使在明确指令下，拒答行为在不同模型之间也存在差异，限制了其在实际机器人应用中的可靠性。
AI.conclusion: 当前VLM在热成像人类活动理解上尚不足以支撑可靠的HRI应用：细粒度动作识别、时间线重建与拒答能力均存在明显缺陷，且常规的输入预处理与推理增强难以系统性弥补，这对面向机器人的热感知VLM部署提出了明确的改进需求。

title: From Association to Decision Value: Testing Paired Instruction Dependence for VLA Corpus Selection
summary: Choosing among robot demonstration corpora is a ranking problem: an upstream diagnostic must preserve which candidates produce better downstream policies, not merely correlate with average performance. We study paired instruction dependence, the rate at which a demonstrator changes its first decision when only the goal changes. Across 136 independently seeded quadruped-navigation corpora, predictions developed on 56 corpora are evaluated prospectively on 80 held-out corpora. The audit is reliable and associated with downstream paired correctness, and lowers mean absolute prediction error when added to a correctness-aware baseline, but the primary proper-log-score increment is +0.059 nats (95% corpus-bootstrap CI [-0.027, 0.133]) and the prespecified top-20% comparison does not establish an incremental selection gain. An exploratory response decomposition suggests a structural source of this predictive-ranking mismatch: under the tested predictor specification, separating both-correct and both-wrong responses yields larger held-out gains than their unsigned switch statistic. Seed-to-seed agreement indicates that the held-out endpoint retains recoverable rank signal. These results show that counterfactual response structure can be reliable and predictive while providing limited incremental decision value in this setting when compressed into an unsigned statistic, motivating diagnostics that preserve outcome-relevant structure and are validated against the decisions they are intended to support.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究机器人演示语料的排序/诊断问题，提出并前瞻性检验"配对指令依赖性"（仅目标变化时演示者首个决策改变的比例）这一诊断指标，发现其可靠且与下游配对正确性相关，但增量选择价值有限。
AI.motivation: 从多个机器人演示语料中挑选合适的训练数据本质上是排序问题：上游诊断指标不仅要与平均性能相关，更需保留候选语料在下游策略质量上的排序能力。作者希望检验一个诊断指标能否真正支持选择决策，而非仅相关。
AI.method: 在136个独立随机种子的四足导航语料上，用56个语料开发预测模型，在80个留出语料上做前瞻性评估。核心诊断量为"配对指令依赖性"：仅改变目标时演示者首个决策发生改变的比例。评估包括与下游配对正确性的关联、加入correctness-aware基线后的预测误差与proper log-score增量、预设的top-20%选择比较，并做探索性响应分解（区分both-correct/both-wrong与无符号switch统计）及种子间一致性分析。
AI.result: 该诊断可复现且与下游配对正确性相关，加入基线后降低平均绝对预测误差；但主要proper log-score增量仅+0.059 nats（95%语料bootstrap CI [-0.027, 0.133]），预设top-20%比较未能确立增量选择收益。探索性分解显示，分离both-correct与both-wrong响应比无符号switch统计带来更大留出增益；种子间一致性表明留出终点仍保留可恢复的排序信号。
AI.conclusion: 反事实响应结构可以是可靠且具预测力的，但压缩为无符号统计量时在该设定下增量决策价值有限。作者呼吁设计保留结果相关结构的诊断指标，并直接针对其旨在支持的决策进行验证。

title: A KAN-based Non-linear Factorization for Embedding Layer Compression
comment: 18th International Conference on Statistical Analysis of Textual Data (JADT 2026)
summary:
Among existing embedding compression approaches, low-rank factorization provides a simple and mathematically principled solution by approximating the embedding matrix with a reduced-rank decomposition. However, its practical effectiveness is often limited, as the resulting linear bottleneck constrains representational capacity. To overcome these limitations, we propose an enhanced factorization scheme that increases expressive power by introducing learnable non-linear projections within the compressed embedding layer. Our method is inspired by the Kolmogorov Arnold Networks (KAN) paradigm, which replaces fixed linear transformations with learnable univariate functions. Despite promising results in other domains, applications of KANs in NLP remain scarce and have so far been largely limited to final or task specific layers, rather than core representational components such as embedding layers.
  We evaluate the proposed approach by integrating the compressed embedding layer into the Skip-gram framework and comparing it against a standard low-rank baseline under matched parameter budgets on the Word Analogy and Semantic Similarity benchmarks. We further introduce an effective initialization strategy from a pre-trained, uncompressed embedding layer. The behavior of the model is analyzed both immediately after initialization and after a brief post-initialization refinement phase, considering training with the standard Skip-gram objective as well as variants augmented with distillation from the original embedding layer. Overall, our results show that augmenting low-rank factorization with learnable non-linear projections effectively mitigates the limitations of linear bottlenecks, yielding more faithful compressed embeddings under fixed dimensionality and suggesting a promising direction for embedding layer compression beyond purely linear methods.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出在压缩嵌入层中引入基于Kolmogorov-Arnold网络(KAN)的可学习单变量非线性投影，以缓解低秩分解的线性瓶颈问题。在相同参数预算下，通过Skip-gram框架在词类比和语义相似度基准上优于标准低秩基线。
AI.motivation: 低秩分解虽数学简洁，但其线性瓶颈限制了表示能力，压缩效果有限；同时KAN在NLP中应用稀少，尚未用于嵌入层等核心表示组件。
AI.method: 在低秩压缩嵌入层内加入可学习的单变量非线性函数（KAN式投影）以增强表达能力；将该压缩嵌入层集成到Skip-gram框架，与标准低秩基线在参数预算匹配条件下对比；并设计从预训练未压缩嵌入层进行初始化的策略，分析初始化后即刻及短期精调后的行为，含标准Skip-gram目标与带原始嵌入蒸馏的变体。
AI.result: 在词类比和语义相似度基准上，加入非线性投影的低秩方法在固定维度下产生更忠实的压缩嵌入，有效缓解线性瓶颈带来的性能损失。
AI.conclusion: 用可学习非线性投影增强低秩分解是超越纯线性嵌入压缩的有前景方向，并展示了KAN在核心表示层（而非仅任务特定层）的可行应用。

title: ER-Chord: Spatially Consistent One-Step Image Editing via Equal-Energy Reliability Redistribution
summary: One-step generative models enable fast text-guided image editing, yet they often introduce unintended changes to regions that should remain unchanged. Temporal aggregation stabilizes editing fields across noise levels, but leaves their spatial allocation insensitive to local variations in reliability. Consequently, temporal stability alone does not ensure spatially consistent editing. To address this lim- itation, we propose ER-Chord, a training-free and inversion-free framework for reliability-guided spatial redistribution. Our key insight is that agreement between editing fields at neighboring noise levels provides a local reliability signal for allocating editing strength. We formulate this allocation as an equal-energy op- timization that redistributes control energy according to local reliability while preserving the original editing directions and total control energy. This formu- lation admits a unique global solution that can be efficiently computed using existing field evaluations, requiring no additional denoiser calls. Experiments on two benchmarks, PIE-Bench and TEdBench, demonstrate improvements over state-of-the-art one-step editing baselines, achieving superior source preservation alongside consistent gains across multiple generative backbones.The project page is at https://github.com/Peizeli1/ER-Chord.

AI.tldr: ER-Chord：免训练、免反演的一步生成图像编辑框架，利用相邻噪声级编辑场的一致性作为局部可靠性信号，通过等能量优化在保持编辑方向与总能量的前提下重分配编辑强度，提升源图像保真度。
AI.motivation: 一步生成式文本引导图像编辑速度快，但常对不该改变的区域引入非预期改动。时间聚合虽能跨噪声级稳定编辑场，却使空间分配对局部可靠性差异不敏感，因此仅靠时间稳定性不足以保证空间一致性编辑。
AI.method: 提出ER-Chord，免训练且免反演。核心洞察：相邻噪声级编辑场之间的一致性可提供局部可靠性信号，用以分配编辑强度。将分配建模为等能量优化问题，在局部可靠性指导下重分配控制能量，同时保持原编辑方向与总控制能量；该问题具有唯一全局解，可利用已有场评估高效计算，无需额外去噪器调用。
AI.result: 在PIE-Bench与TEdBench两个基准上优于当前最先进的一步编辑基线，实现更优的源图像保持效果，并在多个生成骨干网络上取得一致提升。
AI.conclusion: 仅依赖时间稳定性不足以保证空间一致编辑，引入基于噪声级间一致性的可靠性引导空间重分配是有效且高效（免训练、免反演、无额外去噪调用）的方案。

title: ART-MPG: Autoregressive R/T Manifold Path Guiding
summary: Specular chains concentrate important transport in small regions of path space and the structure depends on chain topology. We introduce ART-MPG, a compact neural model that samples chain length, an autoregressive reflection/transmission (R/T) string, and a direction from a topology-conditioned four-component von Mises-Fisher (vMF) mixture. We extend the repeated trial weighting in Manifold Path Guiding (MPG) by conditioning retry sampling on both chain length and the sampled R/T string, accounting for its known mass outside the stochastic re-hit trials. For a fixed proposal and target chain, this preserves the ideal expectation while reducing the expected retry count and reciprocal-estimator variance compared with retries conditioned on chain length alone. We distinguish the formal unbiasedness result from the capped and clamped renderer used in experiments. We evaluate fourteen scenes across a range of samples per pixel (SPP) against existing online and offline rendering algorithms. Our method consistently produces lower mean squared error at equal SPP than the online and offline baselines, with lower standard deviation across runs.

AI.tldr: 提出 ART-MPG，一种紧凑神网络采样器：按链拓扑自回归生成链长、反射/透射 (R/T) 串与方向（四分量 vMF 混合），并扩展 MPG 的重试加权，使重试条件依赖链长与 R/T 串，降低期望重试次数与倒数估计量方差。
AI.motivation: 镜面链将重要的光传输集中在路径空间的局部小区域，且其结构取决于链的拓扑；现有路径引导方法未充分利用拓扑信息，采样效率与估计方差有待改进。
AI.method: ART-MPG：先用神经模型采样链长，再自回归生成反射/透射 (R/T) 字符串，最后由以拓扑为条件的四分量 von Mises-Fisher (vMF) 混合模型采样方向；同时把 Manifold Path Guiding (MPG) 的重复试验加权推广为以链长与 R/T 串为条件的重试采样，考虑随机重命中试验之外的质量；并区分理论无偏性与实验中带截断/钳制的渲染器。
AI.result: 在固定 proposal 与目标链下保持理想期望不变，同时比仅以链长为条件的重试有更低的期望重试次数与倒数估计量方差；在 14 个场景、多种 SPP 下，与在线及离线渲染算法相比，等 SPP 时 MSE 更低且多次运行标准差更小。
AI.conclusion: 拓扑条件的神经采样与改进的重试加权可有效提升镜面链引导的渲染效率与稳定性，实验验证了相对于现有在线/离线基线的持续优势。

title: TraceForge: Distilling with Your Own Thinking
summary:
Using an LLM to generate training data for another is among the most general ways to train one, and it remains common practice. Some frontier teams have closed that route for their own models: what comes back is an answer, or a short summary, without the detailed reasoning trace behind it. That is a little ironic: they were themselves built on distilling human knowledge, and distilling an open-source model is still entirely routine; the restriction applies to their own outputs alone. Recent work recovers the hidden reasoning by replaying encrypted blocks across models. It somehow works, but it breaks the providers' terms of service, so it is not something a product can be built on long-term.
  We built the alternative. We take the context and the teacher's answer as input, and generate the reasoning trace ourselves, in the style of the student's own model family. Training is two-stage, supervised and then adversarial: a generator learns to regenerate the family's own reasoning traces from their context and answer, and a critic learns how real a reasoning trace looks. Applied to a teacher's answer, the generator writes one in the family's style. An independent judge rates how likely traces are to be genuine on a scale from 0 to 1: ours average 0.68, real traces 0.66, and traces selected by the critic from four candidates 0.82. These are authenticity scores, not correctness rates.
  We test the idea on five benchmarks with everything else held fixed. On general tasks the five training corpora are about the same; on coding, the generated reasoning beats Fable 5's own thinking content. With the same 5,000 questions and the same teacher answers, HumanEval+ improves by 3.7 points and MBPP+ by 7.1 at the final checkpoint, and the MBPP+ lead holds at every checkpoint. We suspect that reasoning written in the student's family style is easier for it to learn from.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种在遵循服务条款前提下替代"重放加密推理块"的方法：以教师模型给出的上下文和答案为输入，由两阶段训练的生成器按学生模型家族风格自造推理轨迹，再经对抗训练中的评论器筛选，用其蒸馏学生模型，在编码基准上取得提升。
AI.motivation: 前沿模型厂商已关闭其模型输出的详细推理轨迹，仅返回答案或摘要；现有通过跨模型重放加密思维块来恢复隐藏推理的做法虽有效，但违反服务商条款，无法作为长期产品基础。
AI.method: 以上下文与教师答案为输入，自行生成"学生模型家族风格"的推理轨迹。训练分两阶段：先监督学习，再对抗训练——生成器学习从上下文与答案重建该家族自身的推理痕迹，评论器学习判别推理痕迹的真实度。推理风格与该家族一致后，再用于学生模型蒸馏；并可让评论器从四个候选中挑选最优轨迹。
AI.result: 独立评判器给出的真实性评分（0–1）为：生成轨迹平均0.68、真实轨迹0.66、评论器四选一轨迹0.82（为真实性而非正确率）。在五个基准、其他条件固定的设置下：通用任务上五份训练语料表现大致相当；编码任务上生成推理优于Fable 5自身思维内容。在相同5,000问题与相同教师答案下，最终检查点HumanEval+提升3.7分、MBPP+提升7.1分，且MBPP+的优势在每个检查点都保持。
AI.conclusion: 按学生家族风格书写的推理更易被其学习；该方法可在不违反服务条款的前提下生成高质量推理训练数据，在编码任务上带来稳定增益。

title: DynaWeave: Learning to Adapt through Dynamic Scenario Synthesis
summary: Large language model (LLM) agents increasingly use tools to complete tasks in stateful environments. However, many training environments remain largely static apart from changes caused by the agent's own actions, whereas external events introduced by other users, services, or sudden contingencies in real environments can invalidate ongoing plans. To address this gap, we introduce DynaWeave, an automated synthesis framework that transforms existing static tasks into verifiable dynamic scenarios. The framework generates exogenous events relevant to each task, covering changes in task requirements, environment state, and external information. It uses directed acyclic graphs (DAGs) to represent dependencies between events and an execution engine to activate them during agent interaction. A dynamic verifier revises only the evaluation checks affected by events that actually occur and retains all other checks. Using DynaWeave, we collect 2,095 verified interaction trajectories across 36 environments and use them for supervised fine-tuning of Qwen3.5 models. Experiments on Gaia2, CostBench, and ToolMaze show that DynaWeave achieves consistent improvements in overall performance across all three evaluated model sizes, increasing the task completion rate on CostBench by 67.34 percentage points and even exceeding the performance of Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview on ToolMaze. These results support dynamic scenario synthesis as a practical approach to training agents to adapt to changing environments. Our code is available at https://github.com/Miaow-Lab/DynaWeave.

AI.tldr: 提出 DynaWeave，自动将静态任务改造为可验证的动态场景以训练 LLM 智能体适应外部突发事件。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 智能体训练环境基本是静态的，只响应智能体自身动作；而真实环境中其他用户、服务或突发状况带来的外部事件会使既有计划失效，导致训练与实际部署存在差距。
AI.method: 自动合成框架：为每个任务生成相关的外生事件（任务需求变化、环境状态变化、外部信息变化）；用有向无环图（DAG）建模事件间依赖，并由执行引擎在智能体交互过程中激活事件；动态验证器只修正被实际发生事件影响的评估检查，保留其余检查。
AI.result: 在 36 个环境中收集 2,095 条经验证的交互轨迹用于 Qwen3.5 监督微调；在 Gaia2、CostBench、ToolMaze 上三种模型规模均有一致提升，CostBench 任务完成率提升 67.34 个百分点，ToolMaze 上甚至超过 Gemini-3.1-Pro-Preview。
AI.conclusion: 动态场景合成是训练智能体适应变化环境的可行且有效途径。

title: CRAB: Cuboid-based Representation for As-built BIM from Point Clouds
summary: As-built BIM reconstruction from point clouds demands semantic, volumetric, parametric, and editable building components, beyond 2D layouts or planar abstractions. Yet existing scan-to-BIM pipelines often rely on handcrafted rules, heuristic optimization, or manual correction, while learning-based methods fall short of recovering wall thickness, opening geometry, and component-level BIM structure. We introduce CRAB, a BIM-ready cuboid reconstruction framework that encodes walls, doors, windows, beams, and columns as compact architectural cuboids with IFC-compatible semantics and parameters. CRAB bridges point clouds and editable BIM by combining ProposalNet, which predicts coarse component cuboids, with AssemblyNet, a relation-aware Flow Matching model that refines geometry, predicts structural relationships, and enables automatic structural correction and human-guided editing. To address limited cuboid-level supervision, we extend Structured3D with component-wise cuboid annotations and construct cuboid-based procedural scenes. Experiments show CRAB surpasses floor plan and plane-based alternatives in component completeness, geometric accuracy, and generalization. For interior wall thickness estimation, CRAB achieves a mean error of 2.80 cm, with 79.50% of matched walls within 3 cm. The project page is available at https://vcc.tech/research/2026/CRAB.

AI.tldr: 提出CRAB框架，将墙、门、窗、梁、柱编码为带IFC兼容语义的架构长方体，结合ProposalNet与关系感知Flow Matching的AssemblyNet，从点云重建可编辑BIM，内墙厚度平均误差2.80 cm。
AI.motivation: 现有scan-to-BIM流程依赖手工规则、启发式优化或人工修正，学习类方法难以恢复墙厚、开口几何与构件级BIM结构，缺乏构件级长方体监督数据。
AI.method: CRAB用紧凑建筑长方体表示墙、门、窗、梁、柱并附IFC兼容语义与参数；ProposalNet预测粗粒度构件长方体，AssemblyNet以关系感知Flow Matching精化几何、预测结构关系并支持自动结构纠错与人工引导编辑；扩展Structured3D构件级长方体标注并构建长方体化程序场景。
AI.result: 在构件完整性、几何精度与泛化性上优于平面图与平面基方法；内墙厚度估计平均误差2.80 cm，79.50%匹配墙体误差在3 cm内。
AI.conclusion: CRAB打通了点云到可编辑BIM的桥梁，实现语义、体量、参数化且可编辑的构件级重建，并通过新数据集标注推动该方向研究。

title: Dynamics of Hidden Learning Structure
summary: A learner's present predictions do not fully determine how it will learn next. We study the dynamics of hidden learning structure through two related operations. Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT) describes protected repair of existing function and the learning responses left available after repair. Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT) describes the formation and renewal of trainable structure, distinguishing neutral installation, access to a learning signal, and additional functional directions. The two operations also constrain one another. A repair obligation can force a change in a learning channel, while acquired features can make new protected repairs feasible or reduce the minimum coefficient cost of existing ones. We characterize joint admissibility and response reachability, and give a finite supervised-learning construction in which the two operations together produce a favorable response absent from either operation alone. We implement protected head repair and fixed-capacity LoRA renewal in Qwen2.5-32B with AdamW, under replay and output distillation. Across two training trajectories differing in seed and within-task example order, the coordinated policy achieves higher teacher-forced Exact than either separate policy in all four comparisons. It also has the lowest macro NLL under both learning rules on the second trajectory. The implementations realize structure-conditioned self-regulation within specified information and action constraints: accessible state readouts and arrived evidence guide repairs and structural renewals, and ordinary learning continues from the modified state.

AI.tldr: 提出Fiber Regulation Theory (FRT)与Fiber Acquisition Theory (FAT)两种隐藏学习结构操作，刻画二者联合可行性与响应可达性，并在Qwen2.5-32B上以保护性head修复+定容LoRA更新验证协同策略优于单独策略。
AI.motivation: 学习者的当前预测无法完全决定其后续学习方式，需要研究隐藏学习结构的动态演化，并理解“修复既有功能”与“获取可训练结构”两类操作如何相互约束与协同。
AI.method: 用FRT描述受保护修复及修复后剩余的学习响应，用FAT描述可训练结构的形成与更新（区分中性安装、学习信号接入、额外功能方向）；分析二者的相互约束（修复义务强制学习通道变更，获得特征改变保护性修复的可行性/最小系数成本），刻画联合可采纳性与响应可达性，并给出有限监督学习构造。实验上用Qwen2.5-32B+AdamW，结合replay与输出蒸馏，实现protected head repair与fixed-capacity LoRA renewal。
AI.result: 两条训练轨迹（种子与任务内样本顺序不同）四次比较中，协同策略的teacher-forced Exact均高于任一单独策略；第二条轨迹上在两种学习规则下macro NLL最低。单靠任一操作都无法获得的有利响应，可由两操作协同实现。
AI.conclusion: 在给定信息与动作约束下，该实现实现了结构条件的自我调节：可见状态读数与已到达证据引导修复和结构更新，且普通学习从修改后的状态继续。

title: Real PMIDs, Wrong Papers: Harness Design for Biomedical Claim-Verification Agents
comment: Accepted to the Agentic AI for Biological Discovery (AgenticLS) Workshop at NeurIPS 2026
summary: Literature-searching language agents are becoming a standard component of scientific assistants for the life sciences, yet there is little controlled evidence on which parts of their harness matter. We run a controlled ablation on biomedical claim verification (SciFact) with the live PubMed API as the only tool. Holding the backbone and output format fixed, we compare four harnesses: closed-book answering, single-shot retrieval using the claim as the query, a ReAct-style agent that writes its own PubMed queries, and an oracle given the gold abstracts, each with two efficient frontier backbones. Naive single-shot retrieval finds the gold paper for only 6% of claims and turns overconfident errors into abstentions without improving accuracy. Letting the model formulate its own queries triples gold recall and yields the best verdicts (62% accuracy vs. 49-59% for the other realistic harnesses), although these differences are not significant at our sample size and agents use fewer than half of their search budget. With gold abstracts, the same models reach 79-86% accuracy, a significant 17-24 point gap showing that retrieval, not reasoning, is the main bottleneck. Finally, a citation audit shows that closed-book models cite PubMed IDs that almost always exist (327/335) but are almost never relevant: a cross-family LLM judge rates only 3 of 327 existing citations as relevant to the claim, versus 67% for citations produced by the search agent. Existence checks are therefore insufficient safeguards for scientific agents. We release code, prompts, and all cached tool calls at https://github.com/saqlain2204/real-pmids-wrong-papers.

AI.tldr: 在SciFact生物医学断言验证任务上，以PubMed实时API为唯一工具做受控消融：单次检索几乎无用，让模型自写检索式可将金标论文召回率提高三倍并取得最佳判定（62%），但与金标摘要的79-86%仍有显著差距，说明检索而非推理是主要瓶颈；闭源模型引用的PMID大多存在却几乎不相关，存在性检查不足以防伪。
AI.motivation: 文献检索型语言智能体已成为生命科学科研助手的标准组件，但缺乏关于"架构中哪些部分真正起作用"的受控证据。现有评测混杂了骨干模型、工具与提示差异，无法分离检索策略本身的贡献。
AI.method: 在SciFact断言验证任务上固定骨干模型与输出格式，对比四种harness：(1)闭卷直接作答；(2)以断言为查询的单次检索；(3)ReAct式自写PubMed查询的智能体；(4)给出金标摘要的oracle。每种配两个高效前沿骨干模型，统计金标论文召回、准确率、搜索预算使用情况，并做引用审计（用跨家族LLM评审判断PMID与断言的相关性）。
AI.result: 单次检索仅对6%的断言找到金标论文，且只是把过度自信的错误变成弃答，准确率无提升；模型自写查询使金标召回率提高三倍，判定准确率最佳（62%，其他现实harness为49-59%），但样本量下差异不显著，且智能体只用掉不到一半搜索预算。给定金标摘要时准确率达79-86%，显著高出17-24个百分点。引用审计：闭卷模型给出的PMID有327/335真实存在，但LLM评审仅判定3/327相关，而检索智能体产出引用的相关率为67%。
AI.conclusion: 检索而非推理是当前文献检索智能体的主要瓶颈；简单的单次检索有害无益；智能体自行构造查询价值最大但尚未充分利用搜索预算。仅校验引用标识是否存在不足以保障科学智能体的可靠性，需评估引用的相关性。代码、提示与全部缓存工具调用已开源。

title: Omnilingual-MsASR: Benchmarking Multimodal, Multilingual, Long-Form Multi-Speaker ASR of Omni Large Language Models
summary: Omni-modal large language models (LLMs) have achieved remarkable progress in audio and video understanding. However, existing models struggle with long-form, multi-speaker videos, especially in understanding the entire video and recognizing who says what and when. To characterize the capability limit of current omni LLMs and guide future model development, we introduce Omnilingual-MsASR, a multilingual, multimodal benchmark for long-form Multi-speaker Automatic Speech Recognition (MsASR) covering six languages, recordings up to 30 minutes, and scenarios with up to 20 speakers. Omnilingual-MsASR provides parallel audio and video inputs to evaluate models' cross-modal consistency and their ability to exploit complementary cues across modalities. Extensive evaluations of leading omni-modal LLMs reveal substantial performance bottlenecks, while their tcpWERs frequently exceed 100%. These findings highlight fine-grained temporal localization, speaker disambiguation, and cross-modal synergy as key challenges for future omni-modal foundation models. Our work is available at https://github.com/QwenLM/Omnilingua-Bench/tree/main/Omnilingua-MSpeaker.

AI.tldr: 提出Omnilingual-MsASR，一个覆盖六种语言、录音长达30分钟、最多20位说话人的多语言多模态长视频多说话人ASR基准，用于评测全模态LLM的"谁在何时说了什么"能力。
AI.motivation: 现有全模态大模型在音视频理解上进步显著，但在长时长、多说话人视频上表现不佳，难以同时完成整体理解与说话人—时间—内容的细粒度对齐；缺乏可刻画其能力上限并指导后续模型发展的评测基准。
AI.method: 构建Omnilingual-MsASR基准：六种语言，录音时长至30分钟，场景最多20位说话人；同时提供平行的音频与视频输入，以评测跨模态一致性与多模态互补线索的利用能力；并对主流全模态LLM进行大规模评测，采用tcpWER等指标。
AI.result: 对领先全模态LLM的广泛评测显示存在显著性能瓶颈，tcpWER常超过100%，表明模型在长时多说话人场景下识别与说话人归属均严重不足。
AI.conclusion: 细粒度时间定位、说话人消歧与跨模态协同是未来全模态基础模型的关键挑战；该基准（已开源）为相关研究提供了评测与改进方向。

title: Clinical radar heart sounds with echocardiographic phenotypes of ventricular dysfunction and valvular disease
summary: Radar heart sounds capture cardiac mechanical activity without contact, while echocardiography characterizes ventricular and valvular function. Paired measurements connect these signals to structural heart disease, yet such data remain sparsely represented in public resources. Here we present 537 radar heart-sound recordings paired with one echocardiographic report for each of 162 patients. The cohort covers three overlapping phenotypes: left ventricular ejection fraction (LVEF) below 50%, regional wall-motion abnormality and at least moderate valvular regurgitation, present in 38, 43 and 39 patients, respectively. Original complex signals, processed radar heart sounds and temporal quality segmentation support signal-to-phenotype analysis. Technical validation retains 95.93% of signal duration and confirms reproducible waveform reconstruction. Patient-level five-fold evaluation achieves a mean outer-test AUROC of $0.770\pm0.138$ for reduced LVEF, identifying mechanical information associated with ventricular systolic dysfunction. This resource supports research linking non-contact cardiac mechanical signals to echocardiographic structural and functional phenotypes.

AI.tldr: 该文发布了一个配对数据集：162名患者的537条雷达心音记录，每条记录配套一份超声心动图报告，覆盖LVEF降低、室壁运动异常和瓣膜反流三种表型，并提供信号到表型的分析基线（平均AUROC 0.770）。
AI.motivation: 雷达心音可非接触地捕获心脏机械活动，超声心动图可刻画心室与瓣膜功能，二者配对有望建立非接触信号与结构性心脏病之间的联系；但此类配对数据在公开资源中极为稀缺。
AI.method: 构建配对数据集：537条雷达心音记录对应162名患者各一份超声报告，涵盖三种重叠表型（LVEF<50%：38人；节段性室壁运动异常：43人；中度及以上瓣膜反流：39人）。提供原始复信号、处理后雷达心音及时间质量分段；进行技术验证（时长保留率、波形重建可重复性），并开展患者级五折交叉评估。
AI.result: 技术验证保留95.93%的信号时长，波形重建可重复；患者级五折评估中，LVEF降低检测的平均外部测试AUROC为0.770±0.138，表明信号中存在与心室收缩功能障碍相关的机械信息。
AI.conclusion: 该资源为研究非接触心脏机械信号与超声心动图结构/功能表型之间的关联提供了公开数据基础与初步可行性证据。

title: Distilling Multi-Teacher Scoring Principles for Unsupervised Time Series Anomaly Detection
summary: Time series anomalies take diverse forms, and individual detectors encode different anomaly scoring principles that rarely cover all anomaly types. Recent unsupervised time-series anomaly detectors provide complementary scoring signals, yet deploying them as an ensemble preserves the inference and maintenance cost of every individual detector. We study whether heterogeneous teacher detectors can be distilled into a single lightweight detector in the unsupervised setting, where no anomaly labels are available to define a shared target. AnoMix addresses this by extracting weak pairwise supervision from the training-set anomaly scores of frozen teachers. It normalizes each teacher score sequence independently and trains the student with CoRank, a multi-teacher ranking-distillation objective that converts teacher score gaps into pairwise supervision through teacher consensus. Across seven benchmark datasets, AnoMix successfully integrates complementary teacher scoring principles into a single deployable model, improving over individual detectors and static score ensembles while using a compact student with under 80k parameters on the benchmark settings. A zero-shot variant further shows that the distilled ranking signal transfers to unseen datasets and can outperform large pretrained time-series foundation models for anomaly detection.

AI.tldr: AnoMix 在无监督设定下将多个异构教师检测器的异常打分蒸馏进一个轻量学生检测器，通过从教师打分的成对排序中提取弱监督（CoRank）实现互补整合。
AI.motivation: 时序异常形式多样，单一检测器打分原则难以覆盖所有异常类型；把多个检测器做集成虽能互补，但要付出每个检测器的推理与维护成本。因此希望在无异常标签、无共享目标的无监督场景下，把异构教师蒸馏成单一轻量检测器。
AI.method: 从冻结教师在训练集上的异常打分中提取弱成对监督：先对每个教师的打分序列独立归一化，再用 CoRank 多教师排序蒸馏目标，借助教师间共识把教师打分的差距转成成对监督来训练学生。
AI.result: 在七个基准数据集上，AnoMix 成功把互补的教师打分原则整合进单个可部署模型，效果优于各单检测器和静态分数集成，且学生模型在基准设定下参数量不足 80k。零样本变体表明蒸馏出的排序信号可迁移到未见数据集，并可超过大型预训练时序基础模型的异常检测表现。
AI.conclusion: 异构教师检测器可被有效蒸馏为单个紧凑的无监督检测器，排序蒸馏提供了可迁移的异常信号，为低成本多检测器知识整合提供了可行路径。

title: COMET: A coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework for human-supervised AI-enabled safety systems
comment: for associated GitHub repository, see https://github.com/nicmig/COMET
summary: Incorporating AI systems into safety systems requires monitoring to avoid silent faults and ensure safe and reliable operation. Single monitors often do not provide actionable information for human supervisors, who act as the system's adaptive controller. We present COMET, a coordinated multi-layer runtime monitoring framework for human-supervised AI-enabled safety systems in which each monitor is anchored in a different fault mode. Monitor outputs are combined in a coordination layer and mapped by a communication layer to a traffic-light display. In this work, COMET consists of three monitoring layers: signal integrity, physics consistency, and the AI system's competence envelope. The framework is evaluated on an open dataset of compressed-air leaks, where an AI system detects leaks from acoustic emissions, with held-out conditions simulating covariate shift, semantic shift, and sensor faults, events expected during runtime but unknown in their exact appearance. All monitors are frozen after development and tested zero-shot, and the framework is compared against no-monitoring and single-monitor setups. The bare AI system fails silently and confidently under all three shift types, whereas COMET reduces the trusted-wrong-answer rate to zero on covariate-shifted no-leak data and on three of four sensor faults, at a nominal false-alarm rate of $\approx 1\%$. Single monitors come close in detection but cannot attribute the fault mode. COMET converts their anonymous detection flags into diagnoses. Residual silent misses under semantic shift define the boundary of passive monitoring. Runtime monitoring frameworks for AI-enabled safety systems must therefore combine quantitative fault detection and isolation with qualitative, human-oriented feedback.

AI.tldr: COMET是一个协调式多层运行时监控框架，通过信号完整性、物理一致性和AI能力包络三层监控，将故障检测映射为交通灯式人机反馈，把单监控的"匿名告警"转化为可操作的故障诊断。
AI.motivation: 将AI系统纳入安全系统时需要监控以避免静默故障，但单一监控器难以给作为自适应控制器的人类监督者提供可操作信息，且裸AI在协变量偏移、语义偏移和传感器故障下会自信地给出错误结果。
AI.method: 构建COMET三层监控框架（信号完整性、物理一致性、AI能力包络），各监控锚定不同故障模式；输出经协调层合并，再由通信层映射为交通灯显示。在压缩空气泄漏开放数据集上评估，模拟协变量偏移、语义偏移和传感器故障，所有监控器开发后冻结并零样本测试，与无监控和单监控方案对比。
AI.result: 裸AI在三种偏移下均静默且自信失败；COMET在协变量偏移的无泄漏数据及四类传感器故障中的三类上将"可信错误答案率"降至零，误报率约1%；单监控检测效果接近但无法归因故障模式，COMET将其匿名检测标志转化为诊断。
AI.conclusion: 语义偏移下残留的静默漏检界定了被动监控的边界；面向AI安全系统的运行时监控框架必须将定量故障检测与隔离同面向人的定性反馈相结合。

title: OmniSimulator: Aligning Small Language Models for Authentic Heterogeneous Behavior Modeling
summary: Large language models (LLMs) have shown great potential as general-purpose user simulators for interactive systems. Prior studies have demonstrated that training on high-quality data can substantially improve model reasoning and downstream task performance. However, the upper bound of user simulation is still constrained by the model's reasoning paradigm: native chain-of-thought often degenerates into shallow pattern matching and fails to adequately model the behavioral factors underlying real user decisions. In this paper, we propose OmniSimulator, a novel training framework designed to improve the predictive ability of small LLMs for realistic user simulation on short-video platform environments. Specifically, OmniSimulator organizes behavior-oriented reasoning through a structured schema with five dimensions, carefully selects data from real user-behavior scenarios, and introduces a teacher model to generate high-quality reasoning traces under the proposed schema, helping small models learn behavior-relevant reasoning patterns rather than relying on superficial behavioral correlations. Based on this process, we construct 9,881 high-quality training instances from three months of historical interaction trajectories of 200 real users, averaging about 50 distilled examples per user. Experimental results show that OmniSimulator improves the average score of Qwen3-8B by 34.33%, achieves performance competitive with Claude-Sonnet-4.5, and supports smaller-scale, self-hosted deployment. These results suggest that learning structured behavior-oriented reasoning patterns is a promising direction towards scalable and high-fidelity LLM-based user simulation.

AI.tldr: 提出 OmniSimulator 训练框架，通过五维结构化行为推理 schema 与教师模型蒸馏高质量推理轨迹，提升小模型在短视频平台用户模拟上的预测能力。
AI.motivation: 现有 LLM 用户模拟受限于推理范式：原生思维链易退化为浅层模式匹配，无法充分建模真实用户决策背后的行为因素，故需行为导向的结构化推理。
AI.method: 设计含五个维度的结构化推理 schema 组织行为推理；从真实用户行为场景中筛选数据；引入教师模型按该 schema 生成高质量推理轨迹进行蒸馏训练。
AI.result: 基于 200 名真实用户三个月历史交互轨迹构建 9,881 条训练样本（人均约 50 条）；Qwen3-8B 平均分提升 34.33%，性能与 Claude-Sonnet-4.5 相当，且支持更小规模的自托管部署。
AI.conclusion: 学习结构化、行为导向的推理模式是实现可扩展、高保真 LLM 用户模拟的有前景方向。

title: Certified Abstention for Provably-Unidentifiable Index-Phase Recovery in Image Registration
comment: 13 pages, 5 figures; supplementary material in ancillary files. Code and data: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.21502909
summary: Image registration underpins measurement across scanning, camera, and microscopy imaging, yet a fundamental question is rarely posed: when is the sample-to-position map recoverable at all, and when does any estimator that reports a position necessarily fabricate one? We show that in reference-perturbed sampled imaging, where samples are localized through a perturbed reference, position fidelity (where samples land) and phase fidelity (which reference index becomes each block's origin) are logically independent: no policy acting on position information alone can guarantee phase fidelity. We derive a tight resolution threshold separating recoverable from provably-unidentifiable registration, and a recovery framework that certifies identifiable regions--recovering them exactly--while abstaining on provably-unidentifiable regions rather than hallucinating structure. On a deployed scanning system we measure a direction-bimodal registration offset consistent with the theory. Against classical and learned restoration baselines, certificate-free offset estimators fabricate structure on the unidentifiable regime, whereas the certified method abstains rather than fabricating. Finally, the certified-abstention mechanism carries across scanning, rolling-shutter, and cryo-electron-microscopy imaging--declining rather than fabricating on the regime it flags--though how completely it abstains and how tightly it bounds kept-region risk stay modality-specific (at extreme SNR the cryo-EM certificate abstains only partially): a structural-versus-statistical boundary in registration reliability.

AI.tldr: 论文指出在参考受扰的采样成像中，位置保真度与相位保真度逻辑独立，仅靠位置信息的估计器无法保证相位正确；由此推导出可恢复与不可辨识之间的紧致分辨率阈值，并提出可证明的恢复框架与"认证弃权"机制。
AI.motivation: 图像配准支撑扫描、相机与显微成像中的测量，但一个根本问题很少被追问：样本到位置的映射何时可恢复？任何报告位置的估计器何时必然是在"编造"位置而非真实恢复？作者希望在理论上划清可辨识与不可辨识的边界。
AI.method: 在参考受扰的采样成像模型下，证明"位置保真度"（样本落在何处）与"相位保真度"（哪个参考索引成为每块的起点）在逻辑上独立，因此仅使用位置信息的策略无法保证相位保真。据此推导紧致分辨率阈值，区分可恢复与可证明不可辨识的配准；并构建带证书的恢复框架：对可辨识区域精确恢复，对可证明不可辨识区域主动弃权而不编造结构。
AI.result: 在实际部署的扫描系统上测得与理论一致的方向双峰配准偏移。与经典及学习型复原基线相比，无证书的偏移估计器在不可辨识区间编造结构，而认证方法选择弃权。该弃权机制可迁移至扫描、卷帘快门与冷冻电镜（cryo-EM）成像，在所标记区间内选择拒绝而非编造；但弃权程度与保留区域风险界紧致度依赖模态（极端信噪比下cryo-EM证书仅部分弃权）。
AI.conclusion: 配准可靠性存在"结构性 vs 统计性"的边界：可辨识性是结构性质，而弃权完整性与风险界紧致度是统计/模态特定性质。认证弃权为可靠图像配准提供了原则性保障，但极端条件下仍需模态适配。

title: The Price of Choice in Selective Prediction
summary: A selective classifier may be claimed to satisfy a risk-coverage contract if some rule from a predeclared menu (a threshold or a union of $K$ score intervals) attains coverage at least $κ$ and error at most $α$. Refuting this existential claim requires ruling out every permitted rule. The intersection-union test (IUT) achieves validity without a multiplicity correction, but its sample cost can increase with menu richness. We characterize this cost and compare it with the optimal audit. For a fixed interior risk target $α$ and gap $γ$, the minimax sample size for K-interval menus at coverage floor $κ$ is $K(1-κ)/(κγ^2)$, up to logarithmic factors, in the stated small-gap, large-menu regime; exact IUT attains this rate. The lower bound holds even with a known score distribution, while the upper bound extends to menus of VC dimension $d$. Procedures that refuse to reject whenever any rule appears feasible on the audit sample can pay a linear $K$ cost even when a square-root rate is possible. Reference-free testing reaches a smaller scale under constant-risk alternatives, whereas unknown heterogeneous risks can make the linear cost unavoidable. In simulations with $K=4$, the raw menu cost varies 7.7-fold between $κ=.5$ and $κ=.95$; after theorem-motivated normalization the endpoint values differ by approximately 5%. Held-out experiments with three VLM judges show positive exact-hiding windows in all 60 split-specific confidence-gate families, with 28/30 contracts chosen on audit-A remaining hidden on untouched audit-B. On a cleaner multi-annotator target, hiding is weaker and transfers in 3/10 resplits. Frozen image and multimodal classifiers show boundary behavior consistent with the IUT guarantee and strong power relative to practical certificates.

AI.tldr: 论文研究选择性分类器的"风控-覆盖率契约"审计问题：反驳"菜单中某个规则同时满足覆盖率≥κ且错误率≤α"这一存在性主张需要排除所有允许规则。作者刻画了IUT（交集-并检验）的样本代价随菜单复杂度增长的规律，并与最优审计比较。
AI.motivation: 选择性分类器宣称某预声明规则菜单（阈值或K个分数区间并集）中存在满足风险-覆盖率契约的规则。反驳这种存在性主张需排除所有规则，而IUT虽无需多重校正即有效，其样本代价是否会随菜单规模急剧膨胀尚不清楚，需理论刻画并给出最优审计下界。
AI.method: 在固定的内部风险目标α与间隔γ下，给出大菜单、小间隔区间内K区间菜单的minimax样本量刻画，并证明精确IUT达到该速率；同时证明下界即使已知分数分布也成立，上界可推广至VC维d的菜单。进一步区分"任何规则看起来可行即不拒绝"的程序与无参考检验。
AI.result: K区间菜单在覆盖率下限κ处的minimax样本量为K(1-κ)/(κγ²)（忽略对数因子），精确IUT达到该速率；下界在已知分数分布下仍成立，上界扩展到VC维d菜单。模拟中K=4时原始菜单代价在κ=.5到.95间变化7.7倍，定理驱动的归一化后端点仅差约5%。三名VLM评委的留出实验中，60个置信门家族均有正的精确隐藏窗口，28/30在audit-A上选中的契约在audit-B上仍隐藏。
AI.conclusion: 精确IUT在K区间菜单上达到minimax最优速率，但其线性K代价在小间隔、大菜单区域确实存在；无参考检验在恒定风险替代下可达到更小的规模，而未知异构风险会使线性代价不可避免。实践证书显示出与IUT保证一致的边界行为和较强功效。

title: UserSWE: Evaluating Coding Agents in Multi-Turn Conversations with Dynamic Users
summary: As coding agents become more capable, developers increasingly use them to fix bugs through multi-turn interactions. Existing benchmarks do not adequately cover this scenario. Most present a complete issue report in a single turn without interaction. Their evaluation can produce both false positives and false negatives, accepting incorrect patches or rejecting correct ones. We introduce UserSWE for evaluating coding agents' ability to fix repository-level bugs through multi-turn interactions with dynamic users and execution-grounded verdicts at every turn. Its construction pipeline turns repository history and existing single-turn benchmarks into multi-turn tasks. At each turn, information pools constrain what the simulated user can reveal, while a persona chain sampled from a transition model calibrated on 20,859 development sessions governs how it speaks. Tests run after every turn, and a pair of agents from different model families writes and gates each verdict, using test results as primary evidence and model judgment only for aspects the tests cannot resolve. We evaluate eleven agents on 72 tasks from 42 repositories and find that agent rankings change with the interaction budget. Claude Fable 5.1 resolves the most tasks in one turn, GPT-6-Astra resolves the most by the eighth turn, and Claude Opus 5 leads at most intermediate budgets. These results indicate that single-turn performance is insufficient to characterize interactive coding ability.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 UserSWE，一个基于多轮交互与动态模拟用户的仓库级缺陷修复评测基准，每轮执行测试并用双模型代理给出有依据的判定。
AI.motivation: 开发者越来越多用编码代理通过多轮交互修 bug，但现有基准大多一次性给出完整 issue 报告、无交互，评测既有误判（接受错误补丁）也有漏判（拒绝正确补丁）。
AI.method: 构建流程把仓库历史与现有单轮基准转化为多轮任务；每轮用信息池限制模拟用户可透露的信息，并以在 20,859 条真实开发会话上校准的转移模型采样人格链来控制说话方式；每轮结束运行测试，由来自不同模型家族的成对代理撰写并把关每个判定，测试结果为主证据，模型判断仅处理测试无法解决的部分。
AI.result: 在 42 个仓库的 72 个任务上评测 11 个代理，发现排名随交互预算变化：Claude Fable 5.1 单轮解决最多，GPT-6-Astra 在第 8 轮最多，Claude Opus 5 在多数中间预算下领先。
AI.conclusion: 单轮性能不足以刻画交互式编码能力，需以多轮、动态用户与执行验证的评测来评估编码代理。

title: TenetBench: A Clause-Anchored Russian Corpus for Evaluating Language Models against Professional Codes of Ethics
comment: Preprint under review. 39 pages, 2 figures, 5 tables; Online Resource 1 appended (9 pages). Dataset and code: https://doi.org/10.5281/zenodo.22678484
summary: Codes of professional ethics guide and restrict specialists, who increasingly work with assistants built on large language models. Such an assistant can breach the user's code, or help the user breach it, without the user noticing. Evaluations reporting broad categories of harm cannot show how often this happens or which provision is breached. TenetBench pairs 3,433 requests conflicting with clauses of fifteen Russian-language professional codes with benign twins that differ only in the legitimacy of what is asked. An automated pipeline generates the tasks from the text of a code, so the corpus grows with every code added and a provision yields new tasks on every run. It also produced tasks and human-validated verdicts from two English codes of other jurisdictions. In human validation of the frozen pipeline, specialists rated 0.995 of the conflicting tasks plausible, and the model judge agreed with the adjudicated label at Gwet's AC1 of at least 0.894 on 1,860 elements. We evaluated fourteen model and reasoning-mode combinations on whether they produce the conflicting text, decline or warn. Eleven of the fourteen produce conflicting content on most such requests, mostly without a warning, and nearly three warnings in four accompany conflicting content. The models that conform more do so by declining while still serving the legitimate twin, and enabling reasoning halved the refusals of two models. We hope the dataset and pipeline will help evaluate how language models observe professional norms and let diagnostic datasets be built for particular professions and organisations.

AI.tldr: TenetBench将3,433条与15部俄语职业道德准则条款冲突的请求与仅合法性不同的良性孪生请求配对，用自动化流水线从准则文本生成任务，并评估14种模型/推理模式组合对职业规范的遵循情况。
AI.motivation: 专业人士日益依赖大语言模型助手，助手可能在用户不知情时违反或帮助用户违反职业道德准则；而现有按危害大类报告的评测无法说明此类违规发生的频率或具体违反哪一条款。
AI.method: 构建TenetBench：将冲突请求与仅请求合法性不同的良性孪生配对（3,433条冲突请求，覆盖15部俄语职业准则）；自动化流水线从准则文本生成任务，可在新增准则时扩充语料、每次运行针对同一或多条款生成新任务，并用两部其他司法辖区的英文准则生成任务及人工验证标签；人工验证中专家对0.995冲突任务的合理性评分，模型裁判与裁决标签的一致性Gwet's AC1≥0.894（1,860个元素）；评估14种模型与推理模式组合是否生成冲突内容、拒绝或警告。
AI.result: 14种组合中11种在多数此类请求上生成冲突内容，且大多无警告；近四分之三的警告与冲突内容同时出现；更守规的模型通过拒绝实现，同时仍能服务良性孪生请求；启用推理使两个模型的拒绝率减半。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集与流水线可用于评测语言模型对职业规范的遵循程度，并支持为特定职业和组织构建诊断数据集。

title: Computer Vision and Knowledge-Grounded Language Models for Intelligent Beekeeper Assistance
summary: Managed and wild bees sustain roughly a third of the global food products, yet colonies face mounting stress from climate-change including extreme weather patterns, altered parasite and disease patterns. Timely assessment of colony condition such as understanding colony strength, brood area, honey and pollen storage, comb usage, is essential to adaptive management. However, manual hive frame inspection is slow, costly, and quality depends on scarce expertise. We present an artificial targeted intelligent system framework focusing on edge deployable pipeline that turns hive frame photographs into interpretable and action-oriented inspection report. The pipeline includes an object detector to detect biologically-meaningful comb-cell classes; detections are distilled into structured fact schema; facts are converted into constrained factual text; the text triggers a grounded knowledge-base for interpretations and recommendations. Knowledge-base entries are required to be triggerable by evidence expressed in the fact schema. We built our system based on open source FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset and favour reproducible, edge-deployable models over large general purpose frontier models. We additionally release FAIRHiveText-1K dataset that turns FAIRHiveFrames-1K dataset into interchangeable facts and text interpretation of the facts, making it easy for further LLM-based research into this area. We also propose a pathway to develop the grounded knowledge-base that will be helpful in providing interpretable and actionable reports from the facts.

AI.tldr: 提出面向蜂箱巢框图像的边缘可部署智能检测框架：目标检测识别巢脾单元→结构化事实模式→受限事实文本→触发知识库给出可解释、可行动的巡检报告；并发布FAIRHiveText-1K数据集。
AI.motivation: 蜜蜂维系全球约三分之一食物供给，却受极端天气、寄生虫与疾病模式变化等气候压力；及时评估蜂群强度、子脾面积、蜜粉储存与巢脾利用情况对适应性管理至关重要，但人工查脾慢、成本高且依赖稀缺专家经验。
AI.method: 构建端到端流水线：目标检测器识别具有生物学意义的巢脾单元类别；检测结果蒸馏为结构化事实模式（fact schema）；事实转为受限的事实性文本；文本触发基于证据的grounded知识库生成解释与建议，且知识库条目须可由事实模式中的证据触发。系统基于开源FAIRHiveFrames-1K数据集搭建，优先采用可复现、边缘可部署的模型而非大型通用前沿模型；另发布FAIRHiveText-1K，将图像数据转为可互换的事实-文本解释对。
AI.result: 基于FAIRHiveFrames-1K建立了系统；发布FAIRHiveText-1K数据集（事实与文本解释可互换），便于后续基于LLM的研究；并提出构建grounded知识库的路径，以支撑基于事实生成可解释、可行动的报告。
AI.conclusion: 该工作以轻量边缘模型加知识库触发的方式，替代昂贵人工查脾，实现可解释、可操作的蜂群状态巡检，并通过新数据集与知识库建设路径推动该方向研究。

title: Value-Rectified Distillation for Flow-based Offline Reinforcement Learning
summary: We aim to address the problem of Out-of-Distribution (OOD) Mode Averaging, a critical problem that emerges when distilling Flow Matching (FM) based behavior policies in offline Reinforcement Learning (RL): When learning over multi-modal datasets, standard distillation inadvertently forces the policy to interpolate across different behavioral modes, causing the generated actions to collapse into invalid, OOD regions. To resolve this, we propose Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD), a novel framework that reformulates offline policy distillation as a value-guided generative trajectory alignment problem. By employing a dynamic coupling mechanism, VRD actively rectifies flow dynamics to explicitly decouple distinct behavioral modes, cleanly isolating high-value actions. Specifically, we instantiate VRD through two complementary algorithms: VRD-Q, which utilizes value-quantile behavior distillation to statistically filter out low-value behaviors, and VRD-R, which reorganizes the latent space to geometrically isolate high-value generative trajectories from the FM-based behavior policy. Extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate that VRD improves existing generative baselines across diverse continuous control and planning tasks on the D4RL, OGBench, and Minari benchmarks, especially over those multi-modal, non-expert datasets.

AI.tldr: 本文提出Value-Rectified Distillation (VRD)框架，将离线RL中基于Flow Matching的行为策略蒸馏重构为价值引导的生成轨迹对齐问题，通过动态耦合机制解耦多模态行为，避免OOD模式平均，并提出VRD-Q与VRD-R两种算法。
AI.motivation: 在多模态离线数据集上蒸馏FM行为策略时，标准蒸馏会迫使策略在不同行为模式间插值，导致生成动作坍缩到无效的OOD区域，即Out-of-Distribution Mode Averaging问题。
AI.method: 把离线策略蒸馏建模为价值引导的生成轨迹对齐问题，采用动态耦合机制修正流动力学以显式解耦行为模式、隔离高价值动作。实例化为两种算法：VRD-Q用价值分位数行为蒸馏统计过滤低价值行为；VRD-R重组潜空间，几何上隔离高价值生成轨迹。
AI.result: 在D4RL、OGBench和Minari基准的多种连续控制与规划任务上，VRD优于现有生成式基线，尤其在多模态、非专家数据集上提升明显。
AI.conclusion: 价值引导的轨迹对齐是解决FM策略蒸馏中OOD模式平均的有效途径，VRD在多个基准上验证了其有效性。

title: ToM2Vec: Continuous Theory-of-Mind Tokens for Multi-Agent Coordination
summary: Forming an accurate theory-of-mind (ToM) is key to successful multi-agent collaboration and requires reasoning under uncertainty to capture multiple possible partner states. This is hard to do in the text representation space native to large language model (LLM) agents, which more easily describe a single partner state. To address this challenge, we introduce ToM2Vec, which learns to form abstract theories-of-mind in a rich latent space via a fixed budget of continuous reasoning tokens. During training, supervision for these tokens comes from the partner's actual thoughts, which the ToM tokens are trained to abstract and match. At test-time, ToM tokens are generated by each agent and act as conditioners for that agent's thoughts and actions. Across several environments covering collaborative, competitive, and mixed-motive settings (Overcooked-AI, multiparty negotiation, Decrypto, Hanabi, and Collab Escape/Capture), we evaluate ToM2Vec's ability to support multi-agent interactions and collaboration, finding consistent improvements over the base model and a variety of competitive trained and prompted baselines. We show that latent reasoning is critical, with performance dropping when reasoning is expressed in text. Moreover, we show that ToM2Vec training generalizes to partner model families not seen at train-time, including a proprietary model (GPT-5.4). In our analysis, we provide evidence that the latent tokens encode a ToM, rather than task-specific information: ToM2Vec's tokens improve the agent's ability to directly answer questions about partner beliefs, desires, and next actions.

AI.tldr: 论文提出ToM2Vec，用固定预算的连续潜在推理token学习抽象的"心智理论"（ToM）表征，在多个多智能体环境中一致优于基线与各类竞争方法。
AI.motivation: LLM智能体在文本表征空间中难以在不确定性下建模伙伴的多种可能状态，往往只能描述单一伙伴状态，从而限制了准确ToM的形成，而这对多智能体协作至关重要。
AI.method: 通过固定数量的连续推理token在潜空间中学习抽象ToM；训练时以伙伴真实想法作为监督信号，使ToM token抽象并匹配这些想法；测试时由各智能体生成ToM token，作为其自身思考与动作的条件。
AI.result: 在Overcooked-AI、多方谈判、Decrypto、Hanabi、Collab Escape/Capture等协作、竞争与混合动机环境中，性能一致优于基础模型及多种训练/提示基线；文本形式推理会显著掉点；训练可泛化到未见伙伴模型族（含专有模型GPT-5.4）。
AI.conclusion: 潜空间推理对ToM至关重要；分析表明ToM token确实编码了心智理论而非任务特定信息——能提升智能体直接回答伙伴信念、欲望与下一步动作问题的能力。

title: A Strong MoE Is All You Need for Process Supervision
summary: Process reward models (PRMs) provide fine-grained supervision for multi-step reasoning, yet obtaining reliable process labels remains a central bottleneck. Existing approaches typically rely on human annotation, rollout-based estimation, or auxiliary verification. In this work, we explore a different source of process supervision natively exposed by Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) models: expert routing. We show that simple routing statistics provide an intrinsic process-confidence signal that is competitive with conventional output-logit confidence. Building on this observation, we construct routing confidence by combining overall routing mass, head routing mass, and within-step routing variation, and introduce RoCo-Rethink, which identifies the least confident reasoning step and selectively regenerates the subsequent trajectory. We further introduce RoCo-PRM, which uses a strong MoE to automatically annotate reasoning trajectories with routing-derived step scores and distills them into a standalone PRM. Across multiple MoE architectures and diverse reasoning tasks, both RoCo-Rethink and RoCo-PRM consistently outperform strong baselines, while RoCo-PRM transfers effectively across both model architectures and tasks. Our findings suggest that expert routing is more than a computational dispatch mechanism: it provides an architecture-native source of process supervision for reasoning.

AI.tldr: 利用MoE模型的专家路由统计作为内在过程置信度信号，提出RoCo-Rethink（定位低置信步骤并重生成）与RoCo-PRM（自动标注并蒸馏为独立PRM），在多种MoE架构与推理任务上优于强基线并具良好迁移性。
AI.motivation: 过程奖励模型（PRM）对多步推理提供细粒度监督，但获取可靠的过程标签是关键瓶颈；现有方法依赖人工标注、rollout估计或辅助验证，成本高或不可靠。作者希望找到一种模型架构原生提供的过程监督来源。
AI.method: 观察到MoE的专家路由统计可提供与输出logit置信度相当的过程置信信号；据此由整体路由质量、头级路由质量和步内路由变化组合构建“路由置信度”。基于该信号提出RoCo-Rethink：识别置信度最低的推理步骤并选择性重新生成后续轨迹；以及RoCo-PRM：用强MoE模型自动为推理轨迹标注路由衍生的步骤分数，并蒸馏为独立PRM。
AI.result: 在多种MoE架构与多样化推理任务上，RoCo-Rethink与RoCo-PRM均持续优于强基线；RoCo-PRM还能跨模型架构与跨任务有效迁移。
AI.conclusion: 专家路由不仅是计算调度机制，更是架构原生的过程监督来源，可用于推理改进与PRM构建。

title: Latent space configuration for neural network finetuning, fast ranking, and embedding dimensionality reduction
summary: Finding K most similar elements for a query in a large gallery of neural network (NN) embeddings is essential in various areas of computer science and industrial applications of artificial intelligence. This paper proposes search algorithms for structured latent spaces (LS) of NNs which allow to speed up top K item retrieval owing to O(1) complexity small candidate gallery subset search. ArcFace-pretrained IResNet50 models are finetuned using Latent Space Configuration (LSC) methodology to obtain new distribution of embeddings with desired geometric properties. Applying the proposed algorithms to embeddings obtained from finetuned models leads to several times speed-up over baseline exhaustive search. Specifically, we report up to 3 times speed-up on GPU and 40% speed-up on CPU compared to the baseline method GPU speed. These results are obtained for the original and reduced numbers of LS dimensions. The results show that LS dimensionality reduction allows to further accelerate the search and even improve rank-N metrics.

AI.tldr: 提出面向神经网络结构化潜在空间（LS）的top-K检索算法，利用O(1)复杂度的小候选集搜索加速，并通过LSC微调IResNet50使嵌入具有有利几何性质，GPU提速达3倍、CPU提速40%。
AI.motivation: 在大规模神经网络嵌入库中为查询寻找K个最相似元素是AI工业应用的关键需求，但穷举搜索代价高，亟需加速检索的方法。
AI.method: 用Latent Space Configuration（LSC）方法微调ArcFace预训练的IResNet50，获得具有期望几何性质的嵌入分布；在此基础上提出针对结构化潜在空间的搜索算法，以O(1)复杂度先选出小的候选画廊子集，从而加速top-K检索。
AI.result: 相比基线穷举搜索，所提算法带来数倍加速：GPU上最高3倍、CPU上40%（对比GPU基线速度）；在原始及降维的LS维度下均得到该结果。LS降维可进一步加速搜索，甚至提升rank-N指标。
AI.conclusion: 通过LSC控制嵌入几何结构并结合结构化LS搜索算法，可在保持或改善检索质量的同时显著加速top-K检索，潜在空间降维是进一步提升效率与效果的有效手段。

title: Causal world models under physical parameter shifts
summary: World models predict how embodied systems evolve under actions, but their accuracy can degrade when physical conditions move outside the training distribution. We study two components of causal modeling: which inputs a predictor may use, and how its mechanism computes their effects. In a synthetic benchmark with shortcut features, a frozen dependency mask derived from paired interventions reduces mean out-of-distribution (OOD) RMSE from 1.769 for a fully connected predictor to 0.697, close to the generator-oracle mask (0.694). For robot link-mass extrapolation in CausalWorld, with disjoint training and test mass ranges, we develop finger-local world models in which link masses enter inertia and dynamics-bias terms through explicit affine coefficients, actions act through either a learned torque network or the known PD controller, and learned residuals capture contact-related effects. Compared with a separately trained control whose mass inputs are fixed at training means, the known-PD model turns out-of-range masses into a consistent predictive gain: median time-averaged joint R2 over 150-step rollouts rises from 0.609 to 0.727, with improvement in all ten task-seed runs (exact two-sided sign test, p = 0.002). In a shared 100-step forecast, the learned-torque model is competitive with the strongest recurrent robotic world model (RWM) configuration (median joint R2 of 0.755 - 0.768 versus 0.752), whereas supplying out-of-range masses sharply degrades the MLP and recurrent predictors. These results indicate that how a physical parameter enters the dynamics mechanism determines whether its out-of-range value helps or harms prediction.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究世界模型在分布外物理条件下的因果建模问题，认为"输入选择"与"机制计算方式"共同决定OOD预测表现，并提出将物理参数以显式仿射方式进入动力学机制的建模方法。
AI.motivation: 具身系统的世界模型在物理条件超出训练分布时精度下降。作者想弄清因果建模的两个维度——预测器可用哪些输入、机制如何计算其效应——是否决定物理参数越界时是帮助还是损害预测。
AI.method: 1) 合成基准含捷径特征，用成对干预导出的冻结依赖掩码约束输入；2) CausalWorld机器人连杆质量外推（训练/测试质量区间不相交），构建finger-local世界模型：质量通过显式仿射系数进入惯性与动力学偏置项，动作经学习力矩网络或已知PD控制器，学习残差捕捉接触效应。
AI.result: 合成基准：冻结依赖掩码把OOD RMSE从全连接预测器的1.769降至0.697，接近生成器oracle掩码0.694。CausalWorld：已知PD模型使越界质量转为预测增益，150步滚动中位关节R2由0.609升至0.727，10次任务种子全部提升（符号检验p=0.002）；100步预测中学习力矩模型中位R2为0.755–0.768，与最强RWM配置0.752相当；而MLP与循环预测器直接输入越界质量会显著退化。
AI.conclusion: 物理参数进入动力学机制的方式决定其越界取值是有益还是有害；显式因果结构（依赖掩码、仿射参数化）能显著提升世界模型的OOD鲁棒性与外推能力。

title: Commit or Abstain? System One Decision Models, LLMs, and Missing Legal Authority
comment: 16 pages, 4 figures, 4 tables. Under review. Code, data, and model outputs: https://github.com/mmikaildemir/commit-or-abstain
summary: Given the enormous number of claims to be checked, verifiable legal AI requires scalable, cost-effective models that answer the practical needs of law. System One decision models are built on large language models but, instead of generating text, return a calibrated probability for each option. This suits the verification of legal authority, where the question is closed: a given holding, or none of them. We test whether such models abstain when the correct authority is missing. We extend CaseHOLD with an abstention condition in which the correct holding is replaced in 1,670 of 5,314 items, and compare four decision models with six generative LLMs. When no option is correct, generative LLMs still pick one in 38-86% of items; the most cautious decision model does so in 30%. On standard CaseHOLD, a decision model matches the best generative LLM (88.1% vs. 88.2%) at 1/55 of the cost. Accepting that LLM's answer only when a decision model agrees halves its wrong citations, and distilling a decision model's probabilities into Qwen3-8B, without labels, yields a well-calibrated local model. Legal AI should be judged by its wrong citations, not by accuracy alone.

AI.tldr: 本文提出并评估"System One"决策模型（基于LLM但不生成文本，而是为每个选项输出校准概率），考察其在法律权威验证中的弃权能力与成本效益。在扩展的CaseHOLD弃权测试中，生成式LLM有38–86%概率强行选择错误项，最佳决策模型仅30%；标准任务上决策模型以1/55成本达到与最佳生成式LLM相当精度（88.1% vs 88.2%）。
AI.motivation: 面对海量待核查的法律主张，可验证法律AI需要可扩展、低成本的模型。法律权威验证是封闭式选择题（给定判决或"都不对"），但生成式LLM在正确答案缺失时仍会强行作答，导致错误引用，危害严重。
AI.method: 构建"System One"决策模型：基于LLM但输出各选项的校准概率而非文本。将CaseHOLD扩展出弃权条件（5,314题中1,670题替换掉正确判决），比较4种决策模型与6种生成式LLM；并测试决策模型与LLM协同（仅在决策模型同意时采纳LLM答案）及无标签概率蒸馏到Qwen3-8B。
AI.result: 无正确选项时，生成式LLM仍有38–86%题目强行选择，最谨慎决策模型为30%；标准CaseHOLD上决策模型达88.1%，接近最佳生成式LLM的88.2%，成本仅1/55。仅在决策模型认可时采纳LLM答案可将错误引用减半；无标签蒸馏使Qwen3-8B成为良好校准的本地模型。
AI.conclusion: 决策模型在弃权与成本上显著优于生成式LLM，二者协同可有效降低错误引用。法律AI应以错误引用来评价，而非仅看准确率。

title: Keeping Time vs. Understanding Time: Neither Alone Explains Temporal Reasoning in LLMs
summary: Temporal reasoning is widely assumed to decompose into two modes: temporal arithmetic (date and time calculations), and temporal semantics (understanding temporal and causal relations). This dichotomy shapes how benchmarks are designed, how models are trained, and how progress is measured, yet its empirical validity has never been directly tested. We provide two lines of evidence that challenge it. First, we test whether tasks labelled as arithmetic or semantic by the benchmarks support transferable gains within their purported mode. Finetuning on these subsets yields predominantly dataset-specific gains ($+6.8$ to $+23.1$ percentage points), while transfer to a different dataset in the same mode ranges from $-3.2$ to $+1.1$ percentage points. Across the two benchmark families used in the transfer analysis, this pattern provides little evidence of coherent, transferable temporal abilities. Second, using cognitive-demand-based model evaluation, we examine which capabilities actually drive performance on these benchmarks. We find that quantitative and logical reasoning, the assumed proxies for temporal arithmetic and temporal semantics, are not the primary drivers; knowledge is. Together, these findings show that current temporal reasoning benchmarks do not cleanly realise the arithmetic-semantics distinction and instead largely reward models for remembering how time typically works.

AI.tldr: 该论文实证检验了"时间推理可分为时间算术与时间语义两模态"这一被广泛接受的假设，发现两项证据均不支持该二分法：时间能力并不具备可迁移性，且驱动基准表现的主要是知识而非推理。
AI.motivation: 时间推理长期被视为由时间算术（日期时间计算）与时间语义（理解时间与因果关系）两模态构成。这一二分法决定了基准设计、模型训练与进展衡量方式，但其经验有效性从未被直接检验。作者旨在直接验证这一假设是否成立。
AI.method: 两条证据路径：（1）迁移实验——在基准标注为算术或语义的子集上微调，检验同一"模态"内能否获得可迁移提升；（2）基于认知需求的模型评估——分析哪些能力实际驱动基准表现，检验定量推理与逻辑推理（分别作为算术与语义的代理）是否为关键驱动因素。
AI.result: 微调增益主要为数据集特化（+6.8 至 +23.1 个百分点），而同一模态下跨数据集迁移仅 −3.2 至 +1.1 个百分点，缺乏连贯可迁移的时间能力证据；认知需求评估显示，定量推理与逻辑推理并非主要驱动因素，知识才是主要驱动因素。
AI.conclusion: 现有时间推理基准并未清晰实现算术—语义之分，其奖励的更多是模型对"时间通常如何运作"的记忆与知识，而非专门的时间推理能力。这对基准设计与能力测量方式提出质疑。

title: OpenMAP-HIE: Pathology Informed Score-based Diffusion Model for Unsupervised Neonatal Hypoxic-Ischemic Encephalopathy Lesion Segmentation
summary: Accurate localization of neonatal hypoxic--ischemic encephalopathy (HIE) lesions on apparent diffusion coefficient (ADC) images is clinically important but is limited by scarce expert annotations and substantial variation in lesion appearance. We propose OpenMAP-HIE, a pathology-informed score-based diffusion model for unsupervised HIE lesion localization without voxel-wise lesion supervision. A denoising diffusion model learns the healthy neonatal ADC distribution, while a ControlNet-based conditional branch preserves patient-specific anatomy. At inference, anomaly evidence is derived directly from differences between conditional and unconditioned noise predictions at independently evaluated diffusion noise levels, avoiding dependence on a final pseudo-healthy reconstruction or sequential reverse-diffusion chain. Based on the characteristic ADC reduction associated with acute HIE, only discrepancies consistent with the expected pathological direction are retained and aggregated across noise levels using a geometric mean. Spatial mean filtering further suppresses isolated responses. The framework was evaluated on the BONBID-HIE dataset. The ADC-only method achieved a Dice score of $0.283\pm0.244$, average precision of $0.505$, Hausdorff distance of $25.45\pm15.63$ mm, mean average surface distance of $9.40\pm8.49$ mm, and normalized surface distance of $0.355\pm0.236$, providing the best overlap and surface-distance performance among the evaluated unsupervised methods and Dice performance comparable to supervised ADC-only models. Optional population-derived ADC $Z$-map refinement further increased Dice to $0.602\pm0.269$. These findings support pathology-informed score discrepancies as a useful signal for neonatal HIE lesion localization, while highlighting remaining challenges in detecting small and low-contrast lesions.

AI.tldr: 提出OpenMAP-HIE，一种基于病理先验的打分扩散模型，在无体素级标注下实现新生儿HIE病灶的无监督定位；仅用ADC时Dice达0.283，加入人群Z-map细化后提升至0.602。
AI.motivation: 新生儿缺氧缺血性脑病（HIE）病灶在ADC图像上的精确定位具有临床价值，但专家标注稀缺、病灶表现差异大，难以依赖体素级监督训练。
AI.method: 用去噪扩散模型学习健康新生儿ADC分布，配合ControlNet条件分支保留患者解剖结构；推理时直接比较条件与非条件噪声预测之差获取异常证据（不依赖最终伪健康重建或完整反向扩散链）；利用急性HIE的ADC降低特征仅保留方向一致的异常；跨噪声水平用几何均值聚合，并做空间均值滤波抑制孤立响应；可选人群ADC Z-map细化。
AI.result: 在BONBID-HIE数据集上，仅ADC方法取得Dice 0.283±0.244、AP 0.505、HD 25.45±15.63 mm、MASD 9.40±8.49 mm、NSD 0.355±0.236，在无监督方法中重叠度与表面距离最优，Dice与有监督ADC模型相当；加入Z-map细化后Dice提升至0.602±0.269。
AI.conclusion: 病理先验引导的打分差异可作为新生儿HIE病灶定位的有效信号；但小病灶与低对比度病灶的检测仍是主要挑战。

title: MHeatmap: Two-Walk Laplacian Reordering and Mosaic Layout for Rectangular Matrix Visualization
summary: Weighted rectangular matrices record relations between two types of objects, such as occupations and industries, documents and terms, origins and destinations, or annotated classes and computed clusters. Their heatmaps become difficult to read when arbitrary row and column orders scatter related objects, while equal size cells hide large differences in row and column totals. We present MHeatmap (Mosaic Heatmap), which addresses these problems in two stages. Two-Walk spectral seriation first represents the matrix as a weighted bipartite graph. Ordinary bipartite ordering uses only observed row to column links. Two-Walk also uses length-two walks, so rows that share columns and columns that share rows receive explicit similarity links. Sorting a Fiedler vector of the resulting graph Laplacian gives coordinated row and column orders. The Mosaic layout then partitions a unit square so that row height is proportional to the row total and column width is proportional to the column total, while color represents the observed entry. We prove how the Two-Walk energy combines direct alignment with shared-neighbor smoothness, derive an exact matrix vector product that permits sparse computation, and formalize the tiling and area semantics of Mosaic. Across 300 synthetic matrices and seven real data sets, Two-Walk obtains the lowest normalized 2-SUM in all 15 synthetic regimes and the highest Band@10% in 14. The largest gains occur when shared neighborhoods express the latent relational structure.

AI.tldr: 提出 MHeatmap（Mosaic Heatmap），通过 Two-Walk 谱序化与 Mosaic 马赛克布局两阶段改进加权矩形矩阵热图：行列排序协调、单元格面积反映行列总量，并在合成与真实数据上显著优于基线。
AI.motivation: 加权矩形矩阵（如职业-行业、文档-词项、起点-终点等）的热图在行列顺序任意时难以阅读，相关内容散乱；同时等大单元格掩盖了行列总和的巨大差异。
AI.method: 1) Two-Walk 谱序化：将矩阵视为加权二部图，除直接用观测的行-列链接外，还引入长度为 2 的游走，使共享列的行、共享行的列获得显式相似边；对所得图拉普拉斯矩阵的 Fiedler 向量排序，得到协调的行列顺序。2) Mosaic 布局：划分单位正方形，使行高正比于行总和、列宽正比于列总和，颜色编码观测值。理论上证明 Two-Walk 能量等价于直接对齐与共享邻居平滑的组合，推导可稀疏计算的精确矩阵-向量乘积，并形式化 Mosaic 的铺砌与面积语义。
AI.result: 在 300 个合成矩阵和 7 个真实数据集上，Two-Walk 在全部 15 个合成场景中获得最低归一化 2-SUM，在 14 个场景中取得最高 Band@10%；共享邻域体现潜在关系结构时增益最大。
AI.conclusion: 共享邻域信息对矩阵热图的行列排序至关重要；结合面积编码的 Mosaic 布局能同时解决顺序混乱与单元格等大的可读性问题。

title: TIDE: Tree-Induced Fine-Grained Diagnostic Evaluation from Model Behaviors
summary: Benchmark performance is the dominant standard for comparing large language models (LLMs), typically summarized by a single aggregate score, such as accuracy, pass rate, or rubric score. This aggregate score provides limited information about a model's underlying capabilities, yet understanding these capabilities is crucial for model development and evaluation. To this end, we propose Tree-Induced Diagnostic Evaluation (TIDE), which recasts diagnostic evaluation as behavior-driven decision-tree induction to perform fine-grained capability diagnosis. TIDE recursively builds a hierarchical capability tree from benchmark samples and model scores: at each node, an LLM judge proposes candidate splits and performs sample-to-group classification, and behavior-based information gain selects among them. We apply TIDE to five models across four benchmarks to demonstrate its effectiveness, and find fine-grained capability contrasts invisible at the aggregate level: Claude Opus 4.6 achieves 100% on microeconomic market reasoning where GPT-5.4 scores 83.3%, but trails GPT-5.4 on contract law reasoning with 77.8% versus 88.9%. We hope TIDE can be extended to past and future benchmarks so that the rich behavioral signal in evaluation results is fully leveraged for understanding model capabilities.

AI.tldr: 提出TIDE，将基准测试的诊断评估重构为行为驱动的决策树归纳，从聚合分数中挖掘细粒度能力画像。
AI.motivation: 现有LLM评测多以单一聚合分数（准确率、通过率等）汇总，信息量有限，难以揭示模型底层能力，而理解这些能力对模型开发与评估至关重要。
AI.method: TIDE递归地从基准样本与模型得分中构建分层能力树：每个节点由LLM评审提出候选划分并执行样本到分组分类，再以基于行为的信息增益在候选划分中选择。
AI.result: 在4个基准、5个模型上验证有效，发现聚合层面不可见的对比：Claude Opus 4.6在微观经济市场推理上达100%，GPT-5.4为83.3%；但在合同法推理上Claude为77.8%，落后于GPT-5.4的88.9%。
AI.conclusion: TIDE能实现细粒度能力诊断，作者希望将其扩展至过去与未来的基准，充分利用评测结果中的丰富行为信号来理解模型能力。

title: Mitigating Query Shortcuts in Chain-of-Thought with Context-Aware Decoding
summary: While Chain-of-Thought (CoT) prompting improves the reasoning performance of large language models (LLMs), recent studies have shown that final answers do not always depend on the generated rationales. In particular, LLMs may rely on query-specific shortcuts rather than the information provided by their reasoning steps. In this paper, we investigate whether context-aware decoding (CAD), an existing contrastive decoding method, can mitigate such shortcut behavior when applied to CoT reasoning. We study this application as Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD), which contrasts the next-token distributions conditioned on the query with and without its rationale, amplifying tokens whose likelihood increases due to the rationale. We provide a theoretical interpretation of this decoding rule via a KL-regularized reward-maximization objective. Experiments across five reasoning benchmarks demonstrate that RCD improves answer accuracy over standard CoT. Furthermore, intervention analyses using ground-truth and random rationales reveal that RCD increases the behavioral dependence of final answers on the rationale content. Our findings suggest that contrastive decoding offers a simple, training-free approach to mitigating query shortcuts.

AI.tldr: 论文研究将上下文感知解码(CAD)应用于CoT推理，提出Rationale Contrastive Decoding (RCD)，通过对比有无推理步骤时的下一词分布来抑制查询捷径，提升答案准确率并增强答案对理由的依赖。
AI.motivation: CoT提示虽提升LLM推理性能，但最终答案并不总依赖生成的推理步骤，模型可能依赖查询相关的捷径而非推理信息。作者希望探索现有对比解码方法能否缓解此类捷径行为。
AI.method: 提出RCD：对比条件于查询+理由 与 仅查询 的下一词分布，放大因理由而似然上升的token；并通过KL正则化奖励最大化目标给出该解码规则的理论解释。实验覆盖五个推理基准，并用真实/随机理由做干预分析。
AI.result: 在五个推理基准上，RCD相较标准CoT提升了答案准确率；干预分析显示RCD增强了最终答案对理由内容的行为依赖。
AI.conclusion: 对比解码为缓解查询捷径提供了一种简单、免训练的方法。

title: Mitigating Reward Hacking in Realistic Scenarios Through Representation Engineering
summary: Reward hacking is a major problem in current production machine learning systems, resulting in costly and dangerous failures. Here we study how to monitor for and mitigate reward hacking in realistic settings, including tool calls and long contexts. We apply a dynamic intervention to steering directions obtained by three different methods: difference-in-means vectors from labeled rollouts, gradient optimization-based vectors, and vectors extracted when models reference an anti-reward-hacking model spec. This dynamic intervention perturbs model representations less than uniform steering vector addition to the residual stream, allowing for more precise edits. We find that we are able to cheaply and significantly reduce reward hacking without correspondingly significant costs to model coherence or capability, and that steering vectors originally extracted from coding environments also generalize to reducing reward hacking in other domains. Our results pave the way towards latent space monitoring and control over realistic production systems.

AI.tldr: 本文研究如何监控并缓解真实场景（含工具调用与长上下文）中的奖励黑客，通过动态干预三种方法得到的转向向量，证实可低成本显著减少奖励黑客且不显著损害模型连贯性与能力。
AI.motivation: 奖励黑客是当前生产级机器学习系统的重大难题，会带来昂贵且危险的失败；现有研究多停留于简化设定，缺乏对真实场景（工具调用、长上下文）的监控与缓解手段。
AI.method: 获取三种转向向量：基于标注 rollout 的difference-in-means向量、基于梯度优化的向量、以及模型引用"反奖励黑客规范"时提取的向量；对它们施加动态干预（而非均匀加性steering），从而以更小的表征扰动实现更精确的编辑。
AI.result: 动态干预能显著且低成本地降低奖励黑客，同时对模型连贯性和能力的代价不显著；在编码环境中提取的转向向量也能泛化到其他领域减少奖励黑客。
AI.conclusion: 研究为在真实生产系统中实现潜空间监控与控制铺平了道路。

title: GuideEvolve: Self-Evolving Agent Framework with Expert Guidance and 3Ts Mechanisms
summary: This study introduces GuideEvolve, a self-evolving agent framework incorporating expert guidance and three autonomous regulatory mechanisms, collectively termed the 3Ts: Think Fast and Slow, Throwback, and Termination by choice. The framework addresses critical limitations in extant self-evolving agent paradigms through dual innovations: (1) a task-specific expert-evaluation-driven evolutionary pipeline, and (2) the integration of 3Ts mechanisms to facilitate cognitive optimization, performance recovery via temporal rollback, and adaptive termination protocols. Empirical validation across the MGSM and MMLU benchmarks demonstrates that GuideEvolve attains performance metrics comparable to current state-of-the-art models (89.8% accuracy versus Gödel Agent's 90.6% on MGSM; 89.1% versus 87.9% on MMLU), while exhibiting notably reduced variance (25-59%) and enhanced robustness. Furthermore, the framework achieves a 100% evolution success rate, superior to the baseline's 82%, diminishes required optimization iterations by approximately 50% (from 30 iterations in baseline to 15.1 and 13.4 across tasks), and provides improved stability for production deployment.

AI.tldr: 提出自进化智能体框架GuideEvolve，结合专家指导与3Ts机制（快慢思考、回滚、自主终止），在MGSM/MMLU上以更高稳定性、100%进化成功率和约减半迭代次数达到接近SOTA的性能。
AI.motivation: 现有自进化智能体范式存在关键局限：进化成功率不高、迭代开销大、性能波动明显、缺乏认知优化与自适应终止能力，难以稳定用于生产部署。
AI.method: 双创新：(1) 任务特定的专家评估驱动的进化流水线；(2) 3Ts自主调控机制——Think Fast and Slow（快慢思考的认知优化）、Throwback（时间回滚以恢复性能）、Termination by choice（自适应终止协议）。
AI.result: MGSM 89.8%（Gödel Agent 90.6%），MMLU 89.1%（对比87.9%）；方差降低25–59%；进化成功率100%（基线82%）；迭代次数由30降至15.1/13.4，约减半。
AI.conclusion: GuideEvolve在保持与SOTA相当精度的同时显著提升稳定性、鲁棒性与进化效率，为自进化智能体的生产级部署提供了更可靠的方案。

title: RCSD: Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Domain-Specific Speculative Decoding
summary: Speculative decoding accelerates large language model inference by employing a compact draft model to propose candidate tokens that are verified in parallel by a target model. Conventional training relies on soft-label distillation, which forces the draft model to mimic the target's full output distribution, including high-entropy regions that degrade acceptance rates and increase early rejection risk. We propose RCSD (Reinforcement and Continual Learning for Speculative Decoding), a training framework that aligns draft model optimization with the system-level objective of maximizing acceptance length. RCSD leverages naturally occurring accepted and rejected sequences during speculative inference to construct implicit preference pairs, with masked loss to avoid penalizing target-aligned tokens. Evaluated across multiple benchmarks, RCSD improves average acceptance length by 35% over HASS and achieves 1.35x faster end-to-end inference than HASS on practical workloads, without compromising generation quality.

AI.tldr: RCSD 用强化学习+持续学习训练投机解码的草稿模型，直接以最大化接受长度为优化目标，替代软标签蒸馏。
AI.motivation: 传统软标签蒸馏迫使草稿模型模仿目标模型完整输出分布，包含高熵区域，导致接受率下降、早期拒绝风险升高；且训练目标与系统级目标（接受长度）不一致。
AI.method: 利用投机推理中自然产生的接受/拒绝序列构造隐式偏好对，采用强化学习优化草稿模型，并引入掩码损失避免惩罚与目标一致的 token；结合持续学习。
AI.result: 多基准测试下，平均接受长度较 HASS 提升 35%，实际负载端到端推理速度提升 1.35 倍，且不损失生成质量。
AI.conclusion: 将草稿模型训练目标对齐系统级接受长度可显著提升投机解码效率，验证了偏好式训练范式的有效性。

title: Reading the Mask: Descriptor-Grounded BI-RADS Rationale Generation for Breast MRI Segmentation
summary: Deep learning based models accurately delineate tumours on dynamic contrast-enhanced MRI (DCE-MRI), but segmentation masks alone do not provide the rationales or reasoning used by radiologists to assess the lesion suspicion. This limits the explainability as well the clinical integration. We investigate whether clinically relevant descriptors can instead be derived from the segmentation masks and their dynamic contrast-enhancement series. We have used Breast Imaging Reporting and Data System (BI-RADS) guidelines as a structured framework. Using these guidelines we designed a BI-RADS decision tree with eight quantitative measurements using radiomics, together with the lesion size and component count, that determine the descriptors at eight nodes. Using these descriptors we generate natural-language rationale using a large language model. The model was constrained to express only the derived records from the decision tree. After applying this framework to the expert and automatic masks of each of the 1,506 cases in the MAMA-MIA dataset, we generated a reproducible corpus of 3,012 BI-RADS grounded rationales. We obtained a faithfulness score of 99.98% and a counterfactual accuracy of 99.3%, indicating that the generated rationales faithfully verbalises the measured descriptors and correctly reflects changes in the underlying record. Agreement between the descriptors from expert and automatic masks falls from 0.832 to 0.549 as mask quality falls from Good to Missed. The generated rationales are intended as draft representations for radiologist review and final sign-off rather than autonomous clinical reports.

AI.tldr: 提出基于BI-RADS决策树从DCE-MRI分割掩膜中推导临床可解释描述符，并用LLM生成忠实 rationale，构建3012条可复现语料。
AI.motivation: 深度学习分割模型能准确勾画肿瘤，但掩膜本身缺乏放射科医生评估病灶可疑性所依赖的推理依据，限制了可解释性与临床整合。
AI.method: 以BI-RADS指南为结构化框架，设计含8个节点的决策树，结合影像组学的8项定量测量、病灶大小与成分计数来推导描述符；再用LLM生成自然语言 rationale，并约束模型仅表达决策树导出的记录。在MAMA-MIA数据集的1506个病例上，对专家掩膜与自动掩膜分别应用该框架。
AI.result: 生成3012条BI-RADS接地的可复现 rationale 语料；忠实性99.98%，反事实准确率99.3%；专家与自动掩膜描述符一致性随掩膜质量由Good到Missed从0.832降至0.549。
AI.conclusion: 生成式 rationale 能忠实表达所测描述符并反映底层记录变化，但掩膜质量显著影响描述符一致性；其定位为供放射科医生审核签字的草稿，而非自主临床报告。

title: Conditional Flow Models Convert Epistemic Uncertainty into Apparent Aleatoric Variance
summary:
Conditional Flow Models (CFMs) are increasingly being used in place of deterministic predictors across machine learning, including for tasks that were classically formulated as regression. Given their success in such tasks, we ask the question: what useful information do the conditional distributions produced by CFMs carry beyond what a point predictor would provide?
  We identify a systematic phenomenon: in many natural regimes, CFM samples routinely have larger variance than the true conditional distribution, even in nearly deterministic regression problems. This effect is most pronounced where the model has not resolved the dependence on the conditioning variable, and thus the additional variance can be viewed as converting epistemic uncertainty in fitting the ground truth conditional distribution into apparent aleatoric variance in the generated samples. Through controlled synthetic and real-data experiments, and comparisons with explicit smoothing estimators, we show that the induced variance tracks model underfitting of complex or hard-to-fit targets, and decreases with additional training or data. We provide a theoretical account of the phenomenon in a simplified setting and demonstrate a consequent practical use-case of conditional flow-matching: designing high-coverage predictive sets that cover the ground-truth regression target.

AI.tldr: 条件流模型(CFM)在回归任务中生成的样本方差常大于真实条件分布的方差；这一额外方差本质上是把模型拟合的认知不确定性转化为表观的偶然不确定性，可被有效利用来构造高覆盖率的预测集。
AI.motivation: CFM 被广泛用于替代确定性预测器，包括经典回归任务，但尚不清楚其条件分布相比点预测器额外提供了哪些有用信息，因此作者追问这一信息内涵。
AI.method: 指出并系统刻画一个现象：在多种自然情形下CFM采样方差偏大，且在模型尚未解析出对条件变量依赖处最明显；通过受控的合成与真实数据实验、与显式平滑估计器的对比进行验证，并在简化设定下给出理论解释。
AI.result: 诱导出的额外方差随模型对复杂或难以拟合目标的欠拟合程度而变化，并随更多训练或更多数据而下降，说明其与拟合误差(认知不确定性)相关。
AI.conclusion: 该现象有一个实际用途：利用CFM的额外方差设计高覆盖率的预测集，以覆盖真实回归目标。

title: Robust Soft Skill Adaptation via Behavioral Localization in Tool-Using Agents
summary: Text skills can extend the capabilities of tool-using agents, but long skill descriptions increase computational costs. Soft prompts provide a compact alternative, yet learning from entire successful trajectories may also introduce unnecessary behavioral changes. We find that the useful effect of a text skill is highly concentrated in a small subset of trajectory positions. Based on this observation, we propose Behavioral Localization, which compares the frozen agent with and without the text skill to identify positions where the skill both increases the likelihood of successful tokens and meaningfully changes the next token distribution. We use these localized positions to supervise a short soft prompt. Experiments on SpreadsheetBench with a frozen Qwen3.6-35B-A3B agent show that the top 10\% of trajectory positions capture 96.12\% of the total positive skill gain. In the shared prompt setting, selective supervision improves success from 30.36\% with full trajectory to 36.79\%. Under task-specific conditions, using the top 10\% localized positions achieves 57.38\%, outperforming both the full text skill and the on-policy OPCD baseline. These results show that a small set of behaviorally relevant trajectory positions can provide effective supervision of soft skills.

AI.tldr: 行为定位方法用少量关键轨迹位置监督软提示，以低成本复现文本技能效果。
AI.motivation: 文本技能可提升工具智能体能力，但长描述增加计算开销；软提示虽紧凑，但从完整成功轨迹学习会引入不必要的行为改变。
AI.method: 提出Behavioral Localization：对比冻结智能体在有/无文本技能下的表现，定位既提升成功token似然、又显著改变下一token分布的位置，仅用这些位置监督短软提示。
AI.result: SpreadsheetBench上Qwen3.6-35B-A3B：前10%位置捕获96.12%正增益；共享提示下成功率由30.36%升至36.79%；任务特定下前10%定位达57.38%，优于完整文本技能和OPCD基线。
AI.conclusion: 少量行为相关的轨迹位置即可有效监督软技能学习。

title: PACE: Periodic and Channel-Aligned Encoding of Four-Bit Recurrent States
summary: Linear-attention language models keep their context in a recurrent state of fixed size, where an inference system stores one copy of this state for every sequence it decodes at the same time. Storing the state at lower precision therefore lets more sequences share an accelerator. Existing state quantizers round the state after every generated token and report that four bits lose accuracy unless the bit width is raised or the model is fine-tuned.\par We introduce PACE, a post-hoc four-bit state quantizer. PACE rounds the state only once every few generated tokens, as chunked kernels already do once per chunk during prefill, and keeps the tokens generated in between in a small buffer. Rounding less often reduces the error that accumulates in the state. Additionally, we find that the large entries of the gated-delta state gather in columns, because some channels of the update written at each token remain large across many tokens. PACE therefore shares each quantization scale within one column. It also keeps the heads that retain rounding error longest at eight bits. On four hybrid models from 4B to 35B parameters, PACE with mixed four- and eight-bit heads is competitive with eight-bit DAMP on the three larger models at about two thirds of its memory, PACE with four-bit heads throughout scores higher than Q-Mamba at equal memory, and rounding every few tokens preserves the decoding speedup of the buffer.

AI.tldr: PACE 是一种事后四比特线性注意力状态量化方法，通过"隔几个 token 才量化一次+列内共享量化尺度+少数头保留 8 比特"，在几乎不损失精度的前提下把状态显存降至约 8 比特 DAMP 的三分之二，并保持解码加速。
AI.motivation: 线性注意力模型把上下文压缩为固定大小的循环状态，推理系统需为每条并发序列存一份状态副本，因此降低状态精度可让更多序列共享同一加速器。但现有量化器每生成一个 token 就对状态取整一次，四比特若不提升位宽或微调就会掉精度。
AI.method: PACE 仅在每几个 token 后量化一次状态（与预填充阶段分块核一致），中间 token 存于小缓冲区，减少累积误差；观察到门控 delta 状态的大数值集中在列上（某些通道的更新在多个 token 上持续较大），故在同一列内共享量化尺度；并将舍入误差滞留最久的头保留为 8 比特（混合 4/8 比特）。
AI.result: 在 4 个 4B–35B 参数的混合模型上：混合 4/8 比特头的 PACE 在较大三个模型上与 8 比特 DAMP 相当，但显存约为其三分之二；全部 4 比特头的 PACE 在同显存下优于 Q-Mamba；每隔几个 token 量化仍保留缓冲带来的解码加速。
AI.conclusion: 降低量化频率、按列共享尺度与选择性保留高精度头，可让四比特状态量化在无需微调的情况下接近八比特精度，同时显著节省显存并维持推理速度。

title: Seeing through Denoising: Frequency-guided One-step Denoising for Infrared Small Target Detection
