Moreover, due to the tightly interleaved nature of reasoning and retrieval, it remains unclear how the evolving reasoning process influences query intent. To characterize the evolution of query intent during reasoning, we introduce search momentum, which captures the accumulated retrieval tendency induced by historical changes in generated sub-queries along the reasoning trajectory. Through momentum-based analysis, we find that the query generation process tends to continuously evolve along existing retrieval trajectories. Based on this observation, we propose MAPS, a Macro-Adaptive Parallel Reasoning framework for regulating search momentum and mitigating query-intent drift. MAPS first retains the retrieved knowledge and a refined reasoning state, thereby reducing the influence of historical reasoning trajectories on subsequent sub-query generation. Subsequently, MAPS extends the conventional sequential reasoning process into a parallel reasoning paradigm. At each iteration, MAPS identifies complementary retrieval directions, generates corresponding sub-queries for parallel retrieval, and consolidates the retrieved evidence to update the knowledge and reasoning states. Experiments on six question-answering benchmarks demonstrate that MAPS consistently outperforms representative RAG methods across different backbone models. All code and resources are available at https://github.com/NEUIR/MAPS.

AI.tldr: 论文提出 MAPS 框架，通过动量分析刻画检索意图漂移，并用并行推理调节检索动量，提升 RAG 性能。
AI.motivation: 现有交错式推理-检索 RAG 存在冗余/无效子查询、查询多样性不足的问题；且因推理与检索紧密交织，难以理解演化中的推理过程如何影响查询意图。
AI.method: 引入 search momentum（检索动量）刻画历史子查询累积的检索倾向；分析发现查询沿既有轨迹不断演化。据此提出 MAPS：先保留已检索知识与精炼的推理状态，削弱历史轨迹影响；再将顺序推理扩展为并行推理，每轮识别互补检索方向、并行生成子查询并整合证据更新知识与推理状态。
AI.result: 在六个问答基准、不同骨干模型上，MAPS 一致优于代表性 RAG 方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过动量视角调控检索意图漂移、引入并行互补检索，可有效缓解冗余查询与意图漂移问题，代码已开源。

title: Extending Affordance Segmentation for Wearable Robots to Multi-Object Images
summary: This paper proposes a refinement to existing vision-based portable pipelines for the recognition of graspable object parts. Such pipelines can effectively support automatic grasp selection and preshaping in upper-limb prosthetic devices. However, realistic scenarios in which multiple objects are present still represent a challenge. The proposed method exploits a minor modification to the conventional hardware setup and a custom training approach to extend the applicability of vision-based pipelines. A laser pointer is introduced in the setup as an effective mechanism for object disambiguation. Accordingly, a suitable retraining of the deep convolutional neural networks supporting recognition of graspable parts is implemented. A mixed reality strategy allows the reuse of available high-quality segmentation masks to generate realistic images procedurally, extending the range of scenarios supported by the final device. Experimental results confirm that the proposed pipeline improves target disambiguation accuracy by up to 9% compared with existing solutions, while preserving the computational cost.

AI.tldr: 提出一种改进的视觉可抓取部件识别流程：在硬件中加入激光指示器用于目标消歧，并配合自定义训练与混合现实数据生成，提升多物体场景下的识别准确率。
AI.motivation: 现有基于视觉的便携式可抓取物体部件识别流程可支持上肢假肢的自动抓取选择和预塑形，但在存在多个物体的真实场景中，目标消歧仍是挑战，限制其实用性。
AI.method: 对传统硬件配置做小幅修改，引入激光指示器作为物体消歧机制；据此重新训练用于可抓取部件识别的深度卷积神经网络；并采用混合现实策略复用已有高质量分割掩码，程序化生成真实感图像以扩展支持场景范围。
AI.result: 实验表明，该流程相比现有方案将目标消歧准确率最高提升9%，同时保持计算开销不变。
AI.conclusion: 通过激光指示器硬件微调与配套训练/数据生成策略，可有效扩展视觉抓取识别流程在多物体场景中的适用性，且不增加计算成本。

title: MemoryTax: The Bitter Lesson of Agent Memory
summary: Agent memory systems such as Mem0 and Zep decide what to keep before any question arrives; coding agents keep the raw history and let the model search it with its own tools. We ask whether designed memory still helps once the model is strong enough to search for itself. On one LoCoMo conversation (419 turns, 152 questions), we run four memory methods (full context, BM25, Mem0, Zep) and three coding agents (Pi, Codex, Claude Code), each with GPT-4o-mini, GPT-6 Luna and Claude Opus 5.5, and record what every rollout costs. This is a short empirical study, with one conversation and one run per cell. Agent memory is a costly patch for a weak model: Mem0 beats full context only with GPT-4o-mini, and its build alone costs more than a whole full-context rollout. Agent memory also has a ceiling, set by the model that writes it: a stronger reader does not recover what a weaker writer left out. With Claude Opus 5.5, Pi tops the cost-accuracy frontier, scoring 99% for less than half the cost of full context; its one miss is a wrong answer key. Part of that lead comes from photo captions that only the agents could read: on the 88 questions whose evidence has no photo, Pi and full context differ by one answer.

AI.tldr: 本文在一段LoCoMo对话上实证比较"设计式记忆系统"（Mem0、Zep）与"编码智能体直接搜索原始历史"两条路线，发现记忆系统主要是弱模型的昂贵补丁，且在强模型下被自搜索智能体（Pi）超越。
AI.motivation: 现有记忆系统（Mem0、Zep）在与问题到来之前就决定保留什么，而编码智能体保留原始历史并用自身工具检索。作者想验证：当模型足够强、能自行搜索时，预设计的记忆机制是否仍有价值。
AI.method: 单段LoCoMo对话（419轮、152问）上的小型实证研究，每格一次运行。交叉比较四种记忆方法（全上下文、BM25、Mem0、Zep）与三种编码智能体（Pi、Codex、Claude Code），每种分别配 GPT-4o-mini、GPT-6 Luna、Claude Opus 5.5，并记录每次运行的完整成本。
AI.result: Mem0 仅在 GPT-4o-mini 下优于全上下文，且其构建成本本身已超过一次全上下文运行；记忆效果存在由"写入模型"决定的上限，更强的读取模型无法找回弱写入者遗漏的信息。使用 Claude Opus 5.5 时，Pi 位于成本-准确率前沿，以不到全上下文一半的成本达到 99% 准确率，唯一错题系答案键有误。该优势部分来自只有智能体能读到的图片描述：在证据不含图片的 88 题上，Pi 与全上下文仅差一题。
AI.conclusion: 一旦模型强到能自行检索原始历史，人工设计的记忆系统收益有限且代价高昂；记忆的瓶颈在于写入侧，应优先增强模型自身搜索与多模态读取能力，而非预先压缩记忆。结论受限于单对话、单次运行的样本规模。

title: Balancing Foundation Models and Trait-Specific Learning for Forehead-Crease Recognition
summary: Biometric recognition often degrades under partial facial vis- ibility, where conventional facial cues are occluded. The forehead region remains consistently visible and contains distinctive crease patterns that can serve as a complementary biometric trait. We present a unified eval- uation of forehead-crease recognition across explainable zero-shot rea- soning, domain-adaptive learning, and trait-specific modeling. FIRE en- ables interpretable zero-shot verification using multimodal large language models, while pretrained face-recognition models are adapted to the fore- head domain through margin-based learning. Under open-set evaluation, the best zero-shot model GPT-4o+FIRE achieves 18.22% EER, while Edge-Forehead achieves 8.30% EER and 54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR. The results show that although MLLMs offer interpretable zero-shot verifi- cation, trait-specific learning remains more effective for robust forehead- crease biometric recognition.

AI.tldr: 该文系统评估了前额皱纹作为部分面部遮挡场景下辅助生物特征的有效性，比较了可解释零样本推理（FIRE）、域自适应学习与特征专门建模三条路线，发现专用模型（Edge-Forehead）显著优于MLLM零样本方案。
AI.motivation: 部分人脸遮挡会导致传统面部特征失效，而前额区域持续可见并具有可辨识的皱纹纹理，可作为补充生物特征；但该特征此前缺少统一的评估与建模对比。
AI.method: 提出FIRE：利用多模态大语言模型实现可解释零样本前额皱纹验证；同时通过基于间隔（margin-based）的学习将预训练人脸识别模型适配到前额域（Edge-Forehead），并在开集协议下与零样本方案统一评测。
AI.result: 开集评估中最佳零样本模型GPT-4o+FIRE取得18.22% EER；Edge-Forehead取得8.30% EER与54.01% TMR@0.1% FMR。
AI.conclusion: MLLM可提供可解释的零样本验证，但针对特征专门学习在鲁棒的前额皱纹识别上更为有效；前额皱纹可作为可行的补充生物特征。

title: Reader--Writer Coupling in Transformer MLPs
summary: A transformer MLP gives each hidden channel two roles: a reader that decides when the channel responds, and a writer that decides what it adds back to the residual stream. Read as a key--value memory, the layer can be measured one factor set at a time: the pairing of readers to writers is carried only by their shared index, invisible to any quantity computed from one factor set alone. Yet training couples the two factors through their joint update, so we ask what reading them together shows. The block supplies the joint instrument: the MLP writes back into the very stream it reads, so the exact Jacobian of its update is square, and its agreement with its own transpose resolves into reader--writer terms whose inner products give each channel, read as a couple, a signed pairing coordinate. Ranked by this coordinate, each block we measure has a small core of strongly coupled channels; where initialization gives either sign equally, the core is nearly all opposed: each writer points against the direction its reader responds to. This opposed core recurs from the smallest models trained from scratch to released checkpoints; its sign is in place within a few percent of training and holds while the coupling grows. Read as couples, most channels return their contribution against the reader that fired it, and the readers of later blocks take it up; few show in the logits. Training holds the couples in place: flipping the opposed writers moves the output toward common tokens, and a writer permuted onto another reader regrows to fit that reader while the reader stays.

AI.tldr: 提出将Transformer MLP的每个隐藏通道视为"读者-写者"耦合对，利用MLP更新关于残差流的精确Jacobian为方阵这一性质，定义每通道的带符号配对坐标，发现约化后各块存在一个小核心——其写者与读者方向近乎相反。
AI.motivation: 单看读者（何时激活）或写者（写回什么）任一因子，都无法刻画二者的配对关系（配对只由共享索引承载，单因子量不可见）；但训练通过联合更新耦合了两者，因此需要一种能同时读取两个因子的度量。
AI.method: 把MLP视作key-value记忆；因MLP写回它读取的同一残差流，其更新的Jacobian为方阵，与自身转置的一致性可分解为读者-写者项，其内积为每个通道（作为耦合对）给出带符号的配对坐标；按此坐标排序分析各块。
AI.result: 各块都有强耦合通道的小核心，且当初值使正负号等概率时核心几乎全为"相反"配对（写者指向读者响应方向的反侧）；该反向核心从小模型到发布检查点普遍存在，符号在训练早期（几个百分点）即定型并在耦合增强时保持；多数通道把贡献回写以对抗触发它的读者，由后续块读者接手，很少体现在logits中。
AI.conclusion: 训练维持这些耦合对：翻转反向写者使输出偏向常见token；把写者置换到另一读者上时，写者会重新生长以适配新读者而读者保持不变——表明读者-写者耦合是训练中被稳固维持的结构单元。

title: S-EDL: Eliciting Self-Evidence from Sequence Likelihoods for Semantic Calibration of LLMs
summary: Calibrating large language models (LLMs) in open-ended generation is uniquely challenging because many distinct token sequences can express the same underlying meaning. Prior calibration techniques target either fixed-set classification confidence or the binary correctness of individual strings, making them inherently ill-suited for the dynamic, multi-string nature of open-ended semantic outcomes. To bridge this gap, we introduce S-EDL, a novel evidential method that natively optimizes LLMs for semantic calibration. By eliciting evidence from the sequence likelihoods of the model itself, S-EDL constructs a differentiable Dirichlet prior over prompt-specific semantic classes. Optimizing the evidential loss under this prior yields a calibration-aware training signal over variable semantic classes, completely bypassing the need for fixed multiple-choice options. Evaluations across four open-ended benchmarks and three models demonstrate that S-EDL substantially reduces semantic calibration error while improving accuracy. By aligning generative likelihoods with semantic correctness, this work establishes a framework for deploying trustworthy LLMs in complex, open-ended applications. Code is available at: https://github.com/sandylaker/s-edl.

AI.tldr: S-EDL：用证据学习方法对开放生成中的LLM进行语义校准，构造基于序列似然的Dirichlet先验，无需固定选项。
AI.motivation: 开放生成中同一语义可由多个不同token序列表达，现有校准方法只针对固定集分类置信度或单字符串二元正确性，无法适配动态多字符串的语义结果。
AI.method: 从模型自身序列似然中提取证据，构建针对特定提示语义类别的可微Dirichlet先验；在该先验下优化证据损失，得到可变语义类别上的校准感知训练信号，完全绕过固定多选题选项。
AI.result: 在4个开放基准和3个模型上，S-EDL显著降低语义校准误差并提升准确率。
AI.conclusion: 将生成似然与语义正确性对齐，为复杂开放场景中部署可信LLM建立了框架。

title: AutoPhyX: Automatic Text-Condition Physics Property Generation
summary: High-fidelity 4D physical simulation requires accurate physical parameter assignments that align with diverse material properties. Previous methods struggle with critical bottlenecks: they either rely on computationally intensive per-scene optimization or predict parameters from purely visual inputs. The latter suffers from inherent ambiguity, e.g., the inability to distinguish the stiffness of rubber from its appearance alone. To bridge this gap, we propose AutoPhyX, a text-conditioned framework for predicting spatially-varying physical properties. Since training robust feed-forward models requires fine-grained supervision, we first introduce a novel part-controllable data generation pipeline that decomposes complex 3D assets into semantically distinct components and pairs them with physically plausible, diverse parameters and corresponding text descriptions. Leveraging this dataset, AutoPhyX employs a cross-modal modulation mechanism where text features dynamically modulate visual features for precise physical grounding. By formulating property prediction within a voxel field, AutoPhyX ensures compatibility with diverse 3D representations, including meshes, point clouds, Gaussian Splatting, and NeRF. Experiments demonstrate that our method enables physically plausible, text-driven parameter assignment in a single forward pass. It achieves high accuracy and robust generalization to in-the-wild objects, paving the way for future physics-intensive embodied and robotic applications.

AI.tldr: 提出文本条件化的空间物理属性预测框架AutoPhyX，配合部件可控数据生成流程，单次前馈即可为多种3D表示赋予物理合理参数。
AI.motivation: 高保真4D物理仿真需要与材质属性匹配的精确物理参数，但现有方法要么依赖计算昂贵的逐场景优化，要么仅从视觉输入预测参数，存在固有歧义（如仅凭外观无法区分橡胶硬度）。
AI.method: 首先提出部件可控的数据生成流水线，将复杂3D资产分解为语义独立部件，并配以物理合理且多样的参数及文本描述；再基于该数据集构建AutoPhyX：采用跨模态调制机制，用文本特征动态调制视觉特征实现物理接地；并将属性预测形式化为体素场，兼容网格、点云、Gaussian Splatting和NeRF等表示。
AI.result: 实验表明该方法能在单次前向传播中实现物理合理、文本驱动的参数赋值，精度高，并对野外（in-the-wild）物体具有稳健泛化能力。
AI.conclusion: AutoPhyX通过文本条件化与体素场表示弥补视觉歧义与优化开销问题，为物理密集型具身智能与机器人应用奠定基础。

title: Benchmarking and Error Analysis of Deep Search and Deep Research LLM Agents
comment: Proceedings of the 1st ICML Workshop on Failure Modes in Agentic AI (FAGEN), Seoul, South Korea, 2026
summary: As Large Language Models (LLMs) evolve into autonomous Deep Search and Deep Research Agents capable of executing long-horizon, multi-step tasks, evaluating their reliability becomes increasingly critical. However, existing evaluation paradigms predominantly focus on final task outcomes, leaving a significant gap in understanding the intermediate execution traces, where agents are highly susceptible to various errors. To address this critical gap, we introduce a comprehensive methodology and analytical framework designed specifically to diagnose errors in intermediate workflows. Building upon this framework, we establish a structured taxonomy that categorizes these vulnerabilities into two primary dimensions: System-Level Errors and Task-Level Errors. Through a systematic examination of step-by-step execution traces and agent-environment interactions, we reveal how these underlying errors affect overall performance. Finally, through empirical experiments and systematic analysis of the identified error types, we provide actionable design guidelines, aiming to enhance the robustness, reasoning capabilities, and reliability of Deep Search and Deep Research agents.

AI.tldr: 针对Deep Search/Deep Research智能体，提出聚焦中间执行轨迹的错误诊断方法论与分类框架，揭示系统级与任务级错误对整体性能的影响，并给出可落地的设计准则。
AI.motivation: LLM已发展为可执行长程多步任务的自主深度搜索与深度研究智能体，其可靠性评估愈发关键；但现有评估范式主要关注最终任务结果，忽视了对中间执行轨迹的理解，而智能体在中间步骤中极易产生各类错误，形成明显的研究空白。
AI.method: 提出一套面向中间工作流错误诊断的综合方法论与分析框架；在此框架上建立结构化分类体系，将脆弱性划分为系统级错误与任务级错误两大维度；通过系统检查逐步执行轨迹及智能体—环境交互，分析底层错误如何影响整体表现；并结合实证实验与系统分析。
AI.result: 通过逐步执行轨迹与环境交互的系统性分析，揭示了各类底层错误如何传导并影响整体性能，并基于对已识别错误类型的实证实验与系统分析，得到一系列具有可操作性的设计准则。
AI.conclusion: 评估应从仅看最终结果转向对中间执行过程的细粒度诊断；所提分类框架与经验发现可为提升Deep Search与Deep Research智能体的鲁棒性、推理能力与可靠性提供指导。

title: Every Part Has Its Role: Part-of-Speech Effects in LLM Post-Training
summary: Large language models are typically trained with next-token prediction (NTP), which rewards predicting specific tokens rather than explicitly accounting for the semantic similarities between different words or expressions. Prior work has addressed this limitation by augmenting training data with minimally varying sentences that replace a target word with conceptually related alternatives, e.g., "The tired coach ran home" $\rightarrow$ {"The tired trainer ran home", "The tired instructor ran home", ...}. Such concept augmentation improves performance, but it remains unclear whether its effectiveness depends on where in the sentence the concept is expressed. We reproduce and extend prior work $\textit{beyond nouns}$ to verbs and adjectives, asking whether the part of speech (POS) carrying the concept signal affects perplexity and downstream performance. We find different patterns across evaluation settings: concept augmentation improves perplexity most consistently on news, independent of the POS used, whereas verbs provide the most reliable downstream gains. Despite these behavioral differences, representational analyses using CKA and linear probing show that the conditions yielding the largest downstream gains are not necessarily those that most alter the model's internal representations. Together, these results suggest that the effectiveness of concept augmentation depends on where and how conceptual information is introduced during training.

AI.tldr: 概念增强训练的效果取决于概念在句子中以何种词性（名词、动词、形容词）引入：困惑度改进在新闻文本上最稳定且与词性无关，而下游任务收益主要来自动词增强。内部表征分析（CKA、线性探针）显示，下游收益最大的条件并非表征改变最大的条件。
AI.motivation: NTP训练奖励预测特定token，忽略词语/表达间的语义相似性；已有的“概念增强”方法（用概念相关的近义词替换目标词构造最小变化句）能提升性能，但其有效性是否依赖概念在句中的表达位置（词性）尚不清楚。
AI.method: 复现并扩展先前工作，将概念增强从名词扩展到动词和形容词；比较不同词性承载概念信号时对困惑度和下游性能的影响；并用CKA与线性探针进行表征分析。
AI.result: 不同评测设置下呈现不同模式：概念增强在新闻文本上对困惑度的改进最一致，且与所用词性无关；动词增强带来最可靠的下游性能提升。CKA与线性探针显示，下游收益最大的条件并不一定是最显著改变模型内部表征的条件。
AI.conclusion: 概念增强的有效性取决于概念信息在训练中被引入的位置与方式；行为层面的收益与表征层面的变化并不对应。

title: Supervision-Adaptive Curriculum and Guarded Anti-Curriculum Learning for Dense Prediction
summary: Curriculum learning orders samples by difficulty, but difficulty alone does not establish supervision reliability for dense prediction. Easy samples can expose shortcuts, hard samples can be informative, and noisy or ambiguous samples can mislead training. Building on our conference method CurriSeg, we present PaceShift, a stabilize-then-challenge paradigm combining supervision-adaptive curriculum selection with guarded spectral post-training. A learning-dynamics view motivates separating supervision reliability from temporal update value and applying spectral challenges after stabilization. The first phase estimates reliability from available supervision, augmentation consistency, model disagreement, and prediction certainty. Temporal statistics guide sample weighting, while pixel-uncertainty weights reduce the early influence of uncertain regions. The second phase ranks predictions from multiple spectral views using supervision agreement, robustness, reference consistency, and penalties. A pairwise preference objective measured against the frozen Phase-I reference, together with an anchor, refines the prediction. The framework supports full, weak, semi-supervised, and model-derived supervision. Experiments across context-entangled content segmentation (CECS), broader dense-prediction tasks, and foundation-model and cross-modal adaptations show accuracy gains. Targeted diagnostics indicate improved pooled calibration and corruption robustness in the evaluated settings. PaceShift preserves the deployed architecture and adds no inference computation. Code will be publicly released.

AI.tldr: PaceShift提出"先稳定后挑战"的课程学习范式：第一阶段基于监督可靠性估计进行样本选择与加权，第二阶段在稳定后引入守护式谱域后训练精化预测。
AI.motivation: 仅以难度排序样本不足以刻画稠密预测中的监督可靠性：简单样本可能暴露捷径、难样本可能有效、噪声或歧义样本会误导训练，需将监督可靠性与时序更新价值分离。
AI.method: 基于学习动力学视角的两阶段框架。Phase-I从现有监督、增强一致性、模型分歧和预测确定性估计可靠性，用时序统计指导样本加权、像素不确定度降权；Phase-II在稳定后对多谱视图预测按监督一致性、鲁棒性、参考一致性及惩罚项排序，以冻结Phase-I参考的成对偏好目标加锚点精化预测。支持全监督、弱监督、半监督及模型派生监督。
AI.result: 在上下文纠缠内容分割（CECS）、更广泛稠密预测任务以及基础模型与跨模态适配实验中均取得精度提升；诊断显示所评估设置下池化校准与腐蚀鲁棒性改善。保持部署架构不变，且不增加推理计算。
AI.conclusion: PaceShift表明，将监督可靠性评估与稳定后的谱域挑战相结合可有效提升稠密预测的精度、校准与鲁棒性，且零推理开销，适配多种监督形式，具备实用部署价值。

title: Data Schedules and Learning Rate Schedules Should Be Designed Together
summary: Mid-training (MT) is a training phase in LLM training pipelines that continues pretraining (PT) on smaller datasets of higher value. Taking the PT and MT phases as a whole, training usually starts with only PT data and then transitions completely to MT data. In this work, we view this complete transition from PT to MT data as a special case of a broader class of data mixing schedules that specify how the proportions of PT and MT tokens in each batch change over training. Under fixed total training compute and MT token budgets, we ask: Is this complete transition to MT data optimal for minimizing final MT loss? We show that the answer depends on the learning rate (LR) schedule: one data schedule may outperform another under one LR schedule, but changing only the LR schedule can reverse the outcome. Specifically, when the LR decays throughout continued training, introducing MT data earlier and mixing it with PT data lowers the final MT loss compared with placing all MT data at the end of training, but this result is reversed if we use constant LR. We therefore study how to jointly choose when to introduce MT data and when to decay the LR through ablation studies, and find that it is better to decay the LR only after MT data enters training. Finally, we develop a theoretical model that explains why the optimal data schedule for a fixed MT token budget depends on the LR schedule.

AI.tldr: 本文研究PT到MT数据的过渡安排是否为最优，发现其最优性取决于学习率调度：LR衰减时提前引入并混合MT数据更优，恒定LR时结论反转；建议在MT数据进入训练后再衰减LR，并给出理论解释。
AI.motivation: LLM训练中PT与MT整体上从纯PT数据完全切换到MT数据，但这种"完全过渡"是否为固定总算力与MT token预算下的最优数据混合策略尚未被检验。
AI.method: 将PT→MT的完全切换视为更广泛的数据混合调度（每批次中PT/MT token比例随训练变化）的特例，在固定总算力与MT token预算下做消融实验，联合考察MT数据引入时机与LR衰减时机，并建立理论模型。
AI.result: 最终MT损失的最优数据调度依赖LR调度：LR全程衰减时，提前引入MT并与PT混合可降低最终MT损失，优于把全部MT数据放在训练末尾；改用恒定LR则结论反转。实验还表明应在MT数据进入训练之后再衰减LR。
AI.conclusion: 完全过渡并非普遍最优，数据调度与LR调度需联合设计；理论模型解释了固定MT token预算下最优数据调度为何依赖LR调度。

title: Investigating the Impact of Learner Errors on Social Bias in Large Language Models
summary: Existing social bias benchmarks evaluate large language models mostly on fluent, well-formed English, reflecting native speaker usage and leaving non-native writers unrepresented. To address this gap, we investigate how grammatical errors by non-native writers affect social bias. We develop a controlled framework that injects common learner errors into prompts and apply it to three bias benchmarks covering stereotype alignment and demographic preference across gender, race, and religion. We find that grammatical errors increase bias, and the effect grows with the error rate. Among the four common error types we consider, preposition errors produce the largest and most consistent increase in stereotype alignment. Our analysis suggests that errors increase bias when they are more likely to interfere with comprehension. Finally, fine-tuning on erroneous texts reduces the bias increase caused by grammatical errors. Our findings show that bias evaluations based exclusively on well-formed prompts may underestimate the bias experienced by users whose English contains grammatical errors.

AI.tldr: 语法错误会加剧大语言模型的社会偏见，且随错误率上升而增强；介词错误影响最显著，错误干扰语义理解是关键机制，在错误文本上微调可缓解。
AI.motivation: 现有社会偏见基准主要基于流利、规范的英语，反映母语者用法，忽视了非母语写作者。因此作者希望探究非母语者语法错误如何影响社会偏见评估，填补这一空白。
AI.method: 构建受控框架，向提示中注入常见学习者语法错误，并将其应用于三个覆盖性别、种族、宗教的偏见基准（含刻板印象对齐与人口偏好任务），考察四种常见错误类型及不同错误率的影响，并分析错误是否干扰理解这一机制，最后尝试在含错文本上微调。
AI.result: 语法错误使偏见上升，且效应随错误率增加而增强；四种错误类型中介词错误带来最大且最一致的刻板印象对齐提升；分析表明当错误更可能干扰理解时偏见上升更明显；在错误文本上微调可降低由语法错误引起的偏见增加。
AI.conclusion: 仅基于规范英语提示的偏见评估可能低估了英语存在语法错误的用户所经历的偏见，偏见评测应纳入非母语错误场景。

title: Melange: A Synthetic Visual Bias Benchmark for Multi-modal Large Language Models
summary: Multi-modal Large Language Models (MLLMs) have seen broad adoption, but their biases are still far less examined than those of standard LLMs, creating possible social harms when deployed in real-world settings. Prior efforts to extend bias analyses from LLMs into the multi-modal space either cover only a few bias categories or do not ensure that the groups being compared are clearly addressed by visual cues in the images. To overcome these limitations, we introduce Melange, a wide-ranging synthetic visual benchmark covering seven categories for assessing social biases in MLLMs. It is grounded in the widely used language-only BBQ dataset (Bias Benchmark for Question Answering) from BigBench, carefully extending its constructed contexts via controlled generation of visual scenarios so the target attributes appear visually and clearly. To maximize reliability, our generated images pass through two stages of validation: automated screening using visual question answering (VQA) and subsequent manual inspection by human annotators. By systematically evaluating 23 open-source MLLMs across three matched evaluation settings---text-only, image-only, and image-with-context---Melange isolates the fairness effect of the input modality. Switching from text to vision reduces fairness by 0.291 on average, a gap that varies by model family rather than by scale alone. A perception control confirms that this gap is not an artifact of visual comprehension: models identify the depicted attributes at 90--95\% accuracy yet still fail to abstain. When models do commit to a biased answer, polarity-aware stereotype alignment shows they choose the human-stereotypical response roughly three-quarters of the time.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出 Melange，一个覆盖七类社会偏见、基于 BBQ 数据集扩展的合成视觉基准，用于评估多模态大模型（MLLMs）的偏见，并在 23 个开源 MLLM 上系统比较文本、图像、图文三种输入下的公平性。
AI.motivation: MLLM 已广泛部署，但其偏见研究远少于纯文本 LLM，可能造成现实社会危害。已有将偏见分析扩展到多模态的工作要么只覆盖少数偏见类别，要么未确保被比较的群体在图像中有清晰的视觉线索，难以进行可靠评估。
AI.method: 以 BigBench 的纯语言 BBQ 数据集为基础，通过受控生成视觉场景扩展其构造语境，使目标属性在视觉上清晰可见，覆盖七个偏见类别。生成图像经两阶段验证：VQA 自动筛选 + 人工检查。随后在 23 个开源 MLLM 上于三种匹配设置（纯文本、纯图像、图像加语境）下评估，并进行感知控制和极性感知的刻板印象对齐分析。
AI.result: 从文本切换到视觉输入平均使公平性下降 0.291；该差距随模型家族而非仅随规模变化。感知控制显示模型识别图像属性的准确率达 90–95%，却仍无法拒答；当模型给出有偏答案时，约四分之三选择符合人类刻板印象的回答。
AI.conclusion: MLLM 的偏见在视觉模态下显著加剧，且不能归因于视觉理解不足。Melange 提供了覆盖广泛类别、视觉线索明确的可靠基准，揭示多模态输入的公平性风险，呼吁针对模态差异的偏见缓解研究。

title: GaP-MoE : Explicit Expert Specialization in Mixture-of-Experts via Orthogonal Gradient Accumulation and Projection
summary: Sparse Mixture-of-Experts (SMoE) models improve scalability by routing input tokens to only a subset of expert networks, but they often suffer from representation collapse, in which multiple experts converge toward similar functions and lose their intended diversity. Prior work has addressed this limitation either by improving router architectures or by introducing auxiliary loss terms that implicitly penalize similarity among experts. However, router-based approaches remain vulnerable to routing collapses, and loss-based approaches can conflict with the task's original objective during optimization. In this work, we propose GaP-MoE (Gradient Accumulation and Projection in MoE), which induces expert specialization by directly manipulating expert output gradients rather than modifying the loss function. At each training step, GaP-MoE stochastically selects one of the $TopK$ routed experts as a leader based on normalized routing scores, and projects the gradients of the remaining follower experts onto the orthogonal complement of the subspace spanned by the leader's recent gradients. This removes directional overlap between expert gradients without altering the task loss, allowing specialization to emerge as a direct consequence of the optimization dynamics rather than an externally imposed constraint. We evaluate GaP-MoE in both fine-tuning settings (BERT-based, on GLUE) and from-scratch pretraining settings (GPT-2-based, on WikiText-103, enwik8, and text8), and further confirm its compatibility as a drop-in module for existing SMoE architectures. Experimental results show that GaP-MoE achieves performance comparable to or better than standard SMoE.

AI.tldr: 提出GaP-MoE，通过在梯度层面正交投影诱导专家分化，缓解SMoE表示坍缩，无需改损失函数。
AI.motivation: SMoE路由token到部分专家以提升可扩展性，但常出现表示坍缩（专家功能趋同、丧失多样性）。此前方法或改路由架构（仍易路由坍缩），或加辅助损失隐式惩罚相似性（可能与原任务目标冲突）。
AI.method: 直接操纵专家输出梯度而非改损失。每步按归一化路由分数从TopK专家中随机选一个“leader”，将其余“follower”专家的梯度投影到leader近期梯度张成子空间的正交补上，消除专家梯度间的方向重叠，使专业化源于优化动态。
AI.result: 在微调（BERT-based，GLUE）与从头预训练（GPT-2-based，WikiText-103、enwik8、text8）两种设置下评估，并验证可作为现有SMoE架构的即插即用模块；性能与标准SMoE相当或更优。
AI.conclusion: 梯度层正交投影是诱导专家专业化、缓解表示坍缩的有效且与损失解耦的手段，且易于集成到现有SMoE架构。

title: Benchmarking Large Language Models for Detecting Satirical Code-Mixed Sentences
summary: Code-switching is a natural linguistic phenomenon, yet its impact on high-level reasoning tasks remains largely unexplored in under-resourced languages like Romanian. Natural language processing tasks, such as satire detection, rely heavily on nuanced cultural and syntactic cues that large language models struggle to capture. In this paper, we investigate four methods (i.e., random replacement, phrase translation, dependency parsing, and large language models) for generating synthetic code-mixed Romanian sentences with English, German, French, and Italian. We start with an existing dataset for satire detection, compiled from Romanian news articles and annotated at the sentence level by humans, and augment it with over 600k samples, namely CS-SeLeRoSa. We provide an in-depth analysis of the dataset generation process. Then, we evaluate several multilingual large language models across zero-shot, chain-of-thought, and fine-tuning regimes on both the synthetic corpus and a human-adjudicated gold benchmark, namely CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold. While older open models suffer substantial degradation (dropping to 37%-55% macro-F1), newer models like Gemma 4 31B achieve 68.1% zero-shot, rivaling frontier models like GPT-5 mini (69.5%). Furthermore, fine-tuning significantly reduces formatting errors and improves the results, increasing Gemma 4 31B to 77.5% on CS-SeLeRoSa and 72.6% on the gold standard, outperforming frontier zero-shot baselines.

AI.tldr: 本文研究罗马尼亚语-英语/德/法/意语码转换对讽刺检测等高层推理任务的影响，构建600k+合成数据集CS-SeLeRoSa及人工把关的金标准CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold，并评测多语言大模型；微调后Gemma 4 31B达77.5%（合成集）与72.6%（金标准），超越前沿零样本基线。
AI.motivation: 语码转换是自然语言现象，但其对低资源语言（如罗马尼亚语）高层推理任务的影响尚少研究；讽刺检测高度依赖文化与句法线索，大模型难以捕捉。
AI.method: 提出四种合成语码混合句生成方法（随机替换、短语翻译、依存句法分析、大模型），基于罗马尼亚新闻讽刺检测数据集扩充出600k+样本CS-SeLeRoSa，并构建人工裁决的金标准CS-SeLeRoSa-Gold；在零样本、思维链、微调三种范式下评测多个多语言大模型。
AI.result: 较旧开源模型显著退化（宏F1降至37%–55%）；较新模型如Gemma 4 31B零样本达68.1%，接近GPT-5 mini（69.5%）。微调显著减少格式错误并提升性能，Gemma 4 31B在CS-SeLeRoSa上达77.5%、金标准上72.6%，优于前沿零样本基线。
AI.conclusion: 合成语码混合数据结合微调可有效缓解低资源语言语码转换带来的性能退化，并超越前沿模型的零样本表现。

title: Hyperspherical Simplex Representations for Backward-Compatible Retrieval
summary: Training modern AI models has become increasingly expensive, and updating deployed models can alter their internal feature representations, affecting applications built upon them. In retrieval systems, such updates often require complete gallery re-indexing, a computationally expensive process at scale. Existing backward-compatibility methods enable direct comparison of representations from updated and earlier models, avoiding re-indexing. However, they typically require compatibility-specific training, learned mapping functions, or architectural modifications, and often depend explicitly on the previous model. We propose hyperspherical simplex representations derived from softmax outputs and logits for backward-compatible retrieval across independently trained models. They leverage the simplex structure induced by softmax cross-entropy training with one-hot labels as a common geometric reference across model updates. Since this reference depends on the number of classes, adding new ones expands the simplex, misaligning existing class prototypes with their earlier counterparts. We therefore derive a deterministic linear transformation to restore their alignment. Our theoretical analysis of the formal backward-compatibility definition identifies two geometric conditions under which its inequalities hold in expectation, assuming von Mises--Fisher class distributions with increasing concentration across updates. Aligned regular-simplex representations satisfy these conditions, providing a theoretical basis for the proposed representations under the stated assumptions. Without using additional compatibility-specific losses, learned mappings, or architectural modifications, the proposed representations achieve competitive results on standard compatibility benchmarks, including expanded class sets, more expressive architectures, and independently trained models from public repositories.

AI.tldr: 提出基于softmax输出与logits的超球单纯形表示，可在独立训练的模型间实现无需重索引的向后兼容检索。
AI.motivation: 模型更新会改变特征表示，检索系统更新后通常需对全库重新索引，代价高昂；现有向后兼容方法需专门训练、学习映射或改动架构，且往往显式依赖旧模型。
AI.method: 利用one-hot标签下softmax交叉熵训练诱导的单纯形结构作为跨模型更新的公共几何参照，构造超球单纯形表示；针对新增类别扩展单纯形导致的错位，推导确定性线性变换恢复对齐；并在von Mises–Fisher类分布、更新间集中度递增的假设下，分析向后兼容定义成立的几何条件。
AI.result: 在对齐正则单纯形表示上验证了理论条件；不使用兼容专用损失、学习映射或架构修改，在类别扩展、更强架构及公共仓库独立训练模型等标准基准上取得有竞争力结果。
AI.conclusion: 为独立训练模型的向后兼容检索提供了轻量、无需重索引且有理论支撑的表示方案，但理论保证依赖于所假设的分布形式与集中度递增条件。

title: Compositional neural networks for multimodal X-ray and neutron scattering inversion
summary: X-ray and neutron scattering are indispensable for structural characterization across condensed-matter physics and materials science. Yet, because scattering experiments generally record intensities without phase information, distinct structures can yield similar scattering patterns, rendering the corresponding inverse problems non-unique. This ambiguity can be reduced by combining complementary measurements, but their integration into machine-learning frameworks remains challenging. Here we introduce a modular framework for probabilistic multi-measurement analysis based on prior-amortized flow matching. Single-observation posterior estimators are trained separately for individual observation types or physical probes and combined only at inference time through a compositional sampler. This late fusion approach allows pretrained single-observation models to be reused without dedicated joint retraining. As a case in point, we consider reflectometry, which provides depth-resolved, nanometer-scale information about thin films and interfaces. Our single-observation demonstrations span X-ray, time-of-flight neutron and polarized neutron reflectometry. In separate co-refinement studies, task-matched estimators enable homogeneous composition across multiple neutron contrasts and heterogeneous multimodal composition of X-ray and neutron measurements. Together, these results establish compositional flow matching as a modular approach to uncertainty-aware inversion and co-refinement, with potential applicability to other scattering problems in which multiple observations constrain a common physical structure while retaining measurement-specific parameters.

AI.tldr: 提出基于先验摊销流匹配（prior-amortized flow matching）的模块化概率多测量反演框架，通过推理时组合采样实现晚期融合，用于反射术等散射问题的联合精修。
AI.motivation: 散射实验仅记录强度而丢失相位，逆问题非唯一；多互补测量可减少歧义，但难以融入机器学习框架，且联合训练代价高、不可复用。
AI.method: 为每种观测类型/探针分别训练单观测后验估计器（基于先验摊销的流匹配），推理时通过组合采样器进行晚期融合，无需联合重训练即可复用预训练模型；以X射线、飞行时间中子、极化中子反射术为案例。
AI.result: 单观测演示覆盖三种反射术；在独立共精修研究中实现多中子对比度的同质组合，以及X射线与中子测量的异质多模态组合。
AI.conclusion: 组合式流匹配为不确定性感知的反演与共精修提供了可模块化方案，可推广至其他多观测约束同一结构、保留测量特定参数的散射问题。

title: Unintended Side Effects of Value Training in LLMs
summary: As LLMs are increasingly deployed in value-sensitive contexts, aligning them with human values has emerged as a post-training objective in NLP, aimed at instilling additional values and guiding model behaviour. However, current evaluations remain narrow. Because values are interconnected, it is unclear how fine-tuning for specific values alters unrelated capabilities and behaviours. In this work, we adapt four instruction-tuned LLMs across individual Hofstede's value dimensions and evaluate them on both cross-value transfer and broader behaviours. We find that value-specific training produces unintended side effects on untrained values, risk preferences, social cognition, and safety traits. Consequently, we suggest that value alignment after post-training should incorporate broader behavioral evaluations, and we highlight the need to investigate where additional value training might best fit into the pipeline.

AI.tldr: 论文系统评估了针对单一价值维度微调LLM所产生的非预期影响：在Hofstede价值维度上训练四个指令调优模型后，发现会波及未训练的其他价值、风险偏好、社会认知与安全特质，呼吁价值对齐需纳入更广泛的行为评估。
AI.motivation: LLM日益部署于价值敏感场景，价值对齐成为后训练目标，但现有评估范围过窄；由于价值相互关联，为特定价值微调如何改变无关能力与行为尚不清楚。
AI.method: 将四个指令调优LLM分别在各Hofstede价值维度上适配训练，随后在跨价值迁移及更广泛行为（风险偏好、社会认知、安全特质）上进行评测。
AI.result: 特定价值训练会对未训练价值、风险偏好、社会认知和安全特质产生非预期副作用（溢出效应）。
AI.conclusion: 价值对齐的后训练后应纳入更广泛的行为评估，并需探究额外价值训练在训练流程中的最佳插入位置。

title: Generalized CycleGRPO for Fine-Grained Multimodal Understanding and Grounding
summary: Fine-grained multimodal intelligence requires models to both understand a designated region and localize it from language. Existing methods learn these directions with separate objectives and task-specific annotations. We present Generalized CycleGRPO, the first unified reinforcement learning framework coupling region understanding and localization across spatial, temporal, and spatio-temporal domains. Given a region, a multimodal large language model generates candidate descriptions and then localizes each description to reconstruct the input region. Reconstruction overlap provides a verifiable reward for captioning, while individual localization rewards improve the inverse mapping. A common region-space formulation extends this cycle from image masks and boxes to video intervals and timestamped spatial evidence, without reference captions or an external language-model judge during reinforcement learning. In videos, the cycle encourages descriptions that distinguish a target event from similar recurrences. We introduce DOVE (Distinctive Occurrence-level Video-caption Evaluation), a human-verified contrastive benchmark for this temporal distinctiveness. CycleGRPO improves SAMTok's overall gIoU from 57.5% to 68.2% on GroundingSuite and average gIoU from 71.2% to 78.7% on GRES. For temporal tasks, it achieves 51.9% tIoU on Charades and 33.3% Temporal Evidence Coverage on DOVE, compared with 45.6% and 14.8% for the Qwen3-VL initialization. These results establish region-text cycle consistency as a general self-evaluation principle for multimodal understanding and localization. Models, code, and DOVE are available at https://devinxzhang.github.io/Generalized-CycleGRPO-Page/.

AI.tldr: 提出 Generalized CycleGRPO，首个统一强化学习框架，用区域理解与定位互相重建的"循环一致性"作为可验证奖励，跨空间、时间与时空域耦合两类任务，无需参考描述或外部语言模型裁判。
AI.motivation: 细粒度多模态智能需同时"理解指定区域"和"从语言定位区域"，但现有方法用独立目标和任务专属标注分别学习这两方向，割裂且依赖大量人工标注。
AI.method: 给定区域，MLLM 生成候选描述，再将每条描述定位回区域，重建重叠度作为描述生成的可验证奖励；单项定位奖励提升逆映射。采用通用区域空间表示，将循环从图像掩码/框扩展到视频区间与带时间戳的空间证据；视频中鼓励描述能区分目标事件与相似重复事件，避免参考描述与语言模型评判。
AI.result: GroundingSuite 上 SAMTok gIoU 由 57.5% 升至 68.2%，GRES 平均 gIoU 由 71.2% 升至 78.7%；Charades tIoU 51.9%、DOVE 时间证据覆盖率 33.3%，对比 Qwen3-VL 初始化的 45.6% 与 14.8%。同时提出人工校验的对比基准 DOVE。
AI.conclusion: 区域-文本循环一致性可作为多模态理解与定位的通用自评估原则，且无需外部监督即可统一提升空间与时间任务。

title: Cascading Bandits with Noisy Observations: Algorithms and Regret Bounds
summary: We propose a novel stochastic cascading bandit setup where probing an ordered shortlist of $K$ out of $L$ arms incurs position-dependent costs, and the learner observes only noisy feedback regarding each arm's true output. We identify a sub-class of noise models for which the optimal shortlist can be found by sorting arms according to a per-arm score: such a score exists for both selection and ordering when the channel has no false positives, and for ordering alone (but not selection) when measurements are costless; however in general neither selection nor ordering is separable once noise and cost are both present. For the case where both selection and ordering scores exist, we provide a UCB-based algorithm with $O((L-K)\log T)$ instance-dependent regret over a time horizon $T$, which matches an algorithm-agnostic lower bound (up to constant factors). For the more challenging scenario where scores don't exist, we develop a new algorithmic template, DP-UCB, that embeds optimism directly inside an exact dynamic program, yielding $O\big(LK\log T\big)$ regret. Finally, we validate our theoretical results through extensive numerical evaluations and simulations over both synthetic and real-world datasets.

AI.tldr: 论文提出"随机级联赌博机"新设定：从L个臂中按序探测K个候选，探测成本与位置相关，且只得到关于臂真实输出的噪声反馈。作者刻画了可按"单臂得分"排序求解的噪声子类，并分别给出UCB型算法（得分存在时，O((L−K)log T)）与DP-UCB模板（得分不存在时，O(LK log T)）两种算法。
AI.motivation: 经典级联赌博机假设探测无成本且反馈精确，而实际推荐/检索系统中短列表的展示位有位置相关成本，观测也带噪声。噪声与成本同时存在时，最优短列表是否仍能通过逐臂打分排序得到并不清楚，需要从理论与算法两方面重新刻画。
AI.method: 先分析噪声模型的可分性：无假阳性时选择与排序均有单臂得分；测量无成本时仅排序有得分；噪声与成本并存时二者一般均不可分。对可分情形设计UCB型算法；对不可分情形提出DP-UCB，将乐观估计嵌入精确动态规划。
AI.result: 可分情形下UCB型算法达到O((L−K)log T)的实例相关遗憾，与算法无关下界常数因子内匹配；不可分情形下DP-UCB达到O(LK log T)。在合成与真实数据上的数值实验验证了理论结论。
AI.conclusion: 论文厘清了噪声与位置成本共同作用下最优短列表的可分性边界，并分别给出近最优的两种算法，为带成本与噪声的级联决策问题提供了理论框架与实用方法。

title: Task-Preserving Multilingual Instruction Tuning for Open-Ended QA in WMT 2026 MIST
summary: This paper describes our submission to the WMT 2026 Multilingual Instruction Shared Task. We adapt Qwen3-8B with LoRA using organiser-provided data, EuroAlpaca, a multilingual instruction dataset created through task-preserving localisation, and CrossEuroAlpaca, a cross-lingual augmentation that assigns different source and target languages to instructions, contexts and responses. Our system targets open-ended question answering (QA-OEG) in ten shared-task languages represented in the auxiliary data. Under matched decoding, adaptation improves the mean Gemma-4 judge score on target-language QA-OEG by 7.8% relative to the base model. On an additional evaluation using the Aya Evaluation Suite across all shared-task languages, it yields relative gains of 41.5% in macro-averaged ROUGE-L and 2.9% in BERTScore-F1, with larger improvements in target languages. However, these gains are task- and language-specific. Gemma-4 scores improve for QA-OEG and summarisation in the target languages but decline for context-grounded QA there and across all three tasks in the non-target languages.

AI.tldr: 本文是 WMT 2026 多语言指令共享任务的参赛系统：用 LoRA 微调 Qwen3-8B，并引入 EuroAlpaca（任务保持式本地化的多语言指令数据）和 CrossEuroAlpaca（跨语言增强，让指令、上下文、回答分别使用不同语言）进行适配，针对十种目标任务语言的开放式问答。匹配解码条件下，目标语言 QA-OEG 的平均 Gemma-4 评分相对基座提升 7.8%；Aya 评测集上 ROUGE-L 宏平均提升 41.5%、BERTScore-F1 提升 2.9%，目标语言增益更大。但增益具有任务和语言依赖性：目标语言 QA-OEG 与摘要提升，而上下文接地问答及非目标语言的三项任务均下降。
AI.motivation: 共享任务需要把通用多语言大模型适配到十种任务语言上的开放式问答；难点在于目标语言的指令数据稀缺，而单纯本地化或单语训练容易造成任务能力与跨语言能力此消彼长。作者希望在不依赖大规模人工标注的前提下，用任务保持式本地化与跨语言增强同时兼顾任务表现和语言覆盖，并检验这种适配的实际边界。
AI.method: 以 Qwen3-8B 为基座，采用 LoRA 在组织方提供的数据上做参数高效微调。构建 EuroAlpaca：通过任务保持式本地化生成多语言指令数据；构建 CrossEuroAlpaca：跨语言增强，为指令、上下文和回答分别指定不同的源语言与目标语言，从而显式训练跨语言迁移与混语条件。评测聚焦十种共享任务语言上的开放式问答 QA-OEG，采用匹配解码与基座对比，另用 Aya Evaluation Suite 在全部共享任务语言上评测 ROUGE-L 与 BERTScore-F1，并用 Gemma-4 作为裁判模型分任务统计。
AI.result: 匹配解码下，目标语言 QA-OEG 的平均 Gemma-4 评分相对基座提升 7.8%（相对值）。在 Aya Evaluation Suite 上，宏平均 ROUGE-L 相对提升 41.5%，BERTScore-F1 相对提升 2.9%，且目标语言提升幅度更大。但增益并不普遍：目标语言上 QA-OEG 与摘要的 Gemma-4 评分上升，而目标语言的上下文接地问答出现下降；在非目标语言上，QA-OEG、摘要、上下文接地问答三项任务均下降。
AI.conclusion: 任务保持式本地化加跨语言增强的 LoRA 适配能显著提升目标语言上的开放式生成质量，且对词面与语义相似度指标均有效，但收益是任务与语言特异的，存在明确的负迁移风险（上下文接地任务、非目标语言）。因此多语言指令适配应按任务与语言分别评估，并对混语增强比例和语言配比做更细的权衡控制，而非假设收益可跨任务、跨语言普遍成立。

title: Rethinking Underwater Image Enhancement: Learning through Text-Guided Degradation Curriculum
summary: Existing paired clean-degraded datasets have advanced learning-based underwater image enhancement, but they remain either limited in scale or difficult to acquire, and still fail to adequately cover the diverse degradations encountered in real-world underwater environments. Such scarce and insufficient data ultimately restrict the generalization of underwater image enhancement models, highlighting the need for realistic and controllable degradation modeling to better capture real underwater conditions and improve enhancement robustness. To this end, we propose a unified degradation-aware training framework for the underwater image enhancement task. A Text-Conditioned Degradation Augmentation Pipeline uses a text-guided diffusion model to synthesize diverse and semantically consistent degraded samples, providing paired data to support the subsequent curriculum learning strategy. The proposed Progressive Degradation Curriculum organizes training across multiple attributes and difficulty levels to promote balanced learning, and a Transmission-Guided One-Step Diffusion Model leverages this progressive process to better address the wide range of degradation severity and restoration ambiguity in underwater images. Extensive experiments on multiple underwater benchmarks demonstrate that our proposed method achieves superior performance. Our code and models will be released upon the publication of this work.

AI.tldr: 提出统一的退化感知训练框架，通过文本条件扩散合成退化数据、渐进式退化课程与传输引导单步扩散模型，提升水下图像增强的泛化能力。
AI.motivation: 现有成对清晰-退化数据规模受限、获取困难，无法覆盖真实水下环境中的多样退化，导致增强模型泛化性差；需要真实且可控的退化建模。
AI.method: 一、文本条件退化增强流水线，用文本引导扩散模型合成多样且语义一致的退化样本，为后续课程学习提供成对数据；二、渐进式退化课程，按多属性、多难度层级组织训练以促进均衡学习；三、传输引导单步扩散模型，利用该渐进过程应对宽范围的退化程度与复原歧义。
AI.result: 在多个水下基准上的大量实验表明该方法取得优越性能。
AI.conclusion: 退化感知的数据合成与课程化训练结合单步扩散复原，可有效提升水下图像增强的鲁棒性与泛化性；代码与模型将于论文发表后公开。

title: Parallelizable Probabilistic Latent Reasoning for Diverse Reasoning Trajectories
summary: Language models relying on verbalized Chain-of-Thought (CoT) are constrained to token-by-token generation in the language space, where many tokens serve textual coherence rather than core reasoning. This entangles genuine differences in logical trajectories with superficial variations in verbalization. Moving reasoning into a compact, continuous latent space offers a promising alternative for efficiently representing and exploring diverse reasoning trajectories. However, current latent models remain largely deterministic, capturing only a single reasoning trajectory rather than modeling a distribution over multiple valid alternatives. While stochastic approaches parameterize distributions over latent reasoning steps, they frequently suffer from unstable optimization and limited empirical performance. Furthermore, their reliance on autoregressive latent prediction during training precludes effective parallelization, leading to prohibitively long training times. To overcome these bottlenecks, we propose Probabilistic Latent Reasoning Models (PLRM), a parallelizable variational framework for probabilistic latent reasoning. PLRM adopts a JEPA-style objective in which the posterior infers latent distributions in parallel from observed reasoning trajectories, while the prior learns to predict the subsequent latent distribution via teacher forcing. To model heterogeneous reasoning processes, we introduce a discrete strategy variable together with a mixture-based prior, allowing the model to preserve the Gaussian-mixture structure induced by multiple distinct reasoning trajectories rather than collapsing them into a single Gaussian. Across diverse benchmarks, PLRM achieves performance competitive with deterministic latent reasoning models on single-trajectory datasets while enabling efficient training and consistently outperforming competing stochastic baselines on multi-trajectory datasets.

AI.tldr: PLRM：可并行化的变分概率潜空间推理框架，用JEPA式目标+离散策略变量与混合先验建模多条推理轨迹，兼顾性能与训练效率。
AI.motivation: 语言空间逐token的CoT把逻辑差异与表层措辞纠缠，且只能刻画单一推理路径；现有潜空间模型多为确定性，随机方法又存在优化不稳、性能有限及自回归训练难以并行的问题。
AI.method: 提出PLRM：后验从观测推理轨迹并行推断潜分布，先验以teacher forcing预测下一潜分布（JEPA式目标）；引入离散策略变量与基于混合的先验，保持多轨迹诱导的高斯混合结构而非坍缩为单一高斯。
AI.result: 在多类基准上：单轨迹数据集性能与确定性潜推理模型相当，训练高效；多轨迹数据集上稳定优于随机基线。
AI.conclusion: 将概率化与并行化结合可有效缓解潜推理模型瓶颈，混合先验结构有助于保持 reasoning 多样性。

title: Graph Topology Meets Energy-Driven Pathfinding: Preserving Contextual Consistency in Retrieval-Augmented Generation
comment: Accepted to Findings of the Association for Computational Linguistics: EMNLP 2026
summary: Retrieval-augmented generation (RAG) frequently integrates knowledge graphs (KGs) for complex multi-hop question answering. However, their performance is increasingly bottlenecked by the knowledge structuring and reasoning processes. (i) Severe semantic loss: Distilling continuous texts into discrete symbols strips away contextual nuances and narrative coherence. (ii) Pronounced modality mismatch: Fragmented graph structures clash with the continuous texts LLMs are pre-trained on, while rewriting them into natural language introduces generative noise and omits information. To address these limitations, we propose ThreadRAG, a semantic-topology-based RAG framework for context-preserving knowledge structuring and modality-native evidence reasoning. ThreadRAG introduces a Semantic Topology Mapper (STM), which organizes retrieved documents into context-intact Semantic Nodes and constructs a Semantic Topology Graph (STG) through narrative, semantic, and lexical edges. It further incorporates Energy-Driven Pathfinding (EDP), which identifies query-relevant subgraphs via energy diffusion and deterministically linearizes them into coherent textual evidence paths. Experiments on three multi-hop QA benchmarks demonstrate that ThreadRAG consistently outperforms strong baselines. Notably, it achieves a 14.4% EM improvement over text-centric methods on HotpotQA and surpasses the best baseline by 5.8% EM on 2WikiMultihop, while reducing token cost to 23.3% of the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出 ThreadRAG，一种基于语义拓扑的 RAG 框架，通过保留上下文的知识结构化与模态原生证据推理解决 KG-RAG 的语义损失与模态错配问题，在多跳 QA 上显著超越强基线并大幅降低 token 成本。
AI.motivation: 现有将知识图谱引入 RAG 的多跳问答方法存在两大瓶颈：(i) 严重语义损失——将连续文本蒸馏为离散符号会剥离上下文细节与叙事连贯性；(ii) 明显模态错配——碎片化图结构与 LLM 预训练的连续文本不匹配，而改写为自然语言又引入生成噪声并丢失信息。
AI.method: ThreadRAG 包含两个核心组件：语义拓扑映射器（STM），将检索文档组织为上下文完整的语义节点，并通过叙事、语义、词汇三类边构建语义拓扑图（STG）；能量驱动寻路（EDP），通过能量扩散识别查询相关子图，并确定性地线性化为连贯的文本证据路径。
AI.result: 在三个多跳 QA 基准上持续优于强基线：HotpotQA 上较文本中心方法提升 14.4% EM，2WikiMultihop 上超过最佳基线 5.8% EM，同时 token 成本降至最强基线的 23.3%。
AI.conclusion: ThreadRAG 证明了以语义拓扑保留上下文、并以文本线性化实现模态原生推理的路线，可在提升多跳问答效果的同时显著降低计算开销。

title: Unlocking Spatial Grounding in Flow-Matching Models via SNR Tuning
summary: Despite the success of foundation models in image synthesis, achieving fine-grained spatial control remains a significant challenge, typically requiring auxiliary structural adapters or complex inference-time steering. While modern vision-language (VLM) text encoders possess the latent capacity to represent spatial coordinates, generative models often fail to leverage this information. We demonstrate that the signal-to-noise ratio (SNR) distribution is a critical determinant of spatial grounding in flow-matching models. Using a novel synthetic benchmark of geometric primitives, we isolate structural mechanics from textural complexity inherent in natural imagery and introduce a rigorous color-aware layout metric to quantify spatial fidelity. We show that training on a centered SNR distribution results in poor layout adherence (25.9%). Instead, we identify high-noise regimes as a "critical learning phase" for spatial grounding. Shifting the training focus toward these stages increases layout adherence to 80.8%, effectively reaching the 83.6% reconstruction ceiling of the underlying variational autoencoder. We find that the necessity for this shift scales with resolution and aspect ratio variance, and that the conservative noise schedules employed by models like FLUX.1 are insufficient for precise layout adherence. Finally, we show that these findings translate to real-world imagery via the COCO dataset (1.0 vs. 57.3 Average Precision), where state-of-the-art layout adherence is unlocked through distribution tuning alone, without architectural modifications.

AI.tldr: 该论文揭示信噪比（SNR）分布是流匹配模型空间定位能力的关键决定因素：将训练重心转向高噪声阶段，可仅通过分布调优（无需架构改动）将布局遵循度从25.9%提升至80.8%，接近VAE重建上限83.6%，并在COCO上实现1.0→57.3 AP的跃升。
AI.motivation: 基础模型图像合成虽成功，但细粒度空间控制仍困难，通常需辅助结构适配器或复杂推理期引导。现有VLM文本编码器虽隐式编码空间坐标，生成模型却常无法利用；作者怀疑问题根源在于训练时SNR分布不当，而非架构缺失。
AI.method: 构建由几何基元组成的合成基准，剥离自然图像的纹理复杂度以隔离结构机制；提出严格的颜色感知布局度量量化空间保真度；对比中心化与高噪声偏移的SNR训练分布，并分析分辨率、宽高比方差的影响，以及在FLUX.1等模型噪声调度上的适用性。
AI.result: 中心化SNR训练布局遵循度仅25.9%；偏移至高噪声"关键学习阶段"后升至80.8%，接近VAE重建天花板83.6%；该需求随分辨率与宽高比方差增大而增强，FLUX.1等模型的保守噪声调度不足以实现精确布局；结论迁移至COCO，平均精度从1.0提升至57.3。
AI.conclusion: 空间定位的瓶颈在于噪声调度（SNR分布）而非架构；高噪声阶段是空间结构学习的关键期，仅通过分布调优即可解锁SOTA级布局遵循，为可控生成提供无需额外适配器的简洁新路径。

title: Nominate-then-Adjudicate: LLM-Assisted One-Pass and Per-Instance MIP Solver Tuning
comment: 10 pages, 7 figures, 6 tables. Accepted as a short paper at IEEE BigData 2026
summary: Mixed-integer programming solvers expose hundreds or even thousands of parameters whose best setting varies per instance, yet per-instance search is prohibitively expensive. We frame this as configuration for heterogeneous Big Data optimization workloads and propose a nominate-then-adjudicate pipeline built around two design choices. First, a fixed portfolio is sampled once and reused across instances, removing per-instance configuration search at inference; on the evaluated families, the resulting shortlist retains substantial oracle headroom, making selection within it the empirical focus. Second, the fixed 20-feature representation can map structurally different instances to the same vector, preventing a feature-only selector from distinguishing them even when they prefer different configurations. The foundation model receives no task-specific weight updates, and selection is one-pass: one model call and no solver calls at inference. The study represents structural Variety through distinct formulation families and decision Value through solver-performance outcomes; the one-call, zero-solve protocol specifies the decision interface and leaves end-to-end latency unmeasured. Among comparisons exceeding a 20% practical-difference threshold, the complete adjudicator records 538 wins and 185 losses against the top nominee, while its win rate against the default rises from 84.9% to 90.2%. Against per-instance configuration baselines under a matched one-pass protocol it leads the cluster-level methods and the best-performing evaluated per-instance baseline, ISAC+.

AI.tldr: 提出"先提名再裁决"（nominate-then-adjudicate）的MIP求解器参数配置流水线：固定参数组合组合集一次性采样跨实例复用，再用基础模型一次性裁决选择，实现推理时零求解调用。
AI.motivation: MIP求解器参数众多且最优设置因实例而异，但逐实例搜索代价过高；同时固定20维特征表示会把结构不同的实例映射为同一向量，导致纯特征选择器无法区分。论文面向异构大数据优化工作负载，寻求无需逐实例搜索的轻量配置方案。
AI.method: 两项设计：(1) 固定组合集只采样一次并跨实例复用，推理时取消逐实例配置搜索；(2) 基础模型不做任务特定权重更新，作一次性裁决（one-pass），推理仅一次模型调用、零次求解器调用。以不同模型族体现结构"多样性"，以求解性能体现决策"价值"。
AI.result: 在所评估族上，短名单保留了可观的oracle上调空间；完整裁决器相对最强提名者在超出20%实际差异阈值的比较中取得538胜185负；对默认配置的胜率由84.9%提升至90.2%；在匹配的一次性协议下优于聚类级方法与最佳逐实例基线ISAC+。
AI.conclusion: 固定组合集加基础模型一次性裁决可有效替代昂贵的逐实例参数搜索。局限：一次性零求解协议仅界定决策接口，端到端时延未测量；固定特征表示的歧义需依赖裁决器弥补。

title: Towards English - Mizo Legal Machine Translation: Corpus Creation, Analysis, and Benchmarks
summary: Indian court proceedings are held in English, so speakers of languages with limited translation technology have limited access to them. We present the first English Mizo parallel dataset of Indian court judgments. It contains 13,168 sentence pairs from the Gauhati High Court and the Supreme Court of India. Professional native Mizo translators translated complete documents; sentence pairs were manually aligned, and two independent reviewers checked the results. Our study finds that English words are borrowed in a very selective way: official and legal terms are almost always kept in English, but words for everyday things like actions, situations, and results are usually expressed in native Mizo. Mizo diacritics are also used inconsistently across the corpus. When we fine tune the NLLB 200 1.3B model on our training data, it scores 27.47 BLEU on a balanced legal test set of 1,000 sentence pairs, an improvement of 7.16 BLEU over the base model. However, it still uses English words about three times more often than a human translator does.

AI.tldr: 本文构建了首个英-米佐（Mizo）印度法院判决平行语料库（13,168句对），并基于微调NLLB-200 1.3B实现法律文本翻译，发现模型仍显著过度借用英语词汇。
AI.motivation: 印度法院以英语审理，米佐语等缺乏翻译技术的语言使用者难以获取司法信息，且此前无英-米佐法律平行数据。
AI.method: 由专业米佐语母语译者翻译完整判决文书（来自Gauhati高等法院与印度最高法院），人工句级对齐，并由两名独立评审核查；对语料中英语借词模式与变音符号使用进行分析；在训练集上微调NLLB-200 1.3B。
AI.result: 数据共13,168句对。借词具有选择性：官方与法律术语几乎保留英语，日常行为/情境/结果多用米佐语本土表达；变音符号使用不一致。微调后在1,000句对的均衡法律测试集上BLEU达27.47，较基座模型提升7.16，但英语词使用频率仍约为人工译者的三倍。
AI.conclusion: 该数据集为低资源法律翻译提供基础资源，并揭示法律域中借词规范与变音符标准化问题；现有模型在借词分布上与人工译者仍有较大差距，是后续改进方向。

title: CineEvolve: An Agentic Self-Evolution Framework for Cinematic Multi-Shot Video Generation
summary: Cinematic multi-shot video generation requires both narrative planning and iterative refinement. Existing methods either lack narrative reasoning or rely on feed-forward workflows without policy updates. In this paper, we propose CineEvolve, an agentic self-evolution framework for cinematic multi-shot video generation that unifies a Director and a Critic within a single vision-language policy. Emulating real-world filmmaking that couples iterative direction with critical feedback, we train CineEvolve via alternating reinforcement learning, where the Director surfaces flaws to sharpen the Critic, and the updated Critic guides the Director's targeted revisions. To stabilize co-evolution, we introduce Evolutionary GRPO (E-GRPO), leveraging historical anchoring and revision safeguarding to mitigate advantage inflation. Additionally, we contribute CineTraj, a 40K cinematic trajectory dataset spanning creation, critique, and revision. Extensive experiments demonstrate that CineEvolve outperforms existing approaches. Our code will be available at https://github.com/JingZhe-8/CineEvolve.

AI.tldr: 提出 CineEvolve，一个将"导演"和"评论家"统一在单一视觉语言策略中的智能体自进化框架，用交替强化学习实现电影级多镜头视频生成的叙事规划与迭代精修。
AI.motivation: 电影级多镜头视频生成需要叙事规划与迭代精修，但现有方法要么缺乏叙事推理能力，要么采用无策略更新的前馈式工作流，无法像真实拍片那样"指导—批评—再修改"地自我提升。
AI.method: 1）将 Director 与 Critic 统一到一个 VLM 策略中，模拟真实制片的"导演+评审"闭环；2）采用交替强化学习训练：Director 主动暴露缺陷以强化 Critic，更新后的 Critic 再引导 Director 做针对性修改；3）提出 Evolutionary GRPO（E-GRPO），通过历史锚定与修改保护机制缓解优势膨胀，稳定协同进化；4）构建 CineTraj，含 4 万条覆盖创作、批评与修改的电影轨迹数据集。
AI.result: 大量实验表明 CineEvolve 在电影级多镜头视频生成上优于现有方法；文中提出 E-GRPO 有效稳定了协同训练；并开源发布 CineTraj 数据集；代码将公开。
AI.conclusion: 将叙事规划与批评—修改循环统一到同一策略并以自进化交替强化学习训练，是提升多镜头视频生成质量的有效范式，历史锚定等技巧可保证训练稳定，具备可复现与推广价值。

title: Progressive Permutation Alignment with Temperature-Controlled Spectral Sharpening
summary: In implicit neural representations (INRs), 3D signals are encoded directly in network weights, making stable weight-space operations essential. However, permutation symmetry causes independently trained yet functionally equivalent models to appear distant in weight space, often inducing large loss barriers under linear interpolation. Existing neuron alignment methods either commit early to discrete matches and become trapped in inconsistent local optima or rely on computationally expensive gradient optimization over continuous relaxations, both of which are unreliable in challenging cases such as NeRF. We adopt progressive alignment, a layer-wise strategy that follows inter-layer dependencies from input to output. At each layer, a correlation matrix is estimated and aligned with a discrete anchor obtained by the Hungarian algorithm, after which temperature-controlled spectral annealing gradually sharpens the correlation structure toward a permutation matrix. This update is deterministic and lightweight, avoiding the inner-loop gradient optimization required by continuous relaxation methods. A final refinement stage further optimizes the network layer-by-layer via weight matching, starting from the aligned solution. Experiments on MLPs, CNNs, and Neural Radiance Fields (NeRFs) show that the proposed method reliably recovers neuron correspondences and achieves stable alignment across architectures. In practical experiments aligning independently trained NeRF models, our method reduces the loss barriers under weight interpolation compared with existing approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出一种逐层渐进式的神经元对齐方法，用匈牙利算法锚定+温度控制谱退火逐步锐化相关矩阵为置换矩阵，避免内层梯度优化，在MLP、CNN和NeRF上稳定恢复神经元对应关系并降低线性插值的损失壁垒。
AI.motivation: INR将3D信号直接编码在网络权重中，需要稳定的权重空间操作；但置换对称性使独立训练、功能等价的模型在权重空间中相距很远，线性插值出现大损失壁垒。现有神经元对齐方法要么过早锁定离散匹配陷入局部最优，要么依赖连续松弛上的昂贵梯度优化，在NeRF等困难场景不可靠。
AI.method: 采用渐进对齐的逐层策略，沿输入到输出方向遵循层间依赖。每层估计相关矩阵，以匈牙利算法得到的离散锚点进行对齐，再用温度控制的谱退火逐步将相关结构锐化为置换矩阵。该更新确定且轻量，无需连续松弛方法所需的内层梯度优化。最后以权重匹配方式进行逐层精修，从已对齐解出发进一步优化网络。
AI.result: 在MLP、CNN和NeRF上的实验表明，该方法能可靠恢复神经元对应关系，并在不同架构上实现稳定对齐。在实际对齐独立训练NeRF模型的实验中，相比现有方法降低了权重插值下的损失壁垒。
AI.conclusion: 逐层渐进对齐配合离散锚点与谱退火，是解决置换对称下INR权重空间对齐的有效、轻量方案，并可与精修阶段结合提升效果，尤其适用于NeRF这类挑战性任务。

title: CulturalRiddles: A Multicultural Benchmark of Riddles
summary: As LLMs expand their language coverage, evaluating how well they understand and represent diverse cultures becomes increasingly important. However, many benchmarks remain English-centric, with limited cultural coverage and a focus on factual knowledge over its application in real-world cultural contexts. We propose CulturalRiddles, a benchmark of original, culturally grounded riddles created entirely by humans through a participatory community effort, spanning 62 cultures (45 countries, 51 languages). These riddles are deeply rooted in their respective cultures and require abductive and compositional reasoning, alongside detailed factual and social knowledge, language skills, and an understanding of culturally specific associations. We benchmark 28 LLM configurations using both automatic and large-scale human evaluation. Even frontier models achieve at most 22% accuracy in some communities. We publicly release all artifacts alongside an open contribution process to expand the benchmark's linguistic and cultural coverage.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 CulturalRiddles，一个由人类通过社区参与式协作创作、覆盖 62 种文化（45 个国家和地区、51 种语言）的文化谜语基准，用于评测 LLM 的文化理解与应用能力；评测 28 种模型配置后发现，即便前沿模型在部分社区准确率最高也仅 22%。
AI.motivation: 随着 LLM 语言覆盖范围扩大，评估其文化理解与表征能力愈发重要。但现有基准多为英语中心，文化覆盖有限，且侧重事实性知识而非真实文化情境中的应用能力。
AI.method: 构建 CulturalRiddles：由社区参与式方式全部由人类原创、深植于本土文化的谜语，覆盖 62 种文化、45 个国家、51 种语言。这些谜语需要溯因与组合推理，并依赖细节性事实与社会知识、语言技能以及文化特定联想；随后采用自动评测与大规模人工评测对 28 种 LLM 配置进行基准测试。
AI.result: 即便前沿模型在部分社区中准确率最高也仅为 22%，说明模型在文化情境下的推理与知识应用能力仍存在显著不足。
AI.conclusion: 论文公开全部数据与制品，并建立开放贡献流程，以持续扩展基准的语言与文化覆盖范围，推动多文化 LLM 评估发展。

title: No Frames, Just Frequencies: Bandwidth-Efficient Deployment-Time Adaptation for Smart Glasses
summary: Deep neural networks deployed on smart glasses must adapt to changes in the distribution of incoming data while adhering to strict privacy and device constraints. We present No Frames, Just Frequencies, a bandwidth-efficient source-assisted adaptation framework that characterizes distribution shifts using compact frequency descriptors computed on-device. Rather than transmitting camera frames, the glasses compute and send frequency descriptors to a host device that contains a replica of the model. The host device maps the received frequency descriptor to a distribution shift operator that synthesizes out-of-distribution data and adapts a model replica using a pre-defined adaptation protocol. We evaluate the framework on mixtures of ImageNet-C corruptions using convolution-based (ConvNeXtV2-Femto), self-attention-based (DeiT-Tiny), and hybrid (TinyViT-5M) vision models, on person classification (Visual Wake Words), and on object detection (MS-COCO). Our results reveal that adaptation driven solely by the transmitted descriptors recovers $93-95\%$ of the supervised oracle adaptation gain on all three architectures, $82\%$ on Visual Wake Words and $94$--$98\%$ on MS-COCO. Notably, adaptation quality degrades gracefully as the descriptor resolution decreases from $224 $ to $28$ pixels, consistently across architectures, enabling bandwidth reductions from $213\times$ to $784\times$ across the frequency descriptors.

AI.tldr: 提出"No Frames, Just Frequencies"框架：智能眼镜端只计算并传输紧凑的频率描述符（而非图像帧），主机端将描述符映射为分布偏移算子，合成OOD数据并在模型副本上完成自适应，实现高带宽效率的隐私保护测试时自适应。
AI.motivation: 部署在智能眼镜上的深度网络需应对数据分布漂移，但受严格隐私与设备（带宽/算力）约束，无法传输原始帧或做端上重训练，需要一种既隐私安全又低带宽的自适应方案。
AI.method: 端侧对输入计算紧凑的频率描述符替代相机帧；主机端持有模型副本，将收到的描述符映射为分布偏移算子，合成OOD数据，并按预定义自适应协议更新模型副本。
AI.result: 在ImageNet-C混合腐化上，ConvNeXtV2-Femto、DeiT-Tiny、TinyViT-5M三种架构均恢复93–95%的监督oracle增益；Visual Wake Words上82%，MS-COCO上94–98%。描述符分辨率从224降至28像素时性能平缓退化，带宽降低213×–784×。
AI.conclusion: 仅凭传输的频率描述符即可驱动有效自适应，跨架构一致、随描述符分辨率下降而优雅退化，兼顾隐私、带宽与设备约束，适用于智能眼镜等边缘部署场景。

title: The Predictive--Optimization Gap in GuanDan Self-Play
summary: Outcome-predictive signals are often treated as promising optimization targets in reinforcement learning, but predictive validity and optimization utility are different claims. We expose this distinction in GuanDan, a multi-round imperfect-information game in which the implication of a round outcome depends on the public match state. Held-out analysis shows that state--gain interactions provide incremental predictive value beyond a constant signed-gain effect, establishing that match progress is predictively meaningful. We then use changes in a frozen match-win predictor, $ΔΦ$, as a controlled round-level supervision intervention in a matched DanZero-style Monte Carlo self-play protocol. The intervention can succeed in an individual lineage: a selected progress-augmented checkpoint substantially outperforms its matched Baseline on a locked evaluation. Yet the method-level result reverses this impression: none of five preregistered replication seeds is positive, the pooled ten-seed interval includes zero, and across-iteration effects repeatedly change sign without a common late-stage advantage. These results identify a predictive--optimization gap: under the studied learner, a signal can describe outcome-relevant progress while failing to provide a reliably beneficial optimization direction.

AI.tldr: 本文以掼蛋(GuanDan)为平台，区分"预测有效性"与"优化有效性"，发现虽然对局进度信号具有增量预测价值，但将其作为强化学习优化目标并不能带来可复现的性能提升，揭示了预测-优化差距。
AI.motivation: 强化学习中常把"能预测结果的信号"直接当作有前景的优化目标，但预测有效(能描述与结果相关的进展)与优化有效(能提供可靠有益的优化方向)是两个不同主张，二者被混为一谈，缺乏严格检验。
AI.method: 在多人多轮不完美信息博弈掼蛋中，(1)通过留出分析检验状态-收益交互是否在常数符号收益效应之外提供增量预测价值；(2)以冻结的比赛胜率预测器的变化ΔΦ作为受控的轮级监督干预，嵌入匹配的DanZero风格蒙特卡洛自我对弈协议中，并进行五种子预注册复现与合并十种子分析。
AI.result: 留出分析证实对局进度具有预测意义；在单条训练谱系中，选定的进度增强检查点在锁定评测上显著优于匹配的基线。但方法层面结果反转：五个预注册复现种子无一为正，合并十种子的置信区间包含零，且跨迭代效应反复变号，不存在共同的后期优势。
AI.conclusion: 在所研究的learner下存在"预测-优化差距"：一个信号可以刻画与结果相关的进展，却无法提供可靠有益的优化方向；因此单谱系/单检查点的成功不能替代方法级的可复现验证。

title: Remembering Through Change: Provenance-Preserving Hypergraph Memory for Multimodal Agents
summary: Long-term memory for multimodal agents remains challenging, as it must preserve fine-grained visual evidence while tracking entity evolution across sessions. Existing abstraction-based memories compress images into text, often discarding visually discriminative details, whereas pixel-preserving memories retain raw observations but struggle to reliably associate diverse observations with persistent entity identities and track their evolving states. To address these limitations, we propose MHG-Mem, a multimodal hypergraph memory that jointly organizes entity identity, state evolution, and provenance to visual evidence. Specifically, MHG-Mem represents distinct entity mentions and their observed facts as individual nodes, grouping identity-consistent mentions and facts through occurrence hyperedges. It then synthesizes aspect-specific evolution states from these grouped observations and links them to supporting entities, facts, and source evidence through evolutionary and evidential hyperedges. To navigate this structured memory, we introduce hypergraph-based agentic search, which adaptively selects an entry layer, traverses typed hyperedges across memory levels, and inspects source observations when fine-grained verification is required. These designs support both detailed visual verification and reasoning over cross-session state changes. Extensive experiments across three benchmarks demonstrate the effectiveness of MHG-Mem, improving performance by 8.20-9.98% over the strongest baseline.

AI.tldr: 提出MHG-Mem多模态超图记忆，将实体身份、状态演化与视觉证据溯源统一组织，并配合超图智能体搜索，在三个基准上较最强基线提升8.20-9.98%。
AI.motivation: 多模态智能体长期记忆需同时保留细粒度视觉证据并跟踪跨会话实体演化。现有抽象式记忆把图像压缩为文本会丢失视觉辨别细节；像素保留式记忆虽保留原始观测，却难以将多样观测可靠关联到持久实体身份并追踪其演化状态。
AI.method: 构建多模态超图记忆：将实体提及及其观测事实作为独立节点，用共现超边聚合身份一致的提及与事实；据此合成方面特定的演化状态，并通过演化超边和证据超边连接到支持实体、事实与源证据。配合超图智能体搜索：自适应选择入口层，跨记忆层级遍历类型化超边，并在需要细粒度验证时检查源观测。
AI.result: 在三个基准上验证有效，相比最强基线提升8.20-9.98%。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式建模实体身份、状态演化与视觉证据溯源的结构化多模态记忆，可同时支持细粒度视觉验证与跨会话状态变化推理，优于纯文本抽象或纯像素保留方案。

title: Diff-IrisPAD: Modeling Bona Fide Iris Distributions for Unsupervised Presentation Attack Detection
summary: Iris recognition systems are vulnerable to presentation attacks (PAs), including textured contact lenses, print replays, and synthetic irises. Existing PAD methods rely on supervised learning with attack data, limiting generalization to unseen attacks and new sensors. We propose Diff-IrisPAD, an unsupervised framework based on Brownian Bridge Diffusion that models bona fide iris distributions without using attack samples. The method reconstructs clean iris textures from degraded inputs and detects attacks via reconstruction inconsistency using ViT scoring and pixel-level measures. Experiments on a large-scale multi-sensor dataset (125K+ images, NIR and VIS, 8 attack types) show that Diff-IrisPAD achieves an overall ACER of 30.52, significantly outperforming diffusion-based baselines while demonstrating strong generalization to unseen attacks. These results highlight the effectiveness of diffusion-based bona fide modeling for robust and scalable iris PAD.

AI.tldr: 提出无监督框架Diff-IrisPAD，基于布朗桥扩散建模真实虹膜分布，仅用真样本即可检测多种呈现攻击并泛化到未见攻击。
AI.motivation: 现有虹膜PAD依赖有监督学习与攻击数据，难以泛化到未见攻击类型和新传感器。
AI.method: 基于Brownian Bridge Diffusion的无监督框架，仅学习真实虹膜分布；从退化输入重建干净虹膜纹理，利用ViT打分与像素级度量刻画重建不一致性来判别攻击。
AI.result: 在12.5万+图像、NIR与VIS、8类攻击的多传感器大规模数据集上，整体ACER为30.52，显著优于扩散类基线，并对未见攻击展现强泛化性。
AI.conclusion: 扩散式真样本建模对稳健、可扩展的虹膜PAD有效，为无需攻击数据的PAD提供可行路径。

title: Alternative Strategies for Active Learning with Bayesian Bradley Terry Model
summary: Comparative judgement uses pairwise comparisons to rank items, but recovering accurate rankings from a limited number of judgements depends on both the inference method and the pairs selected. We developed a Bayesian Bradley-Terry model (BBTM) that uses Polya-Gamma data augmentation for efficient Gibbs sampling and quantifies uncertainty in latent abilities and ranks. We propose three active learning strategies based on the knowledge gradient (KG) principle. We define our acquisition functions using Kendall's tau distance, posterior rank entropy, and posterior separation. Approximate one-step updates to posterior moments reduce the computational cost of evaluating candidate pairs. We also introduce Posterior Separation Reliability (PSR), which measures the spread of posterior mean abilities relative to posterior uncertainty. It provides an internal indicator of ranking reliability without requiring a reference ranking. In synthetic experiments covering different item counts, comparison budgets, and noise levels, BBTM generally recovers ranking more accurately than preference-based Bayesian comparative judgement (PBCJ). At low to moderate noise levels, the pairwise entropy pair selection strategy performs best in ranking recovery. However, at the highest noise levels, the KG strategy based on posterior separation produces better point rankings. PSR increases alongside improvements in ranking accuracy as comparisons accumulate. Robustness experiments identify the proportion of informative outcomes needed to meet specified accuracy targets within a fixed comparison budget. In a moderate noise setting, replacing 30\% of outcomes with random choices has little effect on ranking performance. These findings demonstrate the value of Bayesian inference and active learning pair selection for recovering ranks from limited, noisy paired comparisons.

AI.tldr: 提出贝叶斯Bradley-Terry模型(BBTM)结合主动学习配对选择,从有限含噪成对比较中更准确恢复排序,并给出无需参考排序的可靠性指标PSR。
AI.motivation: 成对比较的排序准确性同时依赖推断方法和所选配对的策略;有限判断次数下,需要量化的不确定性、高效的采样与更聪明的配对选择。
AI.method: BBTM采用Polya-Gamma数据增广实现高效Gibbs采样,量化潜在能力与排名的不确定性;基于knowledge gradient提出三种主动学习策略,分别以Kendall tau距离、后验排名熵、后验分离度定义采集函数,并用后验矩的近似一步更新降低候选配对评估成本;另提出PSR(后验均值能力分散度相对后验不确定性)作为内部可靠性指标。
AI.result: 在项目数、比较预算与噪声水平不同的合成实验中,BBTM总体优于PBCJ;中低噪声下成对熵配对策略排序恢复最佳,最高噪声下基于后验分离的KG策略点排序更好;PSR随比较累积与精度同步上升;中等噪声下30%结果为随机选择几乎不影响性能,并识别出达标所需信息性结果比例。
AI.conclusion: 贝叶斯推断与主动学习配对选择对从有限、含噪成对比较中恢复排名具有明确价值,且PSR可在无参考排序时提示可靠性。

title: Building Auditable AI Text Detectors with Sparse Autoencoders
summary: AI-generated text detectors are increasingly deployed in consequential settings---peer review, education, admissions, journalism, and content moderation---where their outputs directly affect individuals. Yet the strongest detectors are fine-tuned neural classifiers whose decisions are opaque, while transparent alternatives (stylometric and linguistic-feature classifiers) underperform them by wide margins. We present a pipeline that converts a fine-tuned neural detector into a classifier that operates on human-readable concepts. We accomplish this by training sparse autoencoders (SAEs) directly on a detector's residual stream, assigning auto-interpretation labels to each SAE feature, and retaining only features whose generated descriptions pass a global fidelity threshold. We then train a lightweight classifier on just the interpretable features. We find that our SAEs recover latent concepts that correspond to highly specific and predictive linguistic "tells" of AI-generated text. Classifiers built on these extracted features are not only highly interpretable but exhibit stronger performance on out-of-distribution texts than either neural or stylometric alternatives.

AI.tldr: 将微调神经网络AI文本检测器的残差流上训练稀疏自编码器(SAE)，把特征映射为人类可读概念，再在可解释特征上训练轻量分类器，兼顾解释性与分布外泛化。
AI.motivation: AI生成文本检测器已用于同行评审、教育、招生、新闻和内容审核等高影响场景，直接左右个人命运。但最强检测器是决策不透明的微调神经分类器，而透明替代方案（文体计量与语言特征分类器）性能又明显落后，存在"性能与可解释性不可兼得"的矛盾。
AI.method: 直接在检测器的残差流上训练稀疏自编码器，对每个SAE特征做自动解释标注(auto-interpretation)，仅保留生成的描述通过全局保真度阈值的特征，然后只用这些可解释特征训练轻量分类器。
AI.result: SAE恢复了对应高度具体且具预测力的AI文本语言"破绽"的潜在概念；基于这些特征的分类器不仅高度可解释，在分布外文本上的表现还优于神经分类器和文体计量方法。
AI.conclusion: 通过SAE将黑箱检测器"翻译"为人类可读概念分类器，可同时获得可解释性和更强的分布外鲁棒性，为高风险场景下可信AI检测提供了路径。

title: An interpretable deep learning method for early hepatocellular carcinoma diagnosis on multiphase CT
summary: Early diagnosis of hepatocellular carcinoma is critical to preserve access to curative treatment options. The Liver Imaging Reporting and Data System (LI-RADS) provides a standardized framework for non-invasive diagnosis on multiphase computed tomography, based on major visual imaging features. However, these features may be difficult to assess consistently, particularly in small liver lesions. We developed dLI-RADS, an interpretable artificial intelligence method designed to estimate the probability of hepatocellular carcinoma from multiphase computed tomography images of manually segmented liver lesions, while remaining aligned with LI-RADS-related imaging concepts. dLI-RADS combines neural network-derived predictions with handcrafted quantitative imaging measurements reflecting LI-RADS major features and integrates these inputs using logistic regression. In this multicenter retrospective study, patients with multiphase computed tomography and at least one liver lesion were included, while lesions larger than 40 mm were excluded. Histology served as the reference standard for hepatocellular carcinoma, and a composite reference standard was used for non-hepatocellular carcinoma lesions. The lesion-level accuracy of dLI-RADS and LI-RADS were compared on the internal evaluation set using 10,000-repetition bootstrap non-inferiority tests, with 5% margins and significance levels. On the external test set, sensitivities were similarly compared. dLI-RADS was non-inferior to LI-RADS for lesion-level accuracy in the internal evaluation set, achieving 80% accuracy compared with 74% for LI-RADS (p = 0.04)...

AI.tldr: 提出dLI-RADS——一种与LI-RADS概念对齐的可解释AI方法，融合神经网络预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的手工影像定量测量，经逻辑回归整合，在多中心回顾性数据上诊断肝细胞癌（HCC）；内部集病灶级准确率80% vs LI-RADS 74%，达到非劣效。
AI.motivation: HCC早期诊断对保留根治性治疗机会至关重要；LI-RADS提供基于多期CT主要视觉特征的无创诊断标准框架，但这些视觉特征评估一致性差，尤其在小型肝病灶中难以判断。
AI.method: 多中心回顾性研究，纳入有多期CT且至少一个肝病灶的患者，排除>40mm病灶；HCC以组织学为参考标准，非HCC采用复合参考标准。dLI-RADS对人工分割的病灶，将神经网络预测与反映LI-RADS主要特征的手工定量影像测量结合，用逻辑回归整合。内部评估集上以10,000次重复bootstrap做5%界值、显著性水平的非劣效检验比较dLI-RADS与LI-RADS的病灶级准确率，外部测试集比较敏感度。
AI.result: 内部评估集：dLI-RADS病灶级准确率80%，LI-RADS为74%，非劣效检验p=0.04；外部测试集敏感度比较结果（摘要未完整给出）表明二者相当。
AI.conclusion: dLI-RADS在保持与LI-RADS影像概念对齐、具备可解释性的同时，病灶级诊断表现不劣于放射科医师使用的LI-RADS，显示出作为标准化可解释HCC无创诊断辅助工具的潜力。

title: Generalization Bounds via Vector-Valued $L_p$ Correlation $V_α$
summary: Understanding generalization of randomized learning algorithms remains a central challenge. Mutual-information and total-variation bounds provide complementary ways to quantify data--hypothesis dependence, but they can behave quite differently in high-dimensional regimes. We study a one-parameter family of dependence measures, the vector-valued $L_p$-norm correlation $V_α$, and derive generalization bounds whose dependence terms interpolate between total variation (TV) at $α=1$ and variance and $χ^2$ related behavior at $α=2$. For $α>2$, the Hölder-conjugate loss moment is below two, yielding heavy-tailed specializations that can remain finite even when the loss variance is infinite. A particularly interpretable specialization occurs at $α=2$, where the bound can be expressed in terms of the variability of the algorithm's output density across datasets, $\int \sqrt{\mathrm{Var}_S[p(w\mid S)]}~ dw$. We show that the entire $V_α$ family is invariant under smooth bijective reparameterizations of the hypothesis space. We also introduce an adaptive density stability (ADS) condition that implies explicit control of $V_2$, and we verify it for Gibbs-type posteriors under bounded losses (yielding rates that depend on the inverse temperature and sample size). To address scaling, we extend the framework to a conditional formulation using supersamples, analogous in spirit to conditional mutual information (CMI), and discuss evaluations in the output space as a practical surrogate for estimating dependence. Simulations on Bayesian linear regression illustrate how tuning $α$ can change the tightness of the resulting bounds across regimes. Additional supersample experiments on noisy MNIST and on a pretrained ResNet-50 for CIFAR-10 show similar behavior of the projected loss-space bounds beyond the original clean-MNIST setting.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究随机学习算法的泛化界，提出一族依赖度量——向量值 L_p 范数相关 V_α，把总变差（α=1）、方差/χ²（α=2）与重尾情形（α>2）统一起来，并给出可解释、重参数化不变的泛化界及条件化（supersample）扩展。
AI.motivation: 互信息界与总变差界在量化数据—假设依赖时互补，但在高维情形行为差异很大，缺乏统一视角；同时希望泛化界具备重参数化不变性、能处理重尾损失，并可扩展到大规模场景。
AI.method: 定义单参数族向量值 L_p 范数相关 V_α，导出依赖项在 TV 与方差/χ² 之间插值的泛化界；α=2 时以输出密度跨数据集的变异性 ∫√Var_S[p(w|S)] dw 表达；给出 V_α 在光滑双射重参数化下的不变性；提出自适应密度稳定性（ADS）条件以显式控制 V_2，并在有界损失下的 Gibbs 型后验中验证；用 supersample 做条件化扩展（类比 CMI），并以输出空间评估作为依赖估计的实用代理。
AI.result: α>2 时 Hölder 共轭损失矩低于二阶，得到重尾特化界，即使损失方差无穷仍可有限；Gibbs 后验下 ADS 给出依赖逆温与样本量的显式速率；贝叶斯线性回归仿真显示调节 α 可改变不同 regime 下的界紧致程度；noisy MNIST 与 CIFAR-10 上 ResNet-50 的 supersample 实验在投影损失空间呈现类似行为。
AI.conclusion: V_α 族提供了一个统一互信息型与 TV 型依赖度量的泛化框架，兼具重参数化不变性、重尾适应性与可扩展性，α 与输出空间代理成为实践中调节与估计的有效手段。

title: FogTTA: Online Test-Time Adaptation for Robust Transformer-based Object Detection in Foggy Weather
comment: Published in Proceedings of the 39th Canadian Conference on Artificial Intelligence (Canadian AI 2026), PMLR 318:13-24. Available at https://proceedings.mlr.press/v318/abedi26a.html
summary: Object detection models for autonomous driving commonly experience substantial performance drops when deployed under adverse weather due to the domain shift between training data and real-world operating conditions. This degradation is especially evident when models trained on clear-weather images encounter foggy environments with reduced visibility and contrast. To address this challenge, we introduce FogTTA, an online test-time adaptation framework designed to improve the robustness of Transformer-based object detectors in fog. Using RF-DETR as the underlying object detector, FogTTA enables real-time adaptation to the streaming target domain without requiring source data or retraining. The framework follows a teacher-student design, where the deployed model serves as the teacher and generates pseudo labels from weakly augmented target inputs. These predictions are subsequently refined through non-maximum suppression and confidence filtering. The student model then learns from strongly augmented target sample using the Varifocal loss to mitigate pseudo-label noise. The teacher is updated via exponential moving averaging to ensure stable and continuous adaptation. Experiments show that FogTTA outperforms prior baselines, delivering improved detection accuracy and stability while maintaining real-time performance.

AI.tldr: 提出FogTTA——一种面向雾天场景的在线测试时自适应框架，基于RF-DETR检测器，用师生自训练与伪标签精炼提升Transformer目标检测器在雾中的鲁棒性。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶目标检测模型因训练数据与真实部署条件（如雾天低能见度、低对比度）存在域偏移，性能显著下降；且现有方案需源数据或重新训练，难以实时适应流式目标域。
