Experimental results in real-world datasets demonstrate that incorporating reviews into the recommendation process improves the precision of the recommendation.

AI.tldr: 提出SOAR模型，融合用户好友网络与文本评论（尤其是评论情感），用于兴趣点（POI）个性化推荐，实验表明引入评论可提高推荐精度。
AI.motivation: 在线平台推荐面临难点：复杂用户行为、习惯与偏好演化难以分析，需及时推荐相关内容；POI推荐还需识别影响用户行为的因素、刻画用户倾向，并为每个个体生成准确的个性化推荐。
AI.method: SOAR（Social and Opinion Aware Recommendation）：同时利用用户友谊网络与文本评论，判断某地点是否适合特定用户，重点关注共享评论的情感倾向。
AI.result: 在真实数据集上的实验表明，将评论纳入推荐过程可提升推荐精度。
AI.conclusion: 社交关系与评论情感信息对POI推荐有效，融合二者可改善个性化推荐效果。

title: GuidedSAM-Plume: An Expert-Guided Segmentation Framework for Volcanic Plumes
summary: Quantitative analysis of environmental phenomena increasingly relies on image-based measurements. In volcanology, the geometric characterization of volcanic plumes and clouds from RGB images remains hindered by the scarcity of dedicated segmentation solutions and partially handcrafted annotations remain widely prevalent. We present GuidedSAM-Plume, an open-source expert-guided framework tailored for the interactive segmentation of volcanic plumes and clouds. It leverages the zero-shot, spatial prompt-based capabilities of SAM2. The framework was thoroughly validated on a challenging dataset through dedicated segmentation metrics and field-relevant volcanological descriptors. From minimal user inputs, it is able to significantly increase performance compared to fully automatic dedicated solutions while preserving the reliability of derived volcanological parameters. The absence of retraining requirements lowers adoption barriers within the volcanological community, and the framework's demonstrated suitability for complex, diffuse plume-shaped phenomena extends its applicability to broader environmental science domains. The re-annotated dataset, produced under the guidance of expert volcanologists within the proposed framework, ultimately yields a more standardized release. The framework and accompanying dataset are made available at https://github.com/tad-damo/GuidedSAM-Plume.

AI.tldr: GuidedSAM-Plume：基于SAM2零样本空间提示的开源专家引导交互式分割框架，用于火山羽流与云的RGB图像分割，仅需极少用户输入即可超越全自动专用方案，并保持火山学参数可靠性。
AI.motivation: 火山羽流与云的几何刻画日益依赖图像测量，但专用分割方案稀缺，且标注仍多为半手工方式，制约了定量分析的一致性与推广。
AI.method: 利用SAM2的零样本、基于空间提示的能力构建专家引导交互式分割框架；在挑战性数据集上用专门分割指标与领域相关火山学描述符进行验证；无需重训练。
AI.result: 在极少先验输入下显著优于全自动专用解决方案，同时保持所导出的火山学参数的可靠性；在复杂、弥散状羽流形态上表现良好。
AI.conclusion: 免重训练降低社区采用门槛，可拓展至更广泛环境科学领域；在专家引导下重标注的数据集更具标准化价值，框架与数据集已开源。

title: Implicit Feature Reweighting for Label-Free Graph Generalization
comment: We propose an implicit feature reweighting method to enhance graph-level OOD generalization without class labels
summary: Graph-level out-of-distribution (OOD) generalization is critical for deploying graph neural networks in real-world applications where distribution shifts are inevitable. Existing approaches typically require class labels during representation learning to decide which substructures are predictive, limiting their applicability. We propose SCARCE, a label-free representation-learning framework that yields distribution-shift-robust graph representations from an environment partition of the training graphs alone, whether that partition comes from dataset metadata or, when none is available, from clustering a self-supervised embedding. Our method operates in two stages: (1) a variational graph autoencoder is warm-started for graph reconstruction; and (2) an adversarial confusion mechanism forces the encoder to produce representations from which a discriminator cannot distinguish environments, while preserving graph-reconstruction fidelity. We provide theoretical analysis showing that environment confusion contracts environment-discriminative directions in the representation space, which, under regularized downstream classifiers, is equivalent to imposing a stronger directional penalty on environment-associated features. This feature-reweighting mechanism reduces reliance on spurious correlations without erasing information, offering a label-free, continuous relaxation of last-layer reweighting methods. Experiments on a controlled synthetic datasets and the DrugOOD datasets show that SCARCE achieves state-of-the-art OOD generalization among label-free methods, using no class labels during representation learning.

AI.tldr: SCARCE 是一个无需类别标签的图表示学习框架，仅依赖训练图的环境划分（元数据或自监督嵌入聚类），通过变分图自编码器预热与对抗混淆机制学习对分布偏移鲁棒的图表示。
AI.motivation: 图级 OOD 泛化对图神经网络的实际部署至关重要，但现有方法在表示学习中需要类别标签来判断哪些子结构具有预测性，限制了其适用范围。
AI.method: 分两阶段：(1) 用图重构任务预热变分图自编码器；(2) 引入对抗混淆机制，使判别器无法从编码器输出中区分环境，同时保持图重构保真度。环境划分可来自数据集元数据，无元数据时则对自监督嵌入聚类获得。
AI.result: 理论分析表明，环境混淆会在表示空间中压缩环境可判别方向，在正则化下游分类器下等价于对环境相关特征施加更强的方向性惩罚，从而降低对虚假相关性的依赖且不抹除信息，可视为末层重加权方法的无标签连续松弛。在受控合成数据集和 DrugOOD 数据集上，SCARCE 在无标签方法中达到最先进的 OOD 泛化性能。
AI.conclusion: SCARCE 证明了在表示学习阶段不使用类别标签也能有效提升图级 OOD 泛化，为无标签场景下的鲁棒图表示学习提供了可行方案。

title: Early versus Late RGB-Infrared Fusion for Counter-UAV Detection: A Comparative Study
comment: This version differs from the article published in IEEE Access. It includes revisions requested by the reviewers during the final review round that could not be incorporated into the published version
summary: This paper presents a novel strategy for UAV detection through visible (RGB) and infrared (IR) fusion, in order to improve accuracy and precision in harsh environments and weather conditions. In this research, two opposite approaches have been studied and implemented: the first concerns image-level (early) fusion, which merges two different spectra into a single image to which one detector is applied. On the other hand, the second approach, called decision-level (late) fusion, focuses on blending together the output bounding boxes of two different detection pipelines, aiming to create a common result that can be applied to both spectra simultaneously. Both strategies have been extensively tested in a dedicated environment, which included alternating low and high brightness scenes, different backgrounds (sky and ground), distances (5, 25 and 60 m), altitudes and zoom levels (1X, 2X and 4X). These tests allowed for the assessment of actual detection capabilities and system reliability in real-world applications. Furthermore, the two fusion strategies were evaluated and compared over a set of aligned images in order to highlight the better approach of the two. The results indicate that early fusion achieves better raw performance, since it incorporates the thermal information from the beginning of the training process. However, late fusion presents an innovative and useful detection workflow that can be applied in cases of sensor or frame misalignment. Both positive and negative aspects have also been pointed out and discussed, in order to give a more comprehensive overview. Finally, the paper outlines implementation considerations and practical recommendations based on operational priorities. Overall, the findings contribute to the research in RGB-IR fusion modalities, with the goal of enhancing UAV detection capabilities.

AI.tldr: 本文研究无人机检测中RGB与红外图像的融合策略，对比了图像级（早期）融合与决策级（晚期）融合两种方案，通过多场景实验证明早期融合原始性能更优，而晚期融合在传感器或帧失配时更具实用性。
AI.motivation: 在恶劣环境与天气条件下，单一光谱（可见光）检测无人机精度不足，需要融合RGB与红外信息以提升检测准确性和鲁棒性，因此需明确哪种融合策略更有效、更实用。
AI.method: 实现并对比两种对立的融合方式：图像级（早期）融合将两个光谱合成单幅图像后输入单一检测器；决策级（晚期）融合则结合两条检测流程输出的边界框以得到可同时用于两个光谱的统一结果。在专门环境中测试，涵盖明暗场景交替、天空与地面背景、5/25/60米距离、不同高度及1X/2X/4X变焦，并在对齐图像集上对两种策略进行评估比较。
AI.result: 早期融合取得更好的原始检测性能，因为它从训练开始就融入了热红外信息；晚期融合则提供了一种创新且实用的检测工作流，适用于传感器或帧失配的情况。
AI.conclusion: 论文系统分析了两种融合策略的优缺点并给出实施考量与实用建议，为RGB-IR融合模态及无人机检测能力提升提供参考；优先选择取决于实际运行需求。

title: Private Online Prediction from Experts with Small Losses
summary: We consider online prediction from experts, a fundamental problem in machine learning, under differential privacy constraints. Existing private algorithms achieve near-optimal regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{T})$, where $T$ is the time horizon. However, this bound becomes suboptimal when $L^\star$, the cumulative loss of the best expert, is significantly less than $T$. In this work, we present the first differentially private algorithm with regret $\tilde{O}(\sqrt{L^\star})$, offering a substantial improvement in the low-loss regime. Our regret bound matches the non-private lower bound up to poly-logarithmic factors for constant privacy parameters, demonstrating that privacy incurs only a small cost in this setting. Our result assumes that the input sequence is oblivious, i.e., it is fixed in advance and independent of the algorithm's outputs. We also prove that an $\tildeΩ(\sqrt{T})$ regret is inevitable for adaptively generated inputs, even when $L^\star = 0$.

AI.tldr: 本文研究差分隐私约束下的在线专家预测问题，首次给出在低损失情形下 regret 为 Õ(√L*) 的私有算法，达到（除多项对数因子外）非私有下界，并证明自适应输入下 Õ(√T) 无法避免。
AI.motivation: 已有的差分隐私在线专家算法 regret 为 Õ(√T)，但当最优专家累计损失 L* 远小于 T 时该界次优，因此需要在低损失情形下改进私有 regret 界。
AI.method: 提出一种新的差分隐私在线学习算法（基于 oblivious 输入假设），使其 regret 依赖于 L* 而非 T；并给出针对自适应输入的下界构造证明。
AI.result: 私有 regret 达到 Õ(√L*)；对常数隐私参数与不依赖隐私的非私有下界在多项对数因子内匹配，说明隐私代价很小。同时证明自适应输入下即使 L*=0，Õ(√T) regret 也是不可避免的。
AI.conclusion: 在 oblivious 输入下，隐私在低损失区域几乎不带来额外代价；但自适应输入下存在本质障碍，说明 oblivious 假设是该改进的必要条件。

title: Revealing Hidden Failure Modes in Chest X-ray Classification via Spectral Domain Analysis
summary: Deep learning models for chest X-ray anomaly detection remain vulnerable to subtle distributional shifts (e.g., acquisition technique, patient-related factors, and preprocessing). Traditional error analysis often relies on semantic metadata or model embeddings, which can mask low-level signal variations that degrade performance. In this work, we propose a data-centric framework for automated failure mode discovery using spectral analysis. We project images into the frequency domain and extract a compact profile summarizing the distribution of signal energy across frequency bands. By performing unsupervised clustering on these spectral profiles, we demonstrate that model failures are not randomly distributed, but are strongly concentrated within specific spectral clusters. This method effectively isolates "blind spots", enabling the prediction of model reliability and the discovery of performance-degrading data slices without requiring ground-truth failure annotations.

AI.tldr: 提出一种以数据为中心、基于频谱分析的框架，将胸片投影到频域并提取紧凑的频谱能量分布画像，再通过无监督聚类发现模型失败模式，表明失败强烈集中在特定频谱簇中，从而在无需人工失败标注的情况下定位"盲点"。
AI.motivation: 胸片异常检测的深度学习模型对细微分布偏移（采集技术、患者相关因素、预处理）仍很脆弱。传统误差分析依赖语义元数据或模型嵌入，容易掩盖导致性能下降的低层信号变化，因此需要一种能暴露低层信号差异的失败模式发现方法。
AI.method: 将图像投影到频域，提取概括各频带信号能量分布的紧凑频谱画像；对这些频谱画像进行无监督聚类；再分析模型失败在各频谱簇中的分布，以隔离"盲点"并预测模型可靠性。
AI.result: 模型失败并非随机分布，而是强烈集中在特定的频谱簇中；该方法能有效隔离盲点，实现模型可靠性预测，并在无需真实失败标注的情况下发现导致性能下降的数据切片。
AI.conclusion: 频谱画像聚类是一种有效的、以数据为中心的自动化失败模式发现工具，可作为传统基于语义元数据或嵌入的误差分析的替代/补充手段，用于胸片AI模型的可靠性评估与数据切片诊断。

title: The Reflexivity Threshold: A Phase Transition for Multi-Agent Performative Prediction
comment: Accepted at NeurIPS 2026. 20 pages, including appendix and checklist. Code: https://github.com/AhmedMahrous00/reflexivity-threshold
summary: Many learning systems are performative: once deployed, their predictions change the data distribution on which future models are trained. In multi-agent settings, this feedback is routed through a network of interacting learners, so stability depends not only on the strength of performativity but also on who affects whom. We study repeated retraining in multi-agent performative prediction and identify a spectral threshold that separates stable learning from worst-case learning obstruction. Prior work often collapses cross-agent feedback into a scalar contraction constant, missing this network structure. We instead introduce the reflexivity matrix $Γ$, which records how strongly one agent's deployment can move another agent's best response, defined from per-agent gradient sensitivities and curvature parameters. The threshold occurs when the spectral radius of this matrix crosses one. Below the threshold, repeated retraining converges geometrically to a unique performatively stable equilibrium, with cumulative excess loss bounded uniformly in the time horizon. Above the threshold, we construct noisy supercritical instances in which every local-information learner incurs expected cumulative excess loss growing linearly for horizons up to order $1/(ρ(Γ)-1)$. Together, these results characterize the threshold behavior through upper and lower bounds and recover the single-agent scalar threshold from prior work as a special case.

AI.tldr: 该论文研究多智能体表演性预测中的重复再训练稳定性，提出"自反性矩阵"Γ，并证明当其谱半径跨过1时，学习从稳定收敛突变为最坏情形下的学习障碍。
AI.motivation: 现有工作常把跨智能体反馈压缩为单一收缩常数，忽略了"谁影响谁"的网络结构；而多智能体表演性系统中稳定性不仅取决于表演性强弱，还取决于交互拓扑。
AI.method: 定义自反性矩阵Γ，记录一个智能体部署对其余智能体最优响应的影响强度，由各智能体的梯度敏感性与曲率参数构造；以谱半径ρ(Γ)刻画阈值，并分别给出上下界分析（收敛性证明与构造性下界实例）。
AI.result: ρ(Γ)<1时，重复再训练几何收敛到唯一表演性稳定均衡，累积超额损失在时间跨度上一致有界；ρ(Γ)>1时，构造含噪超临界实例，使任何局部信息学习者的期望累积超额损失在时域至多1/(ρ(Γ)−1)阶内线性增长。单智能体标量阈值作为特例被恢复。
AI.conclusion: 多智能体表演性学习的稳定性由自反性矩阵谱半径的临界阈值为1所决定，上下界共同刻画了阈值行为，强调网络结构而非单一收缩系数的重要性。

title: How Do DiTs Denoise? An Aggregator-Predictor View of Attention and MLPs
summary: How do diffusion transformers (DiTs) represent image content and learn rules for reusing it to generalize? We develop an aggregator--predictor view of DiTs as input-adaptive local denoisers, in which context aggregation and patch prediction provide functional roles for interpreting attention and MLPs. We first establish that, for Gaussian Markov random field (GMRF) priors, the global Bayes denoiser can be approximated using only a subset of context patches, with error decaying exponentially in context radius. We further show that patchwise linear denoisers, often invoked to explain diffusion generalization, recover the empirical local denoiser with sufficiently informative aggregation. Within this view, AdaLN-modulated attention naturally parameterizes an input- and noise-dependent aggregator, while the MLP admits a learned key--value representation for tokenwise patch prediction. Our experiments support this view. DiTs trained on real images exhibit noise-dependent denoising contexts resembling those in the analytic GMRF setting, while attention mass exhibits a qualitatively corresponding broadening pattern. In a controlled CelebA64 study, shared-memory patch predictors used in place of DiT MLPs achieve competitive denoising and generative performance. Finally, cross-dataset component transplantation reveals compatibility patterns consistent with the proposed roles of QK in spatial weighting, VO in feature transport, and MLPs in patch prediction. Together, these results provide a component-level account of DiT denoising and motivate architecture-specific fine-tuning and controlled intervention.

AI.tldr: 本文提出"聚合器—预测器"视角解释DiT：attention充当输入与噪声自适应的局部上下文聚合，MLP充当逐patch预测，并用理论与实验验证。
AI.motivation: 理解DiT如何表征图像内容、如何学习"复用规则"以泛化，此前缺乏组件级别的功能解释。
AI.method: 将DiT刻画为输入自适应的局部去噪器：(1)证明GMRF先验下全局贝叶斯去噪器可只用部分上下文patch逼近，误差随上下文半径指数衰减；(2)表明足够信息化的聚合下，逐patch线性去噪器可恢复经验局部去噪器；(3)对应注意力=AdaLN调制的聚合器，MLP=学习的key-value patch预测器。实验：真实图像DiT的噪声依赖去噪上下文、CelebA64中用共享记忆patch预测器替换MLP、跨数据集组件移植。
AI.result: DiT呈现与GMRF解析设定相似的噪声依赖上下文，注意力质量有相应展宽；共享记忆预测器替代MLP可达竞争性去噪与生成性能；组件移植显示QK负责空间加权、VO负责特征搬运、MLP负责patch预测的兼容性规律。
AI.conclusion: 给出DiT去噪的组件级解释，启发架构特定微调与受控干预。

title: Fast Bayesian Optimization Through Linear Models
summary: Bayesian optimization (BO) is typically used only for problems where the underlying function is deemed "expensive" (e.g. in time or money), with the speed of the BO algorithm being of little importance. In the real world, however, problems span a continuous range of values, going from cheap to expensive. In this paper, we present BO algorithms through the lens of a speed-performance Pareto frontier: we compare BO against faster algorithms like CMA-ES, and highlight how certain regions of the Pareto frontier are currently empty. As a solution, we propose a new set of fast BO methods that exploit the linear structure in existing BO algorithms, for both continuous and combinatorial inputs (from ~10 to 6000+ dimensions). Our methods achieve performance similar to state-of-the-art BO, while being more than $10^2\times$ to $10^3\times$ faster, opening the field of BO to an entirely new class of problems.

AI.tldr: 提出快速贝叶斯优化框架，利用BO中的线性结构，在速度-性能Pareto前沿上填补空白，比SOTA BO快100~1000倍而性能相当。
AI.motivation: 传统BO仅用于"昂贵"函数优化，算法速度不被重视；但现实问题从廉价到昂贵连续分布，需要兼顾速度与性能，现有Pareto前沿存在空白区域（介于快速CMA-ES与慢速BO之间）。
AI.method: 以速度-性能Pareto前沿的视角审视BO，与CMA-ES等快速算法对比；提出利用现有BO算法中线性结构的新型快速BO方法，覆盖连续与组合输入（约10到6000+维）。
AI.result: 在连续与组合、10至6000+维问题上，性能接近SOTA BO，速度快100倍至1000倍以上。
AI.conclusion: 快速BO方法填补了Pareto前沿空区，将BO拓展到一类全新的廉价问题领域，打破BO仅适用于昂贵函数的传统定位。

title: GeoMem-VLA: Internalizing 3D Scene Understanding into Temporal Memory for Vision-Language-Action Models
summary: Geometric structure is essential for robotic manipulation and understanding the 3D world. Most VLA models rely on 2D representations of current observations, while geometry-aware approaches often require additional 3D information. However, geometry inferred independently from individual observations is often discarded rather than accumulated into a persistent task representation. Our key insight is that action generation needs a compact, task-relevant geometric abstraction that can be continuously updated, rather than a complete, renderable 3D reconstruction at every step. We introduce GeoMem-VLA, a VLA framework that internalizes explicit 3D supervision into dedicated geometric tokens and maintains them as temporal memory for action generation, without directly aligning the VLM's native visual embeddings with the teacher feature space. During training, a frozen geometry foundation model supervises learnable GeoPlan tokens through a geometric flow-matching objective over the current scene point map and future end-effector tracks. These tokens are integrated with the memory of observation representations, where historical information is retrieved, adaptively fused with current observations, and consolidated to retain event frames as the task progresses. At inference, the policy retrieves historical representations and fuses them with the current working representation to predict actions, without invoking the 3D teacher or explicitly reconstructing the scene. After benchmark-specific downstream adaptation, GeoMem-VLA achieves 98.9% average success on LIBERO and 91.10% / 91.24% on RoboTwin's clean/randomized settings. Across five real-world tasks, GeoMem-VLA achieves 78.0% average success. These results suggest that internalizing and remembering 3D scene understanding is a promising approach to robot control.

AI.tldr: GeoMem-VLA 将显式 3D 监督内化为几何 token，并将其作为时序记忆用于动作生成，在 LIBERO、RoboTwin 和真实任务上取得高成功率。
AI.motivation: 多数 VLA 模型依赖 2D 观测表示，几何感知方法又常需额外 3D 信息；且从单帧独立推断的几何往往被丢弃，未累积成持久任务表示。
AI.method: 引入可学习 GeoPlan tokens，训练时由冻结几何基础模型以几何流匹配目标监督（当前场景点图与未来末端轨迹）；token 与观测表示记忆集成，历史信息检索、自适应融合并巩固事件帧；推理时不调用 3D 教师、不显式重建场景，仅用历史与当前表示预测动作，且不直接对齐 VLM 原生视觉嵌入与教师特征空间。
AI.result: LIBERO 平均成功率 98.9%；RoboTwin 干净/随机设置 91.10% / 91.24%；五项真实任务平均 78.0%。
AI.conclusion: 将 3D 场景理解内化并记忆，是机器人控制的有前景方向。

title: Fragment-Level Graph Encoding for Interpretable Molecular Property Prediction
comment: 12 pages, 3 figures, 6-page appendices, to be published in Proceedings of the 8th Northern Lights Deep Learning Conference (NLDL), 2027. For associated code, see https://github.com/4D-Lab/frame
summary: Graph neural networks (GNNs) are among the standard tools for molecular property prediction, but the atom-level explanations of their predictions are hard for medicinal chemists to act on. We propose a change of input representation rather than a new model: molecules are encoded as fragment-level graphs from BRICS decomposition, where each node is a synthetically meaningful fragment whose features are the element-wise sum of its atoms' features. Because only the representation changes, any message-passing GNN and any post-hoc attribution method produces explanations at the resolution of functional groups instead of single atoms. Across four architectures, four prediction tasks, and two explainers under scaffold splits, fragment-level encoding matches atom-level test accuracy on roughly five-fold smaller graphs. Integrated-Gradients attributions recover known pharmacophores above chance on two enzyme targets, namely BACE at 1.5 times the chance rate, and PTR1 at 3.2 times. A like-for-like comparison against an aggregated atom-level baseline shows that post-hoc aggregation is not a stable substitute: its BACE hit rate range both exceeds and falls below the fragment model's hit rate depending on two arbitrary aggregation choices, whereas fragment-level training yields a single convention-free attribution at no predictive cost. The code is available at: https://github.com/4D-Lab/frame

AI.tldr: 用BRICS把分子编码成片段级图，不换模型、不换解释器，就能在保持预测精度的同时把GNN解释提升到官能团层面，且比事后聚合原子归因更稳定。
AI.motivation: GNN是分子性质预测的标准工具，但其原子级解释对药物化学家而言难以直接指导行动，因此希望解释粒度与合成/官能团语义对齐。
AI.method: 不做新模型，而是改变输入表示：用BRICS分解将分子编码为片段级图，节点为具有合成意义的片段，节点特征为内部原子特征的逐元素求和；因此任意消息传递GNN与任意事后归因方法都可直接在片段粒度输出解释。
AI.result: 在4种架构、4个任务、2种解释器及scaffold划分下，片段级编码在约小5倍的图上取得与原子级相当的测试精度。Integrated-Gradients归因在BACE上以1.5倍随机率、PTR1上以3.2倍随机率找回已知药效团。与聚合原子级基线对比，其BACE命中率范围随两个任意聚合选择而上下波动，既可能高于也可能低于片段模型。
AI.conclusion: 片段级表示以零预测代价换取单一、无约定依赖的官能团级归因，优于事后聚合原子归因，为可行动的分子解释提供了简单替代方案。

title: Stochastic Nonlinearities Improve Uncertainty Estimation
comment: Accepted to the British Machine Vision Conference (BMVC) 2026. 33 pages, including supplementary material
summary: Reliable uncertainty estimation is important across visual recognition tasks, providing information about the confidence and reliability of model predictions. Many uncertainty estimation methods obtain predictive diversity through mechanisms that can suppress intermediate features, perturb the input, or require substantial additional computation. Stochastic activation functions, where network units randomly select between multiple nonlinearities during a forward pass, have previously been used to improve optimization behavior, mitigate limitations of fixed ReLU activations, and increase output diversity. In this work, we reframe stochastic activation switching as a lightweight mechanism for uncertainty estimation. The proposed method samples between nonlinear activation functions, inducing predictive diversity while keeping intermediate feature pathways active. This enables uncertainty estimation from a single trained model without the training cost of ensembles, task-specific uncertainty heads, or architectural redesign. We evaluate the proposed approach across classification, semantic segmentation, and out-of-distribution detection using convolutional and transformer-based architectures on diverse datasets. Across these settings, stochastic activation switching improves uncertainty quality while preserving competitive primary-task performance, showing that stochastic nonlinearities provide an effective and information-preserving source of predictive variation for visual recognition.

AI.tldr: 将随机激活函数切换（stochastic activation switching）重新定位为一种轻量级不确定性估计机制，在保持中间特征通路激活的前提下引入预测多样性。
AI.motivation: 现有不确定性估计方法常通过抑制中间特征、扰动输入或引入大量额外计算来获得预测多样性，代价高或损失信息；而随机激活函数原本多用于改善优化与输出多样性，尚未被用作不确定性来源。
AI.method: 在前向传播中让网络单元在多个非线性激活函数之间随机采样（stochastic activation switching），从而在不阻断特征通路的情况下产生预测多样性；单一训练模型即可完成不确定性估计，无需集成训练、任务专用不确定性头或架构改动。
AI.result: 在分类、语义分割和分布外检测任务上，使用卷积与Transformer架构并在多数据集评测，随机激活切换提升了不确定性质量，同时保持有竞争力的主任务性能。
AI.conclusion: 随机非线性是一种有效且信息保持的预测变异来源，可作为轻量级不确定性估计手段用于视觉识别。

title: A Transfer Learning-Driven Methodology for Efficient and Sustainable Indoor Localization Using VLC
summary: The rapid expansion of the Internet of Things enables seamless collaboration among connected devices, making indoor localization a critical component of industrial automation. However, conventional localization techniques struggle in dynamic environments. These methods depend on extensive, frequent data collection and environment-specific calibration, limiting scalability, interoperability, and effective use of prior research while imposing significant energy penalties that hinder practical deployment. To address these challenges, we propose an energy-efficient transfer learning (TL) based approach for visible light communication based indoor localization. Our method leverages TL to tackle environmental variability, including lighting fluctuations and physical obstacles that typically degrade localization performance, while simultaneously reducing computational overhead and energy consumption compared to conventional approaches. We also introduce a novel model efficiency (ME) metric, designed to integrate localization accuracy, energy efficiency, data efficiency, and transfer gain into a single evaluative measure for comprehensive optimization. Evaluations on a real-world dataset collected from a BOSCH factory demonstrate that our model achieves a 47% improvement in localization accuracy compared to a conventional model that does not utilize TL, and achieves up to 67.5% ME with TL models, compared to only 10.4% in conventional models under high-noise conditions. These results underscore the potential of our approach to deliver a highly efficient and scalable indoor localization system suitable for energy-constrained industrial applications.

AI.tldr: 提出基于迁移学习的可见光通信室内定位方法，并引入模型效率(ME)指标，在BOSCH工厂实测中定位精度提升47%，高噪声下ME达67.5%。
AI.motivation: 传统室内定位方法依赖大量频繁的数据采集与环境特定校准，在动态环境（光照波动、物理障碍）下性能差、可扩展性与互操作性不足，且能耗高，难以实际部署。
AI.method: 采用基于迁移学习(TL)的可见光通信(VLC)室内定位方案，以应对环境变化并降低计算与能耗开销；同时提出模型效率(ME)指标，将定位精度、能效、数据效率与迁移增益统一为一个评价度量。
AI.result: 在BOSCH工厂采集的真实数据集上，相比未使用TL的传统模型定位精度提升47%；高噪声条件下TL模型ME最高达67.5%，而传统模型仅10.4%。
AI.conclusion: 该方法具备高效、可扩展的室内定位能力，适用于能源受限的工业应用场景。

title: Expandable Modality Experts for Medical Vision-Language Learning
comment: 11 pages (main text), 42 pages (supplementary material), 2 main figures. Submitted to ICLR 2027
summary: Learning across medical imaging modalities requires making use of images without paired text and accommodating new domains while retaining existing representations. We propose a medical vision-language technique built around an expandable bank of modality experts. Its Multiway Transformer combines shared visual computation with deterministically routed feed-forward experts and a separate text pathway. A modality-aware visual tokenizer supplies targets for masked pretraining on 19.4 million unpaired image rows across seven modalities; contrastive alignment then uses 3.23 million image-text pairs. Additional fundus and optical coherence tomography experts learn from paired data while the original image and text embedding paths remain frozen. With a ViT-Large backbone, the proposed technique achieves the best or tied-best result in 24 of 25 benchmark settings across nine modalities: 10 of 11 zero-shot classification benchmarks, all 10 linear probes, and all four retrieval benchmarks. Mean balanced accuracy is 0.674 for zero-shot classification and 0.856 for linear probing, and mean bidirectional retrieval recall is 20.70%. A separate three-seed sequential experiment with matched adaptation data yields fundus and OCT retrieval gains of 14.95 and 9.31 percentage points, with no measured loss on preceding fundus or pathology tasks. The preservation argument requires unchanged existing computation paths and inference conditions, and feature-identity checks verify retention on evaluated inputs. The proposed technique provides a modular approach to learning and expanding medical vision-language representations.

AI.tldr: 提出基于可扩展"模态专家库"的医学视觉-语言方法，用共享视觉计算+确定性路由MoE+独立文本通路，实现无配对文本预训练与增量扩展且不遗忘旧任务。
AI.motivation: 医学影像跨模态学习需同时解决两个问题：利用大量无配对文本的图像，以及在保留已有表征的前提下扩展新模态/新领域（避免灾难性遗忘）。
AI.method: 构建可扩展的模态专家库；Multiway Transformer将共享视觉计算与确定性路由的FFN专家结合，并保留独立文本通路。先用模态感知视觉分词器在7个模态、1940万无配对的图像行上做掩码预训练，再用323万图文对做对比对齐。新增眼底与OCT专家时冻结原有图文嵌入路径，仅用配对数据训练新专家。
AI.result: ViT-Large骨干下，在9个模态的25项基准中24项取得最佳或并列最佳（11个零样本分类中10个、全部10个线性探针、全部4个检索）；零样本平衡准确率均值0.674，线性探针0.856，双向检索召回均值20.70%。三随机种子顺序实验中，眼底与OCT检索分别提升14.95与9.31个百分点，且先前眼底/病理任务无可测损失，特征一致性检查验证保留性。
AI.conclusion: 该技术为医学视觉-语言表征的学习与扩展提供了模块化方案；但保留性结论依赖原有计算路径与推理条件不变。

title: Local and Global Recursive Ridge Regression for Online Residual Correction of Frozen Multivariate Forecasters under Label Delay
summary: A frozen multi-horizon forecaster can be corrected online from its own residuals. However, under label delay the target of a block arrives only after the whole horizon has passed, and the corrector's retained state grows with the number of channels. Aiming to combine a small retained state with a large error reduction, we propose DRiC (DCT Ridge Corrector), which fits a ridge regression of the leading discrete cosine transform (DCT) coefficients of the next residual block on those of the frozen forecast and of the latest input block, with sufficient statistics updated recursively. Its local variant, DRiC-L, keeps one such regression per channel; its global variant, DRiC-G, pools all channels into one regression, whose statistics do not depend on the channel count. A guard tracks a running scale of the frozen forecast's residual for each channel; it skips updates on blocks far outside that scale and clips the issued correction. We evaluate on seven datasets (four ETT series, Weather with its missing-value codes filled, Electricity, and Traffic) with DLinear, PatchTST, and iTransformer backbones, against 10 naive, gradient-trained, and closed-form methods. DRiC-L with eight DCT coefficients (DRiC-L8) reduces the mean squared error (MSE) by 14.55% on average over 126 conditions, against 12.98% for ELF, the most accurate comparator, while retaining 15-17 times less state, although ELF is more accurate on Traffic. DRiC-G retains 14.6 kB on the 321-channel Electricity data and 18.9 kB on the 862-channel Traffic data and is the most accurate method at or below its state on both. However, 5 to 7 of the 10 comparators, all with at least 10 times its state, are more accurate there. On the unfilled Weather file, DRiC-L8 without the guard has on average 8.0 times the frozen forecast's MSE, whereas with the guard it reduces the MSE by 7.94%. Code: https://github.com/keiotakmin/dric.

AI.tldr: DRiC用DCT域岭回归在线校正冻结多步预测器的残差，状态小、误差降幅大，优于ELF等10个对照方法。
AI.motivation: 冻结的多步预测器可用自身残差在线校正，但存在标签延迟（目标块需等整个预测horizon过去才到达）以及校正器保留状态随通道数增长的问题。目标是同时实现小状态与大误差降低。
AI.method: DRiC对下一残差块的前若干DCT系数，以冻结预测与最新输入块的DCT系数为自变量做岭回归，用递归更新的充分统计量；DRiC-L为每通道一个回归，DRiC-G把所有通道汇成一个回归（统计量与通道数无关）；另有guard跟踪各通道残差的滑动尺度，跳过远离该尺度的块更新并裁剪输出校正。
AI.result: 7个数据集（4个ETT、填充缺失码的Weather、Electricity、Traffic）×DLinear/PatchTST/iTransformer×10个基线。DRiC-L8在126种条件下平均降MSE 14.55%，最优对照ELF为12.98%，状态少15-17倍（Traffic上ELF更准）。DRiC-G在Electricity(321通道)仅占14.6 kB、Traffic(862通道)18.9 kB，在同状态量级方法中最准，但5-7个状态大10倍以上的对照更准。未填充Weather上无guard的DRiC-L8 MSE为冻结预测的8.0倍，加guard后降7.94%。
AI.conclusion: DCT岭回归校正在小状态约束下取得较强误差降低，全局变体状态与通道数无关但有精度取舍；guard对分布异常/缺失数据至关重要。代码已开源。

title: ViBMR: A Large-Scale Multi-Sequence Brain MRI Dataset and Comprehensive Evaluation for Vietnamese Radiology Report Generation
comment: Accepted at IEEE/CVF Winter Conference on Applications of Computer Vision (WACV 2027)
summary: Automated radiology report generation for multi-sequence brain MRI holds strong promise for alleviating radiologists' workload, yet it remains a demanding problem: brain MRI studies are inherently volumetric, each pulse sequence carries complementary diagnostic information, and annotated data are critically scarce for low-resource clinical languages. Existing brain MRI-report resources are still dominated by English reports, translated clinical text, or datasets adapted from task-specific imaging benchmarks, leaving routine low-resource clinical reporting and heterogeneous multi-sequence MRI protocols insufficiently represented. To bridge this gap, we introduce ViBMR, to the best of our knowledge, the first large-scale multi-sequence brain MRI dataset paired with routine Vietnamese clinical reports, comprising 3,649 patients and 11,875 MRI series across T1, T2, FLAIR, and contrast-enhanced T1 sequences. Building on ViBMR, we establish a comprehensive evaluation setup for brain MRI report generation, covering representative medical vision-language models, multi-sequence inputs, and feature aggregation strategies. The results provide key insights into dataset characteristics and model behavior, while demonstrating the necessity of native low-resource clinical datasets for reliable Vietnamese-origin brain MRI report generation. Our dataset and baseline models will be released for non-commercial research.

AI.tldr: ViBMR是首个大规模多序列脑部MRI-Vietnamese常规临床报告配对数据集（3,649名患者、11,875个序列，覆盖T1/T2/FLAIR/CE-T1），并建立脑部MRI报告生成的综合评测基准。
AI.motivation: 脑部MRI报告自动生成可减轻放射科医师负担，但面临三大挑战：MRI本质为三维体积数据、各脉冲序列含互补诊断信息、低资源临床语言标注数据极度稀缺。现有资源以英文报告、翻译文本或由任务型影像基准改造的数据集为主，难以覆盖低资源语言的常规临床报告与异构多序列协议。
AI.method: 构建ViBMR数据集：3,649名患者、11,875个MRI序列，涵盖T1、T2、FLAIR及增强T1四种序列，配以真实Vietnamese常规临床报告。在此基础上搭建评测框架，覆盖代表性医学视觉-语言模型、多种多序列输入方式与特征聚合策略。
AI.result: 实验揭示了数据集特性与模型行为的关键规律，并证明使用原生低资源临床数据集对于可靠的Vietnamese来源脑部MRI报告生成是必要的。
AI.conclusion: 原生低资源临床数据不可替代，ViBMR为多序列脑部MRI报告生成提供数据与基准支撑；数据集与基线模型将开放用于非商业研究。

title: Improved Training of Strong Stochastic Flow Maps
summary: Stochastic flow maps promise few-step sampling of stochastic differential equations (SDEs) by learning to directly jump between times along the solution path, yet training these models to learn this solution map remains difficult. The primary obstacle is the Brownian path itself: it is an infinite-dimensional object which needs to be passed to the neural network and is nowhere differentiable, which makes the implementation of derivative-based losses that power the state-of-the-art deterministic flow maps just out of reach. We identify two core design principles which address these issues: a) represent the Brownian path with a basis which carries higher-order local information, and b) train with an objective that forces the network to use the full representation of the path, not just the first order. To address this, we leverage the shifted Legendre polynomial expansion with a Wong-Zakai styled objective, unlocking derivative-based losses. Finally, we propose a recipe for fine-tuning large pre-trained flow models into strong stochastic flow maps. We ablate through this design space on several toy problems and use our findings to transform a large flow model into a strong stochastic flow map on ImageNet, achieving roughly a three-fold improvement in FD-DINOv2 over SSFM at four NFE.

AI.tldr: 该论文提出用移位勒让德多项式基表示布朗路径并结合Wong-Zakai风格目标，使随机流映射可训练，并将大规模预训练流模型微调为强随机流映射，在ImageNet上4 NFE时FD-DINOv2较SSFM约提升3倍。
AI.motivation: 随机流映射能实现SDE的少步采样，但训练困难：布朗路径是无限维且处处不可微的对象，无法直接用于依赖梯度的损失，而这类损失正是确定性流映射成功的核心。
AI.method: 提出两条设计原则：(a) 用携带高阶局部信息的基函数表示布朗路径；(b) 设计迫使网络使用完整路径表示（而非仅一阶信息）的目标。具体采用移位勒让德多项式展开配合Wong-Zakai风格目标，从而启用基于导数的损失；并给出将大型预训练流模型微调为强随机流映射的方案。
AI.result: 在多个玩具问题上消融设计空间；基于结论将大型流模型转化为ImageNet上的强随机流映射，在4 NFE下FD-DINOv2相比SSFM约提升三倍。
AI.conclusion: 通过合适基表示与Wong-Zakai目标可克服布朗路径不可微的障碍，使随机流映射获得可扩展训练，并可从预训练确定性流模型高效迁移。

title: Asking a Multimodal LLM Whether Someone Fell: Zero-Shot Screening of Low-Resolution Thermal Video in a Laboratory and an Occupied Home
summary: Thermal cameras can watch over older people living alone without capturing faces, and multimodal large language models (LLMs) can judge a short video without task-specific training. We evaluate a production multimodal LLM, Gemini 3.8 Flash at temperature 0, as the decision stage of an event-triggered fall screener, used exactly as a deployed prototype uses it: one request per short thermal clip, with its sound track when there is one, and its predecessor Gemini 3.7 Flash on the same requests. On 438 staged falls and 563 non-fall windows that we located by hand in a public 32x24 thermal dataset, the deployed request called 69% of the held-out subjects' falls (67% over all subjects; bed falls excluded) and none of 499 non-fall windows, including people lying on the floor and getting up. Over 76 h of ordinary life in an occupied room, recorded at 160x120 with sound, it called none of 395 clips a fall (95% upper bound 1.2 false alarms per day) and caught 4 of the 9 staged falls the camera could see. One cautionary sentence in the prompt ("a person who goes out of view ... is not a fall") accounted for many of the misses: removing it raised sensitivity on the held-out subjects from 69% to 83% on 3.8 Flash and from 80% to 92% on Gemini 3.7 Flash, and in the home from 4 to 9 of the 9 visible falls, with no false call in ordinary living but at the price of calling deliberate lie-downs a fall. Sensitivity collapsed at 8x6 pixels (34%); identical requests disagreed on 4% of windows; and when the model called a fall, its explanation placed it within a second of the annotated landing 99% of the time. Two conventional detectors trained on the laboratory data caught nearly every held-out laboratory fall but raised 14.2 and 23.9 false alarms per day in the home. We release the frame-level fall annotations of the public dataset and every model answer on it.

AI.tldr: 用生产级多模态大模型 Gemini 3.8 Flash 作为事件触发式跌倒筛查器的决策环节，在公开 32x24 热成像数据集与真实居家 76 小时数据上评估：留出受试者跌倒召回 69%、零误报；居家 395 段日常片段零误报，但提示词一句"出画面不算跌倒"导致大量漏检。
AI.motivation: 独居老人监护需隐私友好方案：热像仪不拍人脸，多模态 LLM 无需任务特定训练即可判读短视频。作者希望检验生产环境中的模型在真实部署方式（每段热成像短片段一次请求、含音轨）下的跌倒筛查表现，并与前代模型和传统检测器对比。
AI.method: 将 Gemini 3.8 Flash（temperature=0）与原样部署方式一致地用作事件触发跌倒筛查器的决策阶段，每段热成像短片段一次请求、有音轨则一并输入；同请求也交给 Gemini 3.7 Flash。数据为公共 32x24 热成像数据集中人工定位的 438 次摆拍跌倒与 563 个非跌倒窗口，以及 160x120 带音频的占用房间 76 小时日常记录。分析提示词消融、分辨率退化、请求一致性与解释时间对齐，并与两个在实验室数据上训练的传统检测器比较。
AI.result: 留出受试者跌倒召回 69%（全体受试者 67%，排除床上跌倒），499 个非跌倒窗口零误报（含倒地、起身）；居家 76 小时 395 段片段零误报（95% 置信上界每日 1.2 次），但 9 次可见摆拍跌倒仅捕获 4 次。删除提示词中"出画面不算跌倒"一句后，留出召回升至 83%（3.8）与 92%（3.7），居家 9 次可见跌倒全部捕获，日常零误报，代价是把刻意躺下判为跌倒。8x6 像素时召回跌至 34%；相同请求 4% 窗口结论不一致；判定为跌倒时解释定位在标注落地 1 秒内的概率为 99%。两个传统检测器几乎捕获全部留出实验室跌倒，但居家误报达每日 14.2 与 23.9 次。
AI.conclusion: 生产级多模态 LLM 可在零样本、隐私友好条件下以极低误报率完成居家跌倒筛查，但敏感度受提示词措辞与目标分辨率强烈影响，需谨慎设计提示并注意偶发不一致；相比传统检测器显著降低居家误报。作者公开该数据集的帧级跌倒标注及全部模型回答。

title: Reliability-Aware Probabilistic Fusion for Multimodal Learning with Incomplete Evidence
summary: Multimodal inputs may be missing or degraded, raising distinct questions of evidence availability and trust. We introduce a reliability-aware Gaussian Product-of-Experts (PoE) in which an input-dependent reliability weight tempers each modality's latent precision, while missing experts are omitted. We characterize how reliability and availability affect posterior information and expert influence. Across two clinical multimodal tasks, the full framework remains competitive with complete inputs and achieves its clearest mean-AUROC advantage under modality absence, particularly on HAIM-MIMIC-MM. Ablations show a substantial gain from missing-aware training and an additional HAIM improvement from reliability weighting under matched PoE, missing-aware, and consistency training. Unseen test-time corruptions are used diagnostically and reveal modality-dependent reliability-weight and latent-uncertainty responses, including failure under severe degradation. Thus, reliability weighting provides an explicit evidence-control mechanism, while learning dependable quality signals remains an open challenge.

AI.tldr: 提出可靠性感知的高斯PoE融合框架，用输入相关的可靠性权重调节各模态潜在精度，缺失专家直接省略，在多模态临床任务中于模态缺失时取得最佳平均AUROC。
AI.motivation: 多模态输入可能缺失或质量退化，带来证据可得性和可信度两方面的问题，需要显式地区分并控制每个模态证据的可用性与可靠性。
AI.method: 在每个模态专家的高斯潜在精度上乘以输入相关的可靠性权重，融合时采用Product-of-Experts；缺失模态的专家被省略。理论上刻画了可靠性与可得性如何影响后验信息量和专家影响力。在两个临床多模态任务上评估，并进行消融（缺失感知训练、匹配PoE下的可靠性加权、一致性训练），还用未见过的测试时损坏进行诊断分析。
AI.result: 完整框架在输入完整时保持竞争力；在模态缺失下平均AUROC优势最明显，尤其在HAIM-MIMIC-MM上。消融显示缺失感知训练带来显著提升，可靠性加权在匹配PoE、缺失感知与一致性训练下还能进一步提升HAIM表现。未见损坏下表现出模态相关的可靠性权重与潜在不确定性响应，并在严重退化时失败。
AI.conclusion: 可靠性加权提供了一种显式的证据控制机制；但学习可靠的质量信号仍是未解决的挑战。

title: CausalAlign: Causal Alignment of Video Generation Models for Consistent Ego-Motion
summary: Diffusion-based video generation models (VGMs) can produce visually plausible videos, yet their camera ego-motion often drifts over long horizons. Camera ego-motion determines how the viewpoint changes between frames and is essential for maintaining consistent geometry and trajectories. To address this problem, we propose CausalAlign, a causal alignment framework with two components. First, we diagnose how precise ego motion is represented, used, and retained within VGMs using linear probes and causal interventions, revealing a rise-and-fall pattern during denoising. Second, we strengthen ego-motion state in VGM by aligning the representations at the identified layers to a 3D foundation model through delta-token space. This space encodes the changes between consecutive frames, allowing the alignment to focus on ego-motion dynamics rather than static scene content. With Wan2.2 fine-tuned on DL3DV and RealEstate10K, CausalAlign can largely improve motion accuracy, geometric consistency, and temporal smoothness, while preserving visual quality. For example, it improves geometric consistency by more than 20% relative to the base model. Moreover, with the fine-tuned VGM, CausalAlign improves the success rate of world action models (WAMs) by 10 points on mobile manipulation tasks of RoboCasa365 benchmark. Overall, CausalAlign improves ego-motion consistency in diffusion-based VGMs and yields noticeable gains in embodied models.

AI.tldr: 提出 CausalAlign 因果对齐框架，通过诊断 VGM 中自我运动（ego-motion）表示的"先升后降"模式，并在关键层将 delta-token 表示对齐到 3D 基础模型，从而提升扩散视频生成的相机运动一致性。
AI.motivation: 扩散视频生成模型视觉上逼真，但长时序下相机自我运动易漂移，破坏几何与轨迹一致性。相机 ego-motion 决定帧间视角变化，是保持几何与轨迹一致的关键，而现有模型对其建模不足。
AI.method: CausalAlign 含两部分：(1) 用线性探针与因果干预诊断 ego-motion 在 VGM 中的表示、使用与保留，发现去噪过程中呈"先升后降"模式；(2) 在识别出的层通过 delta-token 空间将表示对齐到 3D 基础模型，该空间编码相邻帧变化，使对齐聚焦于 ego-motion 动态而非静态场景内容。基于 Wan2.2 在 DL3DV 与 RealEstate10K 上微调。
AI.result: 显著提升运动精度、几何一致性与时间平滑度，同时保持视觉质量；几何一致性相对基线提升 20% 以上。用微调后的 VGM，在 RoboCasa365 移动操作任务上使世界动作模型（WAMs）成功率提升 10 个百分点。
AI.conclusion: CausalAlign 有效提升扩散 VGM 的 ego-motion 一致性，并为具身模型带来明显收益，说明改进视频生成中的相机运动建模可下游迁移到世界动作模型。

title: Cross-Area Transfer Learning for VLC-based Indoor Localization with a Transfer Efficiency Score
summary: Indoor localization systems are critical for Industry-4.0 applications. Visible Light Communication (VLC)-based systems offer advantages such as immunity to electromagnetic interference, high accuracy, and energy efficiency, but their performance is hindered by environmental variability across deployment areas. This paper presents a transfer learning (TL) framework for VLC-based indoor localization that enhances cross-area robustness while reducing data requirements. Using real-world measurements from four distinct areas of a Bosch manufacturing facility, we show that fine-tuning a deep neural network (DNN) pre-trained on source area data with only 40% of target-area measurements recovers 97% of full-data performance, thereby reducing the amount of target data needed. We further introduce the Transfer Efficiency Score (TES), a composite metric that identifies the most effective source models for transfer without exhaustive evaluation. Guided by TES, the framework selects the best source model, yielding localization errors as low as 40.9 cm with success rates above 86%. Validation on an unseen area confirms its generalization capability, with a 3.28 cm mean error achieved using the TES-selected source model. Overall, the proposed framework provides a scalable and data-efficient pathway for industrial VLC localization, substantially reducing deployment costs and computational burden while maintaining high accuracy in diverse and dynamic environments.

AI.tldr: 提出面向VLC室内定位的迁移学习框架，利用源区域预训练+少量目标数据微调，并引入迁移效率评分(TES)选择最佳源模型，实现跨区域鲁棒、低数据、低成本部署。
AI.motivation: VLC室内定位虽具抗电磁干扰、高精度、节能等优势，但部署区域间环境差异导致性能下降，且目标区域数据采集成本高。
AI.method: 基于Bosch制造厂四个真实区域的实测数据，用源区域数据预训练DNN后仅用40%目标数据微调；提出复合指标TES评估并选择最优源模型，并在未见区域验证泛化性。
AI.result: 仅40%目标数据微调可恢复97%的全数据性能；按TES选源，定位误差低至40.9 cm、成功率超86%；未见区域平均误差3.28 cm。
AI.conclusion: 该框架为工业VLC定位提供可扩展、数据高效路径，在多样化动态环境下保持高精度的同时显著降低部署成本与计算负担。

title: DewHand: Direct Metric World-Space Hand Motion Reconstruction from Egocentric Videos
summary: Recovering metric world-space hand motion from egocentric video supports understanding human interactions and transferring them to embodied agents. Three challenges complicate this task: multi-stage pipelines propagate errors from independently estimated hand and camera motion; monocular observations leave physical scale ambiguous; and occlusion and out-of-view hands admit multiple plausible motion trajectories. We present DewHand, a unified model for direct joint reconstruction of world-space hand and camera motion. To avoid compounding errors from multi-stage estimation, DewHand jointly predicts hand and camera motion in a shared world coordinate system within a single-stage pipeline. To resolve metric-scale ambiguity, it combines scene-level geometric features from VGGT-$Ω$ with metric-space supervision, while hand-specific features preserve fine-grained articulation. To handle occlusion and out-of-view hands, we formulate reconstruction as conditional motion generation with flow matching. Under the same architecture, this generative formulation outperforms direct regression in both accuracy and temporal smoothness with only two sampling steps. Experiments on HOT3D and ARCTIC demonstrate improved world-space accuracy and temporal consistency over state-of-the-art methods. DewHand reduces rigid-aligned world-space error relative to StableHand from 32.9 to 28.4 mm on HOT3D and from 76.2 to 36.2 mm on ARCTIC. It also recovers camera scale within 10% on two thirds of HOT3D clips, versus about a quarter for SLAM. Moreover, in zero-shot evaluations on HoloAssist, H2O, and TACO, captured with different devices, DewHand achieves the lowest rigid-aligned world-space error (WA-MPJPE) on each dataset.

AI.tldr: DewHand 是一个单阶段统一模型，直接联合重建第一视角视频中的世界空间手部与相机运动，并用流匹配生成式建模应对遮挡和出画问题。
AI.motivation: 从第一视角视频恢复度量世界空间的手部运动有助于理解人类交互并迁移到具身智能体，但存在三大挑战：多阶段流水线误差累积、单目尺度歧义、以及遮挡和出画导致的多解轨迹问题。
AI.method: 在共享世界坐标系中单阶段联合预测手与相机运动以避免误差累积；融合 VGGT-Ω 的场景级几何特征与度量空间监督解决尺度歧义，同时保留手部细粒度特征；将重建建模为带流匹配的条件运动生成，仅用两步采样。
AI.result: HOT3D 上刚体对齐世界空间误差从 StableHand 的 32.9 mm 降至 28.4 mm，ARCTIC 上从 76.2 mm 降至 36.2 mm；三分之二 HOT3D 片段相机尺度误差在 10% 以内（SLAM 约四分之一）；在 HoloAssist、H2O、TACO 零样本评测中均取得最低 WA-MPJPE。
AI.conclusion: DewHand 通过单阶段联合估计与生成式重建，同时提升世界空间精度和时间一致性，并具备跨设备零样本泛化能力。

title: Probabilistic Machine Learning for Short-Term Atmospheric Seeing Forecasting
comment: 9 pages, 2 figures, Proceedings of the SPIE 2026 Astronomical Telescopes + Instrumentation, Copehagen, July 2026
summary: Accurate short-term forecasting of atmospheric seeing is of significant interest for astronomical observations and free-space optical communication systems, where rapid variations in optical turbulence can affect system performance and operational planning. In this work, we benchmark machine learning models for predicting atmospheric seeing up to two hours in advance, with a particular focus on probabilistic forecasting and uncertainty quantification. We compare two probabilistic approaches, Gaussian Processes (GPs) and a normalizing-flow- based model (FloTS), against deterministic recurrent neural network (RNN) and long short-term memory (LSTM) baselines. All models are trained and evaluated on seeing measurements from the Maunakea summit. We assess the models using both deterministic metrics, including the root mean square error and the Pearson correlation coefficient, and probabilistic metrics that evaluate the quality and calibration of predictive uncertainty estimates. The results show that deep learning approaches outperform standard recurrent networks for short-term forecasting, with LSTM and FloTS achieving the best overall predictive accuracy. While Gaussian Processes provide a useful probabilistic baseline, their predictive distributions are limited by the Gaussian assumption. FloTS combines competitive forecasting accuracy with flexible uncertainty quantification and produces the most informative probabilistic forecasts.

AI.tldr: 本文以Maunakea观测站的大气视宁度数据为对象，基准测试了GP、归一化流模型FloTS与RNN/LSTM在提前两小时短期预报上的表现，重点评估概率预报与不确定性量化。结果显示LSTM与FloTS确定性精度最佳，而FloTS在提供灵活、信息量更丰富的不确定性估计方面表现最好。
AI.motivation: 大气视宁度的快速变化影响天文观测与自由空间光通信的系统性能和运行规划，准确的短期视宁度预报（尤其带不确定性量化的概率预报）对此类应用具有重要价值，但现有工作多关注确定性预测，缺乏对概率方法与不确定性校准的系统比较。
AI.method: 构建基准实验：概率方法为高斯过程（GP）与基于归一化流的模型FloTS，确定性基线为RNN与LSTM；全部模型在Maunakea峰顶的视宁度实测数据上训练与评估，预测提前量最长2小时。评价指标包括确定性指标（RMSE、Pearson相关系数）和评估预测不确定性质量与校准的概率指标。
AI.result: 深度学习类方法在短期预报上优于标准循环网络，LSTM与FloTS取得最佳整体预测精度；GP作为概率基线虽有参考价值，但其预测分布受高斯假设限制；FloTS在保持有竞争力的预报精度的同时提供灵活的不确定性量化，产生信息量最丰富的概率预报。
AI.conclusion: 对于大气视宁度短期概率预报，归一化流模型（FloTS）兼顾精度与不确定性表达能力，优于受高斯假设约束的GP，是更具实用价值的概率预报方案；LSTM可作为强确定性基线。

title: Training-free Acceleration for Blind Compressed Image Restoration via Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition
comment: 12 pages. Accepted for publication in IEEE Journal on Emerging and Selected Topics in Circuits and Systems
summary: Transformer-based models achieve strong performance on blind compressed image restoration (CIR) under unknown compression settings, but their densely stacked projection operators make deployment costly. We study training-free acceleration for such models through an empirical, operator-level analysis. Specifically, we profile where computation is concentrated, characterize channel-wise activation distributions under compressed inputs, and examine the singular-value decay of representative projection weights. These measurements identify the recurring projections in the attention, feed-forward, convolutional, and prompt-conditioning pathways as effective low-rank replacement targets that preserve the original inference graph. They further establish truncated SVD (TSVD) as a principled training-free baseline for blind CIR and reveal why a uniform low-rank objective is mismatched to the channel-imbalanced feature distributions of compressed images. Accordingly, we formulate Activation-Calibrated Singular Value Decomposition (ASVD) for this restoration setting, deriving low-rank factors entirely offline from pretrained weights and lightweight activation statistics gathered from only a few compressed calibration images. By weighting the decomposition with channel-wise activation magnitudes, our ASVD assigns larger penalties to errors on more active channels, requiring neither retraining nor online calibration and leaving the restoration pipeline intact. When instantiated on PromptCIR at rank 64, ASVD consistently improves PSNR-B over TSVD across four standard benchmarks under identical parameter and MAC budgets. At this operating point, the factorized model cuts parameters by 59% (34.75M to 14.34M) and computation by 16.1% (258.79 to 217.16 GMACs for a 256 x 256 input), enabling acceleration without retraining.

AI.tldr: 提出一种免训练的低秩加速方法 ASVD，通过激活校准的奇异值分解对盲压缩图像复原 Transformer 的重复投影算子进行分解，在 PromptCIR 上同时减少 59% 参数与 16.1% 计算并提升 PSNR-B。
AI.motivation: 基于 Transformer 的盲压缩图像复原（CIR）模型在未知压缩设置下性能很好，但密集堆叠的投影算子使部署成本高。论文希望在不重新训练的前提下加速这类模型，并解决统一低秩目标与压缩图像通道不均衡特征分布不匹配的问题。
AI.method: 进行算子级经验分析：统计计算集中位置、刻画压缩输入下通道激活分布、分析代表性投影权重的奇异值衰减。据此确定注意力、前馈、卷积与提示条件通路中的重复投影为低秩替换目标，并建立截断 SVD（TSVD）作为免训练基线。进一步提出激活校准奇异值分解（ASVD）：仅用少量压缩标定图像获得的轻量激活统计，离线从预训练权重导出低秩因子，以通道激活幅度加权分解，对高活跃通道的误差施加更大惩罚。
AI.result: 在 PromptCIR 上以秩 64 实例化时，ASVD 在参数量和 MAC 预算相同条件下，于四个标准基准上一致优于 TSVD 的 PSNR-B。该配置下参数从 34.75M 降至 14.34M（减少 59%），256×256 输入的计算从 258.79 降至 217.16 GMACs（减少 16.1%）。
AI.conclusion: 免训练低秩分解可有效加速盲压缩图像复原 Transformer；结合通道激活统计的 ASVD 比统一秩的 TSVD 更契合压缩图像特征分布，无需重训练或在线校准即可保持完整复原流程并实现一致的性能提升。

title: SPARE: Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy for Efficient MoEs
summary: Mixture-of-Experts (MoE) architectures scale model capacity efficiently, yet their substantial memory footprint poses a major barrier to deployment. Expert pruning reduces this footprint, but most methods focus on which experts to remove and prune every layer equally. We propose SPARE (Sparsity Allocation via Routing Entropy), a training-free, selector-agnostic method that decides how many experts to remove from each layer using routing entropy, the entropy of tokens' normalized Top-K gate weights on calibration data. When a token's gate weight is spread evenly, removing one active expert discards little of it, so SPARE prunes layers with more diffuse routing more aggressively. A perturbation bound under random pruning formalizes this intuition, and controlled interventions with a fixed selector link concentrated routing to larger output changes. With the same selector and budget, SPARE improves average accuracy over uniform allocation on Mixtral, Qwen3, and DeepSeek models, especially at high pruning ratios. At 50% expert pruning, it raises the eight-task average of Qwen3-30B-A3B from 57.2% to 63.8%, and the math, code, and science average of DeepSeek-R1 from 80.1 to 82.8.

AI.tldr: SPARE提出一种无需训练、与选择器无关的层级专家剪枝预算分配方法，利用路由熵决定每层剪掉多少专家——路由越分散（熵越高）的层剪得越多，在Mixtral、Qwen3、DeepSeek上优于均匀分配。
AI.motivation: MoE架构虽能高效扩展模型容量，但内存占用大，难以部署。现有专家剪枝方法多关注"剪哪些专家"，却对每层采用相同剪枝比例，忽略了层间路由行为的差异。
AI.method: SPARE基于校准数据上token归一化Top-K门控权重的路由熵来分配各层剪枝数量：当门控权重分布均匀时，移除一个激活专家损失的信息较少，因此熵更高（路由更分散）的层被更激进地剪枝。作者还给出随机剪枝下的扰动上界以形式化该直觉，并通过固定选择器的干预实验验证：路由越集中，输出变化越大。
AI.result: 在相同选择器与剪枝预算下，SPARE的平均准确率优于均匀分配，高剪枝率时尤为明显。50%专家剪枝时，Qwen3-30B-A3B八任务平均从57.2%提升至63.8%；DeepSeek-R1的数理代码科学平均从80.1提升至82.8。
AI.conclusion: 层级剪枝预算应依据路由熵而非均匀分配，SPARE以零训练成本、选择器无关的方式带来稳定增益，可作为现有专家剪枝流程的即插即用增强模块。

title: Looking Ahead: Modeling Future Evolution in Autoregressive Video Generation
summary: Autoregressive video diffusion models generate videos chunk by chunk, yet producing plausible continuations does not guarantee that they capture how scenes evolve. Under teacher forcing, strong temporal redundancy may allow local visual continuity to serve as a shortcut for current-chunk denoising, reducing the pressure to model visual evolution. We introduce Future Chunk Prediction (FCP), an auxiliary objective jointly optimized with teacher-forced denoising that predicts temporally separated chunks without access to the intervening visual context. Drawing supervision directly from training videos, FCP requires no additional pretrained visual encoder and leaves autoregressive inference unchanged. Our method achieves superior physical plausibility over standard teacher-forced autoregressive training with a lower overall training compute budget, highlighting the effectiveness and efficiency of future-chunk supervision for modeling visual evolution. Intriguingly, our visualizations suggest that FCP fosters a more structured representation space, which may be valuable for building autoregressive world models.

AI.tldr: 提出Future Chunk Prediction (FCP)辅助目标，与teacher forcing去噪联合训练，无需额外视觉编码器、不改变自回归推理，以更低训练算力获得更好的物理合理性。
AI.motivation: 自回归视频扩散模型逐块生成视频，teacher forcing下强时间冗余使局部视觉连续性成为当前块去噪的"捷径"，削弱了模型对场景演化（visual evolution）的建模压力。
AI.method: FCP作为与teacher-forced去噪联合优化的辅助目标，在无中间视觉上下文的情况下预测时间上相隔的future chunk；监督信号直接来自训练视频，无需额外预训练视觉编码器，且推理流程保持不变。
AI.result: 相比标准teacher-forced自回归训练，在更低的总训练算力预算下取得更优的物理合理性；可视化显示FCP形成更结构化的表示空间。
AI.conclusion: future-chunk监督对建模视觉演化有效且高效，更结构化的表示空间或有助于构建自回归世界模型。

title: Leveraging Time-Series Foundation Models for Financial Crime Detection
comment: 9 pages, 5 figures, 5 tables. Accepted at the ACM International Conference on AI in Finance (ICAIF '26), Milan, Italy
summary: Financial crime detection requires identifying illicit activity within large transaction networks, where suspicious behaviour is rare and unfolds over time. Existing graph-based methods capture relationships among accounts but typically underuse the temporal behaviour encoded in account transaction histories. We introduce Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment (TCEE), a framework that addresses this gap by summarising each account's transaction history with a frozen time-series foundation model (TSFM), and enriching each transaction's representation with the relevant temporal context from these summaries. These enriched representations can be scored directly for edge classification, or fed into a graph neural network (GNN) as edge features to capture broader structural information. Across six AMLWorld datasets, TCEE improves PR-AUC over the strongest evaluated baseline on five by a relative 10.8% on average, while training 6.0x faster end-to-end. Feeding TCEE's representations into a GNN raises PR-AUC a further 4.8% on the four smaller datasets. On an Ethereum phishing dataset, we show that TSFM-generated account representations fed into a GNN are also effective for node classification, improving PR-AUC by 14.5% over the strongest baseline. As TSFMs continue to advance, our results suggest they can strengthen financial crime detection by capturing temporal signals that complement graph-based approaches.

AI.tldr: 提出TCEE框架，用冻结的时序基础模型（TSFM）汇总账户交易历史，为每笔交易边注入时序上下文，可直接做边分类或作为GNN边特征，在金融犯罪检测上兼顾效果与效率。
AI.motivation: 金融犯罪检测需在大型交易网络中识别稀有且随时间演化的可疑行为。现有图方法虽能刻画账户间关系，但普遍低估了账户交易历史中编码的时序行为信息。
AI.method: TCEE（Temporal-Context Edge Enrichment）：用冻结的时序基础模型对每个账户的交易历史做摘要表示；再将相关时序上下文注入每笔交易（边）的表示中。所得富化表示既可端到端直接用于边分类打分，也可作为边特征输入GNN以捕获更广的结构信息。
AI.result: 在六个AMLWorld数据集上，TCEE在其中五个上相对最强基线平均提升PR-AUC 10.8%，端到端训练快6.0倍；将TCEE表示输入GNN后，在四个较小数据集上PR-AUC再提升4.8%。在以太坊钓鱼数据集上，TSFM生成的账户表示输入GNN用于节点分类，PR-AUC较最强基线提升14.5%。
AI.conclusion: 时序基础模型能捕捉与图方法互补的时序信号，可强化金融犯罪检测；随着TSFM持续进步，该方向潜力将进一步提升。

title: Multiclass Boundary Refinement with Neural Cellular Automata for Remote Sensing Land Cover Segmentation
summary: Semantic segmentation of remote sensing imagery often places class boundaries a few pixels away from where they truly lie, and this position error is concentrated in the thin band measured by Boundary IoU (BIoU). We treat boundary refinement as the iterated application of a small learned local rule: the Boundary Refinement Neural Cellular Automaton (BRNCA), that starts from the class probabilities of a frozen, pre-trained segmenter and corrects them cell by cell. We generalise the binary rNCA to the multiclass case by keeping the visible channels on the probability simplex through an Aitchison (log-space) update and by adding free hidden channels. The best configuration improves the mean BIoU over the base segmenter by 2.36 points (from 46.63 to 48.99). The gain is concentrated on the irregular woodland class (+8.5 points BIoU); this suggests that position error is correlated with the fractal dimension of the class boundaries.

AI.tldr: 提出BRNCA，将边界细化视为小型可学习局部规则的迭代应用，在多类概率单纯形上做Aitchison更新以提高遥感分割的Boundary IoU。
AI.motivation: 遥感影像语义分割的类别边界常偏移几个像素，误差集中在Boundary IoU所度量的窄带内；现有分割器缺乏专门的边界位置修正机制。
AI.method: 在冻结的预训练分割器输出的类别概率基础上，以神经细胞自动机（BRNCA）逐格修正；将二值rNCA推广到多类：通过Aitchison（对数空间）更新使可见通道保持在概率单纯形上，并引入自由隐藏通道。
AI.result: 最佳配置将平均BIoU相比基础分割器提升2.36点（46.63→48.99）；增益集中于不规则林地类（+8.5点BIoU）。
AI.conclusion: 边界位置误差与类别边界的分形维数相关，BRNCA作为轻量后处理可有效细化遥感分割边界。

title: Characterizing Oblivious Common-Reward Multi-Player Bandits: Universal Stationarity, Coordination Traps, and Certified Global Rates
comment: 20 pages, including 11 pages of supplementary material
summary: This paper presents a theoretical analysis of the oblivious common-reward multi-player multi-armed bandit (OC-MPMAB), a minimal multi-player bandit model in which multiple players select arms simultaneously and observe only a shared reward. Crucially, the players are fully oblivious: they do not observe the actions of other players and do not even know whether any other players exist. The contributions of this work are threefold. First, we prove that the independent gradient-bandit updates applied by the players jointly form an unbiased stochastic gradient estimator of a hidden product-policy objective. This property then yields a universal finite-time first-order stationarity guarantee for every instance. Second, we show that stationarity cannot, in general, be strengthened to global optimality. To illustrate this, we identify a product-policy trap obstruction that rules out the guarantee of global optimality. Third, we show that global optimality can be recovered under structural assumptions on the reward table. To make global optimality achievable, we introduce finite-table certificates that separately characterize product-gradient dominance and self-bounding stochastic noise. We then establish certificate-conditioned bounds on the product-policy gap and pseudo-regret. Consequently, the standard $O(1/t)$ product-policy gap and $O(\log T)$ pseudo-regret rates hold when the certificates are uniform.

AI.tldr: 本文对" oblivious 共同奖励多玩家多臂老虎机 (OC-MPMAB)" 进行理论分析：证明独立梯度-bandit 更新构成隐乘积策略目标的无偏随机梯度，给出通用有限时间一阶平稳性保证；同时证明平稳性一般不能升级为全局最优（存在乘积策略陷阱），并在奖励表结构假设下通过"有限表证书"恢复全局最优与 O(1/t)、O(log T) 速率。
AI.motivation: 针对最简多玩家 bandit 设定——玩家同时选臂、只观测共享奖励、且完全 oblivious（看不到他人动作、甚至不知道他人是否存在），现有理论缺乏对该极端信息受限情形的收敛性与最优性刻画，作者希望厘清在此设定下可达到什么样的理论保证。
AI.method: 将玩家的独立 gradient-bandit 更新视为对某个隐藏乘积策略目标的联合无偏随机梯度估计器；用该性质推出通用有限时间一阶平稳性界；构造"乘积策略陷阱"反例说明全局最优不可保证；再引入有限表证书，分别刻画乘积梯度占优与自界随机噪声，据此给出证书条件下的乘积策略 gap 与伪遗憾界。
AI.result: 得到对任意实例成立的一阶平稳性有限时间保证；证明一般情况下平稳性无法加强为全局最优（乘积策略陷阱障碍）；在证书成立时给出乘积策略 gap 与伪遗憾的证书条件界，当证书一致时恢复标准 O(1/t) gap 与 O(log T) 伪遗憾速率。
AI.conclusion: 在完全 oblivious 的多玩家共同奖励 bandit 中，仅靠独立梯度更新只能普遍保证一阶平稳性；全局最优需依赖奖励表的结构性条件（有限表证书），此时可恢复标准收敛与遗憾速率。该工作为理解多玩家 bandit 中可保证性的边界提供了理论框架。

title: ClunoGS: Compact Language 3D Gaussian Splatting via Unified Optimization
summary: Language 3D Gaussian Splatting enables open-vocabulary scene understanding by associating Gaussian primitives with language features. These semantic attributes increase model storage, while most existing 3DGS compression methods are designed mainly to preserve RGB rendering quality. One straightforward approach is to apply sparsification and quantization sequentially. However, pruning based only on rendering quality can remove Gaussians that have small RGB contributions but are important for semantic prediction. Once removed, their semantic information cannot be recovered by later quantization. We propose ClunoGS, a compact framework for Language 3DGS that combines semantics-aware Gaussian sparsification and vector quantization in a unified constrained objective. Semantic supervision is used during sparsification, and the objective jointly considers rendering quality, semantic accuracy, and compactness. We optimize the unified objective with alternating primal, sparsification, quantization, and dual updates. We evaluate ClunoGS on open-vocabulary localization and segmentation using the LERF and ScanNet-10 benchmarks. Under aggressive compression, our unified, semantics-aware formulation substantially alleviates the degradation of semantic representations caused by sequential compression and semantics-agnostic Gaussian sparsification. Ablations further show that jointly coordinating sparsification and quantization better preserves semantic accuracy than applying them independently.

AI.tldr: 提出 ClunoGS，一个面向语言 3D Gaussian Splatting 的紧凑压缩框架，用统一约束目标联合优化语义感知的稀疏化与向量量化，在激进压缩下显著减缓语义表征退化。
AI.motivation: 语言 3DGS 通过为高斯原语关联语言特征实现开放词汇场景理解，但也大幅增加存储；而现有 3DGS 压缩方法主要以保持 RGB 渲染质量为目标。若把稀疏化和量化简单串联、仅按渲染质量剪枝，会误删对 RGB 贡献小但对语义预测关键的高斯，且被删的语义信息无法在后续量化中恢复。
AI.method: 将语义监督引入稀疏化，并把渲染质量、语义准确率与紧凑度纳入一个统一的约束目标；采用交替优化，依次进行原始变量更新、稀疏化、量化和对偶变量更新。
AI.result: 在 LERF 与 ScanNet-10 的开放词汇定位与分割任务上，激进压缩下该统一语义感知方案明显缓解了顺序压缩与语义无关剪枝带来的语义表征退化；消融实验表明联合协调稀疏化与量化比独立执行更能保持语义准确率。
AI.conclusion: 语义感知与稀疏化—量化的联合建模是保持语言 3DGS 语义能力的高效压缩路径，优于传统“先剪枝再量化”的串行流程。

title: DriveMLP: When Training Strategy Outperforms Model Complexity in Autonomous Driving
comment: Accepted at 2026 Conference on Robot Learning (CoRL)
summary: Learning motion planning policies that remain reliable under closed-loop execution is a central challenge in Autonomous Driving (AD). Imitation Learning (IL) scales well to large AD datasets but suffers from distribution shift, causal confusion, and compounding errors under closed-loop execution. In contrast, Reinforcement Learning (RL) typically requires handcrafted rule-based rewards and massive simulation. We study a simple closed-loop IL framework that uses RL purely as an optimization tool, guided by a trajectory-distance reward derived from logged expert data. We refer to this training strategy as Expert-Guided RL (EGRL). Through a controlled empirical study we find evidence that the training procedure, rather than model size and complexity, accounts for a substantial part of the performance gains. We then introduce DriveMLP, a lightweight MLP policy trained with EGRL, as a simple instantiation of these findings. It achieves a score of 86.51 on the nuPlan Val14 Reactive benchmark, a +3.2 point improvement over the previous best IL planner (Flow Planner), with >15x faster inference. Code is available at: https://github.com/alessandro-canevaro/DriveMLP .

AI.tldr: 提出Expert-Guided RL (EGRL)——将RL仅作为优化工具、以专家轨迹距离为奖励的闭环模仿学习框架，并据此设计轻量级MLP策略DriveMLP，在nuPlan Val14 Reactive上取得86.51分，比此前最佳IL规划器提升3.2分且推理快15倍以上。
AI.motivation: 自动驾驶中闭环可靠的运动规划策略难以学习：模仿学习(IL)易受分布偏移、因果混淆与累积误差影响；强化学习(RL)则依赖手工规则奖励与大规模仿真。作者希望找到一种兼顾两者优点、简单且高效的训练范式。
AI.method: 提出EGRL训练策略：在简单闭环IL框架中，将RL纯粹当作优化工具，奖励定义为与记录的专家数据之间的轨迹距离，无需手工规则奖励。通过受控实证研究验证"训练过程而非模型规模/复杂度"是性能提升的主要来源，再以轻量级MLP策略DriveMLP作为该结论的简单实例。
AI.result: DriveMLP在nuPlan Val14 Reactive基准上得分86.51，较此前最佳IL规划器(Flow Planner)提升3.2分，推理速度提升超过15倍；实验表明训练流程对性能贡献显著大于模型规模与复杂度。
AI.conclusion: 表明高质量的闭环训练策略比模型规模更关键，轻量MLP配合EGRL即可超越更大更复杂的IL规划器，为自动驾驶规划提供简单、高效且可复现的方案(代码已开源)。

title: RealMe: Immersive Volumetric Video from Minimal Captures
comment: 19 pages, 11 figures, including supplementary material. To appear in SIGGRAPH Asia 2026 Conference Papers. Project page: https://zju3dv.github.io/realme
summary: This paper addresses the problem of creating immersive volumetric videos from sparse and low-resolution capture resources. Conventional dense multi-view reconstruction methods can produce high-quality volumetric videos, but their reliance on costly capture setups makes them impractical in real-world scenarios. Recent approaches use generative models to relax capture requirements, but still suffer from limited resolution and 4D inconsistency. To overcome these constraints, we propose RealMe, a unified framework built around a high-resolution video diffusion model that enhances limited captures into high-resolution (2K), 4D-consistent videos for volumetric video reconstruction. Specifically, RealMe constructs auxiliary data from capture videos and encodes them into latents along with layout-aware positional embeddings. The video diffusion model adapts factorized spatio-temporal attention to the multi-view capture layout, denoises these latents across viewpoints and time, and decodes them into enhanced videos to refine the 4D representation. This adaptation helps the model capture temporal dynamics and multi-view relationships, leading to more 4D-consistent generation. To reduce the data gap between generated videos and real captures, we apply a latent frequency loss that provides frequency-domain supervision in latent space. Extensive experiments on the public DNA-Rendering benchmark and our self-captured RealVV dataset demonstrate that RealMe is able to create immersive volumetric videos and outperforms state-of-the-art methods in visual fidelity and 4D consistency.

AI.tldr: 提出RealMe统一框架，基于高分辨率视频扩散模型将稀疏低分辨多视角捕获增强为2K、4D一致视频，用于体积视频重建。
AI.motivation: 稠密多视角重建质量高但采集成本高、不实用；现有生成式放松采集要求的方法仍受限于分辨率低和4D不一致。
AI.method: 从捕获视频构建辅助数据并编码为latent，配合布局感知位置编码；视频扩散模型采用适配多视角布局的分解时空注意力，跨视角与时间去噪并解码为增强视频以细化4D表示；引入潜空间频率损失缩小生成视频与真实捕获的数据差距。
AI.result: 在DNA-Rendering基准和自采RealVV数据集上，RealMe可生成沉浸式体积视频，在视觉保真度和4D一致性上优于SOTA。
AI.conclusion: RealMe验证了高分辨率视频扩散模型在稀疏低分辨输入下实现高质量、4D一致体积视频重建的有效性。

title: Structure-Aware Message Passing on Petri Nets through Directed Walks and Incidence Diffusion
summary: A common application of the process mining discipline is to connect observed event data with Petri nets, which are bipartite, directed graphical process models with rich formal underpinnings. Recent work learns vector representations of Petri nets to retrieve process models and relate them to event logs, but leaves implicit two key aspects hidden within the net's structure: directed cycles (process loops) and invariants recorded by the net's incidence matrix. We expose both of these to message-passing graph neural networks, through a positional encoding built from return probabilities of directed place-transition walks (PNRWPE), and through same-type messages gated by diffusion kernels of the incidence matrix (DA-PNGNN). Our constructions raise macro balanced accuracy in predicting the generation factors of the 96 Process Discovery Contest 2023 models from 0.751 to 0.796 with PNRWPE, which nearly doubles accuracy on process loops, and to 0.830 with DA-PNGNN, which, without retuning, also improves net-to-tree retrieval top-1 accuracy on the self-supervised ProcRosetta benchmark by 4.1 to 5.9 points.

AI.tldr: 提出 PNRWPE 位置编码与 DA-PNGNN 门控消息机制，将 Petri 网中有向环与关联矩阵不变量显式注入图神经网络，提升生成因子预测与网到树检索性能。
AI.motivation: 现有 Petri 网向量表示学习隐含忽略了网结构中两个关键方面：有向环（流程循环）与关联矩阵记录的守恒关系（不变量），限制了模型表达能力。
AI.method: 1) PNRWPE：基于有向 place-transition 游走返回概率构造位置编码，暴露有向环信息；2) DA-PNGNN：用关联矩阵的扩散核门控同类型消息传递，注入不变量信息；均集成到消息传递图神经网络。
AI.result: 在 96 个 Process Discovery Contest 2023 模型生成因子预测上，宏平衡准确率由 0.751 提升至 0.796（PNRWPE，流程循环准确率近翻倍）；加入 DA-PNGNN 达 0.830，并在 ProcRosetta 自监督基准上网到树检索 top-1 无需调参即提升 4.1–5.9 点。
AI.conclusion: 显式编码有向环与关联矩阵不变量可有效增强 Petri 网的 GNN 表示，兼具跨任务泛化性。

title: Plausible but Unimplantable: A Trustworthiness Audit of Shape Completion Foundation Models for Cranial Defect Reconstruction
summary: A patient who has lost part of the skull vault needs an implant that fits the defect exactly, and such implants are still drawn by hand in CAD by specialists, which makes each case slow and expensive. The task can be considered as a shape completion problem, so pretrained completion models, and now the first shape completion foundation models, look like a way to remove that manual step. We audited three publicly released pretrained shape completion models, two of them foundation models, applied zero-shot to 239 cranial defects, some carved from public skull datasets and some real post-craniectomy cases. Each output was compared with simply returning the patient's own remaining bone, and tested for whether the predicted material could be placed without intersecting the bone that is still there. On the 210 carved defects none of the three improved on doing nothing, and on the 29 real cases only one did so beyond chance. Yet not one output, from any model in any configuration, was implantable: none managed both to stay clear of the bone the patient still has and to place more material than doing nothing, where a task-specific volumetric model, trained for this task and selected on these cases, was implantable on all but one. The output that most convincingly resembles a skull is no more placeable than the rest, and at these point densities implant thickness cannot be read off the emitted points at all, which is a property of the output representation rather than of any one model. On this evidence the shape completion foundation models we could obtain cannot be trusted and, used as released, are not usable in clinical practice. Substantial research towards trustworthy foundation models for shape completion is still needed.

AI.tldr: 对三个公开预训练形状补全模型（其中两个是基础模型）在239例颅骨缺损上零样本测试，无一输出可植入；基础模型在临床上不可用。
AI.motivation: 颅骨缺损植入物目前由专家在CAD中手工绘制，耗时且昂贵。形状补全（尤其新出现的基础模型）看似可替代人工步骤，但缺乏其在临床关键指标上的可信度评估。
AI.method: 审计三个公开预训练形状补全模型（两个为基础模型），零样本应用于239例颅骨缺损（210例由公开颅骨数据集雕刻、29例真实去骨瓣术后病例）。将每个输出与"直接返回患者剩余骨"的基线比较，并检验预测材料是否能在不与残留骨相交的前提下放置（可植入性）。
AI.result: 210例雕刻缺损上三个模型均未超越"什么都不做"的基线；29例真实病例中仅一个模型在超越随机水平之外有所改善。没有任何模型任何配置的输出可植入（既避让残留骨又放置更多材料）；而针对该任务训练并在这些病例上选型的专用体积模型除一例外均可植入。外观最像颅骨的输出可放置性并不更好；当前点密度下无法从输出点云读出植入厚度，这是输出表示层面的问题。
AI.conclusion: 现有可获取的形状补全基础模型不可信，按原样发布不可用于临床；仍需大量面向可信形状补全基础模型的研究。

title: Monitorability Is Trainable: Post-Training for Chain-of-Thought Monitorability
comment: The first two authors contributed equally
summary: Chain-of-thought (CoT) monitoring is one of the few practical tools available for overseeing capable AI systems, but it is fragile: a model's reasoning is only useful to a monitor if it remains coupled to what the model actually does. This coupling can be degraded during training through, for example, CoT compression, optimization against a monitor, and out-of-context generalization from synthetic documents. In this work, we propose an unsupervised post-training objective based on maximizing mutual information between CoT and the output for improving CoT monitorability. Across three model organisms with degraded CoT, it recovers most or all of the lost monitorability. Applied to undegraded policies, it further improves judged monitorability, improves prediction of unsafe behavior by CoT monitors and activation probes, and increases the prevalence of consequential reasoning. These results suggest that monitorability should be treated as a trainable attribute of the policy. A dedicated monitorability post-training stage can extend current practices that protect CoT from direct optimization pressure.

AI.tldr: 本文提出一种基于最大化思维链(CoT)与输出之间互信息的无监督后训练目标，用以提升CoT可监控性(monitorability)。在三个CoT退化的模型上恢复大部分乃至全部损失的可监控性；对未退化策略也能提升可监控性、不安全行为预测能力及关键推理的比例，主张把可监控性视为可训练的策略属性。
AI.motivation: CoT监控是监督强AI系统的少数实用手段之一，但其脆弱：只有当推理与实际行为保持耦合时监控才有效。CoT压缩、针对监控器的优化、合成文档带来的分布外泛化等训练过程会削弱这种耦合，而现有做法只是被动保护CoT免受直接优化压力。
AI.method: 提出无监督后训练目标：最大化CoT与输出之间的互信息，作为独立的“可监控性后训练阶段”；在三个CoT已退化的模型organism上验证，并应用于未退化策略，考察评判式可监控性、CoT监控器与激活探针的不安全行为预测、关键推理出现频率。
AI.result: 对三个退化模型恢复大部分或全部可监控性；对未退化策略进一步提升评判可监控性，改善CoT监控器和激活探针对不安全行为的预测，并增加关键推理的普遍程度。
AI.conclusion: 可监控性应被视为策略的可训练属性；专门的可监控性后训练阶段能扩展当前保护CoT免受直接优化压力的实践。

title: Attn-Forcing: Learning Full-Context Attention Proxies for Streaming Video Generation
summary: Increasing the attention context length significantly improves streaming video generation quality, while incurring prohibitive memory and computational costs as the context grows. Existing methods attempt to capture this contextual information through attention selection or compression, but remain limited by bounded representations and lack explicit attention-level supervision to retain historical contributions to current queries. To address this, we introduce Attn-Forcing, a novel framework that preserves full-context attention contributions for streaming video generation under bounded memory and computation. We achieve this by introducing attention proxies that continuously approximate the attention responses induced by the historical context. Specifically, we implement the proxies as learnable visual latents and employ a Proxy Update Module to incorporate visual context from historical latents. Moreover, we propose an Attention Matching Loss to explicitly constrain the attention behavior of the learned proxies using full-context attention supervision. Extensive qualitative and quantitative experiments demonstrate that Attn-Forcing consistently improves streaming video generation quality and achieves state-of-the-art performance over existing baseline methods.

AI.tldr: Attn-Forcing 用可学习的"注意力代理"在有限显存下近似完整历史上下文的注意力贡献，实现高质量流式视频生成。
AI.motivation: 增大注意力上下文长度能显著提升流式视频生成质量，但内存与算力开销随上下文增长而不可承受。现有基于注意力选择或压缩的方法受限于有界表示，且缺乏显式的注意力级别监督来保留历史对当前查询的贡献。
AI.method: 提出 Attn-Forcing 框架：引入注意力代理持续近似历史上下文引起的注意力响应，代理以可学习视觉潜变量实现；设计 Proxy Update Module 将历史潜变量中的视觉上下文注入代理；并提出 Attention Matching Loss，用全上下文注意力作为监督来显式约束代理的注意力行为。
AI.result: 大量定性与定量实验表明，Attn-Forcing 一致地提升流式视频生成质量，并在现有基线方法上取得最先进性能。
AI.conclusion: 通过显式的注意力级监督与轻量代理表示，可在有界内存与计算下保留全上下文注意力贡献，为长上下文流式视频生成提供有效方案。

title: Asymmetric Likelihood-Free Hypothesis Testing
summary:
In likelihood-free hypothesis testing (LFHT), given samples from two unknown distributions $P,Q$ on $[n]$ with $\mathrm{d_{TV}}(P,Q)\geq\varepsilon$, and from a third distribution $D\in\{P,Q\}$, the goal is to identify whether $D=P$ or $D=Q$. We study asymmetric likelihood-free hypothesis testing, where the sample budgets $s_P$ and $s_Q$ for $P$ and $Q$ may differ, and characterize the feasible triples $(s_P,s_Q,s_D)$ up to logarithmic factors. We establish that unequal reference budgets can give a polynomial saving. For instance, for constant separation, $n$ samples from $P$ and $n^{3/4}$ from $Q$ allow testing with $\widetilde O(n^{1/4})$ samples from $D$, whereas both existing baselines---symmetric LFHT and unequal-sample closeness testing---require $Ω(\sqrt n)$ samples from $D$.
  We further apply our results to non-adaptive distribution 2-clustering, where the sample allocation among $k$ distributions must be fixed before observing any data. We obtain matching upper and lower bounds for this problem up to logarithmic factors in terms of the domain size, number of distributions, smaller cluster size, and separation, both with one cluster distribution known and with both unknown. Comparing with known bounds for adaptive sample allocation gives a worst-case adaptivity gap of $\widetildeΘ(k^{1/4})$.

AI.tldr: 研究非对称无似然假设检验，刻画了可行样本三元组 (s_P,s_Q,s_D) 并证明参考分布预算不均衡可带来多项式级节省，进而用于非自适应分布2聚类并给出匹配界与自适应间隙 Θ̃(k^{1/4})。
AI.motivation: 经典无似然假设检验默认从 P、Q 抽取的参考样本量相同，但实际中参考分布采样成本可能差异很大。作者希望刻画不对称参考预算下的可行性，并填补非自适应样本分配情形（必须预先决定采样量）中的理论空白。
AI.method: 对非对称无似然假设检验，刻画可行三元组 (s_P,s_Q,s_D) 的上下界（忽略对数因子），并给出相应检验算法与信息论下界；再将结论用于非自适应分布 2-聚类，针对一个簇已知与两个簇均未知两种设定推导匹配的上下界。
AI.result: 证明不均衡参考预算可带来多项式级节省：如常数分离下，取 n 个 P 样本与 n^{3/4} 个 Q 样本，仅需 Õ(n^{1/4}) 个 D 样本即可检验，而对称 LFHT 与不等样本 closeness testing 的已有基线均需 Ω(√n)。非自适应 2-聚类方面得到关于域大小、分布数、较小簇大小与分离度的匹配上下界，并给出最坏情况自适应间隙 Θ̃(k^{1/4})。
AI.conclusion: 论文建立了非对称 LFHT 的完整样本复杂度刻画，揭示了非对称预算的显著收益，并为非自适应 2-聚类提供紧确界、量化了自适应与非自适应采样之间的差距。

title: ProactEgoMem: Benchmarking Proactive Memory in Streaming Egocentric Video
summary: Today's multimodal assistants are typically prompted to interpret the visual evidence presented to them. To offload the cognitive burden of remembering across long horizons, wearable assistants should instead proactively acquire and maintain useful memory as the user's surroundings evolve. Doing so on the user's behalf requires identifying what matters, understanding the scene in real time, and initiating memory maintenance in the background while the user stays focused on their activities. We introduce ProactEgoMem, a benchmark that evaluates proactive memory in streaming egocentric video. Three tasks ground the evaluation in ambient environmental needs: Information Capture (IC) preserves transient yet dense visual information, State Tracking (ST) follows changing object states, and Location Tracking (LT) records object movements. The benchmark defines its protocol at two levels of proactiveness: the Notification Level asks for a single timely notification that satisfies the user's intent, while the deeper Intervention Level asks the agent to maintain memory on the user's behalf through an active start-to-stop tool lifecycle. Parallel ProactEgoMem-Daily and ProactEgoMem-Sci tracks contain 300/100 clips covering daily and scientific use cases, paired with 1000/500 questions in ProactEgoMem-QA, which measures the quality of the proactively acquired memory. Across proprietary, open-source, video-language, and streaming baselines, even the strongest models fail to capture memory both timely and accurately. ProactEgoMem provides a rigorous evaluation foundation for proactive multimodal assistance and for video agents that co-exist with their users.

AI.tldr: 本文提出 ProactEgoMem，一个评估流式第一人称视频中"主动记忆"能力的基准，包含信息捕获(IC)、状态跟踪(ST)、位置跟踪(LT)三类任务，并在"通知级"与"干预级"两个主动性层次上评测，配套 Daily/Sci 两条轨道与 ProactEgoMem-QA 记忆质量测试。
AI.motivation: 当前多模态助手多是被动响应提示来解读视觉信息；而可穿戴助手需在用户专注自身活动时，主动识别重要信息、实时理解场景并在后台自主维护记忆，以缓解长时段记忆负担。现有基准缺乏对这种主动记忆能力的评测。
AI.method: 构建流式自中心视频基准 ProactEgoMem：设定 IC（保留短暂但密集的视觉信息）、ST（跟踪物体状态变化）、LT（记录物体移动）三类任务；定义两层主动性协议——Notification Level（给出一次及时通知满足用户意图）与 Intervention Level（通过 start-to-stop 工具生命周期在后台自主维护记忆）；含 Daily/Sci 两轨共 300/100 段视频，配 1000/500 道 QA 衡量主动获取记忆的质量。
AI.result: 在专有模型、开源模型、视频-语言模型与流式基线上评测，即使最强的模型也无法同时做到及时且准确地捕获记忆。
AI.conclusion: ProactEgoMem 为主动式多模态辅助以及能与用户共处的视频智能体提供了严谨的评测基础。

title: A Sharp Dynamic Haussler Lemma
summary:
Haussler's covering lemma (JCTA 1995) gives the sharp $(C/δ)^d$ metric-entropy bound for binary VC classes under normalized $\ell_1$ distance. We prove a sharp global dynamic analogue for bounded real-valued classes in normalized $\ell_p$, for every $1\le p<\infty$. Writing $d=\operatorname{sfat}_{\varepsilon/32}(\mathcal F)$, we obtain a global dynamic cover of size at most $(C/\varepsilon^p)^d$ for every horizon and $0<\varepsilon<1/2$. Here a single family of deterministic causal experts, fixed independently of the instance sequence, covers every target on every sequence.
